chapters.title: Chapter 4251: Helper
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Baili Yun’s expression changed drastically.
F***, he had dug a hole and buried himself in it.

The reason why he had sealed off this place with Regulations was naturally to prevent Ling Han from fleeing with the Star Steps. Thus, he had deliberately strengthened it layer after layer, but now? The one who wanted to flee was him.
The Regulations did not distinguish between people, and treated them all the same.
Thus, if he wanted to leave this area, he had to break through the Regulations seal first.
Wasn’t this just digging one’s own grave?

He gave a loud shout, and charged towards Ling Han again. The Imperial Technique channelled, and Regulations transformed into multiple divine lotuses that descended towards Ling Han. Then, they suddenly exploded. Golden energy surged, possessing boundless destructive power.
However, this was completely useless against Ling Han.

He could disperse attacks within six Heavens. Unless Baili Yun’s battle prowess surpassed Ling Han’s by seven Heavens, Baili Yun wouldn’t be able to wound him at all as long as he didn’t stand there and take a beating without fighting back.
After a few moves, Baili Yun also understood this deeply. Thus, after he sent Ling Han flying with a single strike, he immediately began to bombard the Regulations barricade that he had set up.
The Imperial Blood would only be burning for a limited amount of time. Once it was completely burnt, and he was still trapped here, the odds would really be against him.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

He tried his best, but he had put a lot of effort into setting up this Regulationsseal, so how could it be broken through in a few moves? Moreover, Ling Han had only been sent backwards, and had not been injured. He immediately made a comeback.

Baili Yun felt a headache coming on. Ling Han’s attacks couldn’t be underestimated at all. More importantly, this guy seemed to be forged from metal, and his attacks were completely ineffective against him. What kind of despair was this?
However, under the continuous barrage of attacks, the Regulations seal became weaker and weaker. Finally, it was broken.
Baili Yun rushed out. He really did not have much Imperial Blood left. He had to find help as soon as possible.
Ling Han set off in pursuit.

This was really a turn of events. Baili Yun thought back to how he had hunted Ling Han for so far, but now, he had become a stray dog that was sent fleeing in defeat. He couldn’t help but feel bitter.
He had to admit that Ling Han’s natural talent in cultivation was really catching up to the Golden Generation. In fact, he could be considered one of the strongest even among the Golden Generation.
Xiu, his figure traversed, his speed incredibly fast.

Movement techniques were now Ling Han’s weakness. He had only grasped a Saint-level movement technique, so he was naturally no match for Baili Yun. However, don’t forget that he was also a Formation Master, and a grandmaster at that!
Boom, an Earth Dragon soared up, and intercepted Baili Yun.
“Damn it!” Baili Yun cursed softly, yet he had no choice but to move, launching an attack at the Earth Dragon.

Thankfully, his present battle prowess had reached 45 Heavens. With a single strike, the Earth Dragon crumbled, and was only able to slow him down for a while, and in such a short amount of time, with the difference in speed between him and Ling Han, it was impossible for the latter to catch up.
But because of this, he was also unable to completely throw Ling Han off his tail. The two of them continued to maintain a similar distance, one in front and one behind.
“Brother Baili?”
Xiu, Baili Yun was flying, when a voice suddenly rang out in his mind. He immediately looked pleasantly surprised. This was the Imperial Son of the Shi Clan.
Of course, it was not Shi Yuanzhen, but rather Shi Hao, who was also a member of the Silver Generation.
“Brother Shi, help me!” He hurriedly turned around.
“Haha, could it be that it’s a member of the Golden Generation that weakened their own cultivation level and chased Brother Baili to such a sorry state?” Shi Hao laughed loudly.

Of course, this was a joke. Although there was competition among the Imperial Clans, no one would force the other to death. After all, everyone had Saints in their ranks and an Imperial Weapon. Once they went all out in battle, both sides would only suffer heavy losses.
Baili Yun felt slightly embarrassed, because not only was an Imperial Son not the one who had chased him into a sorry state, even his cultivation level was lower than his.
How could he bring himself to say this?
But it was only an instant, and Ling Han’s figure had already appeared.
Shi Hao’s eyes focused, “Ling Han!”
He had naturally guessed that Ling Han was hunting Baili Yun down, but it was precisely because of this that he couldn’t understand.
How was this possible?
Though Ling Han was extraordinary, and the height of his aptitude could even be considered on par with the Golden Generation, his overall cultivation level was too low, after all.

—In a battle of equal cultivation levels, it was possible that the Silver Generation was indeed no match for him, but with how strong an Imperial Son was, as long as he had the advantage of a minor level of cultivation level, it was guaranteed that he would be able to crush his opponent. This was the experience gained after comparison with the Golden Generation.
“Brother Shi, Shi Yuanzhen of your clan has already been killed by this brat,” Baili Yun said calmly. With two Silver Generation elites joining forces, Ling Han naturally had nothing to fear.
Hearing these words, Shi Hao’s expression immediately darkened.

Although they were all members of the same clan, they were all Imperial Sons, so there was naturally a problem of the distribution of cultivation resources. The relationship between Shi Hao and Shi Yuanzhen definitely could not be considered close.
However, now that Shi Yuanzhen had been killed by an outsider, that would be a humiliation to the entire Shi Clan.
If he didn’t kill Ling Han, he would also be embarrassed, and would be mocked outside.
“You killed Shi Yuanzhen?” he asked balefully.
“That’s right.” Ling Han didn’t plan on hiding it. He wanted to let the Imperial Clans know that it wouldn’t be so easy to bully him!
He dared to kill an Imperial Son now, and in future, he would dare to kill Venerate Tiers and Saints of the Imperial Clans!
“All right!” Shi Hao did not speak any more nonsense. Instead, he looked towards Baili Yun, “Let’s destroy this brat together.”
Baili Yun nodded, his killing intent blazing.

Although Shi Hao had never fought with Ling Han before, he was extremely familiar with Baili Yun’s strength. He knew that Ling Han’s strength was definitely terrifying, since he could make him flee in panic.

“This boy’s battle prowess is only at 42 Heavens, but his physique is very amazing. Even if I combust Imperial Blood, I would not be able to break through his defenses,” Baili Yun said. Since they were in the same trench, Baili Yun was naturally willing to share information with Shi Hao.
Shi Hao couldn’t help but raise a brow, “Do Body Arts really have such a great advantage?”
He thought that this was the defense brought about by Ling Han’s Body Arts.
“Don’t be careless,” Baili Yun reminded.
The two of them stood on either side of each other, both staring at Ling Han.
Two Imperial Sons, and they were Silver Generation elites at that.
Ling Han revealed a smile. If he was in the fourth form, so what if there were two Silver Generation elites? They would still be beaten up by him, but now, it was a little problematic.
Xiu, he charged out, and took the initiative to attack.
“How arrogant!” Shi Hao smirked coldly. Faced with an Imperial Son, and there were two of them at that, he actually dared to take the initiative to make a move. This was really too arrogant.
He and Baili Yun attacked at the same time, launching a counterattack at Ling Han.
With a thought from Ling Han, hong, hong, hong, three Earth Dragons shot out at the same time, greeting Shi Hao, while he focused on Baili Yun.
Three Earth Dragons were his limit in this place. The suppression of the power of Regulation was too serious.

It should be known that these three Earth Dragons all had battle prowess of 40 Heavens, and in Shi Hao’s case, without combusting his Imperial Blood, he would only have battle prowess of 41 Heavens. Being ganged up on by three Earth Dragons, he instantly appeared to be experiencing great strain.
In this way, it was equivalent to Shi Hao being excluded from the battle.

Ling Han and Baili Yun were once again engaged in a one-on-one battle, and what about Baili Yun? The Imperial Blood had already been completely burnt, and his battle prowess had fallen back to 41 Heavens, which was slightly inferior to Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4252: The Silver Generation elites joined forces
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Though there was only a gap of battle prowess of one Heaven, but as time passed, Baili Yun would still be in trouble!
“Brother Shi, come and help me!” Baili Yun shouted.
Shi Hao was also extremely annoyed. His opponents kept being the three Earth Dragons. Furthermore, every time he killed one, a new one would be produced, and he would not be able to kill them all.

Moreover, his battle prowess was only 41 Heavens. Against three Earth Dragons with battle prowess of 40 Heavens, it couldn’t be said that he was struggling, but he wouldn’t be able to win easily either.
Seeing that Baili Yun was already in extreme danger, he finally roared loudly and exploded.
Burning Imperial Blood!
Boom, his whole aura instantly changed. With the increase in power of four Heavens, peng, peng, peng, in just three strikes, the three Earth Dragons were all shattered. He charged towards Ling Han.
This was overwhelming battle prowess, and Shi Hao was unstoppable as he rushed to Ling Han’s side, sending him flying with a single strike.
However, without a crushing advantage of battle of six Heavens over Ling Han, how could he be wounded?
Ling Han released a battle cry, and immediately charged back.
“F***, is this brat a monster?” Shi Hao was startled, his face filled with disbelief.

Previously, Baili Yun had indeed said that Ling Han’s defenses were incredibly strong, but ultimately, he had not witnessed it with his own eyes. Only now did he finally believe it, which made his scalp go slightly numb.

After combusting his Imperial Bloodline, his battle prowess had already been pushed to its limits, but with this strike, he actually couldn’t even injure a single hair on Ling Han’s head. What kind of despair was this?

“Retreat! Retreat! Retreat!” Baili Yun shouted loudly. At first, he had thought that by joining forces with Shi Hao, they would be able to firmly suppress Ling Han, but when they really came to blows, he realized that Ling Han’s freakishness had far exceeded his imagination.
He needed more Silver Generation elites — or a Silver Generation elite that had advanced into the fifth form.

This wasn’t difficult to find, because there were only a handful of Silver Generation elites that were still stuck at the fourth form. The majority were already at the fifth form or even the sixth form, and there were even more that had already advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier.

“Humph!” Ling Han switched tactics, using the Earth Dragons to restrain Baili Yun and prevent him from escaping. Meanwhile, he himself faced Shi Hao head-on. Even if the latter’s battle prowess overwhelmed him by three Heavens, so what? He couldn’t wound him at all.
He was determined to kill Baili Yun today.

Baili Yun didn’t have any Imperial Blood to burn. Moreover, he would definitely experience a period of weakness after reaching the pinnacle of his strength. His current battle prowess was actually only a little over 40 Heavens. It wouldn’t be a problem for him to deal with one Earth Dragon, but against three... it would be difficult!
Thankfully, the Earth Dragons lacked flexibility. Otherwise, if all three of them attacked at the same time, he would probably have already been killed.
However, going on like this was not a solution.
Though Shi Hao’s present battle prowess was awesome, the time that the Imperial Blood would be burning was limited. Once his battle prowess dropped, what would he do?
This thought streaked through Shi Hao and Baili Yun’s minds at the same time.
The two of them released a battle cry at the same time. Instantly, their voices rolled out like waves, spreading into the distance in waves.
They were asking for help, hoping to alert even more people. It would be best if the Silver Generation elites could lend a helping hand.
However, it was as if everyone had fled, and only the three of them were left here. No matter how Shi Hao and Baili Yun roared repeatedly, no one responded.
Time continued to pass, and Shi Hao’s Imperial Blood was about to burn completely.
What could they do?
“Let’s go!” Shi Hao made a prompt decision. They couldn’t continue fighting, but they had the Substitution Seal, so it wouldn’t matter even if they were “killed” once or even in fact a few times.

Baili Yun’s face was as white as a sheet. He naturally knew that Ling Han possessed the ability to bypass the Substitution Seal. As long as he was killed once, he would truly be done for. There would definitely be no second chance.
“All right!” A thought flashed through his mind, “Brother Shi, your Imperial Blood is not completely burnt yet. Help me bring up the rear.”
“No problem.” Shi Hao nodded. His present battle prowess was actually superior to Ling Han, and it was just that he had no way to penetrate Ling Han’s defenses.
Thus, he was still as proud as always, and did not panic in the slightest.

“Then please!” Baili Yun turned around and ran. He wouldn’t tell the truth. If someone had to die, then it would definitely be Shi Hao. Worse come to worst, he would just help get revenge in the future.
Ling Han wanted to give chase, but Shi Hao stood in front of him.
“Sigh!” Ling Han sighed, and said, “Do you want to die for him?”
“What a joke. How can you hurt me?” Shi Hao said proudly.
In just a few moments, even if this place was being suppressed by the Regulations of the highest level, which would affect the speed of their advance, Baili Yun was already far away.
“Brat, you dare to oppose the Imperial Clans, your only fate is death,” Shi Hao said balefully, taking the initiative to attack.
His current battle prowess far surpassed Ling Han’s. As long as the Imperial Blood was still burning, he would have a crushing advantage.
Ling Han casually parried, appearing extremely passive.
In Shi Hao’s eyes, this was too normal. Your abilities are inferior, so how could it be that you still want to turn the tables?
After battling for a while, Ling Han smiled and said, “I’m going to kill someone. I’m not going to play with you anymore.”
Xiu, he used the Star Steps, and instantly disappeared.
Yi, where was he?
Shi Hao faltered slightly, then realization dawned on him, “Star Steps!”
Then, his face paled, as he suddenly thought of a possibility.
“Oh no, we’ve fallen into a trap!”

Ling Han had grasped the Star Steps, and could travel 500km in an instant. This speed was actually far superior to them. Now, Baili Yun had fled, and was far enough away that even he didn’t know where he was. However, Ling Han was a Formation Master, and could sense him through the ley lines.

Thus, Ling Han definitely knew where Baili Yun had gone. With the Star Steps, he could also snipe him, but what about him? To say nothing of not being able to make it in time, he didn’t even know the direction — Baili Yun might not run in a straight line all the way.
No wonder this guy was so calm, and did not pursue Baili Yun at all. As it turned out, that brat had already laid out a plan to deal with this.
“What a treacherous guy!” He stomped his feet continuously. Now, Baili Yun could only depend on himself.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure flashed, and appeared more than 500km away.

If the Star Steps were used, the shortest distance would be in the range of a few hundred km. Thus, it was not a good choice in hand-to-hand combat. If Star Steps was used, he would instead lose the target of his pursuit.
But now that the distance had been drawn out, Star Steps would be able to show its best effects.
Ahead of them, Baili Yun hurriedly raced over, as if he was walking right into a trap.
When he discovered Ling Han, Baili Yun cursed internally. He had been stupid; he had actually not thought that Ling Han had also mastered the Star Steps.
If he had known earlier, he would not have split up with Shi Hao. If there were two of them, it would be safer than one of them.
Now, he would have to face him alone again.
Without Imperial Blood burning, and in a weakened state at that, how could he block him?
More importantly, he only had one life.
Baili Yun swallowed with much difficulty. For the first time in his life, he felt a sense of fear.
He... wouldn’t really die here today, right?
“Any last words?” Ling Han asked as he charged over.

Baili Yun roared in fury, “Ling Han, don’t be too arrogant! No matter what, you are only from humble origins, and only the third form of the True Self Tier. Any member of our Ziwei Imperial Clan can easily kill you!”

After battling for a while, Ling Han smiled and said, “I’m going to kill someone.
I’m not going to play with you anymore.”
Xiu, he used the Star Steps, and instantly disappeared.
Yi, where was he?
Shi Hao faltered slightly, then realization dawned on him, “Star Steps!”
Then, his face paled, as he suddenly thought of a possibility.
“Oh no, we’ve fallen into a trap!”
Ling Han had grasped the Star Steps, and could travel 500km in an instant.
This speed was actually far superior to them.
Now, Baili Yun had fled, and was far enough away that even he didn’t know where he was.
However, Ling Han was a Formation Master, and could sense him through the ley lines.
Thus, Ling Han definitely knew where Baili Yun had gone.
With the Star Steps, he could also snipe him, but what about him?
To say nothing of not being able to make it in time, he didn’t even know the direction — Baili Yun might not run in a straight line all the way.
No wonder this guy was so calm, and did not pursue Baili Yun at all.
As it turned out, that brat had already laid out a plan to deal with this.
“What a treacherous guy!” He stomped his feet continuously.
Now, Baili Yun could only depend on himself.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure flashed, and appeared more than 500km away.
If the Star Steps were used, the shortest distance would be in the range of a few hundred km.
Thus, it was not a good choice in hand-to-hand combat.
If Star Steps was used, he would instead lose the target of his pursuit.
But now that the distance had been drawn out, Star Steps would be able to show its best effects.
Ahead of them, Baili Yun hurriedly raced over, as if he was walking right into a trap.
When he discovered Ling Han, Baili Yun cursed internally.
He had been stupid; he had actually not thought that Ling Han had also mastered the Star Steps.
If he had known earlier, he would not have split up with Shi Hao.
If there were two of them, it would be safer than one of them.
Now, he would have to face him alone again.
Without Imperial Blood burning, and in a weakened state at that, how could he block him?
More importantly, he only had one life.
Baili Yun swallowed with much difficulty.
For the first time in his life, he felt a sense of fear.
He... wouldn’t really die here today, right?
“Any last words?” Ling Han asked as he charged over.
Baili Yun roared in fury, “Ling Han, don’t be too arrogant!
No matter what, you are only from humble origins, and only the third form of the True Self Tier.
Any member of our Ziwei Imperial Clan can easily kill you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4253: Killing another Imperial Son
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was indeed the truth.
The greatest strength of the Imperial Clan was naturally their resources. This was both referring to cultivation resources, and also referring to the reserves of elites.

Ling Han’s shortcoming was his cultivation level. After all, he was only at the True Self Tier. No matter how freakish he was, there was no way he could match a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite. There were really too many people that could suppress him.

“Hehe, this has nothing to do with me killing you now,” Ling Han said calmly, but his fists had already delivered a terrifying attack. The heavenly saber slashed out, and the power of Regulations boiled, “When my cultivation level increases, I will naturally uproot the Ziwei Imperial Clan.”
Hiss!
Baili Yun inhaled sharply. This guy actually wanted to eradicate an Imperial Clan?
Where did you get such courage from?
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Ling Han’s fists blasted out madly, his speed becoming faster and faster.

Baili Yun’s situation was becoming more and more difficult. The Imperial Technique couldn’t be channeled continuously, and this had very adverse effects on himself. However, if he didn’t use the Imperial Technique, his battle prowess would drop drastically by three Heavens, so how could he resist Ling Han?

Thus, he was presently drinking poison to quench his thirst. Even if it meant that his body would be damaged, he still had to channel the Imperial Technique. Otherwise, he would be immediately killed.
But in this way, he felt even worse. The skin on his body split open, and blood gushed out violently, making it seem as if his whole person had turned into a figure of blood.
This would lead to a huge problem, causing his meridians to be damaged. In fact, it would even affect his cultivation foundations.

However, Baili Yun had no choice but to do so. Once he stopped, his only fate would be death. Thus, even though he knew that this was severing his own foundations, Baili Yun still couldn’t stop at all.
However, even so, what was the use?
Ling Han’s battle prowess was superior to his, and his fists were already entwined with Destructive Energy, exuding a terrifying destructive power.

Baili Yun held on stubbornly. He did not beg for mercy. From the fact that Ling Han dared to kill an Imperial Son, it could be seen that he did not care at all about offending the Imperial Clans at all — he was practically a maniac. Thus, even if he begged for mercy, it would definitely be useless.
“Within three moves, I will send you on your way to the afterlife!” Ling Han announced coldly.
Meanwhile, Baili Yun roared in fury. As an Imperial Son, as a Silver Generation elite, he was actually going to be announced dead like an animal?
No, definitely not.
He attacked at all costs. Even if it meant death, he was determined to drag Ling Han down with him.
“In your dreams,” Ling Han said coldly.
If this was another opponent, perhaps it would be effective. After all, if an Imperial Son went crazy and put his life on the line, everyone would have to give him a wide berth, right?
However, Ling Han was capable of automatically dispersing all attacks within six Heavens. So what if he put his life on the line? When the attacks reached him, they were completely harmless.
“The first move.”
“The second move.”
“The third move.”
Peng! Ling Han threw a punch, and Baili Yun’s head instantly exploded.
Without another chance to come back to life, those whose vitality had been erased by Destructive Energy would only die. The Substitution Seal would not be able to take effect at all.
Peng! Baili Yun’s corpse collapsed to the ground.
Ling Han was neither happy nor sad. He searched Baili Yun’s corpse, and actually found three Evolution Fruits. Only then did he smile. Not bad, this made him somewhat satisfied.
He communicated with the ley lines, wanting to find Shi Hao again, but the latter had already exceeded the range of his senses.
Obviously, Shi Hao was not an idiot either. When he had dealt with Baili Yun, he would come back to make trouble for him.
Forget it, this was only a minor character.
Ling Han thought internally — if Shi Hao knew this, he would definitely be extremely depressed. He, a dignified Silver Generation elite, could actually only be considered a minor character?
He strolled around, because he also found it strange that everyone had suddenly disappeared.

After walking for quite a while, he finally encountered a cultivator that was hurriedly passing by, and stopped him to ask — of course, that person who had been stopped was very displeased, and even wanted to make a move, but very soon, he “convinced him into submission through virtue”.
As it turned out, that mysterious mountain cave had finally been found.

This meant that a large number of Evolution Fruits were beckoning them, so everyone was naturally excited. However, there were restrictions in the cave that needed to be broken through, so they couldn’t enter for the time being. However, more and more people received the news.
Ling Han allowed the person to leave, yet a question rose up in his heart.
Who would be so kind as to spread the news?
He couldn’t connect to the Galaxy Network in this Mystery Realm, so how had the news spread out?
Oh, who would run all over the valley after seeing the cave, and inform everyone they saw?
Ling Han was filled with disbelief.

Previously, when the news that there was a large number of Evolution Fruits in the Hundred Flowers Valley spread out, Ling Han already felt that something was off. However, he also thought that who would dare offend everyone in the world and lay out such a massive trap?
However, this kind of thing happened time and time again, making Ling Han feel that it was too strange.
“I have to quickly contact Old Black and Four-Legged Snake. There’s something off about this place,” Ling Han murmured to himself as he followed the person from before.

He believed that with the temperament of the little azure dragon and the large black dog, they would definitely have reached the Hundred Flowers Valley by now. Moreover, they would even be at the cave. However, they definitely wouldn’t expose their identities so easily. If there was a trap, they would definitely let others step on it first.
Ling Han moved quickly, using the Star Steps. Not long after, he arrived at the location of the cave.
True enough, there was a large number of people gathered here, a sea of people.
Aside from a very small number of people still trying their luck outside the valley, the majority of them should be here by now, so the scale was naturally astonishing.
“Old Black, Four-Legged Snake!” Ling Han didn’t bother to reveal his identity and called out loudly.
“Hmm?”
Multiple gazes shot over, and then a great many people immediately recognized him, looking stunned.
This was actually Ling Han!
Gods, this guy was wanted by nine great Imperial Clans, and he actually dared to come here? Hiss, there were clearly Venerate Tier elites standing guard outside, so how did he get in?
“Ling Han!” A middle-aged man ran towards him, and said, “I’m Old Black. I’ve disguised myself.”
“Oh, Old Black.” Ling Han nodded.

Shua, the middle-aged man approached, yet suddenly moved. A sharp sword stabbed over at an incredibly fast speed. The power of Regulations wrapped around him, and if one was struck by it, they would definitely die.
This caused everyone to be greatly shocked.
Wasn’t Ling Han familiar with this person? From the looks of it, they seemed to be good friends. Why had they suddenly turned against each other?
It was so close and so sudden, so how could he block it?
Oh no, Ling Han was about to be killed on the spot.
However, right at this moment, Ling Han’s figure suddenly turned, and he had already dodged this strike. Then, taking advantage of the momentum, he threw a punch at the middle-aged man.
Peng!

The man, on the other hand, was caught off guard. At first, he had thought that Ling Han would definitely die with this strike, but who knew that the latter seemed to have long since prepared himself. Not only did he dodge this strike, he even counterattacked.
He was instantly hit, and a punch landed on his chest. Under the barrage of violent power, he retreated explosively a few meters, blood spraying madly from his mouth.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “You must be very curious. You clearly wanted to catch me off guard, but why is the situation the other way around?”
The middle-aged man’s face was indeed filled with confusion. He was too confused.
“Because Old Black would definitely not call himself Old Black, nor would he call me Ling Han,” Ling Han said with a smile.

The middle-aged man’s expression was filled with defiance, but his body slowly weakened. His vitality had already been destroyed with a single punch from Ling Han. Now, he was only holding on with a single breath. He did not want to die in such a dubious manner.
Now that the riddle had been solved, he was naturally relieved.
F*ck, it was actually so simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 4254: The Trap Appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This middle-aged man was an assassin from the Battle God Palace.
From the way he moved, it could be seen. After all, Ling Han had also stayed in the Battle God Palace for a period of time. For better or worse, he was still a seed.

At this time, another two men ran over. One was a middle-aged man, who was incredibly tough, and the other was a young boy. His face was filled with childishness, yet carried an expression of arrogance.
“Little Han!” the two of them called out through divine sense.
Ling Han nodded. This was the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
“Very well, Ling Han, are you walking right into a trap?” A person said balefully, striding towards Ling Han.
Imperial Son, Lin Yun.
This was a member of the Silver Generation, and he had already advanced into the Fifth Form. His strength was unimaginable.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He had grasped the Star Steps, so what did he have to fear?
“Old Black, Four-Legged Snake, prepare to run,” he said through divine sense.
“Why did you reveal your identity? Otherwise, we could have taken advantage of the crisis,” the large black dog said in defiance.

“That’s right,” the little azure dragon also said. They hid their identities very well, and didn’t need to worry about being discovered at all. Moreover, a large number of Evolution Fruits were about to appear, and it was time to make a fortune.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I think there’s a trap in this matter. Don’t be blinded by greed.”
“Ling Han!” Lin Yun shouted loudly. He was filled with fury. Ling Han actually dared to ignore him.
“Yes, yes, yes. I’m not deaf, so I heard very clearly,” Ling Han finally replied.
“You’re seeking death!” Lin Yun was just about to make a move, but right at this moment, he heard a round of cheers, causing him to stop abruptly.
What was going on?
“The restriction has been lifted.” Cheers surged out like a flood.
Lin Yun faltered for a moment, then humphed coldly, “Consider yourself lucky.”

In comparison, it was the Evolution Fruit that was more important. It was related to whether he could quickly break through to the sixth form, or even had hopes of breaking through to the seventh form in fact.

If he could reach the Seventh Form, he would be able to shorten the gap between himself and the Golden Generation, and if he could take another step further, and reach the Eighth Form, then he would not be inferior to the Golden Generation at all.
Thus, the Evolution Fruit was incredibly important in his eyes. In fact, he could even temporarily spare Ling Han for this.
The Imperial Sons all rushed into the mountain cave, especially the Silver Generation. Their status had been awkward for a long time, and they were more eager to change this than anyone else.
Ling Han didn’t move. In fact, he even pressed down on the little azure dragon and the large black dog.
“What did you sense?” Chi Menghan walked over gracefully, her figure graceful and captivating.
The silver-haired little lolita and Chi Dao were both here, yet they were actually able to restrain themselves and not rush into the mountain cave at the first instant. This was truly a rare sight.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “It’s dangerous.”
“Dangerous?” Chi Dao scratched his head, “There are so many Imperial Clan elites gathered here. Who dares to touch us?”
This action was equivalent to offending all the Imperial Clans. One after another, Saints would charge over with Imperial Weapons in their hands. Who in the world could withstand this?
“I don’t know. It’s just an instinctive feeling,” Ling Han said.
“Brother-in-law, when did you become a woman?” the silver-haired little lolita shouted.
“Little girl, it’s not only women that have instincts,” the large black dog said in an experienced manner.
“Prepare to retreat. I keep feeling that this place is filled with killing intent,” Ling Han said.
“Hahaha, what powerful instincts. As expected of the legendary prodigy that can match the Golden Generation.” A voice suddenly rang out, and there was even the sound of applause.
Who was it?
Ling Han and the others all turned around, only to see a group of people walking over from outside the valley.

There were not many, only nine, and the person in the lead was an elder. He had white brows and a white beard, and his aura was not apparent. It was unknown whether he was strong or weak, but the eight people behind him... there was no shortage of Sect Master-level elites!

Hiss, wasn’t this place forbidding cultivators above the True Self Tier from entering? Why were there suddenly four Sect Masters, three Spirit Transformation True Lords, and only one of them was at the True Self Tier. He looked to be in his early twenties, and his flame of life was flourishing.
“Dongfang Clan Leader!” Chi Menghan said. She bowed slightly to the white-browed elder as a token of respect.
This was natural. She was the Imperial Daughter, so who would be worthy of such respects from her?
Ling Han was astonished. This elder was actually the clan leader of the Dongfang Clan?
No wonder they could enter. The Island of the Sky had always been under their control, so they definitely had a way to enter.
The question was, why?

The white-browed elder was called Dongfang Bai, and he was a Venerate Tier-level great elite. He had already lived for over 90,000 years, and theoretically speaking, he wasn’t far from reaching the end of his lifespan. It was possible that he would die at any moment.
He smiled faintly, and said, “I heard that Donglin Imperial Clan’s prized daughter is exquisitely beautiful. You are indeed graceful and enchanting.”
Chi Menghuan couldn’t help but frown. ‘You’re a senior, so it’s inappropriate for you to say such things in front of me.’
“The news of the Hundred Flowers Valley was spread by you guys, right?” Ling Han asked directly.
Dongfang Bai’s gaze shifted to Ling Han, and he showed a hint of surprise. However, he nodded decisively, “That’s right.”
“Why?” Ling Han asked.
“Well, that’s a long story,” Dongfang Bai said with a smile.

“There’s still a lot of time. Senior, why don’t you explain slowly?” Ling Han also smiled, “I can tell that Senior has prepared for this for a very, very long time. Now that the matter is about to be settled, if you don’t share it with others, wouldn’t that be too boring?”
“Haha, young man, you’re quite interesting. It’s a pity to kill such an interesting person,” Dongfang Bai said with a smile.
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but feel anxious. The Dongfang Clan had really planted killing intent?
She couldn’t help but say, “Dongfang Clan Leader, don’t forget how many Imperial Clan clansmen are here. Don’t bring a fatal disaster to the Dongfang Clan!”

“Little girl, are you threatening me?” Dongfang Bai shook his head, and said, “That young man is right. I’ve already planned for far too long for today. If I don’t share this with others, my sense of accomplishment will truly be greatly reduced.”
He began to speak.
“This Island of the Sky was discovered by our Dongfang Clan in the first place, but we couldn’t hide it for many years before it was discovered.”

“Hoho, at that time, all the Imperial Clans fought over this island, but no one noticed that the one who was most injured was our Dongfang Clan! A fire broke out at the city gates, bringing disaster to the bystanders!”
“You guys have finished fighting, but our Dongfang Clan has also suffered heavy casualties!”

“In the end, you all lightly threw down a few words, and had our Dongfang Clan continue to manage the Island of the Sky, yet did not even ask how many members of our Dongfang Clan had died for this matter.”
“You Imperial Clans are noble and dignified, so how could you possibly care?”

“Haha, well said. The Island of the Sky is still managed by our Dongfang Clan, but in truth, from now onwards, the many generations of descendants of the Dongfang Clan have all become your gardeners and servants.”
“We... are naturally unwilling to accept this!”
“You people have only roughly examined the Island of the Sky, so how can you compare to us, who have lived here for generations?”
“Our elders from the previous generations discovered a rare treasure in this place.”
“Natural-born Stone Spirit!”

The silver-haired little lolita and Chi Dao were both here, yet they were actually able to restrain themselves and not rush into the mountain cave at the first instant.
This was truly a rare sight.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “It’s dangerous.”
“Dangerous?” Chi Dao scratched his head, “There are so many Imperial Clan elites gathered here.
Who dares to touch us?”
This action was equivalent to offending all the Imperial Clans.
One after another, Saints would charge over with Imperial Weapons in their hands.
Who in the world could withstand this?
“I don’t know.
It’s just an instinctive feeling,” Ling Han said.
“Brother-in-law, when did you become a woman?” the silver-haired little lolita shouted.
“Little girl, it’s not only women that have instincts,” the large black dog said in an experienced manner.
“Prepare to retreat.
I keep feeling that this place is filled with killing intent,” Ling Han said.
“Hahaha, what powerful instincts.
As expected of the legendary prodigy that can match the Golden Generation.” A voice suddenly rang out, and there was even the sound of applause.
Who was it?
Ling Han and the others all turned around, only to see a group of people walking over from outside the valley.
There were not many, only nine, and the person in the lead was an elder.
He had white brows and a white beard, and his aura was not apparent.
It was unknown whether he was strong or weak, but the eight people behind him... there was no shortage of Sect Master-level elites!
Hiss, wasn’t this place forbidding cultivators above the True Self Tier from entering?
Why were there suddenly four Sect Masters, three Spirit Transformation True Lords, and only one of them was at the True Self Tier.
He looked to be in his early twenties, and his flame of life was flourishing.
“Dongfang Clan Leader!” Chi Menghan said.
She bowed slightly to the white-browed elder as a token of respect.
This was natural.
She was the Imperial Daughter, so who would be worthy of such respects from her?
Ling Han was astonished.
This elder was actually the clan leader of the Dongfang Clan?
No wonder they could enter.
The Island of the Sky had always been under their control, so they definitely had a way to enter.
The question was, why?
The white-browed elder was called Dongfang Bai, and he was a Venerate Tier-level great elite.
He had already lived for over 90,000 years, and theoretically speaking, he wasn’t far from reaching the end of his lifespan.
It was possible that he would die at any moment.
He smiled faintly, and said, “I heard that Donglin Imperial Clan’s prized daughter is exquisitely beautiful.
You are indeed graceful and enchanting.”
Chi Menghuan couldn’t help but frown.
‘You’re a senior, so it’s inappropriate for you to say such things in front of me.’
“The news of the Hundred Flowers Valley was spread by you guys, right?” Ling Han asked directly.
Dongfang Bai’s gaze shifted to Ling Han, and he showed a hint of surprise.
However, he nodded decisively, “That’s right.”
“Why?” Ling Han asked.
“Well, that’s a long story,” Dongfang Bai said with a smile.
“There’s still a lot of time.
Senior, why don’t you explain slowly?” Ling Han also smiled, “I can tell that Senior has prepared for this for a very, very long time.
Now that the matter is about to be settled, if you don’t share it with others, wouldn’t that be too boring?”
“Haha, young man, you’re quite interesting.
It’s a pity to kill such an interesting person,” Dongfang Bai said with a smile.
Chi Menghan couldn’t help but feel anxious.
The Dongfang Clan had really planted killing intent?
She couldn’t help but say, “Dongfang Clan Leader, don’t forget how many Imperial Clan clansmen are here.
Don’t bring a fatal disaster to the Dongfang Clan!”
“Little girl, are you threatening me?” Dongfang Bai shook his head, and said, “That young man is right.
I’ve already planned for far too long for today.
If I don’t share this with others, my sense of accomplishment will truly be greatly reduced.”
He began to speak.
“This Island of the Sky was discovered by our Dongfang Clan in the first place, but we couldn’t hide it for many years before it was discovered.”
“Hoho, at that time, all the Imperial Clans fought over this island, but no one noticed that the one who was most injured was our Dongfang Clan!
A fire broke out at the city gates, bringing disaster to the bystanders!”
“You guys have finished fighting, but our Dongfang Clan has also suffered heavy casualties!”

“In the end, you all lightly threw down a few words, and had our Dongfang Clan continue to manage the Island of the Sky, yet did not even ask how many members of our Dongfang Clan had died for this matter.”
“You Imperial Clans are noble and dignified, so how could you possibly care?”
“Haha, well said.
The Island of the Sky is still managed by our Dongfang Clan, but in truth, from now onwards, the many generations of descendants of the Dongfang Clan have all become your gardeners and servants.”
“We... are naturally unwilling to accept this!”
“You people have only roughly examined the Island of the Sky, so how can you compare to us, who have lived here for generations?”
“Our elders from the previous generations discovered a rare treasure in this place.”
“Natural-born Stone Spirit!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4255: Waiting for a miracle
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hearing the words Natural-born Stone Spirit, Ling Han couldn’t help but help but wear a strange expression.
He could already vaguely guess what was going on. However, if he told the truth, Dongfang Bai would probably go crazy with anger.
However, he was the only one who knew the truth. When they heard the words Natural-born Stone Spirit, Chi Mengan and the others all looked stunned.
At the same time, a series of tragic cries rang out from within the mountain cave. In an instant, a large number of people rushed out, all of them looking like they had been frightened.
When they entered, the Imperial Sons were at the forefront, and when they came out, the Imperial Sons were also at the forefront.

“Dongfang Bai, you’ve gone crazy!” Lin Yun shouted loudly. There were traces of blood on his body, but they shouldn’t be his, because there were no injuries. However, his expression was filled with both fury and fear.

“How dare you!” One of the Sect Masters of the Dongfang Clan humphed. He sent out a palm strike, which turned into a colossal hand. Peng, the large hand pressed down, and various kinds of light of energy flashed violently. The Regulations were interwoven.
When he withdrew the large hand, it was seen that in the area covered by the attack, only Lin Yun was still standing. The others had all died.
If Lin Yun didn’t have the Substitution Seal, he would have definitely died as well.
Seeing this scene, everyone inhaled sharply, and those who had just come out of the cave still had no idea what had happened. They were all extremely dumbfounded.
The Dongfang Clan actually dared to make a move on an Imperial Son!
This wasn’t putting on an act to scare them, but they were really going to be ruthless and assassinate them.
Crazy, they must have gone crazy!

Lin Yun’s body was also trembling. He was an Imperial Son, and possessed invincible battle prowess at the same cultivation level. However, in front of a Sect Master elite, he was like a blade of grass, completely unable to withstand a single blow.
Thus, if the clansmen of the Dongfang Clan really went mad and wanted to kill an Imperial Son, then his end... could only be one word. Terrible.
What was the use of the Substitution Seal? With a few more kills, with the Sect Masters or even Venerate Tiers keeping watch, how could he escape?
Crazy, they had really gone crazy.
Dongfang Bai coughed, and in an instant, all eyes were focused on him. There was confusion, fear, and terror.
He smiled faintly, and said, “Where were we just now?”
“Oh, right, Natural-born Stone Spirit.”

The old geezer swept an eye over the surrounding people, and said with a smile, “There should be some people here that still don’t know what Natural-born Stone Spirit is. I’ll give you guys some general knowledge first.”
“Less nonsense. What exactly do you want?” Another Silver Generation member stepped out and shouted at Dongfang Bai.
Now that the other party clearly wanted to kill him, there was naturally no need for him to be respectful.

Dongfang Bai looked towards that Imperial Son. With a pa, that Imperial Son exploded. Thankfully, there was the Substitution Seal. He had not really died, but it still caused him to break out in a cold sweat.

“This world does not revolve around the Imperial Clans,” the old geezer said calmly. “There are a great many children who still don’t know what the Natural-born Stone Spirit is. What right do you have to deprive them of the right to know?”
After a pause, Dongfang Bai began to introduce the Natural-born Stone Spirit.
After saying this, he smiled, and said, “This Natural-born Stone Spirit is under the Hundred Flowers Valley, but its aura is too powerful, and even I can’t approach it.”
The more this was the case, the more it showed how terrifying the Natural-born Stone Spirit was. If it could be refined into a doppelganger, it would naturally be extremely awesome.
“Thus, I have gathered all of you together, and plan to use you as blood sacrifices, to open up a path.”
When these words were said, there was an uproar.
They were actually going to become sacrifices for a blood sacrifice?
What kind of joke was this!

“Dongfang Bai, you have to consider carefully how many Imperial Clans there are here!” Imperial Son Cheng Qing called out loudly. “Even if your blood sacrifice is successful, and you obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit, would you be able to block the furious Imperial Clans?”
The Saints all came with Imperial Weapon in hand; could you block them?

“Brat, your comprehension ability is quite poor,” Dongfang Bai said with a chuckle. “Once I obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit and refine it into my spiritual body, even the Imperial Weapon won’t be able to kill me!”

“Furthermore, if I sacrifice all of you, I still have the chance to extract your Imperial Scrolls, and use the Natural-born Stone Spirit to make a prediction. Then, it would not be difficult for me to break through to Silent Destruction Tier.”
“At that time, I’ll be able to rival the Imperial Weapon, and I’ll be able to rival the Pseudo-Emperor!”

The Silent Destruction Tier was Saint Tier, but normally, no one would directly address the cultivation level by its full name. Instead, they would respectfully address it as Saint Tier, or Saint-level.
All of a sudden, a dead silence fell.
This seemed... flawless.

According to Dongfang Bai, he indeed could be unafraid of the Imperial Clans. In fact, if he had the strength of Pseudo-Emperor, the Imperial Clans would be forced to behave, not daring to trifle with him.
“Since the leader of the Dongfang Clan needs a blood sacrifice to obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit, I, on behalf of the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan, express my support,” a man suddenly said.
He was the Silver Generation Imperial Son of the Black Sunflower Imperial Clan. His name was Tong Xiao.
‘F*ck! Shameless!’
Hearing Tong Xiao’s words, everyone felt a sense of disdain.
For the sake of survival, could he be so shameless?
“The Seven Luminaries Imperial Clan also expresses their support.”
“The Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan expresses support!”
More Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters stepped out to express their stand. Obviously, as long as they didn’t die, it didn’t matter how many people died.
Dongfang Bai saw this, and suddenly humphed. The aura of a Venerate Tier elite fluctuated, causing everyone to involuntarily shut up.
“What a disgusting face!” he said coldly, “For the sake of survival, you guys are really capable of doing anything.”
All the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters did not speak. As they saw it, those who were not Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters were all ants. So what if 10,000 or 10,000 of them died?
“Your lives are lives, and the lives of others aren’t?” Dongfang Bai said coldly. “Today, I’ll let you know that you people view all life as ants, but in fact... you yourselves are only ants!”
He raised his hand. Weng, instantly, Regulations intertwined, turning into a cage that was closing in on the center.

Peng, peng, peng! These were Regulations that had been activated by a Venerate Tier, and their might was incredibly terrifying. One would definitely die if they came into contact with them, and they would directly explode into a shower of blood.
In just an instant, the whole valley was flooded with blood.
Those who were stronger tried their best to squeeze towards the centre. Though this could not solve the problem, they could at least die later, and who knows, a miracle might happen.
However, this place was only so big, so how could everyone squeeze into the middle?
Thus, the battle immediately broke out. Those with weak abilities were expelled, and then crushed by the Regulations, instantly turning into a rain of blood.

The entire valley had completely turned into a slaughterhouse. In this place, whether it was normal cultivators, Holy Land Dao Child, or even Imperial Sons, the only difference was whether they died earlier or later.
“Little Han, can you leave?” The large black dog was also feeling apprehensive. This was a Venerate Tier cultivator digging a trap for minor characters like them; how could they escape?
Ling Han frowned deeply, and said, “No, the ley lines are also suppressed.”
“Then what do we do? Wait for death?” the little azure dragon asked anxiously.
“No, wait for a miracle,” Ling Han said darkly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4256: Ge Qianqiu appears
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The cage of Regulations continued to shrink. This was a Venerate Tier elite’s attack, so even if one were a Silver Generation elite or a Golden Generation elite, the gap in their cultivation level was extremely large, so they could only wait for death.
Screams of agony rang out endlessly. The blood of the dead turned into a river, which was then used as a blood sacrifice. A blazing light rose up, lighting up the whole valley.
“Ling Han!” At this moment, Chi Menghan suddenly said to Ling Han, “There’s something I want to say to you.”
“Er, if you are going to say you like me, then I have known that long ago,” Ling Han said.
Chi Menghan was rendered speechless. ‘You’re still in the mood to say such words at a time like this?’
“No!” she said through gritted teeth.
“Then what are you trying to say?” Ling Han was curious. Yi, when did his charms become so weak that he actually did not manage to win the heart of this Imperial Daughter?

“Zhi!” The sound of pigs squealing was heard. The perverted pig leaped with all its might, and jumped out of the arms of the silver-haired little lolita. It lay on Ling Han’s back, and then used its four short pig claws to tightly tug on Ling Han’s clothes, looking like it was determined not to let go even if it died.
“Stinky little piggy, what do you mean by this?” The silver-haired little lolita was very hurt. This perverted pig actually abandoned her at this moment.
“Hehe, it clearly feels that it has a higher chance of survival if it follows Little Han,” the large black dog said with a chuckle.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was puzzled, and said, “This pervert pig is invincible. If we throw him out, who knows, we may be able to create a hole in this cage of Regulations.”
The pervert pig’s expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly loosened his limbs before lunging at the large black dog. He desperately tugged at the large black dog’s fur.
There was an upper limit to its invincibility. If a Venerate Tier elite made a move, it would definitely die without a doubt.

Hong, the valley became more and more resplendent. Innumerable drops of blood intertwined, containing powerful life essence, as well as Regulations. With these sacrifices, it was naturally very grand.

Dongfang Bai showed an expectant expression. He did not have much lifespan left, and that was why he was taking this gamble. As long as he could obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit, the Dongfang Clan would be invincible, and if he could obtain the Imperial Scroll, he may be able to advance into Saint Tier.

If he became a Saint, he would gain ten times his lifespan. This was the fundamental motivation for him to take risks. Saying how he could not bear see the Imperial Clans lording their authority, and his clan being oppressed were all excuses.
Soon, soon.
The other members of the Dongfang Clan were also filled with anticipation. They were already tied together. If they didn’t succeed, they could only die trying.
“Sigh!” Right at this moment, a long sigh was heard.
Where did it come from?

Dongfang Bai was startled. With the strength of his cultivation level, he actually couldn’t tell where this sigh was coming from, so how could he not feel nervous? It should be known that he was presently at a crucial moment in his plans to snatch the Natural-born Stone Spirit, so naturally, his heart was tense, and he was on edge.
“Who is it?” he shouted.
Ling Han finally breathed a sigh of relief. Old man Ge Qianqiu was finally going to make a move.

He knew that this old man was in the underground cave, and the so-called blood sacrifice would definitely awaken him, but what he was unsure about was whether Old Man Ge was willing to interfere in this matter.
Moreover, could the old man defeat a Venerate Tier elite?
“This old man is called Ge Qianqiu.” Shua, with a flash, Ge Qianqiu appeared out of thin air. He was filled with emotion, “By now, there should be no one that can remember this name.”

Dongfang Bai looked at the old geezer. This old geezer looked like his vitality was waning. He could clearly see that the old geezer’s lifespan was already close to zero, and probably not much different from his.
Hiss, could it be that the old man had come to snatch the Natural-born Stone Spirit from him?

His expression instantly became baleful. The Natural-born Stone Spirit concerned whether he could live for hundreds of thousands of years or not. To him, this was his life! Whoever dared to fight him for it would be taking his life, and he would spare no expense to battle them.
“Friend, this is the territory of our Dongfang Clan, so please leave,” he said calmly. If he could make the other retreat, that was naturally best.
Ge Qianqiu smiled, yet couldn’t help but start to cough. He couldn’t help but sigh, saying, “I’m old, I’m really old.”
Hearing these words, Dongfang Bai’s heart was filled with alarm bells. ‘You said you’re old, but are you emphasizing your determination to definitely obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit?’
“Friend—”

“I’ll tear apart this cage first. Commit too much bloodshed, and it damages the harmony of the heavens. Your hopes of becoming a Saint would be even slimmer,” Ge Qianqiu said. With a casual press of his hand, peng, peng, peng, the cage immediately crumbled.
Everyone felt as if a heavy burden had been lifted from their shoulders, and they were instantly overcome with ecstasy. Some of them even started to cry.
“This is the miracle that you’re waiting for?” the large black dog, Chi Menghan, and the others all asked.
Ling Han nodded, “That’s right.”

“F***, brat, you clearly know that someone is rescuing you, yet you still refuse to say anything, causing Grandpa Dog to become extremely nervous.” The large black dog gave Ling Han the middle finger.
Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled. In truth, he did not know whether Ge Qianqiu would make a move or not. He only had a 70% chance of success.
On the other side, Dongfang Bai was both shocked and furious.

He was furious because this Ge Qianqiu was indeed aiming for the Natural-born Stone Spirit. He was shocked because the latter was able to dispel his attack with a casual press of its hand. His abilities were quite strong, and he couldn’t figure out his true strength.
“No need to waste your energy,” Ge Qianqiu said with a shake of his head. “The Natural-born Stone Spirit that you wanted already appeared hundreds of millions of years ago.”

“Impossible!” Dongfang Bai naturally refused to believe this. He had prepared for this day for a very, very long time. Furthermore, he had gone all out. He even dared to kill the members of the Imperial Clans, and there was absolutely no way back for him.
Hence, this matter could only succeed, and could not fail.
Ge Qianqiu smiled, “This old man has lived down there for so many years, so I naturally know better than you whether I am or not.”
Dongfang Bai’s killing intent instantly overflowed, “You were the one who stole my Natural-born Stone Spirit?”
His eyes were bloodshot, as if he had gone mad.
This was natural. The Natural-born Stone Spirit was tied to the fate of the Dongfang Clan, as well as his dream of extending his lifespan. This definitely couldn’t go wrong.
Boom!

Dongfang Bai charged over, and his figure rose into the air. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Light continuously shot out from behind him, intertwining into sheets that looked like the feathers of birds. They were incredibly beautiful, but in the next instant, these streaks of light changed direction, and shot towards Ge Qianqiu.
This was all made up of Regulations, which carried a high-level energy, and was indescribably terrifying.

Even the Imperial Sons inhaled sharply. Even if they possessed the Substitution Seal, so what? They would probably be killed by the feathers of Regulations that would follow closely after their “revival”. No matter how many times they had a Substitution Seal to die in their stead, it would not be enough.
This was the might of a Venerate Tier elite.
Meanwhile, Ge Qianqiu shook his head, sighed, and stretched out his shrivelled right hand, waving it lightly in front of him.
Instantly, all the attacks disappeared without a trace.
“What!” Dongfang Bai couldn’t help but feel shocked. What kind of terrifying abilities was this?
He was a Two Star Venerate Tier elite, and to so easily disperse his attack, it would have to be a Five Star or even Six Star Venerate Tier elite, at least.
“No, I definitely won’t hand the Natural-born Stone Spirit over to anyone!” he roared, as if he’d been possessed.
Boom, he once again charged towards Ge Qianqiu.

Yi, when did his charms become so weak that he actually did not manage to win the heart of this Imperial Daughter?
“Zhi!” The sound of pigs squealing was heard.
The perverted pig leaped with all its might, and jumped out of the arms of the silver-haired little lolita.
It lay on Ling Han’s back, and then used its four short pig claws to tightly tug on Ling Han’s clothes, looking like it was determined not to let go even if it died.
“Stinky little piggy, what do you mean by this?” The silver-haired little lolita was very hurt.
This perverted pig actually abandoned her at this moment.
“Hehe, it clearly feels that it has a higher chance of survival if it follows Little Han,” the large black dog said with a chuckle.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was puzzled, and said, “This pervert pig is invincible.
If we throw him out, who knows, we may be able to create a hole in this cage of Regulations.”
The pervert pig’s expression changed drastically, and he hurriedly loosened his limbs before lunging at the large black dog.
He desperately tugged at the large black dog’s fur.
There was an upper limit to its invincibility.
If a Venerate Tier elite made a move, it would definitely die without a doubt.
Hong, the valley became more and more resplendent.
Innumerable drops of blood intertwined, containing powerful life essence, as well as Regulations.
With these sacrifices, it was naturally very grand.
Dongfang Bai showed an expectant expression.
He did not have much lifespan left, and that was why he was taking this gamble.
As long as he could obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit, the Dongfang Clan would be invincible, and if he could obtain the Imperial Scroll, he may be able to advance into Saint Tier.
If he became a Saint, he would gain ten times his lifespan.
This was the fundamental motivation for him to take risks.
Saying how he could not bear see the Imperial Clans lording their authority, and his clan being oppressed were all excuses.
Soon, soon.
The other members of the Dongfang Clan were also filled with anticipation.
They were already tied together.
If they didn’t succeed, they could only die trying.
“Sigh!” Right at this moment, a long sigh was heard.
Where did it come from?
Dongfang Bai was startled.
With the strength of his cultivation level, he actually couldn’t tell where this sigh was coming from, so how could he not feel nervous?
It should be known that he was presently at a crucial moment in his plans to snatch the Natural-born Stone Spirit, so naturally, his heart was tense, and he was on edge.
“Who is it?” he shouted.
Ling Han finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Old man Ge Qianqiu was finally going to make a move.

He knew that this old man was in the underground cave, and the so-called blood sacrifice would definitely awaken him, but what he was unsure about was whether Old Man Ge was willing to interfere in this matter.
Moreover, could the old man defeat a Venerate Tier elite?
“This old man is called Ge Qianqiu.” Shua, with a flash, Ge Qianqiu appeared out of thin air.
He was filled with emotion, “By now, there should be no one that can remember this name.”
Dongfang Bai looked at the old geezer.
This old geezer looked like his vitality was waning.
He could clearly see that the old geezer’s lifespan was already close to zero, and probably not much different from his.
Hiss, could it be that the old man had come to snatch the Natural-born Stone Spirit from him?
His expression instantly became baleful.
The Natural-born Stone Spirit concerned whether he could live for hundreds of thousands of years or not.
To him, this was his life!
Whoever dared to fight him for it would be taking his life, and he would spare no expense to battle them.
“Friend, this is the territory of our Dongfang Clan, so please leave,” he said calmly.
If he could make the other retreat, that was naturally best.
Ge Qianqiu smiled, yet couldn’t help but start to cough.
He couldn’t help but sigh, saying, “I’m old, I’m really old.”
Hearing these words, Dongfang Bai’s heart was filled with alarm bells.
‘You said you’re old, but are you emphasizing your determination to definitely obtain the Natural-born Stone Spirit?’
“Friend—”
“I’ll tear apart this cage first.
Commit too much bloodshed, and it damages the harmony of the heavens.
Your hopes of becoming a Saint would be even slimmer,” Ge Qianqiu said.
With a casual press of his hand, peng, peng, peng, the cage immediately crumbled.
Everyone felt as if a heavy burden had been lifted from their shoulders, and they were instantly overcome with ecstasy.
Some of them even started to cry.
“This is the miracle that you’re waiting for?” the large black dog, Chi Menghan, and the others all asked.
Ling Han nodded, “That’s right.”

“F***, brat, you clearly know that someone is rescuing you, yet you still refuse to say anything, causing Grandpa Dog to become extremely nervous.” The large black dog gave Ling Han the middle finger.
Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled.
In truth, he did not know whether Ge Qianqiu would make a move or not.
He only had a 70% chance of success.
On the other side, Dongfang Bai was both shocked and furious.
He was furious because this Ge Qianqiu was indeed aiming for the Natural-born Stone Spirit.
He was shocked because the latter was able to dispel his attack with a casual press of its hand.
His abilities were quite strong, and he couldn’t figure out his true strength.
“No need to waste your energy,” Ge Qianqiu said with a shake of his head.
“The Natural-born Stone Spirit that you wanted already appeared hundreds of millions of years ago.”
“Impossible!” Dongfang Bai naturally refused to believe this.
He had prepared for this day for a very, very long time.
Furthermore, he had gone all out.
He even dared to kill the members of the Imperial Clans, and there was absolutely no way back for him.
Hence, this matter could only succeed, and could not fail.
Ge Qianqiu smiled, “This old man has lived down there for so many years, so I naturally know better than you whether I am or not.”
Dongfang Bai’s killing intent instantly overflowed, “You were the one who stole my Natural-born Stone Spirit?”
His eyes were bloodshot, as if he had gone mad.
This was natural.
The Natural-born Stone Spirit was tied to the fate of the Dongfang Clan, as well as his dream of extending his lifespan.
This definitely couldn’t go wrong.
Boom!
Dongfang Bai charged over, and his figure rose into the air.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Light continuously shot out from behind him, intertwining into sheets that looked like the feathers of birds.
They were incredibly beautiful, but in the next instant, these streaks of light changed direction, and shot towards Ge Qianqiu.
This was all made up of Regulations, which carried a high-level energy, and was indescribably terrifying.
Even the Imperial Sons inhaled sharply.
Even if they possessed the Substitution Seal, so what?
They would probably be killed by the feathers of Regulations that would follow closely after their “revival”.
No matter how many times they had a Substitution Seal to die in their stead, it would not be enough.
This was the might of a Venerate Tier elite.
Meanwhile, Ge Qianqiu shook his head, sighed, and stretched out his shrivelled right hand, waving it lightly in front of him.
Instantly, all the attacks disappeared without a trace.
“What!” Dongfang Bai couldn’t help but feel shocked.
What kind of terrifying abilities was this?
He was a Two Star Venerate Tier elite, and to so easily disperse his attack, it would have to be a Five Star or even Six Star Venerate Tier elite, at least.
“No, I definitely won’t hand the Natural-born Stone Spirit over to anyone!” he roared, as if he’d been possessed.
Boom, he once again charged towards Ge Qianqiu.

chapters.title: Chapter 4257: Saint!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Ge Qianqiu shook his head again. He still made a pressing motion with his hand, but this time, he wasn’t just simply dispersing the attack. With a palm strike, peng, Dongfang Bai was actually shattered.
Seeing this scene, everyone was dumbfounded.
What was going on here? A mighty Venerate Tier elite was actually killed with a wave of his hand?
What kind of terrifying abilities was this!
“S-Saint!” an Imperial Son exclaimed in a low voice.

Though there were also differences in strength among Venerate Tiers, those that could reach this cultivation level were all prodigies among prodigies. Thus, it was practically impossible to insta-kill a Venerate Tier.
Then, there was only one possibility.
Ge Qianqiu was a Saint, so he was able to smack Dongfang Bai to death with a wave of his hand.
“Greetings, Saint Ge!” Immediately, the majority knelt down. Even the Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters clasped their hands in respect, their expressions respectful.

This was a Saint. In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, that was the strongest existence. Even if they went to the Imperial Clans, they would still be able to receive the highest level of respect. No matter how arrogant and proud the Imperial Son was, he would still have to bow his head in front of a Saint.

It should be known that even if an Ancestral King really appeared in this generation, there would only be one. The others would only be on equal footing with this person, at most, and that would be an unknown number of years later.
Saints were respected by the whole world.

The other members of the Dongfang Clan were all confused. What happened to their plan of the Dongfang Clan becoming a top-notch force? What happened to the plan of the ancestor of the Clan becoming a Pseudo-Emperor?
Why had he died all of a sudden? Furthermore, he had died so badly that not even a single complete bone could be found?
“Ah!” Someone called out first, and the remaining members of the Dongfang Clan instantly fled in panic. All of a sudden, they had disappeared without a trace.
Ge Qianqiu didn’t give chase. In reality, if Dongfang Bai hadn’t been so forceful, he wouldn’t have killed him.
The old man raised his head to look at the sky. He sighed, and said, “A good hiding place has been destroyed. Looks like this is the will of the heavens!”

After the blood sacrifice, flaws appeared in the paramount Regulations. Even the Primordial Source Clay couldn’t suppress his vitality from seeping out. It couldn’t be helped; he was too powerful. Thus, there was no meaning for him to stay here any longer.
Ge Qianqiu swept an eye over the crowd, and when his gaze passed over them, even the Imperial Son couldn’t help but lower his head, not daring to make eye contact.
However, when his gaze shifted to Ling Han, he discovered that this young man was actually looking back at him without the slightest fear.
Yi?

Though the old man had already met Ling Han once, at that time, he had restrained all his aura, and Ling Han was only able to converse with him frankly. But now, his sharpness was slightly revealed, and it was definitely not something that a True Self Tier could withstand.

‘He has the potential to become Emperor,’ he thought to himself. Suddenly, a killing intent rose up in him, which instantly turned into tumultuous waves, causing everyone to feel chills all over their bodies, as if they had fallen into an ice cave.

“Hehe, after experiencing so much, why can’t I see through my obsession?” The old man shook his head internally, “This brat is so young. Even if I want to compete with him for a sliver of fated opportunity, that would be a matter for a very long time later.”
“Let’s go, let’s go.” Ge Qianqiu chuckled, and with a flick of his sleeve, the entire Island of the Sky rumbled. Then, he was seen tearing through the air, and actually tore a rip into the skies.

Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. They could all sense Ge Qianqiu’s killing intent just now, and if a Saint made a move on them, then even Substitution Seal would not be able to take effect, and all of them could only die on the spot.
After circling around the gates of hell, who wouldn’t be afraid?
Ling Han looked up at the sky. This place had been sealed off by the Regulations of the highest level, yet now, a hole had been forcefully created.

“Beauty Chi,” he said, “This place has been sealed off by the Regulations of the highest level. Even Saints won’t be able to break through it, right? They can only rely on the Imperial Weapon to break through it?”
“Correct,” Chi Menghan replied with a nod. A look of astonishment spread across her face.
Hiss, then how did Ge Qianqiu do it?
Did he have the Imperial Weapon on him?
“Ling Han!” A cold humph rang out, and Lin Yun had already charged over.
Not only him, but also Shi Hao.

“Beauty Chi, I’ll take my leave first. We’ll meet again.” Ling Han stretched out a hand and grabbed both the large black dog and the little azure dragon. He activated the Star Steps, and xiu, he had already disappeared without a trace.
“Hey, give me back my pig!” the silver-haired little lolita shouted. The lecherous pig was still hanging from the large black dog’s neck.
Boom, right at this moment, a great many people flew in from the opening above the island. There was no shortage of Sect Master elites.
—The seal of Regulations had been removed.
“What’s going on here?” a Sect Master elite asked. He came from the Imperial Clan, and was also the Dao Protector of one of the Imperial Sons.
Everyone related the situation, and instantly, those elites were stunned.
...There was actually a Natural-born Stone Spirit here!
—The Dongfang Clan was outrageously bold, to actually dare to kill members of the Imperial Clans!
—A Saint was cultivating in seclusion here, and had just appeared!
Every piece of news had a shocking effect, and added together, even the Sect Master elites would be stunned for a moment.
But only after a while, these elites came back to their senses.
“Spread the news, a warrant is issued on all the surviving dregs of the Dongfang Clan, no restrictions on their life or death!”
“Go and investigate that Saint Ge, and find out who he is everywhere.”
“Also... report back to the clan, Ling Han actually dared to kill an Imperial Son!”
This time, Ling Han’s name was really about to soar sky-high. Not only had he killed four Imperial Sons in this battle, there was even one that belonged to the Silver Generation.
The Imperial Clans were furious. If they didn’t kill Ling Han, what face would they have left?
Speaking of Ling Han, after he used the Star Steps to leave, he immediately took out the formation foundations and brought the large black dog and the little azure dragon back to the Sky Planet.
The blockade of the Regulations of the highest level had been broken, so the Transfer Formation was naturally usable.
Without the slightest hesitation, he immediately began to cross galaxies.
He couldn’t stay here any longer. Otherwise, he would be in big trouble.

At the same time, he also released the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower from his mind, keeping it close to him. In this way, with the Origin Gold to conceal his aura, he was sure that even Saints would not be able to predict his whereabouts.

“It’s over, it’s over. From now onwards, we’ll really be blacklisted. Before we become Saints, we can only conceal our identities,” the large black dog wailed. He had just heard Ling Han say that as many as four Imperial Sons had died in his hands.

In the past, though there had been nine great Imperial Clans hunting Ling Han down, Ling Han had only scammed the Imperial Sons at that time. These Imperial Sons had not died, nor were they severely wounded.
But now?
This was really equivalent to having stirred up a hornet’s nest.
“Good kill.” The little azure dragon clapped. He was also someone who feared nothing in the world.
The pervert pig left quietly, tiptoeing cautiously.
Ling Han’s eyes were sharp, and he immediately grabbed it. “Fat pig, why are you running? When we encountered danger just now, you knew to pounce towards me, and now you’re kicking me to the curb?”
“In your dreams!” the large black dog bawled. “Come, let’s share the burden.”
“Zhi! Zhi! Zhi!” The perverted pig screamed and struggled repeatedly. It wanted to lie in the arms of the beautiful sister, b@stard!
The four of them roamed around in the universe for a while, then began to investigate the current situation.
As expected, the Imperial Clans were enraged, and issued a killing order to the world.
