chapters.title: Chapter 4258: Chang Clan moves
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The Baili Clan of the Ziwei Imperial Clan, the Shi Clan of Golden Cauldron Imperial Clan, the Xu Clan of White Feather Imperial Clan, and the Guan Clan of Xuanfeng Imperial Clan all issued a must-kill order at the same time, demanding Ling Han’s head.
Anyone who could bring Ling Han’s corpse to the four great Imperial Clans could request to cultivate any Imperial Technique, and obtain a favor from the Imperial Clans.
When the news spread out, the whole world was shaken.
This decision was too firm. This was absolute determination to kill Ling Han.

And right at this moment, the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm also issued a must-kill order, similarly hunting down Ling Han. However, the conditions they offered were much lower. They only promised to teach the Saint Technique, and similarly promised a favor from the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm.
They also joined in on the fun. This wasn’t strange. After all, Ling Han had killed Shi Mie from the Buddhist Land and almost burned the three Bodhisattvas to death.

He had only offended five Imperial Clans in one go. Oh, that’s right, there was also the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan — Lin Lang’s death had already been confirmed by the Lin Clan to be his fault, and in the case of the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, Ling Han had killed Hong Tianbu.

Thus, there were as many as seven Imperial Clans that were determined to kill him, and there were also a few Imperial Sons that he had humiliated before. If they were added into the equation, the number of parties out for his head would probably be in the double digits.
“Little Han, Grandpa Dog is impressed by your ability to attract trouble,” the large black dog sighed.
Ling Han smiled. After so many days, the Imperial Clans had finally issued a bounty, yet no elite had caught up to them. What did this mean?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was indeed capable of concealing the twists of fate, such that even Saints couldn’t predict its whereabouts.
All right, then he would just develop himself secretly. As long as he advanced into Saint Tier, or advanced into Saint Tier in formations, so what if they were the Imperial Clans?
The Imperial Weapon was indeed powerful, but it was still an inanimate object.
“I’ll connect to the Galaxy Network and take a look.”
At present, they were only scouting out the situation on a certain planet. Whatever they had heard from others naturally was only the tip of the iceberg.
After connecting to the Galaxy Network, it was really lively now. News of Ling Han and the others were spamming everywhere.

Some people admired him. This guy even dared to trifle with the Imperial Clans. He was truly awesome. Of course, there were also those who mocked and ridiculed him, thinking that Ling Han was definitely going to die now. He had really angered the Imperial Clans, and if even Saints moved, Ling Han would not be able to escape this tribulation.

“Little Han, your name has truly shaken the galaxy now. I’m afraid that no one will not know about you in the future,” the large black dog remarked. “For the sake of Grandpa Dog’s safety, it would be best for me to keep my distance from you in future.”
“Yes, yes, yes.” The little azure dragon nodded as well.
The pervert pig was even more direct. He used his two claws to drag the large black dog and little azure dragon, looking like they was going to leave Ling Han behind and flee on their own.
These guys!
Ling Han studied it for a while longer. Was there any new ancient site that had opened, which could allow him to earn some extra income and hide for a while?
However, he is anticipation had been for nothing.
“That Old Man Ge... who exactly is he?” Ling Han asked in curiosity. Ge Qianqiu was definitely no ordinary Saint, as he had actually managed to break through the Regulations’ blockade.

“The existence of the supreme Regulations should be due to the Natural-born Stone Spirit,” the large black dog analyzed. “With the Natural-born Stone Spirit appearing, the supreme Regulations will definitely dissipate slowly. When it becomes weak to a certain extent, it’s not impossible for it to be destroyed by a Saint.”

“That’s right. Previously, after the Imperial Clans tried it out, they discovered that they couldn’t enter without an Imperial Weapon. Then, there would definitely be no one who would be bored enough to try it out again.” The little azure dragon continued, “So, after such a long time, the supreme Regulations should have mostly worn off.”
“I’m sure we’ll see this old man again in the future,” Ling Han said. He didn’t plan to continue this topic, because aside from Ge Qianqiu himself, no one else should know just how strong he was.
“Little Han, where are we going to have fun next?” the large black dog asked.
“What’s the point of having fun? Keep a low profile, understand?” Ling Han said with a smile.
At the same time, in the Four Directions Imperial Clan, Chang Clan.
The Chang Clan today was slightly out of the ordinary, because four Saints had shockingly arrived. They had respectively come from the four Imperial Clans, Shi, Guan, Xu and Baili Clans.
This was naturally a grand show of force. Thus, the Chang Clan also sent out a Saint to accompany them.
“That brat has connected to the Galaxy Network.” At this moment, a member of the Chang Clan arrived at the main hall, and reported this to the Chang Clan’s Saint.
“Where?” the Saint from the Chang Clan asked.
“East Heavenly Realm, Offspring Galaxy, Icy Sea Planet,” that clansman said.

“All right, you may leave.” The Chang Clan’s Saint waved him off, then turned to look at the Saints from the Shi Clan, Guan Clan and the other Clans, “Friends, the Chang Clan has made an exception for you. This matter must not be spread out!”
The four Imperial Clans had come to ask the Chang Clan to help them locate Ling Han’s whereabouts.

However, the Chang Clan had always boasted that they only had the right to protect the Galaxy Network, and could not interfere in its management, but now it was proven that this was obviously nonsense.
The Galaxy Network was the private property of the Chang Clan, and only ordinary members of the Chang Clan were not qualified to know about it.
Thus, this matter definitely could not be spread out, or it would cause a great commotion.
Who would still dare to use Galaxy Network?
“All right.” The four Saints all nodded, “We owe the Chang Clan a favor.”
Meanwhile, the Saint from the Chang Clan waved a hand dismissively, which could be considered as asking them to leave.

Ling Han was still worried about the Galaxy Network, because the Imperial Clans had never used the Galaxy Network before. There must be a reason for this. Thus, after he found out about the situation, he immediately threw away the connection device, and quickly left this planet.

Anyone who could bring Ling Han’s corpse to the four great Imperial Clans could request to cultivate any Imperial Technique, and obtain a favor from the Imperial Clans.
When the news spread out, the whole world was shaken.
This decision was too firm.
This was absolute determination to kill Ling Han.
And right at this moment, the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm also issued a must-kill order, similarly hunting down Ling Han.
However, the conditions they offered were much lower.
They only promised to teach the Saint Technique, and similarly promised a favor from the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm.
They also joined in on the fun.
This wasn’t strange.
After all, Ling Han had killed Shi Mie from the Buddhist Land and almost burned the three Bodhisattvas to death.
He had only offended five Imperial Clans in one go.

If they were added into the equation, the number of parties out for his head would probably be in the double digits.

After so many days, the Imperial Clans had finally issued a bounty, yet no elite had caught up to them.
What did this mean?
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was indeed capable of concealing the twists of fate, such that even Saints couldn’t predict its whereabouts.

chapters.title: Chapter 4259: A Powerful Threat
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“What!” Ling Han suddenly stood up.

Previously, the nine great Imperial Clans had once besieged the Nine Suns Holy Land. However, at that time, Ling Han had already left the Nine Suns Holy Land. The Holy Land’s side had also released an announcement, saying that Ling Han would be expelled from the Nine Suns Holy Land, and from then onwards, there would be no relation between the two.

Though the Imperial Clans were awesome, without solid proof, they did not dare to raze the Nine Suns Holy Land Clan to the ground. After all, there had been precedents in the history of the Nine Suns Holy Land. When a new Emperor ascended the throne, there would be a reckoning.
At first, he had thought that this matter would be over, and there would be no more worries. He had not thought that it would come again.
“The Imperial Clans are getting serious now, and they’re planning to be shameless now,” the large black dog said. “They’re forcing you to show yourself.”
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “Why do they think that I’ll appear?”

Others didn’t know that he had two beautiful wives that had stayed behind in the Nine Suns Holy Land. According to normal people’s logic, who would sacrifice themselves to save an old sect that had expelled them?
“Probable because there is nothing else they can do,” the little azure dragon said. “They’ll try everything they can.”

The Saint’s divination had been unsuccessful, and Ling Han was also very alert. Every time he connected to the Galaxy Network, he would switch locations. Even if the Imperial Clans had overwhelming power, they could not possibly find him.
Thus, the Nine Suns Holy Land was probably the last straw that they could clutch onto.

“They’ve really caught me off guard,” Ling Han said with a bitter smile. It wasn’t just because of Hu Niu and the empress. He couldn’t possibly sit by and watch as the Nine Suns Holy Land was destroyed because of him. To say nothing else, the Nine Mountains Venerate treated him like a son, so how could he not repay this kindness?
“Huh? You’re not really going to walk right into a trap, are you?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “I definitely have to go to the Nine Suns Holy Land. However, to say that I’m going to walk right into their trap... I won’t go so far!”
He bought another connecting device, and then made contact with the Nine Mountains Venerate.
The two of them discussed for a long time. Then, Ling Han threw away the connection device and immediately went to another planet.
“How is it?” the large black dog asked.
“Come, let’s go to the Nine Suns Holy Land,” Ling Han said.
“You’re really going?” the little azure dragon asked.
The perverted pig directly hugged a pillar, as if he was resolutely expressing his stand that it was impossible for him to leave.
Ling Han grabbed it and said, “Let’s go.”
“Zhi!” the pervert pig screamed. He didn’t want to die, b@stard.
They began to traverse the universe, heading towards the Nine Suns Holy Land.

Why had the Imperial Clans set a time limit of a year? Of course, they were afraid that Ling Han was too far away, and would not be able to make it back in time. And with a time limit of a year, unless he was at the edge of the universe, it was absolutely impossible that he would not be able to make it back in time.
Only three months later, they arrived at the Nine Suns Planet.
With the cover of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, the Soul Forming Technique, and a formations grandmaster’s ability, the four of them came quietly without alerting anyone.
Ling Han entered the Nine Suns Holy Land by himself, but he only stayed for a short while before leaving.
“Little Han, what on earth are you playing at?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han smiled, “Don’t be anxious, you have to be patient.”

How could the large black dog and little azure dragon endure this? The one year deadline was drawing closer and closer, yet the threat posed by the five Imperial Clans was extremely real. How were they supposed to deal with this?
These were Imperial Clans. This time, in order to suppress the Nine Suns Holy Land, Saints would definitely come personally. Just ask the Nine Suns Holy Land, how would they be able to block it?
A Saint Tool?
Heh, how could a Saint Tool rival an actual Saint? Moreover, how many Saints would be arriving this time?
However, they believed that Ling Han definitely wouldn’t die for nothing, nor would he bring them along with him to die. Thus, they still suppressed their urges and waited quietly.
Only the perverted pig wanted to flee all day long, but aside from its invincible defense, it was no different from an ordinary piglet. Naturally, it was captured time and time again.
All of a sudden, a year’s time had passed.
Ling Han’s improvement was limited. He had only just advanced the second Stone Fetus to Silver Fetus, and this was still based on the fact that he had previously ingested three Evolution Fruits.

On this day, the five great Imperial Clans charged over. The Shi Clan, Xu Clan, Guan Clan, Baili Clan, and the Buddhist Race of the West Heavenly Realm were here. All these parties were led by a Saint respectively.

“Nine Suns Holy Land, this the deadline. Hand over the unfilial son, Ling Han, or we’ll massacre this place!” the Saint from the Guan Clan said calmly. However, how powerful was a Saint? His words were law, and instantly, the sky above Nine Suns Holy Land was covered with dark clouds.
And this scene was also broadcasted live on the Galaxy Network through the connection device.
“He’s done for.”

“Even if the Nine Suns Holy Land is a veteran Holy Land, it’s not like the how it had been when the Nine Suns Saint was present, after all. Now, there isn’t even a Saint. With just the Saint Tool, how can they stop five Saints?”
“It’s all Ling Han’s fault for implicating the Nine Suns Holy Land. I’m afraid that from now onwards, this Nine Suns Holy Land will disappear from the universe.”
“Che, how could this be blamed on Ling Han? If it was not for those Imperial Sons being overbearing, how could Ling Han have killed anyone?”
“Shh, watch your words. Even a Holy Land is about to be razed to the ground, so don’t seek death!”

The Galaxy Network was filled with sighs. In the past, the Imperial Clans would always abide by a bottom line, but now that the five great Imperial Clans were ganging up on the Nine Suns Holy Land, they obviously planned to break this bottom line.
It could not be helped. If they did not kill Ling Han, what face would the Imperial Clans have left?
Xiu, in the Nine Suns Holy Land, a Venerate Tier elite appeared.

He was Anyun Venerate. Originally, he would be “enjoying his retirement” in the Mountain Sea Heaven, and would either become a Saint, or die of old age within. However, the Mountain Sea Heaven was occupied by Yin souls, so he could only return to the Nine Suns Holy Land, and completely abandon all thoughts of becoming a Saint.
“Lords, Ling Han has long since been expelled by our sect, so how would our sect hand him over?” he argued reasonably.

The Bright Sun Buddha opened his mouth, and said in a hoarse voice, “This is your business. In any case, this unfilial brat came from your Nine Suns Holy Land, and has now committed a heinous crime. Do you think you can just pat your behinds and stay out of this matter?”
Anyun Venerate couldn’t help but feel anger rise up in him. Wasn’t this all caused by the Imperial Clans?
Who would trifle with an Imperial Clan elite for no reason?
Oh, your Imperial Clans went to bully others, yet now that you’ve been rebuffed, you are making outrageous demands?
He was grumbling internally, but of course, he would not say that out loud. He only emphasized that the Nine Suns Holy Land indeed did not know where Ling Han had gone.
“All right, then there is nothing more to say.” The Saint of the Guan Clan stated calmly, “Let’s first raze the Nine Suns Holy Land to the ground.”
“All right.” The other Saints nodded respectively.
“Aren’t you afraid that a new Emperor will appear in the future and call you to account?” Venerate Anyun roared.

“What a joke,” the Baili Saint said coldly. “This generation’s new Emperor will definitely appear among the Golden Generation, and once the curse of an Imperial Clan never producing another Emperor is broken, with the wealth of the Imperial Clans, how could the subsequent new Emperor appear among lowly commoners like you?”
In the future, the Ancestral King would forever be under the control of the Imperial Clan . Thus, as for the reckoning from the new Emperor, hehe, what need was there for them to be concerned?
Anyun Venerate couldn’t help but feel ashen. The Nine Suns Holy Land... were they really going to die?
“Attack!” The five Saints all humphed coldly, and raised their hands respectively.

“Hehe, old friends, can you give me some face?” Right at this moment, an old man rapidly streaked over from the distance. Shua, shua, shua, as if he was traveling through time. At first, he was still very far away, but in an instant, he had arrived on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 4260: Mediator
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This was an old man with a slender figure. He arrived in a flash, leaving behind a long fragmented image of the Void behind him.
To be able to address five Saints as brothers, it was naturally self-evident what cultivation level this old man was at.
A sixth Saint!
Ling Han focused his gaze, and saw that there was another woman beside the old man. She was breathtakingly beautiful.
Yi, Chi Menghan.

Ling Han had never seen the true appearance of this beauty ranked third in the universe before, but he was naturally familiar with her temperament and features. He could recognize her with a single glance. However, he had never thought that he would actually see her true appearance in such a situation.
True, to still be wearing a veil in front of a Saint was firstly, disrespectful, and secondly, it was useless.
By the looks of it, this newly arrived Saint was from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Friend Chi, why did you call us to a halt?” the Saint from the Baili Clan asked.
This Saint that had come from the Chi Clan was none other than the Crystal Saint. He chuckled, and said, “I would like to ask my brothers to give me some face, and spare the Nine Suns Holy Land.”
The five Saints exchanged looks. They had not thought that the Chi Clan would actually stand on the side of the Nine Suns Holy Land.

Ling Han, meanwhile, was filled with gratitude. The Chi Clan would take the risk of offending the five great Imperial Clans to step out. This must be the credit of Chi Menghan. With her identity as Imperial Daughter, and aptitude that was comparable to the aptitude of the Golden Generation, her weight was still quite heavy.
However, she had definitely made a huge sacrifice to be able to summon a Saint.
Ever since coming to this new world, though Ling Han had always been cynical, he had never thought of getting involved in any kind of romantic debts, but this favor... was really too great.
How could he repay the deep love of a beautiful woman?
“Hehe!” The large black dog placed his paw on Ling Han’s shoulder.
“Hehe.” The little azure dragon also rested a paw on Ling Han’s other shoulder.
“Zhi!” The perverted pig was extremely displeased. F*ck, he actually dared to snatch a girl from him!
The five Saints fell silent for a moment, before the Saint of the Shi Clan said, “Friend Chi, I’m afraid I can’t comply with your request!”

The Imperial Son was killed, but the Imperial Clans were still unable to act. The longer the time passed, the greater the effects on the Imperial Clans. Others may not know, but how could it be that the Imperial Clans were unaware of the dangers involved?
The Crystal Saint smiled, and said, “Since that’s the case, I have nothing else to say.”
He clasped his hands behind his back, looking like he was going to stay out of this.
Yi, it ended just like that?

Ling Han came to a sudden realization. Although Chi Menghan was the most outstanding princess of the Chi Clan, she was still only a True Self Tier cultivator, after all. The Chi Clan definitely couldn’t offend the five Imperial Clans for her sake.

Thus, the Crystal Saint was only going through the motions. It was naturally best if he could persuade the five great Imperial Clan Clans to retreat. If hecouldn’t, then he had no plans to turn completley hostile and start a war.

This was very logical. Aside from the Chi sisters and Chi Dao, the other members of the Chi Clan weren’t familiar with Ling Han either. Was there any need for them to fight the Imperial Clans for his sake? Moreover, it was five clans at that. If they really fought, there was a 99% chance that the Chi Clan would be finished.
—If Ling Han had now become a Venerate Tier elite, the Chi Clan would probably take a gamble, betting that Ling Han would become Emperor, but now, hoho.

The five Saints smiled in unison. They knew that the Chi Clan wouldn’t dare to get serious, because the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have any relations with the Chi Clan. They didn’t have any benefits or relations with the Nine Suns Holy Land. Who would be so stupid?

“Ants, accept your fate.” The Saint of the Shi Clan moved, and pressed down on the Nine Suns Saint. Boom, his right hand took the form of a colossal palm. It was really as big as a planet, and was covered densely with stars and Regulations.

Even if the Nine Suns Planet had been strengthened by Saint-level power, being attacked by a Saint-level power would only be the matter of a few more palm strikes, at most, and it was guaranteed that they would disappear from the universe.
This was how domineering Saints were. They weren’t targeting an individual at all, and they were directly destroying planets!

The speed of this palm strike was not very fast, so everyone could clearly see it. And precisely because of this, not only did despair rise up in the hearts of every disciple of Nine Suns Holy Land, even the ordinary people in other places were paralyzed with fear. They did not even know why they had suffered such a calamity.
“Little Han!” the little azure dragon and the large black dog both shouted. The perverted pig squeaked. Although it was amazing, it couldn’t withstand the attacks of Saints!
—Where are your trump cards? Hurry up and release them!

“Humph, you dare to be impudent in our Nine Suns Holy Land!” At this moment, a loud shout was heard. It was as majestic and bright as if opening the sky and striking the earth, and reverberated through the universe.

A large hand suddenly swatted out, greeting that giant palm in the skies. Its speed was much faster, and in a flash, it had touched that giant palm. Boom, instantly, two giant hands that were comparable to planets crashed into each other, creating a terrifying, boundless shockwave.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! It was as if the whole sky was filled with fireworks. Those were Regulations. Those were high-level energies, interwoven into pieces that were incredibly dazzling.
Yi? En? Ya?
In this moment, everyone was incredibly stunned.
What was going on?
Who was attacking? They had actually blocked the Saint’s attack?
Even though the Saint from the Shi Clan had only attacked casually, even Venerate Tier elites would be crushed into smithereens. Thus, the person who had withstood this attack was definitely a Saint.
But the problem here was, where did the Nine Suns Holy Land get a Saint?
“A newly advanced Saint?” Including the Crystal Saint, the six Saints all looked surprised.

They were all veteran Saints, so they could naturally tell with a single glance that the person who had attacked them was a newly advanced Saint. He was still very unfamiliar with the use of Regulations.
The little azure dragon and the large black dog looked pleasantly surprised at the same time. They looked at Ling Han and asked, “Could it be?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, “That’s right!”
Shua, a figure appeared in the skies, facing off against the five Saints. Though it was only one person, his aura was not weak at all, exuding a bold and unrestrained wildness.
Nine Mountains!
“Saint!” the six Saints exclaimed in unison. They could naturally tell that the Regulations of this person was very reserved. This was the symbol of becoming a Saint.
What, the Nine Mountains Venerate had become a Saint?
The disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land were all surprised. Yi, this was too low-key, wasn’t it? They actually had absolutely no idea!
But in an instant, they began to cheer.
With a Saint standing guard, that would be a top-notch force in the world. Even the Imperial Clan would have to treat them with caution.
This time, they were saved!
The Nine Mountains Venerate looked down at the five Saints. The Crystal Saint stood very far away, and looked like he was watching from the sidelines. He said calmly, “Now, you can all get lost!”
How domineering!
He was too domineering. Faced with the five Saints, he directly rebuked them to scram. The only one in this world that had done this was Nine Mountains!

All the disciples felt their blood boil with excitement. Previously, they had been oppressed by the Imperial Clan elites, and their lives were completely in the hands of others. How sullen would that be? But in the blink of an eye, the Nine Mountains Saint had moved aggressively, and with a single word of “get lost”, it could be said that he had spat out all the displeasure and fury in everyone’s hearts.

They were all filled with reverence for the Nine Mountains Saint. This had actually transformed into some kind of power that boosted onto the Nine Mountains Saint, causing him to radiate with light, making him appear even more divine and domineering.
The Saint of the Shi Clan and the other clans exchanged looks, all of them frowning.

chapters.title: Chapter 4261: Domineering rebuke to withdraw
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
As it turned out, this could not be any easier to suppress.
When a Saint moved, no matter how many Venerate Tier elites there were, no matter if you had a Saint Tool or not, it was only a matter of a few more palm strikes.
However, the Nine Suns Holy Land actually produced a Saint?
This would not be easy to deal with.

“This is truly unexpected!” The Saint of the Shi Clan chuckled, and said, “Nine Mountains, right? Let me offer my congratulations first. You’ve broken through to the Saint Tier, and now that you’ve reached this level, you’re more or less standing at the pinnacle of the world. You truly have the right to speak.”

“However!” The Saint from the Guan Clan continued, “Perhaps you know, or perhaps you don’t. Saints are the same as Venerate Tiers, and can be divided into nine levels. You are presently only a One Star Saint, and as for us? Hehe, we are all Three Star Saints!”

“In a one-on-one battle, you have absolutely no chance of winning, what more when there are a total of five of us!” The Saint of the Shi Clan continued, “Since you are also a Saint, you can be considered to have leaped out of a small mud pool. We can give you some face, and you can leave now. You will no longer have any relation with the Nine Suns Holy Land.”
“Otherwise, we would be killing a Saint today!” the Saint from Baili Clan said balefully.

Unless it was absolutely necessary, Saints would not start a battle with each other. At this cultivation level, they were all manifestations of the Regulations. Firstly, they were difficult to kill, and secondly, if they really fought to the death, then as long as the gap in cultivation level was not more than three stars, even if they could win, they would have to pay a very great price.
Even if it was five against one!
Thus, they would rather spare the Nine Mountains Saint than force him into desperate straits.
—A Saint would be treated with respect by the Imperial Clans. How could this be a joke?
Hearing these words from the five Saints, the members of the Nine Suns Holy Land felt a chill in their hearts again.
That’s right. The Nine Mountains Saint was only one person. Furthermore, he had only just broken through to Saint Tier. How could he be a match for the five Saints?

Nine Mountains had lived for more than 80,000 years, and in the case of Venerate Tier, he was about to reach the end of his lifespan. However, he was now a Saint, and theoretically speaking, his lifespan was as long as a million years. It could be said that his lifespan had just begun.
In that case, would the Nine Mountains Saint still put his life on the line at this moment?
Was he an idiot?
All of a sudden, everyone was incredibly nervous, fearing that the Nine Mountains Saint would turn around and leave.
Meanwhile, the Nine Mountains Saint laughed loudly, and said, “Don’t you people understand human language? I already told you to scram!”
This!

The five Saints were all enraged, furious, and confused. Aside from the Great Emperor, who else had the right to reprimand them like this? However, they were also confused. Where had the Nine Mountains Saint gotten such confidence from?
Was this guy not afraid of death?
His life had only just begun, what more when a great era was about to begin. No matter what, a newly advanced Saint would consider breaking through to the Imperial Path, right?
‘You’re so willing to accept this?’
“Nine Mountains, are you courting death?” the Baili Saint asked balefully. His killing intent blazed.
So what if he was a Saint? He was only a newly advanced Saint. With the five Saints working together, even if they had to make some sacrifices, they would still be able to kill him on the spot.
The Nine Mountains Saint smiled. Weng! A precious tower immediately materialized above his head, exuding Primal Chaos Qi. It was more so enveloped in lightning, radiating with a paramount might.
This scene was too shocking!
The six Saints, including the Crystal Saint, were all moved at the same time.
This, this, this was an Imperial Weapon!
How could this be! How could this be!

The Imperial Weapons in the world were numbered, and there were only as many Imperial Weapons as there were Imperial Clans in the world. No more, and no less. Then, where had the Imperial Weapon in the hands of Nine Mountains come from?
To say nothing of borrowing it, there were indeed Imperial Weapons from some Imperial Clans that was tower-shaped, but it was definitely not forged by this kind of Origin Gold.
Thus, this was an Imperial Weapon that belonged to Nine Mountains!
What kind of concept was this?
An Imperial Weapon that he had forged himself could unleash its might at any time, which was completely different from the Imperial Clan’s Imperial Weapon.
In an era when there was no Emperor in the world, having an Imperial Weapon in hand was equivalent to being invincible!
All of a sudden, the five Saints felt suffocated.
What could they do?
They hadn’t brought the Imperial Weapon with them.
—Just to erase a Holy Land, they still needed to use the Imperial Weapon? What kind of joke was that!
In that case, though Nine Mountains Saint was only a One Star Saint, but added with the Imperial Weapon... what Saint would dare to face him head-on?

“Nine Mountains, you’re not the only one who has an Imperial Weapon!” the Baili Saint said. “Even if you force us to leave this time, we can still bring an Imperial Weapon with us next time. You’ll still be outmatched!”

The Nine Mountains Saint was proud, and he said, “You’re right. Thus, the next time I see you two, I’ll immediately tear a rip into the Void and leave. Then, I’ll start to conquer your lairs one by one!”
The expressions of the five Saints changed drastically upon hearing this.

This was a blatant threat. If you dare to bring the Imperial Weapon to the Nine Suns Holy Land, then I would also dare to bring the Imperial Weapon to your Imperial Clans. Worse come to worst, both sides would be severely wounded.

The Imperial Clan was indeed impressive, but half of their power came from the Imperial Weapon. Without the Imperial Weapon keeping watch, how could they possibly stop a Saint that had brought the Imperial Weapon with him?
The five Saints were instantly rendered speechless.
Why was it that when the Imperial Clans got along peacefully with each other, and had occasional conflicts, they would not really fight to the death?
Wasn’t it because everyone had an Imperial Weapon? This was a deadly weapon, and they were all wary of each other.
Right now, the Nine Suns Holy Land had a Saint, as well as an Imperial Weapon, so how could it still be a Holy Land?
No, this was an Imperial Clan!
The Imperial Clan could not be offended, and this was a fact that was known to the whole world.
F***, what the f***!

The five Saints all felt extremely vexed. They had clearly come to raze them to the ground, yet now, it was as if they had swallowed an entire bowl of flies. This was an indescribably horrible feeling.
On the other hand, on the side of the Nine Suns Holy Land, every disciple felt their blood boil with excitement, feeling a pride that they had never felt before.
To reprimand Saints, only I, Nine Mountains, can do it!

The Nine Mountains Saint continued, “From today onwards, Ling Han will return to our Nine Suns Holy Land! I am not concerned about normal battles. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, even if Ling Han dies, I will not pursue the matter. However, if anyone dares to pick on the weak, then don’t blame me for being ruthless!”
Domineering! Protecting his own people!
So what if the five great Imperial Clans joined forces to hunt Ling Han down? I don’t care at all, and even took Ling Han as my disciple again right in front of your eyes.
‘Do you yield or not? So what if you don’t? There’s only one word for it, and that’s battle!’

Furthermore, if they wanted to target Ling Han in future, that was fine. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he would not interfere, but if it was targeting him through someone with a higher cultivation level than Lin Han, then he would bring the Imperial Weapon to his doorstep.

Now that things had come to this, the five Saints couldn’t bring themselves to stay any longer. Wasn’t this completely watching the performance of the Nine Mountains Saint? And they were nothing but a pitiful background to his brilliance.
“Let’s go!” One after another, they flew away. They had all decided internally that they would send out the elites of the Fifth Form or even the Sixth Form of the True Self Tier to kill Ling Han.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The five Saints left, one after another.
Meanwhile, the Crystal Saint didn’t leave. He had come to lend a hand. Although he wasn’t of much use, he had still come with good intentions.

“Friend Nine Mountains, congratulations!” He laughed loudly, his mind racing. Originally, Ling Han had no one to rely on, and was just a commoner, but it was a different story now. He had become Imperial Son-level, completely worthy of Chi Menghan.
The Nine Mountains Saint also withdrew his domineering aura. He clasped his hands in the direction of the Crystal Saint, and said, “Thank you, Friend Crystal. Come and have a cup of tea.”
“Sure!”

Domineering!
Protecting his own people!
So what if the five great Imperial Clans joined forces to hunt Ling Han down?
I don’t care at all, and even took Ling Han as my disciple again right in front of your eyes.
‘Do you yield or not?
So what if you don’t?
There’s only one word for it, and that’s battle!’
Furthermore, if they wanted to target Ling Han in future, that was fine.

In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he would not interfere, but if it was targeting him through someone with a higher cultivation level than Lin Han, then he would bring the Imperial Weapon to his doorstep.
Now that things had come to this, the five Saints couldn’t bring themselves to stay any longer.
Wasn’t this completely watching the performance of the Nine Mountains Saint?
And they were nothing but a pitiful background to his brilliance.
“Let’s go!” One after another, they flew away.
They had all decided internally that they would send out the elites of the Fifth Form or even the Sixth Form of the True Self Tier to kill Ling Han.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
The five Saints left, one after another.
Meanwhile, the Crystal Saint didn’t leave.
He had come to lend a hand.
Although he wasn’t of much use, he had still come with good intentions.
“Friend Nine Mountains, congratulations!” He laughed loudly, his mind racing.
Originally, Ling Han had no one to rely on, and was just a commoner, but it was a different story now.
He had become Imperial Son-level, completely worthy of Chi Menghan.
The Nine Mountains Saint also withdrew his domineering aura.
He clasped his hands in the direction of the Crystal Saint, and said, “Thank you, Friend Crystal.
Come and have a cup of tea.”
“Sure!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4262 - 4260: Mediator
paragraphs: Chapter 4260: Mediator
Editor: Henyee Translations
This was an old man with a slender figure. He arrived in a flash, leaving behind a long fragmented image of the Void behind him.
To be able to address five Saints as brothers, it was naturally self-evident what cultivation level this old man was at.
A sixth Saint!
Ling Han focused his gaze, and saw that there was another woman beside the old man. She was breathtakingly beautiful.
Yi, Chi Menghan.

Ling Han had never seen the true appearance of this beauty ranked third in the universe before, but he was naturally familiar with her temperament and features. He could recognize her with a single glance. However, he had never thought that he would actually see her true appearance in such a situation.
True, to still be wearing a veil in front of a Saint was firstly, disrespectful, and secondly, it was useless.
By the looks of it, this newly arrived Saint was from the Donglin Imperial Clan.
“Friend Chi, why did you call us to a halt?” the Saint from the Baili Clan asked.
This Saint that had come from the Chi Clan was none other than the Crystal Saint. He chuckled, and said, “I would like to ask my brothers to give me some face, and spare the Nine Suns Holy Land.”
The five Saints exchanged looks. They had not thought that the Chi Clan would actually stand on the side of the Nine Suns Holy Land.

Ling Han, meanwhile, was filled with gratitude. The Chi Clan would take the risk of offending the five great Imperial Clans to step out. This must be the credit of Chi Menghan. With her identity as Imperial Daughter, and aptitude that was comparable to the aptitude of the Golden Generation, her weight was still quite heavy.
However, she had definitely made a huge sacrifice to be able to summon a Saint.
Ever since coming to this new world, though Ling Han had always been cynical, he had never thought of getting involved in any kind of romantic debts, but this favor... was really too great.
How could he repay the deep love of a beautiful woman?
“Hehe!” The large black dog placed his paw on Ling Han’s shoulder.
“Hehe.” The little azure dragon also rested a paw on Ling Han’s other shoulder.
“Zhi!” The perverted pig was extremely displeased. F*ck, he actually dared to snatch a girl from him!
The five Saints fell silent for a moment, before the Saint of the Shi Clan said, “Friend Chi, I’m afraid I can’t comply with your request!”

The Imperial Son was killed, but the Imperial Clans were still unable to act. The longer the time passed, the greater the effects on the Imperial Clans. Others may not know, but how could it be that the Imperial Clans were unaware of the dangers involved?
The Crystal Saint smiled, and said, “Since that’s the case, I have nothing else to say.”
He clasped his hands behind his back, looking like he was going to stay out of this.
Yi, it ended just like that?

Ling Han came to a sudden realization. Although Chi Menghan was the most outstanding princess of the Chi Clan, she was still only a True Self Tier cultivator, after all. The Chi Clan definitely couldn’t offend the five Imperial Clans for her sake.

Thus, the Crystal Saint was only going through the motions. It was naturally best if he could persuade the five great Imperial Clan Clans to retreat. If hecouldn’t, then he had no plans to turn completley hostile and start a war.

This was very logical. Aside from the Chi sisters and Chi Dao, the other members of the Chi Clan weren’t familiar with Ling Han either. Was there any need for them to fight the Imperial Clans for his sake? Moreover, it was five clans at that. If they really fought, there was a 99% chance that the Chi Clan would be finished.
—If Ling Han had now become a Venerate Tier elite, the Chi Clan would probably take a gamble, betting that Ling Han would become Emperor, but now, hoho.

The five Saints smiled in unison. They knew that the Chi Clan wouldn’t dare to get serious, because the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have any relations with the Chi Clan. They didn’t have any benefits or relations with the Nine Suns Holy Land. Who would be so stupid?

“Ants, accept your fate.” The Saint of the Shi Clan moved, and pressed down on the Nine Suns Saint. Boom, his right hand took the form of a colossal palm. It was really as big as a planet, and was covered densely with stars and Regulations.

Even if the Nine Suns Planet had been strengthened by Saint-level power, being attacked by a Saint-level power would only be the matter of a few more palm strikes, at most, and it was guaranteed that they would disappear from the universe.
This was how domineering Saints were. They weren’t targeting an individual at all, and they were directly destroying planets!

The speed of this palm strike was not very fast, so everyone could clearly see it. And precisely because of this, not only did despair rise up in the hearts of every disciple of Nine Suns Holy Land, even the ordinary people in other places were paralyzed with fear. They did not even know why they had suffered such a calamity.
“Little Han!” the little azure dragon and the large black dog both shouted. The perverted pig squeaked. Although it was amazing, it couldn’t withstand the attacks of Saints!
—Where are your trump cards? Hurry up and release them!

“Humph, you dare to be impudent in our Nine Suns Holy Land!” At this moment, a loud shout was heard. It was as majestic and bright as if opening the sky and striking the earth, and reverberated through the universe.

A large hand suddenly swatted out, greeting that giant palm in the skies. Its speed was much faster, and in a flash, it had touched that giant palm. Boom, instantly, two giant hands that were comparable to planets crashed into each other, creating a terrifying, boundless shockwave.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! It was as if the whole sky was filled with fireworks. Those were Regulations. Those were high-level energies, interwoven into pieces that were incredibly dazzling.
Yi? En? Ya?
In this moment, everyone was incredibly stunned.
What was going on?
Who was attacking? They had actually blocked the Saint’s attack?
Even though the Saint from the Shi Clan had only attacked casually, even Venerate Tier elites would be crushed into smithereens. Thus, the person who had withstood this attack was definitely a Saint.
But the problem here was, where did the Nine Suns Holy Land get a Saint?
“A newly advanced Saint?” Including the Crystal Saint, the six Saints all looked surprised.

They were all veteran Saints, so they could naturally tell with a single glance that the person who had attacked them was a newly advanced Saint. He was still very unfamiliar with the use of Regulations.
The little azure dragon and the large black dog looked pleasantly surprised at the same time. They looked at Ling Han and asked, “Could it be?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, “That’s right!”
Shua, a figure appeared in the skies, facing off against the five Saints. Though it was only one person, his aura was not weak at all, exuding a bold and unrestrained wildness.
Nine Mountains!
“Saint!” the six Saints exclaimed in unison. They could naturally tell that the Regulations of this person was very reserved. This was the symbol of becoming a Saint.
What, the Nine Mountains Venerate had become a Saint?
The disciples of the Nine Suns Holy Land were all surprised. Yi, this was too low-key, wasn’t it? They actually had absolutely no idea!
But in an instant, they began to cheer.
With a Saint standing guard, that would be a top-notch force in the world. Even the Imperial Clan would have to treat them with caution.
This time, they were saved!
The Nine Mountains Venerate looked down at the five Saints. The Crystal Saint stood very far away, and looked like he was watching from the sidelines. He said calmly, “Now, you can all get lost!”
How domineering!
He was too domineering. Faced with the five Saints, he directly rebuked them to scram. The only one in this world that had done this was Nine Mountains!

All the disciples felt their blood boil with excitement. Previously, they had been oppressed by the Imperial Clan elites, and their lives were completely in the hands of others. How sullen would that be? But in the blink of an eye, the Nine Mountains Saint had moved aggressively, and with a single word of “get lost”, it could be said that he had spat out all the displeasure and fury in everyone’s hearts.

They were all filled with reverence for the Nine Mountains Saint. This had actually transformed into some kind of power that boosted onto the Nine Mountains Saint, causing him to radiate with light, making him appear even more divine and domineering.
The Saint of the Shi Clan and the other clans exchanged looks, all of them frowning.

chapters.title: Chapter 4263: Origin of the Pervert Pig
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Guan Xia was very strong.
He was a member of the Silver Generation, and his raw power was as high as 50 Heavens. If he used Imperial Technique, his battle prowess was close to 60 Heavens.
Such powerful battle prowess was enough to insta-kill Ling Han.
Thus, Ling Han naturally had no intention of fighting him head-on. Using the Star Steps, he was extremely carefree. ‘Come and chase me. If you can catch up to me, it’ll be considered your victory.’
This naturally made Guan Xia feel exasperated. No matter how strong he was, faced with a formations grandmaster that had grasped Star Steps, he could only eat dust behind him.
How many True Self Tier elites were there in this world, but how many formation grandmasters were there?
The chase continued for half a month, and in the end, Guan Xia could only leave helplessly.
If he wanted to kill Ling Han, he would have to add another condition — make it so that he would not be able to use the Star Steps.

This would require an ability to suppress the ley lines. There were two possibilities. Firstly, his abilities were strong enough, and he could cover the heavens and earth with a single hand. Then, he would have to be at least Sect Master-level, which was completely unrealistic. Secondly, a formations grandmaster naturally could snatch the right of use of the ley lines.
However, aside from a freak like Ling Han, who else in the world had achieved such accomplishments in both the path of formations and martial arts?
In the following long period of time, Ling Han lived very peacefully, and no one made a move on him again. It was as if the Imperial Clans had forgotten that Imperial Sons had died in his hands.
However, Ling Han knew that this was impossible.
The Imperial Clan was high and noble, so how could they allow others to slap their faces?
Moreover, Ling Han had only found out after chatting with the Nine Mountains Saint that this also involved a problem of power of belief.
After becoming a Saint, he himself could accommodate the Regulations of heaven and earth, allowing himself to become a manifestation of heaven and earth, but there was a limit here.

Some Saints could only accommodate 10% of Regulations, while others could accommodate 30% or even 40%. There was a problem of natural talent involved, but it also involved another matter, and that was the power of belief.
If there were a large number of people who believed in a Saint, they would form a kind of power of will, so that the Saint would be able to accommodate more heaven and earth Regulations.
These believers didn’t need to be very strong, and only depended on the number of people.

Thus, those forces that had reached Saint-level would all run around in circles, and among them, the most terrifying were the Buddhist Race and the Chang Clan. The Buddhist Race had always been promoting faith, and in the case of the Chang Clan, with the help of the Galaxy Network, they had gathered who knew how many users.
The problem was, both success and failure was dependent on belief..

The five Imperial Clans had suffered such a great loss. If they did not get their pride back, that would naturally cause a great many people to look down on them, and the power of belief would naturally decline greatly as well.
Thus, from this aspect, the Imperial Clans would definitely not spare Ling Han.
After learning of this, a thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and a strange expression appeared on his face.
Speaking of believers, he already had a Genesis World in his body. What kind of terrifying number was that?
If he became a Saint, his acceptance of Regulations would probably reach 100%, right?
In this world, who would be able to rival him?
Oh, that’s right, Ding Shu.
This guy was also the overlord of the Genesis World. Thus, after reaching the level of Saint, it should be a competition between the two prodigies.

“For the moment, staying in the Nine Suns Holy Land is meaningless. It’s time for me to go out for a walk.” Ling Han was extremely calm and ready to move. He had never been a person who could stay idle. “Oh, that’s right. Since the old man has become a Saint, let him help me see what’s going on with the perverted pig.”
He brought the perverted pig to meet the Nine Mountains Saint. This would be a good opportunity to inform the old man that he was going out.

“Yi?” The Nine Mountains Saint glanced at the lecherous pig, and stretched out a hand to grab it. Then, he smiled, “Don’t underestimate this pig. It is a Spiritual Transformation Tier existence, and its cultivation level has only been sealed by a Saint.”
Ling Han was astonished. The pervert pig was actually a Spirit Transformation Tier elite?
No wonder its defenses were so tough. Among the opponents that Ling Han had encountered early on, there was indeed no one that could tear through the defenses of Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Meanwhile, the perverted pig howled loudly, an expression of pride on his face. Uncle Pig was an elite!
The Nine Mountains Saint also expended some effort, and only then did he manage to undo the seal inside the lecherous pig’s body.
“I’m about to suffocate to death!” the pervert pig suddenly said. “I haven’t been able to speak for several hundred years, and I f*cking want to die!”
Hearing these words, Ling Han suddenly felt an urge to ask the Nine Mountains Saint to seal the perverted pig again.
He already had enough unreliable people by his side, and he really didn’t want another one.
“Where are you from, and who sealed you?” the Nine Mountains Saint asked. He naturally didn’t want a ticking time bomb to be buried beside his disciple.
Boom! The might of a Saint surged out, its might boundlessly terrifying.
The pervert pig instantly choked, then said, “My ancestor is the dignified Canopy Demon Emperor, and I’m also a genuine Imperial Son!”
“Pei!” Ling Han immediately gave him the middle finger. Others brag, but you are also bragging, aren’t you?
“Tell me the truth!” the Nine Mountains Saint said in a solemn voice.
Faced with a Saint, the perverted pig did not dare to be flippant either, and said, “This old pig is indeed the descendant of the Canopy Demon Emperor. His name is Zhu Gang!”
“Old man, is there such an Ancestral King?” Ling Han asked.

The Nine Mountains Saint thought for a moment, then said, “Amongst the Primitive Age Demon Emperors, there was indeed such a Great Emperor.” He paused, then continued, “During the extensive development of cultivation, it was basically the Demon Race that first attained Dao, followed by the rise of humans, and there were also plant-type creatures that attained Dao.”
Ling Han was astonished. Was this pervert pig really an Imperial Son?
He really wanted to complain.
“Then who sealed you?” Ling Han asked.

“A female Saint,” the perverted pig said. It sighed, appearing very displeased, “I only looked at her a few times, and she sealed my cultivation level, causing me to be like an ordinary pig, unable to even speak.”
Ling Han thought of the perverted pig’s usual behaviour, and couldn’t help but shake his head, “Under what circumstances did you cast a few looks at this Saint?”
“Er... probably when she was bathing,” the pervert pig said.
F***, she really had a good temper if she didn’t beat you to death.
Ling Han nodded, “You should be grateful to your ancestor. Otherwise, you would have long since been made into grilled pork chops.”

“Che, if it was not for the fact that the ancestor of our race had gone to the edge of the universe, who would dare touch a single hair on this old pig’s head?” The perverted pig said in displeasure, not reflecting on his actions at all.
Yi, why had he gone to the edge of the universe like Brother Monkey’s ancestor?

Facts had proven that without the Imperial Weapon, the Imperial Clan could not possibly last long. Brother Monkey was only left in the line of the Battle Saint Emperor. If it was the line of the Canopy Demon Emperor, it was probable that the perverted pig was also the only descendant.

Moreover, Brother Monkey had been suppressed at the foot of the mountain, while the pervert pig’s cultivation level had been sealed. It was also rare for a dignified Imperial Son to fall to such a state.

“The edge of the universe, could it be that it’s really hiding the secret of immortality?” Ling Han asked curiously. Otherwise, how could it be that the generations of Ancestral Kings were all idiots?
Furthermore, only Ancestral Kings were qualified to go there. The others were all mediocre, and even Saints would not be able to reach that place.
A look of yearning appeared on the Nine Mountains Saint’s face. That was a place that even the Great Emperor wanted to take a gamble on, so he naturally wanted to go as well.
Ling Han bade farewell to the old man. He was going out to take a look and see if he could find any great opportunities.
A horse cannot get fat without an extra ration, a man cannot get rich without an extra opportunities.

It is a Spiritual Transformation Tier existence, and its cultivation level has only been sealed by a Saint.”
Ling Han was astonished.
The pervert pig was actually a Spirit Transformation Tier elite?
No wonder its defenses were so tough.
Among the opponents that Ling Han had encountered early on, there was indeed no one that could tear through the defenses of Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Meanwhile, the perverted pig howled loudly, an expression of pride on his face.
Uncle Pig was an elite!
The Nine Mountains Saint also expended some effort, and only then did he manage to undo the seal inside the lecherous pig’s body.
“I’m about to suffocate to death!” the pervert pig suddenly said.
“I haven’t been able to speak for several hundred years, and I f*cking want to die!”
Hearing these words, Ling Han suddenly felt an urge to ask the Nine Mountains Saint to seal the perverted pig again.
He already had enough unreliable people by his side, and he really didn’t want another one.
“Where are you from, and who sealed you?” the Nine Mountains Saint asked.
He naturally didn’t want a ticking time bomb to be buried beside his disciple.
Boom!
The might of a Saint surged out, its might boundlessly terrifying.
The pervert pig instantly choked, then said, “My ancestor is the dignified Canopy Demon Emperor, and I’m also a genuine Imperial Son!”
“Pei!” Ling Han immediately gave him the middle finger.
Others brag, but you are also bragging, aren’t you?
“Tell me the truth!” the Nine Mountains Saint said in a solemn voice.
Faced with a Saint, the perverted pig did not dare to be flippant either, and said, “This old pig is indeed the descendant of the Canopy Demon Emperor.
His name is Zhu Gang!”
“Old man, is there such an Ancestral King?” Ling Han asked.

The Nine Mountains Saint thought for a moment, then said, “Amongst the Primitive Age Demon Emperors, there was indeed such a Great Emperor.” He paused, then continued, “During the extensive development of cultivation, it was basically the Demon Race that first attained Dao, followed by the rise of humans, and there were also plant-type creatures that attained Dao.”
Ling Han was astonished.
Was this pervert pig really an Imperial Son?
He really wanted to complain.
“Then who sealed you?” Ling Han asked.
“A female Saint,” the perverted pig said.
It sighed, appearing very displeased, “I only looked at her a few times, and she sealed my cultivation level, causing me to be like an ordinary pig, unable to even speak.”
Ling Han thought of the perverted pig’s usual behaviour, and couldn’t help but shake his head, “Under what circumstances did you cast a few looks at this Saint?”
“Er... probably when she was bathing,” the pervert pig said.
F***, she really had a good temper if she didn’t beat you to death.
Ling Han nodded, “You should be grateful to your ancestor.
Otherwise, you would have long since been made into grilled pork chops.”

“Che, if it was not for the fact that the ancestor of our race had gone to the edge of the universe, who would dare touch a single hair on this old pig’s head?” The perverted pig said in displeasure, not reflecting on his actions at all.
Yi, why had he gone to the edge of the universe like Brother Monkey’s ancestor?
Facts had proven that without the Imperial Weapon, the Imperial Clan could not possibly last long.
Brother Monkey was only left in the line of the Battle Saint Emperor.
If it was the line of the Canopy Demon Emperor, it was probable that the perverted pig was also the only descendant.
Moreover, Brother Monkey had been suppressed at the foot of the mountain, while the pervert pig’s cultivation level had been sealed.
It was also rare for a dignified Imperial Son to fall to such a state.
“The edge of the universe, could it be that it’s really hiding the secret of immortality?” Ling Han asked curiously.
Otherwise, how could it be that the generations of Ancestral Kings were all idiots?
Furthermore, only Ancestral Kings were qualified to go there.
The others were all mediocre, and even Saints would not be able to reach that place.
A look of yearning appeared on the Nine Mountains Saint’s face.
That was a place that even the Great Emperor wanted to take a gamble on, so he naturally wanted to go as well.
Ling Han bade farewell to the old man.
He was going out to take a look and see if he could find any great opportunities.
A horse cannot get fat without an extra ration, a man cannot get rich without an extra opportunities.

chapters.title: Chapter 4264: Horn
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

This time, Ling Han didn’t plan to go to any far places. He would simply roam around the trading planets of the North Heavenly Realm. He had a large number of Dao Stones in his possession. If he didn’t use them, they would be no different from a pile of scrap stones.

The Nine Mountains Saint didn’t stop Ling Han. He had already issued a threat. If anyone dared to target Ling Han with the advantage of a major tier in cultivation level, he would bring the “Imperial Weapon” with him to do a raid.
This kind of threat was enough to make any force tremble in fear. Who would dare to take this risk?

Though Ling Han, the Nine Mountains Saint, and the others knew that the so-called “Imperial Weapon” was only forged from Origin Gold, and was far from reaching the level of Imperial Weapon, others did not know either. Was it not enough to scare them?
Thus, Ling Han could completely go out to have fun. He couldn’t be like a flower in a greenhouse, and be protected forever, right?
Without experiencing hardships, how could one possibly thrive?
Ling Han set off with the large black dog, the empress, and the others. Because there was no danger this time, he naturally brought more people with him, as if he was on a holiday.
A few dozen days later, they arrived at the trading planet of North Heavenly Realm.

Because the overall level of the North Heavenly Realm was the weakest among the four great Heavenly Realms, the overall level of this trading planet was also slightly lower. Ling Han roamed around for a daty, but did not make any purchases.
He was not in a rush. He just had to take things slowly.
On the second day, they continued to walk around.
This time, Ling Han had some gains. He bought some Celestial medicine, and planned to concoct alchemical pills for the benefit of those close to him.

Natural treasures were too rare. After a larger force obtained them, they would definitely be internally distributed. Only a small number of lone cultivators would take them out to sell. Thus, this quantity was naturally lesser. If they encountered them, it would be luck, but if they didn’t, there was no need to feel irritated.
In the next few days, Ling Han swept through a great many Celestial medicines, and was able to concoct the Silver Fetus Pill, which doubled his present rate of cultivation.
This was naturally awesome, but to Ling Han, shortening the time of 100 years of hard cultivation to 50 years was still not enough.

He still needed natural treasures such as the Evolution Fruit, but such things were really hard to come by. The majority of treasured medicines that had this effect were controlled by the Imperial Clans, and could not possibly circulate on the market at all.
The remaining ones... were all inside the Mystery Realm.
However, the opening of the Mystery Realm required conditions. It was not something that could be entered just because you wanted to.
Ling Han sighed. Could it be that he really had to earnestly cultivate for fifty years before he could reach the end of the fourth form?

Most importantly, he definitely wouldn’t be satisfied with the Fourth Form. He would still attempt the Fifth Form and the Sixth Form, and only consider breaking through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier when he couldn’t advance any further and broke through all his limits.
Going by that account, how many more years would he need?

It was a great era now, and prodigies from all sides were fighting to survive, snatching that sliver of fated opportunity, and walk the Imperial Path. If they were slightly later, they may not have the chance to become the strongest.
Hence, Ling Han was very anxious. He could not accept this kind of gradual routine.

However, at present, there was no ancient site or danger zone that would open up, so he could only suppress his temper and continue to search for treasures here. Who knows, he might be able to pick up some scraps?

Don’t say, the large black dog, the little dragon, and the others had really picked up a treasure. They had bought treasures that were astonishingly valuable at very low prices, but they were mostly secret techniques, materials used to forge the Spirit Tool, and not those that would improve their cultivation level.

On this day, Hu Niu pulled Ling Han out for a walk early in the morning. The empress naturally followed as well. There was also the perverted pig. This guy still looked like a little piglet, and there was still a rope tied around his neck. The empress held it in her hand.
Most importantly, it also looked like it was earnestly enjoying itself, causing Ling Han to feel disgusted all over.

The market was open all day, and because everyone was a cultivator, it was fine even if they didn’t sleep or rest for a few years. Thus, though Ling Han and the others had come early, this place was still lively, and there was no need to worry that there would be few people.

Ling Han looked around as he walked. He indeed had the intention to pick up scraps. That was because he had discovered another tortoise shell on the trading planet of West Heavenly Realm. As a result, it had drawn out the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor!
Would his luck explode again this time?

After walking for a while, Ling Han discovered a street stall. The things on it were all very old. They were either damaged, or covered with mud. At a glance, it was clear that they had experienced many years.
“Young man, look, look, this was just taken out of a large tomb.” When the stall keeper saw Ling Han and his group, he immediately called out to them.

Ling Han wasn’t his original appearance right now. He was too well-known. If he walked with his original appearance, he would definitely be surrounded by people. Perhaps, once he bought something, a group of people would follow suit and place bids, because they all knew that he definitely had good eyesight.

He smiled, and swept his gaze over the stall. Using his eye technique, he could see through everything. He shook his head, and said, “Brother, the goods here have indeed just been dug out, but they’re not from a large tomb. They’re probably from your own backyard.”
This mud, this damage, it was all deliberately made, and under Ling Han’s eye technique, its true nature was naturally revealed.
The stall keeper instantly smiled sheepishly. As it turned out, he was an expert, so there was nothing to show off.
Ling Han was just about to leave. Yi, his gaze suddenly paused. He picked up an item, and asked, “How much is this?”

The stall keeper glanced at it. This was a bugle horn, and it was really quite old. However, after pondering for a long time, he still could not figure out what it was used for. He could not care less, and made it into an “antique” as well. It was fine even if it was useless. Its age was still there.
“Hehe, 20,000 Dao Stones.” He made an exorbitant demand.
Being seen through was one matter, but since you have your eye on something, then he naturally could make use of it.
Moreover, this horn was indeed an ancient item.
“All right.” Ling Han readily took out 20,000 Dao Stones and handed them over.
F***, what a loss.

The stall keeper instantly looked pained. He had been in business for so many years, so he naturally knew that the reason why Ling Han would be so straightforward meant that the value of the horn was not just limited to this.
But there was nothing that could be done. He was the one who had made the bid, so how could it be that he could go back on his word?
If he raised the bid further, he would not be able to do business here in future.
However, he was also a little puzzled, because he had indeed studied it for a great many years, and had not discovered anything strange about this horn at all.
“Er, have you seen through the use of this horn?” he couldn’t help but ask.
“Want to know?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“En!” The stall keeper nodded repeatedly.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Fine, give me 30,000 Dao Stones, and I’ll tell you.”

The stall keeper instantly rolled his eyes. ‘You’re quite black-hearted, aren’t you? Not only do you want to take your money back, but you even want to take advantage of the opportunity to rip me off?’
“Hehe.” He smiled sheepishly, and resolutely ignored her.
Ling Han picked up the horn and continued to advance. However, after walking for a while, he turned into a small forest, planning to study it carefully.
“Ling Han, what is this?” Hu Niu asked.
“I don’t know either,” Ling Han said. He really didn’t know. The reason why he had moved was because when he stretched out his hand to touch the horn, a strange feeling rose up in his heart.
He did not know why, but for a long time, he had always trusted his instincts very much.
“Let Niu play.” Hu Niu took the bugle horn, but before she had even begun blowing, Ling Han took it back, took out a handkerchief and wiped it carefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 4265: Wolf howls
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hu Niu raised the horn and blew hard, but no sound was heard.
She refused to give up, and blew a few more times, but it was still the same.
“It’s not fun.” She returned the bugle horn to Ling Han, her expression puffed up.
The empress also made an attempt, but similarly, it was completely ineffective.
Right at this moment, the little azure dragon and the large black dog also ran over. They were strolling around nearby, and just happened to see Ling Han and the others.
“Hahaha!” The little azure dragon and the large black dog both laughed loudly. It was rare to see Ling Han suffer a loss.
“Little Han, you also have times when your taste is poor.” The large black dog hit him when he was down.
Ling Han chuckled, “That’s right. For example, when I met the guy standing in front of me.”
The large black dog immediately nudged the little azure dragon, saying, “Four-Legged Snake, Little Han is talking about you!”
The little azure dragon immediately shouted, “Little Han, do you dare to fight for 300 rounds?”
Ling Han ignored him. He took out the horn and began to study it himself.

The reason why he had moved was because he could vaguely sense that there was something special about this thing, but as for what exactly it was, he naturally did not know, and that was why he needed to study it.

This horn was really very ancient, filled with an air of vicissitudes of time. This could not be faked. Thus, even if 20,000 Dao Stones was only to buy an antique, Ling Han would not feel that it was too much of a loss.

He examined it carefully, and discovered that there were many veined patterns on the inside of the horn. At first glance, they were completely unrelated, but when he thought about it in his mind, they were indescribably complicated.
“Let’s go!”
Hu Niu pulled him along, and the group returned to their accommodations. Ling Han closed the doors, and continued to study the horn. He kept feeling that his senses were correct.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon and the large black dog both teased him, saying that he was a sore loser and was still insisting stubbornly.
However, Ling Han didn’t pay any heed to this. He simply mulled over this with his head lowered.
These patterns were indeed incredibly complex. In a short while, even with his comprehension ability, he could not describe how profound they were.
Of course, it was also possible that there was no logic to this in the first place

Ling Han simply connected to the Galaxy Network and rented a Time Chamber. He could use this opportunity to use some of his Universe Coins. Otherwise, if there were any more accidents, this money would once again rot at the Chang Clan.
He spent all of his Universe Coins and spent eleven days in the Time Chamber before finally getting some clues.
“So that’s how it is.”
Ling Han exited the Galaxy Network, then picked up the horn and blew it according to the principles that he had figured out.
Hu, after blowing out a breath of air, Ling Han shockingly discovered that his Spiritual Power had actually dropped by a significant amount!
—This horn was actually activated with Spiritual Power.
However, why was there still no sound?

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel vexed. He had spent an ocean’s worth of Universe Coins, and had initially thought that he had solved the mystery of the bugle horn. Who would have thought that he would have wasted his money for nothing?
“Ao!”
Right at this moment, wolf howls were heard from outside. Then, the voices of the little azure dragon, perverted pig, and large black dog were heard.
“Four-Legged Snake, you’re clearly a snake, so why are you barking like a wolf?”
“Pei, you are clearly a dog, so why do you have to bark like a wolf?”
“Hehe, Grandpa Dog and the wolf are from the same family in the first place. So what if I bark like a wolf?”
“And this perverted pig, why is it howling like a wolf?”
“Uncle Pig likes it, am I not allowed to!”
Ling Han pushed open the doors and walked out, only to see three unreliable guys screaming with flushed necks.
“Were you all imitating the howls of wolves just now?” he asked, a strange expression on his face.
“That’s right. For some reason, I suddenly feel like howling,” the large black dog said.
“En.” The little azure dragon and pervert pig nodded as well.
If one guy howled, that was normal, because these guys were all unreliable, but if three of them howled at the same time, there was something strange about it.
Could it be?

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. He turned around and returned to his room. Then, he took out the horn and placed it by his mouth. With a forceful blow, another large portion of his Spiritual Power was instantly extracted. Then, he heard the howls of wolves coming from outside.
“F***, why are you howling like a wolf again?”
“I want to!”
The little azure dragon and the other two began to argue again.
Ling Han’s expression was strange. This was the effect of the horn, making people bark like wolves?
F***, this was really screwing him over!
His side was full of unreliable guys, and now even something like a Spirit Tool was starting to go into this kind of mode?
Ling Han instantly felt an urge to throw away the bugle horn. What was the use of this thing? When he fought with his opponent, would the bugle horn cause the latter to howl?
This was practically a joke.
Ling Han exited the room again, and saw that the little azure dragon and the others’ eyes were all focused on him.
“Little Han, don’t you have anything to say?” they all asked.
Ling Han spread his hands, “Say what?”
“Humph, you were behind us when we howled for no reason twice. If you say this has nothing to do with you, who’ll believe you?” the little azure dragon immediately said.
“Ang!” The perverted pig nodded.
“F***, didn’t you recover your cultivation level? Why are you still howling like a pig?” Ling Han pointed at the perverted pig.
The perverted pig humphed. Uncle Pig likes to pretend to be a cutie to deceive girls, so what can you do about it?
“Little Han, don’t change the topic. Hurry up and tell me what’s going on?” The large black dog wasn’t so easily fooled, and he immediately turned his attention back to Ling Han.
Only then did Ling Han smile. He picked up the horn, “I think it should be this thing.”
“Are you saying that we’ll only howl when you blow this thing?” the large black dog asked suspiciously.
“En.” Ling Han nodded.
“Grandpa Dog doesn’t believe you.” The large black dog shook its head, and snatched the horn over.
“Grandpa Dragon doesn’t believe it either, who are you kidding!” The little azure dragon also shook its head.
“Zhi!” The perverted pig only let out a squeal.
“Let me give it a try.” The large black dog started to blow it, but no sound was heard, nor was anyone howling.
“See,” the little azure dragon said. It looked like it had seen through Ling Han’s disguise.

Ling Han smiled, took the bugle horn, and blew it with a special technique. Instantly, a portion of Spiritual Power was dispersed, and the large black dog, the perverted pig and the little azure dragon began to howl like wolves. Furthermore, this time, he could see clearly that the three of them had all raised their heads, mimicking wolves fully.
As it turned out, not only could one imitate the howl of a wolf, even their demeanor could be so similar.

The little azure dragon and the others couldn’t help but be stunned. What the hell was this? The horn blew, and they actually imitated the howls of wolves? And they even raised their heads high to imitate it fully?
“Yi, how did you do it?” The large black dog was just about to snatch the bugle horn.
Ling Han dodged to the side.
“Let Grandpa Dragon play!” The little azure dragon also pounced over, but Ling Han also dodged it.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and blew the bugle horn again. Instantly, the three of them began to raise their heads and imitate the howls of wolves.

“Little Han, don’t you think you’re too childish?” the large black dog shouted. It was as if there was an invisible force acting on his brain, causing him to involuntarily raise his head and howl like a wolf.
“Strange!” The little azure dragon’s expression was also filled with shock. This time, he was already prepared, yet he was still hit.
Even the perverted pig was no exception. He opened his mouth and said, “Uncle Pig is a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator, yet he’s actually also affected!”
From this aspect, though the effects of the bugle horn were extremely useless, it was really quite awesome.
