Thus, even if 20,000 Dao Stones was only to buy an antique, Ling Han would not feel that it was too much of a loss.
He examined it carefully, and discovered that there were many veined patterns on the inside of the horn.
At first glance, they were completely unrelated, but when he thought about it in his mind, they were indescribably complicated.
“Let’s go!”
Hu Niu pulled him along, and the group returned to their accommodations.
Ling Han closed the doors, and continued to study the horn.
He kept feeling that his senses were correct.
Meanwhile, the little azure dragon and the large black dog both teased him, saying that he was a sore loser and was still insisting stubbornly.
However, Ling Han didn’t pay any heed to this.
He simply mulled over this with his head lowered.
These patterns were indeed incredibly complex.
In a short while, even with his comprehension ability, he could not describe how profound they were.
Of course, it was also possible that there was no logic to this in the first place
Ling Han simply connected to the Galaxy Network and rented a Time Chamber.
He could use this opportunity to use some of his Universe Coins.
Otherwise, if there were any more accidents, this money would once again rot at the Chang Clan.
He spent all of his Universe Coins and spent eleven days in the Time Chamber before finally getting some clues.
“So that’s how it is.”
Ling Han exited the Galaxy Network, then picked up the horn and blew it according to the principles that he had figured out.
Hu, after blowing out a breath of air, Ling Han shockingly discovered that his Spiritual Power had actually dropped by a significant amount!
—This horn was actually activated with Spiritual Power.
However, why was there still no sound?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel vexed.
He had spent an ocean’s worth of Universe Coins, and had initially thought that he had solved the mystery of the bugle horn.
Who would have thought that he would have wasted his money for nothing?
“Ao!”
Right at this moment, wolf howls were heard from outside.
Then, the voices of the little azure dragon, perverted pig, and large black dog were heard.
“Four-Legged Snake, you’re clearly a snake, so why are you barking like a wolf?”
“Pei, you are clearly a dog, so why do you have to bark like a wolf?”
“Hehe, Grandpa Dog and the wolf are from the same family in the first place.
So what if I bark like a wolf?”
“And this perverted pig, why is it howling like a wolf?”
“Uncle Pig likes it, am I not allowed to!”
Ling Han pushed open the doors and walked out, only to see three unreliable guys screaming with flushed necks.
“Were you all imitating the howls of wolves just now?” he asked, a strange expression on his face.
“That’s right.
For some reason, I suddenly feel like howling,” the large black dog said.
“En.” The little azure dragon and pervert pig nodded as well.
If one guy howled, that was normal, because these guys were all unreliable, but if three of them howled at the same time, there was something strange about it.
Could it be?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind.
He turned around and returned to his room.
Then, he took out the horn and placed it by his mouth.
With a forceful blow, another large portion of his Spiritual Power was instantly extracted.
Then, he heard the howls of wolves coming from outside.
“F***, why are you howling like a wolf again?”
“I want to!”
The little azure dragon and the other two began to argue again.
Ling Han’s expression was strange.
This was the effect of the horn, making people bark like wolves?
F***, this was really screwing him over!
His side was full of unreliable guys, and now even something like a Spirit Tool was starting to go into this kind of mode?
Ling Han instantly felt an urge to throw away the bugle horn.
What was the use of this thing?
When he fought with his opponent, would the bugle horn cause the latter to howl?
This was practically a joke.
Ling Han exited the room again, and saw that the little azure dragon and the others’ eyes were all focused on him.
“Little Han, don’t you have anything to say?” they all asked.
Ling Han spread his hands, “Say what?”
“Humph, you were behind us when we howled for no reason twice.
If you say this has nothing to do with you, who’ll believe you?” the little azure dragon immediately said.
“Ang!” The perverted pig nodded.
“F***, didn’t you recover your cultivation level?
Why are you still howling like a pig?” Ling Han pointed at the perverted pig.
The perverted pig humphed.
Uncle Pig likes to pretend to be a cutie to deceive girls, so what can you do about it?
“Little Han, don’t change the topic.
Hurry up and tell me what’s going on?” The large black dog wasn’t so easily fooled, and he immediately turned his attention back to Ling Han.
Only then did Ling Han smile.
He picked up the horn, “I think it should be this thing.”
“Are you saying that we’ll only howl when you blow this thing?” the large black dog asked suspiciously.
“En.” Ling Han nodded.
“Grandpa Dog doesn’t believe you.” The large black dog shook its head, and snatched the horn over.
“Grandpa Dragon doesn’t believe it either, who are you kidding!” The little azure dragon also shook its head.
“Zhi!” The perverted pig only let out a squeal.
“Let me give it a try.” The large black dog started to blow it, but no sound was heard, nor was anyone howling.
“See,” the little azure dragon said.
It looked like it had seen through Ling Han’s disguise.
Ling Han smiled, took the bugle horn, and blew it with a special technique.
Instantly, a portion of Spiritual Power was dispersed, and the large black dog, the perverted pig and the little azure dragon began to howl like wolves.
Furthermore, this time, he could see clearly that the three of them had all raised their heads, mimicking wolves fully.
As it turned out, not only could one imitate the howl of a wolf, even their demeanor could be so similar.
The little azure dragon and the others couldn’t help but be stunned.
What the hell was this?
The horn blew, and they actually imitated the howls of wolves?
And they even raised their heads high to imitate it fully?
“Yi, how did you do it?” The large black dog was just about to snatch the bugle horn.
Ling Han dodged to the side.
“Let Grandpa Dragon play!” The little azure dragon also pounced over, but Ling Han also dodged it.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and blew the bugle horn again.
Instantly, the three of them began to raise their heads and imitate the howls of wolves.
“Little Han, don’t you think you’re too childish?” the large black dog shouted.
It was as if there was an invisible force acting on his brain, causing him to involuntarily raise his head and howl like a wolf.
“Strange!” The little azure dragon’s expression was also filled with shock.
This time, he was already prepared, yet he was still hit.
Even the perverted pig was no exception.
He opened his mouth and said, “Uncle Pig is a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator, yet he’s actually also affected!”
From this aspect, though the effects of the bugle horn were extremely useless, it was really quite awesome.

chapters.title: Chapter 4266: Trap
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
A True Self Tier blowing the horn could actually affect a Spiritual Transformation Tier, and even if the Spiritual Transformation Tier was prepared, he wouldn’t be able to block it.
From this aspect, it was awesome!
“Which b@stard created this?” The large black dog went to retrieve the bugle horn again. This time, Ling Han did not move aside, but rather allowed it to take the bugle horn.
“This is too much of a scam!” The little azure dragon grimaced. He was the young son of the True Dragon, and he was actually howling like a wolf. This was too demeaning.
“Extraordinary. This should involve a powerful power of Regulation,” the pervert pig said seriously.
At the same time, Ling Han and the others gave it the middle finger.
“Hey, hey, hey, what do you guys mean?” The pervert pig was extremely ticked off.
“A perverted pig suddenly becoming serious is really too unacceptable!” Ling Han mocked.
The perverted pig was rendered speechless for a moment, then asked weakly, “In your hearts, could it be that Uncle Pig is so unreliable?”
“Extremely!” Ling Han and the others nodded in unison.
The pervert pig was angry, and ignored them.
Ling Han was extremely curious, and he asked, “Which cultivation level is the upper limit of this thing?”

“Just the thought of it is quite hilarious. When an elite is showing off, he suddenly raises his head and barks like a wolf. That scene, tsk tsk.” The large black dog snickered. As a screw-over, he naturally thought of how to make use of this thing to screw off others at the first instant.
“A bunch of Saints howling at the same time, this is really something to look forward to!” the little azure dragon also said.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “There’s no need to think about Saints. This will definitely be ineffective.”

Saints were only inferior to the Ancestral King. They themselves could accommodate the Regulations, and they were practically untouchable by all techniques. Thus, it was absolutely impossible for the horn to make Saints howl like wolves.
The Imperial Weapon could suppress Saints, but it had never been heard of being able to control the actions of Saints.
“Finally, you didn’t spend 20,000 Dao Stones for nothing.” The large black dog patted Ling Han’s shoulder, and said, “At least, you obtained a toy.”

Ling Han merely smiled. He had spent more than 20,000. That was only used to buy the bugle horn. In truth, in order to study the patterns within, he had spent an astronomical amount of Universe Coins. Needless to say, the large black dog would probably die of heartache.

He did not think that he had wasted his money for nothing. Putting aside the fact that this horn had the effect of screwing people over, Ling Han studied those patterns, and found that his study of it had produced tremendous gains. They involved some kind of heaven and earth Regulations, and it was like he was cultivating.
“Come, let’s go take a look around. Grandpa Dog also wants to get one to trick people.” The large black dog’s interest was piqued.
“Grandpa Dragon is also going.”
“Zhi.” The pervert pig followed.
After countless years, there would definitely be a great many treasures covered in dust. As long as one had discerning eyes, they would naturally be able to pick up some that they had missed.

Meanwhile, Ling Han continued to study the horn. After a few experiments, he discovered that after blowing the horn, an invisible wave would surge out. As long as one was impacted, he would be affected. He would raise his head high and begin to howl like a wolf. In fact, he would even stop what he was doing.

Only he, the user, could see this kind of ripple. Of course, perhaps those at the Sect Master and Venerate Tier-level could see it as well. This Ling Han had not found someone to test it out, so it could not be confirmed at present.

He gave it a try, and discovered that he could control this kind of ripple. Not only could it be directed in the set direction, it could also transform into an arrow that could be used on one or more specific targets.
After a few times, he became more and more proficient.
Ling Han called the empress and Hu Niu over, and also ran to the marketplace, planning to see if he could find some more good stuff.
However, they definitely couldn’t always encounter such good luck. After circling around for a long time, they returned empty-handed.
“Stop right there!” A shout rang out from behind Ling Han and the others.
Ling Han ignored him, and merely walked side by side with the two women.
“I told you to stop!” At this moment, the person who had shouted ran over from behind and stopped them.
This was a young man, and his cultivation level was Cauldron Forging Tier. In Ling Han’s eyes, he was naturally weak.
However, this kind of weak trash actually dared to take the initiative to provoke him?
Had he gone blind?
“Take off your veil!” When this young man looked at the empress and Hu Niu, his eyes were filled with a lustful light.
Ling Han was astonished. This was a pervert?
“Scram!” He waved his hand dismissively.

“Ha, who do you think you are, to dare tell me, Zhu Ming, to get lost?” That young man was incredibly arrogant, “I am a member of the Zhu Clan, and my grandfather is a Sect Master elite, and you dare tell me to get lost; that is practically courting death!”
“Hand these two women over to me, and I can give you a quick death!”
Idiot.
Ling Han shook his head, and sent out a palm strike. Pa, this Zhu Ming was crushed into a mush of blood.
What was the point of not killing this kind of trash? To leave him alive to disgust others?

The three of them did not take it to heart either. They had killed who knew how many such profligate young masters on their way here, but they had just raised their foot, when they suddenly felt a terrifying pressure assault them.

“How dare you, you even dare to touch this old man’s grandson!” A cold laugh rang out, and an old man appeared soundlessly. His hair was completely white, but his skin was extraordinarily rosy, appearing extremely abnormal.
This was Zhu Ming’s grandfather, the Sect Master elite?

That’s right. This was indeed a Sect Master elite. Ling Han could confirm this with a single glance of his eye technique, but the problem was, he had just killed Zhu Ming, and this Sect Master elite had already appeared?
So coincidental?
If he had been nearby just now, how could he have sat by and watched as Zhu Ming was killed? If that was not the case, how could he have come in such a timely manner?
No matter how he thought about it, there was a strong sense of strangeness about this.

Furthermore, Zhu Ming’s actions could be explained as lecherous, but the empress and Hu Niu were both wearing white veils. There were so many people on the streets, so why had he set his eyes on them with a single glance?
Ling Han sensed the ley lines, and immediately looked surprised, because the nearby ley lines had already been suppressed.
Of course, a Sect Master elite could accomplish this.
But why did he do that? Could it be that he knew that he was a grandmaster of formations?
With all of this added together, Ling Han immediately came to a conclusion. This was a conspiracy from beginning to end.

He should have been recognized long ago. En, perhaps after connecting to the Galaxy Network, a deadly trap was laid out. It began with Zhu Ming provoking Ling Han and inciting him to make a move. Then, the latter’s grandfather would have a reason to make a move.
Ling Han showed a mocking smile, and said, “Old man, who asked you to make a move? Xuanfeng Imperial Clan? White Feather Imperial Clan? Ziwei Imperial Clan?”
The white-haired elder humphed, “I don’t know what nonsense you’re spouting! You killed my grandson, so you’ll pay with your life. It’s only natural.”

“Hehe, you should know who I am, right?” Ling Han said, “Nine Suns Holy Land, Ling Han! You should also know that if you kill me, you’ll be hunted down by a Saint. No matter how big the world is, there’s no place for you.”
“So, let me guess. You should be nearing the end of your lifespan, and that’s why you’re taking a gamble under the instigation of others. It’s for the sake of the clan behind you, right?”
“How many benefits did those Imperial Clans promise you?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4267: Rescue by the Horn
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han’s series of words caused the white-haired elder to feel slightly dazed.
He knew very well that Ling Han had not guessed wrongly at all, and that was exactly what had happened.

He indeed did not have many years left to live, but even if he could only live for a few more days, no one would be willing to die sooner. However, those forces clearly told him that once the matter was settled, the Zhu Clan would become a Venerate Tier-level force, at least.
However, if he didn’t agree, the Zhu Clan would face destruction tomorrow.
The white-haired elder didn’t dare to doubt the words of those clans.
Thus, after much consideration, he decided to throw caution to the winds, and use his remaining life to trade for a bright future for the Zhu Clan.

—Zhu Ming was the profligate descendant that he had chosen from his clan. In any case, he only knew how to eat, drink, and have fun, so it would be fine for him to become this victim that would die in this trap. It could be considered as having contributed to the clan.
He had never imagined that the truth would be more or less pieced together by Ling Han after just a single meeting.
Are you a freak?

Thoughts streaked through the mind of the white-haired elder. He had to kill Ling Han. Otherwise, the Imperial Clans would not spare him, and would even implicate the clan. And if he killed Ling Han, he would be the only one to die, and could still trade his life for the future of the clan.
He couldn’t care less!
“Rubbish!” he rebuked harshly, “You killed my beloved grandson, and I want you to pay with your life!”
He moved directly, not wanting to cause any further trouble.
“Run!” Ling Han hurriedly grabbed the empress and Hu Niu, and used the Imminent Skyline.
But now that the Sect Master had moved, how could he escape?
Boom, a large hand stretched out, blotting out the sky and covering the sun.

The white-haired elder didn’t care at all that he would implicate the innocent. He directly launched a regional attack with a palm strike, relying on his high cultivation level to kill Ling Han in the simplest and most domineering manner.
All of a sudden, the expressions of the people on the streets changed drastically. F***, what business was it of theirs?
This was too f unlucky!
Ling Han immediately took out the bugle horn and blew it soundlessly.
He didn’t know whether this thing could affect a Sect Master or not. Previously, he didn’t have the time to do a test at all, but now, he could only put everything on the line.
Sigh, after the Heavenly Dao Flames had been used up, he had directly lost his most important trump card.

A wave spread out. In such a crucial moment, Ling Han naturally did not have the time to adjust the range of effect of the wave. Thus, at the same time, everyone on the streets raised their heads high and howled at the skies.
“Ao!”
No one could be exempted, including the white-haired elder.
In this way, his offensive dissipated on its own. The massive palm instantly disappeared in the air, turning back into the purest energy and Regulations.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
‘F*ck! What’s going on? Why did I suddenly howl at the sky like a wolf? And at such a critical moment? Could it be that the Wolf Tribe bloodline in my body has awakened on the brink of death?’
However, what the hell was the sudden howling of the wolves from the others? Could it be that all of them were descendants of the Wolf Tribe?
Moreover, what was the white-haired old Sect Master doing? He hadn’t faced the pressure of death, so wouldn’t it be a lie to say that he had suddenly awakened his bloodline?
The white-haired elder was also dumbfounded. Why had he suddenly howled like a wolf?
Furthermore, it was not just him. The others were also howling, as if they were all bewitched.
After being stunned for a moment, he hurriedly moved again. He had to kill Ling Han, or he and the Zhu Clan would be finished.
Boom, a large hand appeared once more, interwoven with mystical power and Regulations, exuding boundless killing intent as it struck out at Ling Han.
Again!
Everyone gritted their teeth. They had just dodged a calamity, and it was another strike.
Yet Ling Han was already confident, and had long since prepared himself. The bugle horn was blown again.
Invisible and untouchable ripples spread out, and instantly, “Ao, ao, ao,” wolf howls rang out, rising and falling.
Everyone was speechless. ‘I’m about to be killed, so why am I still howling?’
The white-haired old man’s attack dispersed on its own again. He couldn’t help but feel terrified.
Which great elite had moved?
This was too terrifying. He didn’t even need to appear, and he had already lost control of his emotions, and began to howl like a wolf. This strength was practically chilling.

He naturally knew who Ling Han was, and also knew that there was a Saint behind Ling Han, who had an astonishing background. If that was not the case, what need was there for those few Imperial Clans to do something so superfluous, and insist on using him to kill Ling Han?
Wasn’t it just pushing out a scapegoat?
Thus, he immediately thought that since Ling Han had such a powerful background, how could he not have a Dao Protector by his side?
From the look of things now, this Dao Protector had to be Venerate Tier-level, at least, to be able to easily affect him without appearing.

He couldn’t help but feel as if his heart had died. Hurriedly, he stopped, and said, “Senior, this old man deserves to die ten thousand times over. Please spare our Zhu Clan, and this old man is willing to bear the consequences!”

Just as he was begging for mercy from the non-existent Dao Protector, Ling Han had already ran out of his range of influence, communicating with the ley lines. Xiu, the Star Steps unfolded, and he instantly disappeared.
After finding the large black dog and the others, Ling Han immediately set up the Transfer Formation and left the planet.
“What, you were ambushed?” When the large black dog and the others found out about the twists and turns of the matter from Ling Han, they immediately jumped up.
Needless to say, this was definitely the doing of those Imperial Clans.
Only they would have such great ability to make a Sect Master-level force obey their commands, and even make an old Sect Master act as a scapegoat.
“The Chang Clan is also involved. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have known where Little Han was at all.”

The truth of the matter was very easily pieced together. It wasn’t complicated in the first place, but once it succeeded, as long as that old Sect Master of the Zhu Clan stubbornly insisted that it was his own doing, or even committed suicide, then how could the Nine Suns Holy Land blame this on the Imperial Clans?

Moreover, Ling Han and the others were very clear that in truth, the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have an Imperial Weapon. It only had a One Star Saint. It was enough to scare people, but if it was really brought to the forefront... then it would be like a paper tiger that would be torn apart with a single poke.
“Motherf*cker, those Imperial Clan bastards still won’t stop!” the large black dog cursed.
“That’s natural. Little Han’s talent scares them. Who knows, he may be able to threaten those Golden Generation members, replace them, and become an Emperor,” the little azure dragon said.

This should be the thought of a portion of the members of the Imperial Clans. They thought that Ling Han was a threat. Of course, even more people believed in the Golden Generation, and thought that with this gap of a hundred years, Ling Han was already too far behind. By the time he became a Saint, the competition for the throne would have already ended.
Thus, there was no rush to settle accounts now. When a new Emperor appeared, he would naturally be able to crush the Nine Suns Holy Land with a single hand.

After Ling Han returned to the Nine Suns Holy Land, he related what had happened to the Nine Mountains Saint. The Nine Mountains Saint immediately moved, destroying several important herbal planets of the Ziwei, Golden Cauldron and other Imperial Clans as a powerful counterattack.

The five Imperial Clans were naturally displeased, and raised their objections to the Nine Suns Holy Land. However, the Nine Mountains Saint was extremely domineering, and he only said, “You guys caused this disaster on your own. Don’t you have any ideas about it?”
The Imperial Clans instantly fell silent.

sentences.text: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han’s series of words caused the white-haired elder to feel slightly dazed.
He knew very well that Ling Han had not guessed wrongly at all, and that was exactly what had happened.
He indeed did not have many years left to live, but even if he could only live for a few more days, no one would be willing to die sooner.
However, those forces clearly told him that once the matter was settled, the Zhu Clan would become a Venerate Tier-level force, at least.
However, if he didn’t agree, the Zhu Clan would face destruction tomorrow.
The white-haired elder didn’t dare to doubt the words of those clans.
Thus, after much consideration, he decided to throw caution to the winds, and use his remaining life to trade for a bright future for the Zhu Clan.
—Zhu Ming was the profligate descendant that he had chosen from his clan.
In any case, he only knew how to eat, drink, and have fun, so it would be fine for him to become this victim that would die in this trap.
It could be considered as having contributed to the clan.
He had never imagined that the truth would be more or less pieced together by Ling Han after just a single meeting.
Are you a freak?
Thoughts streaked through the mind of the white-haired elder.
He had to kill Ling Han.
Otherwise, the Imperial Clans would not spare him, and would even implicate the clan.
And if he killed Ling Han, he would be the only one to die, and could still trade his life for the future of the clan.
He couldn’t care less!
“Rubbish!” he rebuked harshly, “You killed my beloved grandson, and I want you to pay with your life!”
He moved directly, not wanting to cause any further trouble.
“Run!” Ling Han hurriedly grabbed the empress and Hu Niu, and used the Imminent Skyline.
But now that the Sect Master had moved, how could he escape?
Boom, a large hand stretched out, blotting out the sky and covering the sun.
The white-haired elder didn’t care at all that he would implicate the innocent.
He directly launched a regional attack with a palm strike, relying on his high cultivation level to kill Ling Han in the simplest and most domineering manner.
All of a sudden, the expressions of the people on the streets changed drastically.
F***, what business was it of theirs?
This was too f unlucky!
Ling Han immediately took out the bugle horn and blew it soundlessly.
He didn’t know whether this thing could affect a Sect Master or not.
Previously, he didn’t have the time to do a test at all, but now, he could only put everything on the line.
Sigh, after the Heavenly Dao Flames had been used up, he had directly lost his most important trump card.
A wave spread out.
In such a crucial moment, Ling Han naturally did not have the time to adjust the range of effect of the wave.
Thus, at the same time, everyone on the streets raised their heads high and howled at the skies.
“Ao!”
No one could be exempted, including the white-haired elder.
In this way, his offensive dissipated on its own.
The massive palm instantly disappeared in the air, turning back into the purest energy and Regulations.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
‘F*ck!
What’s going on?
Why did I suddenly howl at the sky like a wolf?
And at such a critical moment?
Could it be that the Wolf Tribe bloodline in my body has awakened on the brink of death?’
However, what the hell was the sudden howling of the wolves from the others?
Could it be that all of them were descendants of the Wolf Tribe?
Moreover, what was the white-haired old Sect Master doing?
He hadn’t faced the pressure of death, so wouldn’t it be a lie to say that he had suddenly awakened his bloodline?
The white-haired elder was also dumbfounded.
Why had he suddenly howled like a wolf?
Furthermore, it was not just him.
The others were also howling, as if they were all bewitched.
After being stunned for a moment, he hurriedly moved again.
He had to kill Ling Han, or he and the Zhu Clan would be finished.
Boom, a large hand appeared once more, interwoven with mystical power and Regulations, exuding boundless killing intent as it struck out at Ling Han.
Again!
Everyone gritted their teeth.
They had just dodged a calamity, and it was another strike.
Yet Ling Han was already confident, and had long since prepared himself.
The bugle horn was blown again.
Invisible and untouchable ripples spread out, and instantly, “Ao, ao, ao,” wolf howls rang out, rising and falling.
Everyone was speechless.
‘I’m about to be killed, so why am I still howling?’
The white-haired old man’s attack dispersed on its own again.
He couldn’t help but feel terrified.
Which great elite had moved?
This was too terrifying.
He didn’t even need to appear, and he had already lost control of his emotions, and began to howl like a wolf.
This strength was practically chilling.
He naturally knew who Ling Han was, and also knew that there was a Saint behind Ling Han, who had an astonishing background.
If that was not the case, what need was there for those few Imperial Clans to do something so superfluous, and insist on using him to kill Ling Han?
Wasn’t it just pushing out a scapegoat?
Thus, he immediately thought that since Ling Han had such a powerful background, how could he not have a Dao Protector by his side?
From the look of things now, this Dao Protector had to be Venerate Tier-level, at least, to be able to easily affect him without appearing.
He couldn’t help but feel as if his heart had died.
Hurriedly, he stopped, and said, “Senior, this old man deserves to die ten thousand times over.
Please spare our Zhu Clan, and this old man is willing to bear the consequences!”
Just as he was begging for mercy from the non-existent Dao Protector, Ling Han had already ran out of his range of influence, communicating with the ley lines.
Xiu, the Star Steps unfolded, and he instantly disappeared.
After finding the large black dog and the others, Ling Han immediately set up the Transfer Formation and left the planet.
“What, you were ambushed?” When the large black dog and the others found out about the twists and turns of the matter from Ling Han, they immediately jumped up.
Needless to say, this was definitely the doing of those Imperial Clans.
Only they would have such great ability to make a Sect Master-level force obey their commands, and even make an old Sect Master act as a scapegoat.
“The Chang Clan is also involved.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have known where Little Han was at all.”
The truth of the matter was very easily pieced together.

It wasn’t complicated in the first place, but once it succeeded, as long as that old Sect Master of the Zhu Clan stubbornly insisted that it was his own doing, or even committed suicide, then how could the Nine Suns Holy Land blame this on the Imperial Clans?
Moreover, Ling Han and the others were very clear that in truth, the Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have an Imperial Weapon.
It only had a One Star Saint.
It was enough to scare people, but if it was really brought to the forefront... then it would be like a paper tiger that would be torn apart with a single poke.
“Motherf*cker, those Imperial Clan bastards still won’t stop!” the large black dog cursed.
“That’s natural.
Little Han’s talent scares them.
Who knows, he may be able to threaten those Golden Generation members, replace them, and become an Emperor,” the little azure dragon said.
This should be the thought of a portion of the members of the Imperial Clans.
They thought that Ling Han was a threat.
Of course, even more people believed in the Golden Generation, and thought that with this gap of a hundred years, Ling Han was already too far behind.
By the time he became a Saint, the competition for the throne would have already ended.
Thus, there was no rush to settle accounts now.
When a new Emperor appeared, he would naturally be able to crush the Nine Suns Holy Land with a single hand.
After Ling Han returned to the Nine Suns Holy Land, he related what had happened to the Nine Mountains Saint.
The Nine Mountains Saint immediately moved, destroying several important herbal planets of the Ziwei, Golden Cauldron and other Imperial Clans as a powerful counterattack.
The five Imperial Clans were naturally displeased, and raised their objections to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
However, the Nine Mountains Saint was extremely domineering, and he only said, “You guys caused this disaster on your own.
Don’t you have any ideas about it?”
The Imperial Clans instantly fell silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 4268: Dark Clouds Hell
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
This time, the Nine Mountains Saint had to be domineering.
Even if there was no evidence, everyone was well aware of the situation. If the Nine Mountains Saint chose to swallow his anger in silence, that would prove that he was a weakling.
Then, the Imperial Clans would tear off their pretence of peace and launch a full-scale invasion.

Thus, the Nine Mountains Saint unleashed his most powerful counterattack. ‘You want to kill my disciple, Ling Han, so I’ll return the favor and cause you to suffer grave losses. Moreover, this is only because Ling Han didn’t die. If Ling Han had died, my revenge would have been 100 times more intense!’

The worst off was naturally that old Sect Master of the Zhu Clan, who had been killed on the spot by the Nine Mountains Saint. However, the Nine Mountains Saint did not expand the scope of his revenge, and chose to spare the other members of the Zhu Clan.
And this time, Ling Han should have profited from this disaster.

That was because though the Nine Mountains Saint had destroyed a considerable number of herbal planets from the five Imperial Clans, he had also harvested a great many mature medicinal ingredients at the same time, and handed them all over to Ling Han.
—He naturally knew now that this disciple of his was also an alchemy prodigy!
These were the herbal planets of a few Imperial Clans. Though they did not have the highest grade of Saintly medicine, Ling Han still felt like this was surreal. He had made a fortune!

Ling Han first used natural treasures to cultivate. There was no need to refine them. They themselves were the purest energy, and did not need to be matched with any medicinal effects. Unfortunately, there were too few of these things, and they just barely delivered his fifth Stone Fetus to the state of Silver Fetus.
This, was far from enough.
Ling Han went to find the Nine Mountains Saint. He wanted to quickly become stronger.
Being bullied and ambushed time and time again by the Imperial Clans made him realize that he would be beaten if he didn’t have enough power.
If he was a Saint, what Imperial Clan would dare to speak loudly to him?

“Rapidly become stronger?” The Nine Mountains Saint murmured, “When I advance into Saint Tier, I can allow Regulations to enter my body, and forcibly use Regulations to improve your fruits of cultivation. It would indeed allow you to become Sect Master-level, or even Venerate Tier-level in the short term.”
“However, in this way, you will lose the possibility of advancing further.”

Of course, this was something that Ling Han definitely could not accept. Even the Nine Mountains Saint was just saying this. He was filled with anticipation for Ling Han. He was a potential candidate to become Emperor, so how could he stop at the level of Venerate Tier or even Sect Master-level?
“What else can I do?” Ling Han was unwilling to give up. With how big the heaven and earth was, how could it be that there was nothing that could perform a miracle?

The Nine Mountains Saint pondered for a moment, before saying, “There is indeed a place. However, that place is far too dangerous. Moreover, a Saint’s power is also insufficient. If you head there, you’ll have no option but to rely on yourself.”
“What place?” Ling Han’s eyes lit up.

“Dark Clouds Hell,” the Nine Mountains Saint said solemnly. “This is a desolate land of heaven and earth. It’s filled with all kinds of dangers. In the beginning, this was used as a place of exile. Many people committed serious crimes, yet they also had powerful backgrounds. Those who couldn’t be killed directly were thrown here.”
“But as time passed, someone actually built a city there, and that is... the City of Death!”
“The City of Death is filled with murderers and looters, all of whom are heinous criminals.”
“Thus, that place is naturally incredibly dangerous. Conflicts could break out at the slightest provocation, and people would be killed.”

“However, it’s said that the City of Death is very suitable for cultivating. It can increase one’s cultivation speed by ten times or even a hundred times. Thus, there are many people like you who took the initiative to enter the Dark Clouds Hell in order to quickly become stronger.”
“However, many people died in the Dark Clouds Hell before even finding the City of Death.”
Ling Han only considered for a moment, then said, “I want to go.”
The Nine Mountains Saint sighed. Though he was a little worried, he still supported Ling Han.

That was because he too knew that the Imperial Clans had not given up on killing Ling Han at all, and a conspiracy like the Zhu Clan would definitely not be just this one time. What if Ling Han was not so lucky next time?
Hence, only when he himself was strong, would he be able to fear nothing.
“All right, you have to be careful,” the Nine Mountains Saint reminded.

“I will.” Ling Han nodded. He was going to the Dark Clouds Hell to become stronger, so he could beat up the Imperial Clans as soon as possible. He naturally could not allow himself to be buried there.
“This horn.” The Nine Mountains Saint held that horn that could make one howl like a wolf, his eyes blazing, “According to my deduction, this horn is forged from the bones of a Great Emperor.”
What!
Ling Han was astonished. ‘F*ck! This background is huge!’ He had spent 20,000 Dao Stones to purchase a Great Emperor’s bone?

It should be known that when the Great Emperor was alive, he was extremely domineering, and was the overlord that had suppressed an era. After his death, would he be willing to allow others to trample over his remains?

Thus, the Great Emperor would usually bury himself in some desolate land, or in the Imperial Clan, or directly float in the Void. However, no matter where he was buried, the might of the Great Emperor would be able to shatter Saints, and others would not be able to approach at all.
Take, for example, the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. At that time, those Saints had also relied on the protection of the Imperial Weapon to enter into the body of the Great Emperor.

And this was still because that Holy Emperor had laid out a test, wanting to bestow the inheritance. Otherwise, so what if he possessed the Imperial Weapon? Didn’t you see how the Holy Emperor’s corpse finally broke through the Void and left on its own? Who could stop it?
Thus, Ling Han actually obtained a Great Emperor bone now, and it was even forgedinto a horn. This was really too shocking.

“It is definitely not a Saint that can forge the bone of a Great Emperor into a Spirit Tool,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. “Even if a hundred Saintd were added together, and even if the Imperial Weapon was used, it would still be impossible.”
The Great Emperor was invincible. This was not just empty words. Even after death, he could not be offended.

“Great Emperors don’t offend each other, and this is also an unwritten rule. No Great Emperor would destroy the grave of another Great Emperor and forge his remains into a Spirit Tool.” The Nine Mountains Saint continued, “Thus, this must have been forged from the bones that some Great Emperor had shed.”
Ling Han was astonished. This Great Emperor was truly open-minded. He had actually refined one of his bones into a tool and passed it onto his descendants!
However, as time passed, how had this top grade precious tool become a cheap item?
Er, don’t forget, wasn’t the heirloom of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor also bought at a streetside stall?
With this in mind, Ling Han didn’t find it strange anymore.

The Nine Mountains Saint helped Ling Han with his experiments. This bugle horn was ineffective against Saints, but even Venerate Tiers would be affected — they saw the two Venerates from the Nine Suns Holy Land were earnestly teaching Dao, they suddenly raised their heads and howled, causing the disciples beneath them to turn into stone. Ling Han and Nine Mountains Saint couldn’t help but laugh at this scene.
It was hard to tell that the Nine Mountains Saint also had a childish heart.

According to the deduction of the Nine Mountains Saint, because this horn was forged from the bones of an Emperor, it contained Regulations. Though it was not an Imperial Weapon, its practicality was still very high.
—For example, if he was being hunted down by an elite, and suddenly blew, that elite would immediately raise his head and howl like a wolf, and the crisis would naturally be resolved.
“Although it’s unreliable, it’s quite useful.” Ling Han nodded. Seeing as it was practical, he would endure it!
Next, he planned to go to the Dark Clouds Hell.

chapters.title: Chapter 4269: Entering the Black Hole
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
On this trip to the Dark Clouds Hell, Ling Han did not plan to bring anyone with him.

It was too dangerous there. There were no rules or morals, and the only thing they adhered to was respect for the strong. Thus, Ling Han prepared to go alone. This way, he would have no worries, and it would be convenient for him to do things.
“Little Han, live well,” the large black dog said.
“Come back and fight again. Grandpa Dragon doesn’t believe that I can’t defeat you.” This was naturally the little azure dragon.
“Your wives, I will take care of.” This was the pervert pig.
Ling Han immediately shot out a foot, “Believe it or not, I will ask Old Man Nine Mountains to move, and crush you into dust?”
“Hehe.” The perverted pig hurriedly laughed. One couldn’t be too despicable, even if he was a pig.

The empress and Hu Niu were both reluctant to part with him. It wasn’t easy for Ling Han to finally return to the Nine Suns Holy Land to reunite with them. However, he hadn’t stayed for many days, and he was about to leave again.
Ling Han was also reluctant, but he had to be decisive.
Separating now was for the sake of a better reunion in the future. Without powerful strength, there was no need to mention anything else.
“Alright, remember to bring gifts when you come back!” Hu Niu pouted.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a smile.
After bidding farewell, the Nine Mountains Saint set off with Ling Han, heading towards the Dark Clouds Hell.

This wasn’t in the North Heavenly Realm, but rather the South Heavenly Realm. They were really far apart. However, the Nine Mountains Saint was a Saint now, so how fast could he be? With a rip in space, it took onlt three days, and he had brought Ling Han to the South Heavenly Realm.
And this was a Saint at that. If it was an Ancestral King, he would be able to travel through the universe in a single day!
“This is the Dark Clouds Hell?” Ling Han was surprised, because they had not appeared on any planet, but rather in the universe.

It was complete darkness. There were no planets or stars, only eternal darkness. In fact, Ling Han felt a powerful attraction that wanted to draw him forwards. He could resist it, but there was a tearing feeling in his body.
Yi, what was going on here?

“There’s a black hole here,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. “After the sun dies, it’s possible for a black hole to form. It’ll grow from massive to infinitely tiny, and from there, it’ll also possess a powerful gravitational force. Even Regulations will warp.”
A thought suddenly occurred to Ling Han, “The Dark Clouds Hell is inside this black hole?”

“That’s right,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. “Thus, it’s easy to enter from here. You only have to give up your resistance and allow the black hole to draw you in, and you’ll naturally be able to enter. However, if you want to come out... you’ll have to reach the Venerate Tier to be able to break free from this gravitational pull.”

Ling Han nodded in understanding. The Mountain Sea Heaven was also a sun, and had been refined by the great power of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, then shrunk in size. Even the buildings there would be forcefully flattened, and Cauldron Forging Tier and Core Formation Tier were unable to fly, which showed how strong the gravity was.
The problem was how big was the Mountain Sea Heaven? And what about the black hole?
Hence, if one was sucked into this black hole, without power on the level of Venerate Tier, there was no way they could fight their way out.

“I’ll agree to a time with you. En, how about a time period of 10 years?” The Nine Mountains Saint said, “After 10 years, I’ll open up a passageway here to temporarily suppress the power of the black hole.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. Only Saints could be so powerful and suppress the gravitational pull of the black hole.

“Go on, be careful.” The Nine Mountains Saint looked at this disciple of his. Though he had not taken Ling Han as disciple all this while, in his heart, he had long since considered himself Ling Han’s master.
This disciple of his had never disappointed him. It had been like this in the past, and it was the same now. It would not change in the future.
Ling Han let go of his resistance. Xiu, he was instantly attracted by a powerful force, and headed towards a certain place in the universe.

The further he flew, the greater the gravitational pull was. When he reached a certain extent, Ling Han discovered that even if he resisted now, he would not be able to resist this kind of power, and could only leave it to fate.
He activated his mystical power shield to prevent the gravitational force from being too terrifying and tearing his physical body apart.

Ka, ka, ka! In just a short while, he discovered that a crack had appeared on the mystical power shield, which then shattered loudly. He hurriedly raised another mystical power shield. Though a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier wouldn’t die even if he entered, it was still best to be careful.
After an unknown amount of time, Ling Han suddenly saw a magnificent scene. In this place, light was distorted, and speed was ridiculously slow. He could easily capture it.

Ling Han was still being attracted. After another period of time, the gravitational pull disappeared, but in this place, aside from him, all other objects were torn into particles that were hard to see with the naked eye.
What about the Dark Clouds Hell?
Ling Han activated the mystical power in his body, and shot out a palm strike. Boom, his figure that had already stopped immediately began to move.
He swam in the black hole. The Dark Clouds Hell should be in some corner of this place.
Search.

If anyone else came here, they would definitely be extremely terrified, because the energy of heaven and earth here was all absorbed by the black hole. Even Venerate Tiers would be useless, as they would not be able to compete with the black hole at all. The mystical power would only become less and less.
Furthermore, even the Regulations here had been warped, and could not be used at all.
However, Ling Han was different. He had a frighteningly large reserve of mystical power. Even if he couldn’t replenish it in the slightest, it could still be used for a few years.
However, after a mere two days, he saw a stone door that was filled with a primitive aura.
There was actually a door inside the black hole!
Ling Han floated over, but did not immediately push open the doors and enter. Instead, he looked around.
However, looking at it this way, there was nothing special about it. There was only one word for it: ancient.
There was too much feeling of age. The stone doors were mottled, and it was unknown how many years they had been corroded by time.
Ling Han pushed open the door. The door was very heavy, but for him, it was no big deal. Very soon, it was pushed open a crack, allowing him to pass through.
However, he was curious, so he didn’t enter immediately. Instead, he continued to push.
Hong long long, even in this black hole, a loud sound was heard, as if a new world was being created.
So heavy!

When he had pushed open the doors halfway, even with Ling Han’s strength, he could not bear it any longer. It was as if what he was about to push open was not a door, but rather ten or even a hundred planets that were superimposed on one another.
He looked towards the doorway, but couldn’t see anything. There was only Primal Chaos.
This was the entrance to the Dark Clouds Hell?
Forget it, let’s go.
He leaned forward and entered the stone door. Hong long long, the stone door behind him slowly closed.

Ling Han walked forward. This place was filled with Primal Chaos. It couldn’t be considered dark. It was as if the universe had just been created. There was light, but it was still in the most primitive Primal Chaos.
After walking for two days, the path ahead of him suddenly became clear.
Ling Han couldn’t help but widen his eyes in disbelief.
That was because he had actually walked into a swamp.
In the skies, it was dusky, with heavy dark clouds. There were a small number of dark red clouds, which rendered the atmosphere very oppressive.
Ling Han looked behind him. That passageway was still there.
A swamp had actually appeared inside a black hole?
Ling Han found this to be inconceivable. He was even more curious. Who had discovered this place? What great elite would have nothing better to do, and crawl into a black hole for fun?
However, he had finally arrived at the Dark Clouds Hell.

It was too dangerous there.
There were no rules or morals, and the only thing they adhered to was respect for the strong.
Thus, Ling Han prepared to go alone.
This way, he would have no worries, and it would be convenient for him to do things.
“Little Han, live well,” the large black dog said.
“Come back and fight again.
Grandpa Dragon doesn’t believe that I can’t defeat you.” This was naturally the little azure dragon.
“Your wives, I will take care of.” This was the pervert pig.
Ling Han immediately shot out a foot, “Believe it or not, I will ask Old Man Nine Mountains to move, and crush you into dust?”
“Hehe.” The perverted pig hurriedly laughed.
One couldn’t be too despicable, even if he was a pig.
The empress and Hu Niu were both reluctant to part with him.
It wasn’t easy for Ling Han to finally return to the Nine Suns Holy Land to reunite with them.
However, he hadn’t stayed for many days, and he was about to leave again.
Ling Han was also reluctant, but he had to be decisive.
Separating now was for the sake of a better reunion in the future.
Without powerful strength, there was no need to mention anything else.
“Alright, remember to bring gifts when you come back!” Hu Niu pouted.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a smile.

This wasn’t in the North Heavenly Realm, but rather the South Heavenly Realm.
They were really far apart.

With a rip in space, it took onlt three days, and he had brought Ling Han to the South Heavenly Realm.

It was complete darkness.
There were no planets or stars, only eternal darkness.

He could resist it, but there was a tearing feeling in his body.
Yi, what was going on here?

The problem was how big was the Mountain Sea Heaven?
And what about the black hole?

En, how about a time period of 10 years?” The Nine Mountains Saint said, “After 10 years, I’ll open up a passageway here to temporarily suppress the power of the black hole.”

Only Saints could be so powerful and suppress the gravitational pull of the black hole.

This disciple of his had never disappointed him.
It had been like this in the past, and it was the same now.
It would not change in the future.

Ka, ka, ka!

Though a cultivator of the Core Formation Tier wouldn’t die even if he entered, it was still best to be careful.

Search.

chapters.title: Chapter 4270: Giant Swamp Scorpion
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
It was impossible to determine the location here.
There was no rising sun or setting moon, nor were there Regulations. This was an independent small world.
Ling Han sensed the ley lines, but shook his head. He couldn’t sense the ley lines here.

This meant that he had one less thing to rely on. However, Saints were unable to enter this place, and would be strongly rejected. Thus, if Venerate Tiers were in charge, then Ling Han would have the ability to protect himself with the help of the Great Emperor Horn.

Of course, he definitely couldn’t be careless, because Venerate Tiers were too powerful. If his reaction speed was slightly slower, and he couldn’t blow the horn in time, he would only be smacked into mush.
This thing could only catch save him by catching the other person off guard.

“So, the first thing to do is to keep a low profile,” Ling Han murmured. He definitely couldn’t attract the Venerate Tier elites’ hatred the moment he arrived. Then, he would only be able to hide here and there for the next ten years, so what was the point of talking about rapidly increasing his cultivation level?
“All right, begin searching for the City of Death.”
Ling Han set out, and began to advance.
Was this swamp made from blood clay?

Ling Han lowered his head to look. The ground was crimson red, and there was also a pungent smell of blood. He used his mystical power to form a hand, and grabbed a handful of dirt to observe. The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this was formed from blood and flesh.
“Yi?” He was surprised, because the hand formed from mystical power was actually rapidly corroding.
“Such powerful corrosive power,” Ling Han mused ruefully.

Thankfully, there was no terrifying gravity field suppression here, and there were Regulations that could be used. Flying was a piece of cake, so there was naturally no need to worry about being corroded by the mush.
“The Dark Clouds Hell is incredibly dangerous. It is possible that half of the people would die on the way before they could even find the City of Death.”
“Then, could it be that this blood clay is formed from the generations of people who have entered?”
Every year, a large number of people would be transferred into this space, and added with those prodigies that yearned for strength, the total number was really quite a lot.
Why were they exiled here, and not killed?

It was very simple. For example, the Imperial Son had a rare treasure that allowed him to communicate with his clan. Once he was killed, the Saint would be able to begin his prediction. It was clear who the culprit was, but if he was captured and thrown here, then no signal would be sent out. It was hard to know whether he would live or die.

Of course, there were really not many people that dared to trifle with the Imperial Clans. Thus, those that had been exiled here were mostly those from the Holy Land, Venerate Tier, and Sect Master-level forces, or those that had relations to these forces. They belonged to the category that could not be killed in the open.
This swamp stretched as far as the eye could see, so how many people had died to form it?
Ling Han sighed ruefully, and continued onwards. He had come for the sake of becoming stronger, and not to sigh ruefully.
However, which direction should he head in?
There was no north, south, east, and west here. Furthermore, even if he knew the direction, where should he go?
Ling Han merely headed in one direction. Worse come to worst, he would just walk around when he reached the end.
Peng!
All of a sudden, the mud in front of him split apart, and a dark red whip suddenly pierced out, ruthlessly piercing towards Ling Han.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over it. What whip was this? It was clearly the tail of a scorpion!
This was a sting from the tail, which was extraordinarily sharp and strong. It was covered with seals, and probably had great destructive power.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before retrieving a Three Star Spirit Tool. This was a hammer, a spoil of war that he had obtained previously. He then charged forward to block the attack.
Pu!
The scorpion’s tail pierced through the hammer.
F***, what terrifying destructive power.
This was a Three Star Spirit Tool, not some kind of toy.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, let go of the hammer, and threw a punch at the scorpion’s tail.
The punch landed solidly, and the straight scorpion sting was actually broken.

This time, the swamp below finally exploded. A massive scorpion suddenly burst out of the water, and added with its tail, its length exceeded three hundred meters. It was completely dark red in colour, covered densely with seals, all of which were glowing.
The sting on its tail had been broken, and it had gone mad from the pain!
Boom, the scorpion flicked its tail, and a powerful force assailed, instantly sending Ling Han flying.
What terrifying power.

Ling Han nodded. If a Core Formation Tier cultivator encountered this guy, they would definitely have no option but to flee. They wouldn’t even be qualified to oppose him, or they would definitely die.
He immediately charged back, using the Imperial Technique to battle fiercely with this scorpion.

In terms of power, it was indeed the scorpion that had the upper hand, but the fierce beast was only strong in terms of power, and did not know any celestial technique. Thus, with the advantage being equal, it was only equal in strength to Ling Han.
As they fought, this scorpion’s sting also recovered. Shua, it rapidly stabbed towards Ling Han again.

This was its deadly weapon, possessing a frightening effect of penetrating through defense, and as long as one was pierced by its sting, the frighteningly strong poison would instantly destroy one’s vitality. This was poison on the level of Regulations.
“Are you seeking death?” Ling Han asked with a smile. Weng! The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared before him.
Peng!

The sting of the tail stabbed forth, bringing with it a frightening power. It would be able to create a small hole even in Four Star Divine Metal, and a small hole was enough. As long as it could break through the defenses, it would be able to inject strong poison.
But the problem was, what kind of existence was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?
Origin Gold!

With this stab, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower remained unmoved, but its sting was once again broken, and this time was even worse. Previously, it had only bent slightly, and now, it was directly broken, leaving only a sliver that was still connected.
This caused the giant scorpion so much pain that it began to attack madly.
Ling Han was unafraid. If you can break through the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, then you win.
With the help of this Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, Ling Han easily killed the giant scorpion.
“This meat... is definitely not delicious!” Ling Han looked at the giant scorpion’s corpse slowly sinking into the swamp with a pained expression.
Ordinarily, the meat of fierce beasts would definitely be very fresh and delicious, but this giant scorpion lived in the blood clay all year round. Would he dare to eat this meat?
It was more or less equivalent to eating human flesh, and it was rotten at that.
Forget it. No matter how much he craved it, he couldn’t eat it.
Ling Han sighed, and could only continue onwards.
However, there were really quite a number of giant scorpions in this swamp. Not long after, another sting assailed him, planning to nail him to death on the spot.
There was no need to be reserved. They could only battle.

The battle continued, and after eleven days, Ling Han finally charged out of the swamp. However, there was no path ahead of him. The way ahead was enveloped by a ball of Primal Chaos, and he could not advance further. That Primal Chaos had a powerful rebound, and could not be entered at all.
Ling Han wasn’t disappointed. In the first place, he had wanted to walk around the swamp to take a look if there was no path out of it.
And after so many days, Ling Han had battled countless times, and his cultivation level had actually improved greatly.
“As expected, I am born to battle.”

Walking around the swamp, he naturally wouldn’t encounter the giant scorpions. Thus, even though the path around the outer circle was longer, because he didn’t need to battle, his speed was even faster. In just four days, he circled around about a quarter of the distance.
Ahead of him, a path had appeared.
It was no longer a swamp, but a forest.
He had finally found the right direction.
Ling Han took a few steps forwards, then stopped, and stared at these trees.
Hiss, the branches of these trees were actually covered with bones!

chapters.title: Chapter 4271: Black shadow
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
These white bones corresponded to different living beings.
There were humans, beasts, and some from half-humans and half-beasts. The corresponding remains of practically all the races that could be found in the universe could be found here.
How had these living beings died?
If they had been killed by someone, why had they been hung on a tree? Could it be some kind of ceremony of the natives?
Or perhaps, these trees... were man-killing demonic trees in the first place?
It was possible.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them. Remains hung on every tree. Only the amount differed.
A feeling of danger rose up in his heart, but he did not have the slightest intention of retreating. His figure flashed through the air, and continued onwards.
Everything was peaceful.
Ling Han was astounded as he flew through the air. He hadn’t come across any danger at all, so could it be that all he saw were illusions?
Kuang!

Right at this moment, a blood-colored bolt of lightning suddenly struck directly at him. Its speed was astonishingly fast, and as soon as the light was seen, it had already struck Ling Han’s head, instantly blasting him down from midair.

Thankfully, though the speed of this lightning was fast, its destructive power was only so-so. Ling Han did not land completely on the ground. He adjusted his position, and maintained the height of his flight.
Where had this lightning struck from?

Ling Han looked up at the sky. Most of the clouds here were dusky, but a few of them were blood-red. It was one of those clouds that had shot out blood-colored lightning, almost blasting him out of the sky.
Could it be that those corpses on the tree were the living beings that had been struck down by the lightning, and coincidentally hung on the trees?
He had not even finished the thought, when he heard a sharp cry, and a dark cloud appeared ahead of him.
No, it wasn’t clouds; it was birds!
A large flock of strange birds, all with three heads, were flying towards Ling Han at an extremely fast speed.
In just a short while, they had already drawn close. They stretched out their claws that were like Divine Metal, flickering with the cold light of metal, as they grabbed out at Ling Han.
Peng!

Ling Han exchanged a blow with a strange bird, and was already aware that the strength of this strange bird was inferior to his, but the problem was that it was not just one, but rather a whole flock of them!
With so many strange birds attacking him at the same time, even Ling Han wouldn’t be able to block them. He would be torn to pieces.
Ling Han hurriedly descended, but before he had even landed on the ground, those trees actually stretched out their branches towards him. They were like chains, wanting to entangle him.
‘F*ck! I’m surrounded by enemies!’
No wonder this place was called hell. It was really too unfriendly.
Ling Han channeled the Heavenly Dao Flames, and began a battle with these Tree Demons. Boom, the flames blazed, making the Tree Demons very wary, and not daring to push him too far.
However, was there no end to this?
In the sky, the three strange birds circled around and didn’t go away. Below him, the Tree Demons waved their vines and attacked endlessly, as if they wouldn’t give up unless they killed him.
Who was afraid of who!

Ling Han’s left hand channelled the Heavenly Dao Flames, while his right hand stimulated the Destructive Energy. He had now grasped five corners of the Destructive Energy Spirit Diagram, which was more than half, and was enough to unleash the might of the Destructive Energy.
Boom!

This high-level energy was too terrifying. Even if it was limited by Ling Han’s cultivation level, it still exploded with terrifying might, blasting those Tree Demons until they uprooted themselves and fled in all directions.
However, these creatures were really hard to deal with. Even if they fled, the other Tree Demons still blocked his path, and pushed him to the extent that he had to get serious.
After battling continuously for two days, even Ling Han felt a sliver of weariness.
His mystical power was still endless, but his spirit was weary.
Right at this moment, a sheet of darkness swept over from the distance.

This place was indeed very dim, but it was only dim, and not complete darkness. However, what swept over was pure darkness, as if it had swallowed up the forest in the distance, and nothing could be seen.

Boom! In an instant, the three-headed strange birds hovering in the sky all descended in panic, landing on the tree branches one after another. Meanwhile, the Tree Demons also became quiet, no longer attacking. It was as if they had become ordinary trees.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised. What did this darkness mean? It actually made the strange birds and Demonic Trees become so obedient?
He had not even finished the thought, when the darkness was already surging over fiercely, drowning Ling Han completely.
It was pitch black.
This was Ling Han’s only feeling. In this kind of darkness, he really couldn’t even see his own fingers. Even if he ignited the Heavenly Dao Flames, he still couldn’t see any light.
All of a sudden, he felt a terrifying chill, as if something was crawling on his back. A cold chill shot over, causing his hair to stand on end.
What the hell?
“Scram!” he shouted loudly. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared, instantly releasing streaks of Primal Chaos Qi. Even this darkness could not conceal the brilliance of the Origin Gold.
Ling Han turned his head slightly, and saw a head lying next to his left ear, but this really was just a head. It was incredibly black, and his features and hair could not be seen at all.
When Ling Han looked over, this head immediately cracked open, revealing a blood-red area, as it bit out at Ling Han.
Hehe.
Ling Han blew the Great Emperor Horn, and an invisible wave rippled out. That head immediately raised its neck, and howled at the skies, but did not release the slightest sound.
He took advantage of the opening to shake, and sent the other flying.

It was a human-shaped black shadow, but it seemed to be made of pure darkness. It only had the outline of a human figure. It had a face but no facial features. It had hands but no fingers, and looked indescribably evil.
Ghost?
Ling Han shook his head. Though this was very similar to a Yin soul, there was a sliver of life about it. It was not something from the Netherworld.
The black shadow faltered for a moment. What was going on? Why did he have to imitate the howl of a wolf?
It should be known that it couldn’t even make a sound, so why would it have the urge to bark like a wolf?
“Who cares what you are? I’ll blast you apart!” Ling Han shouted loudly. Boom, Destructive Energy surged all over his body.
Shua, shua, shua! More black shadows appeared, as if there were endless black shadows hidden in this darkness. All of them were staring at Ling Han.
All of a sudden, they all launched attacks at Ling Han.
“Let’s see if you’re ghosts or not!” Ling Han unleashed a murderous aura attack. Weng! The movements of the black shadows faltered, and even their faces twisted.
They didn’t have facial features, so their entire faces were twisted, making for a very strange sight.
“Just take on the barrage of murderous aura!” Ling Han charged over, swinging his fists in a series of punches.
Boom! Destructive Energy surged, and he unleashed his full battle prowess.

Even the Demonic Trees and the strange birds were very wary of these black shadows, but they were completely restrained by Ling Han. Under the barrage of the murderous aura, their battle prowess was greatly weakened. Then, with a blast from Destructive Energy, they dispersed one after another.
However, the darkness was like a tidal wave, and there was still no end to this black shadow.

Ling Han finally understood why the Demonic Trees and the strange birds had to retreat. That was because there were really too many black shadows, and no one could stop them. That was because most of them were in the skies. Thus, when they landed, they could dodge for a while. As long as they did not make any noise, they would not attract any aggro.
However, even though he knew this, he had no intention of fleeing.
Wasn’t this kind of bloody battle what he desired?
Only in battle would he be able to grow rapidly.
‘Come!’

chapters.title: Chapter 4272: Stone House in the Forest
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han fought bloody battles fiercely, and fought fiercely with those black shadow creatures whose origins were unknown.

Even if his battle prowess was formidable, and he himself could disperse attacks within six Heavens, as well as having an incredibly tough physique, faced with so many black shadow shadow creatures, he was still injured.
If they weren’t powerful enough, how could the Tree Demons and the three-headed strange birds avoid them?
Thankfully, this darkness continued to surge forwards, and lasted for about half a day’s time. Finally, all of it had passed.
Once the darkness disappeared, those black shadows also disappeared, as if they could only live in darkness.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief, and flopped onto the ground.
Tired, this was really too tiring. He had not just battled with the black shadow creatures for half a day. Previously, there had also been three-headed strange birds.
Yi?

Ling Han swept an eye over them, and saw that half of those three-headed strange birds had disappeared from the top of the trees, and the remaining ones had seemingly turned into stone statues. They did not immediately flap their wings and fly away, or attack Ling Han.
There was no benefit to be gained from killing these living beings. If they did not take the initiative to attack him, he had no intention of attacking either.
Forget it.
He recovered for a moment, then strode forwards.
After experiencing the havoc caused by the darkness, peace returned to this mountain forest for a short while. Whether it was the strange birds or the Demonic Trees, they all seemed to be sleeping.
No wonder.
Ling Han nodded. If there was no such peaceful time, then how many of the people who entered here would be able to find the City of Death alive?
After walking for a while, Ling Han actually discovered a stone house. It was especially simple and crude, and didn’t even have a table. It was empty, and pitifully small.
He searched for a while, but did not find anything inside.
This should have been left behind by predecessors, but what was the point of building a stone house in this man-eating forest?
Could it be that there would be people resting here?
He had already stepped onto the Celestial Path, so did he still need a place to shelter himself from the wind and rain?
Ling Han didn’t discover any abnormalities. He shook his head, and strode forward.
Another half day passed, and those Demonic Trees were once again “revived”. They began to launch attacks at Ling Han, but as they fought, darkness invaded again, just like before.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and faced off against the darkness, showing his boldness.
Yi?
He charged forward for a while, and couldn’t help but feel surprised, because he saw light.
What was going on?
Ling Han continued forward, and very soon, he discovered the source of the light. It was actually a stone house!

It was not much different from the stone house he had previously discovered. It was just a few stones pieced together, but now, every stone was exuding a gentle light. Though it was not bright at all, in this absolute darkness, it was enough to illuminate and warm the world.

Ling Han charged over, and entered into the stone house. He saw darkness whizzing past the doors, and multiple black faceless faces stopped at the doors. They peered inside for a while, and then whizzed off again.
This was a shelter.
Ling Han finally understood why there was such a stone house in the forest. This wasn’t to block the wind and rain, but to avoid being swallowed by the darkness.

He indeed didn’t need it. With his strength, he was completely capable of resisting the countless living beings in the darkness, but not everyone was as awesome as he was. Furthermore, there were still a great many Core Formation Tier cultivators that had entered here, so how could they resist?
What made Ling Han curious was, who had built this stone house?
Most of the people who had entered this place had been exiled. Who would be so kind as to actually build stone houses here to protect others?

Ling Han stretched out a hand to touch the stones. Previously, he had already studied them, but had not gained any results, and it was the same now. Though these stones were exuding a dim light, they were really very ordinary, as if they were mere rocks.
Half a day later, the darkness passed.

Ling Han tried to dismantle the building. These rocks were simply piled up, forming a house—actually, it would be more accurate to call it a stone box. Thus, as long as he took away the large rock at the top, there would be nothing above his head.
He stretched out a hand and squeezed, easily crushing a corner of the rock, as if he was picking out tofu.
It wasn’t that the stone wasn’t hard enough, but that it was completely inadequate in front of Ling Han.
Ling Han was certain that the strength of this stone was no different from ordinary stones.
But why could this form a shield in the darkness?
Ling Han was confused. He couldn’t figure it out no matter what.
After studying it for a while, Ling Han continued on his way. He couldn’t stay here and study it for the rest of his life just because he didn’t understand, right?

This forest was very big, and they would be able to find a stone house every once in a while. Thus, as long as he calculated the time accurately, one could actually pass through this forest without fighting a single battle.
After passing a few stone houses, when Ling Han arrived at the next stone house, he began to dig.
Perhaps the mystery of the stone house was not in itself, but rather in the ground beneath it.
However, after digging a few times, liquid gushed out.
At first, Ling Han thought that it was an underground spring, but when he saw the liquid gushing out clearly, he frowned.
That was blood!
After digging a few times, bright red blood actually gushed out. This was a little terrifying.
What was going on here? And how many people had died here? It was somewhat similar to the swamp.
He looked at the stone house, and with a thought, he immediately moved, tearing down this stone house and shattering every single stone.
Then, he left.
A day later, Ling Han ran back, but what he saw dumbfounded him.
That was because the stone house that had been torn to pieces was actually standing there again.
How was this possible?
It could not be that this stone house also had the ability to recover on its own. Ling Han didn’t believe it at all. Then who had come over and secretly rebuilt the stone house?
Just thinking about it caused him to feel a chill in his heart, yet a strong curiosity also surged up in him.
He moved again, and dismantled the stone house. Then, he did not leave, and simply waited there.
Nothing happened. The Tree Demons didn’t move, and the three-headed strange birds didn’t attack either. It was as if this was an extremely ordinary mountain forest.
Yi? Yi? Yi?
Could it be that because he was here, the miracle would not be performed?
Ling Han was just about to leave for the moment, then quietly circle back and hide at the side to keep an eye on things. However, darkness was sweeping over from ahead of him.
Prepare for battle!

Ling Han raised his fists. Right at this moment, he saw an inconceivable scene. An old man in grey robes quietly appeared. His hair was also greyish white, and his back was stooped, making him look extremely old.
This caused Ling Han to break out in a cold sweat, because he did not see where this old man had popped out from.
What was going on?

The grey-robed old man walked to the side of the original stone house, and picked up the stones that were scattered on the ground. As if building blocks, he stacked them one by one, and very soon, a simple stone house appeared.

In this process, the grey-robed old man did not cast a second look at Ling Han, but after the stone house was built, he walked in. Then, he turned around and smiled at Ling Han, quietly hiding inside.
This smile caused Ling Han’s hair to stand on end.
This was too bizarre.
