chapters.title: Chapter 4273: Strange Old Man
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Only now did Ling Han realize that though the speed at which the darkness was invading was astonishingly fast, and the grey-robed elder’s speed was very slow, right after he had built the stone house, the darkness actually had not surged over yet.
Boom, right at this moment, endless darkness assaulted.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before dashing toward the stone house.
His curiosity was really too great. He wanted to know what exactly was going on here.
However, after he entered the stone house, he shockingly discovered that there was no sign of the old man here.
Only this simple stone house was exuding a soft light, as if it was telling him that what Ling Han had experienced previously was not a dream, but a real and genuine matter.
Where was he?
He had vanished into thin air, just like how he had appeared out of thin air.
Ling Han released his divine sense, but his divine sense was completely useless in the darkness. It had been completely cut off.
What about underground?
It was useless. It was as if his divine sense had touched a layer of elastic film, and could not surge out at all.
Blood clay?
Ling Han frowned at this. Where had this grey-robed elder come from? Who was he? Why had he come to repair this stone house?
When the darkness had passed, Ling Han destroyed the stone house again, and this time, he shattered every single rock.
Then, he waited.
A day passed, and darkness arrived as promised.

The grey-robed old man appeared once more. This time, Ling Han watched closely. He was still unable to catch a trace of the old man. It was as if he had been here all this while, and he had only just discovered him.
Hehe, now that the stones have all turned into dust, what are you going to do?
However, the grey-robed old man merely stretched out a hand and pressed down. The rock dust all over the ground rose up, and then condensed together. Then, multiple large rocks appeared once more.
Just like yesterday, the old man slowly built the stone house.

This time, Ling Han could clearly see that the speed of the assault of darkness seemed to have slowed down tens of thousands of times in an instant. Including his movements, it was as if they had been frozen. Only the old man’s slow movements were completely unaffected.
Was it some kind of power of Regulation?
Ling Han thought quickly. As long as he had completely grasped the Regulations of Earth, it would naturally be an incredibly simple matter for the rock to transform from dust into solid form.
But this would have to be the cultivation level of a Saint, at least.
This grey-robed elder was a Saint?
What kind of joke was this? This place repelled Saints. Otherwise, Old Man Nine Mountains would definitely be happy to accompany him here, and protect this extremely important disciple of his.
Furthermore, did a Saint have nothing to do, to spend all his time building stone houses here?
Ling Han was extremely curious. Seeing that the stone house was about to be built, he hurriedly stretched out his figure and headed towards the stone house.
However, though the old man’s speed was slow, he was even slower. He had clearly used Imminent Skyline, yet he was crawling towards the stone house at an extremely slow speed like a tortoise.
At this time, the grey-robed old man had finished constructing the stone house. He turned his head, and smiled at Ling Han. The smile was incredibly strange, causing Ling Han to shiver all over.
Xiu, his speed suddenly sped up. No, it should be said that it was as if the effect of slowing down time had already disappeared, and he had returned to his normal speed.
Ling Han entered the stone house, yet he didn’t see the grey-robed elder again.

He shook his head. The grey-robed old man’s cultivation level should be far above him, and from the fact that he could slow down the time of others, it could be seen that the gap was really as wide as the sky.
This place... seemed to have very deep waters.
Ling Han stayed in the stone house for a long time. When it was “light” again, he didn’t cause any more damage to the stone house, because it was meaningless.

He walked along the river, and headed upstream.
After walking for a while, he suddenly saw a small boat in the river ahead of him.
Yi?

He looked closely. This ship was really very small. It was more suitable to call it a raft, and there was only a single person on the raft. Judging by the figure, it should be a man. He wore a bamboo hat on his head, and held a long pole in his hand.
Ling Han felt a sense of absurdity. In such a strange river, there was actually a boatman?
The small boat sailed with the flow of the river, so its speed was naturally fast. In an instant, it had arrived near Ling Han. The boatman raised the bamboo hat and glanced at Ling Han.
Ling Han’s heart involuntarily clenched. The eyes of this boatman were all turbid white, and his skin was greenish white, as if he was a corpse that had been dead for many years.

Endless curiosity welled up in Ling Han’s heart. However, he knew that his present cultivation level was too weak, and he was not qualified to investigate all of this at all.
“Become stronger! Become stronger!”

He strode over, only to see a group of people standing guard at the city gates. They were all at the Foundation Building Tier.
Foundation Building Tiers were guarding the gates, so it could be said that his lineup was quite luxurious.
However, it should bethat only those at the Core Formation Tier and above could come here alive. Otherwise, the black hole from before would be enough to tear people into pieces.
Thus, these people were either brought in by elites, or were natives of this place.

—After innumerable years, this City of Death had grown from nothing, and was created out of thin air. Furthermore, generations of people who had entered had also settled down here, and given birth to descendants, who would grow and multiply.
“Yi, are you new here, brat?” Seeing Ling Han approach, the guards looked at him for a while, then asked.
Ling Han smiled, “I don’t have any words engraved on my face, so how do you guys know that I’m new here?”

“Brat, your face is so fair, I can tell with a single look that you are an outsider!” A guard laughed, “After another month, if you are not dead, and if you still look like this, I will chop off my d*ck and give it to you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4274: Understanding the Situation
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han smiled, “I am indeed an outsider. Everyone, do you have any good suggestions for me?”
He didn’t have the slightest understanding of the City of Death, so he naturally couldn’t rashly barge in recklessly.
A few Dao Stones were gifted out, and instantly, these guards were all smiles, becoming incredibly attentive.

In truth, though Ling Han’s cultivation level was far higher than theirs, they were also people with powerful backers. If Ling Han dared to commit violence, it would be equivalent to embarrassing the Lord backing them. Then, no matter what Core Formation Tier or True Self Tier you were, you would only be blasted into smithereens.
—No matter how powerful his background was in the outside world, it was completely useless here. Even an Imperial Son had to behave himself.
Ling Han didn’t use his cultivation level to suppress them. Instead, he called them brothers, and even took out something as good as Dao Stones, which naturally made them enthusiastic.
Right now, the City of Death was divided into five major forces, and they were all at the Venerate Tier.

These five Venerates were the Ice Silkworm Venerate, the Nine Palace Venerate, the Blood Crow Venerate, the Crimson Moon Venerate, and the Brahman Sea Bodhisattva. The five Venerates led the almost ninety percent of the City of Death’s population, and the remaining portion was divided among the other forces.

The guards at the entrance belonged to the force under Crimson Moon Venerate. Even though they didn’t have much power, if anyone really dared to touch them, that would be equivalent to provoking Crimson Moon Venerate, and there would naturally be great elites who would move to suppress them.

In this place, aside from Dao Stones, there was also an even more valuable cultivation type divine material. It looked no different from a stone, and was covered with blood-colored patterns. If one used it for cultivation, it could increase one’s cultivation level extremely quickly, comparable to natural treasures.
This kind of cultivation DIvine Material was called the Source Dao Stone, because its effects were about the same as the Dao Stone, but a few hundred times better.

The Source Dao Stone was controlled by the five Venerate Tier elites. If one wanted to obtain it, their first priority was naturally to join the forces of the five Venerate Tier elites. After reaching a certain level or having performed a great merit, they would be rewarded.
The second was trading, using a large number of Dao Stones to buy it, or other treasures, such as Great Herbs, precious ingredients, and so on.
Finally, it was also the method that the majority would adopt, and that was to fight on the tournament stage.
After obtaining a certain number of victories, they would be rewarded with the Source Dao Stone, and if they won consecutively, they would also receive additional rewards.

B-but, this tournament stage battle was incredibly cruel, and would cause severe injury at the slightest provocation. After the tournament, losing an arm or a leg was a common occurrence, and there was no small number of people who were carried out every day.

However, this was the fastest way to obtain Source Dao Stones. Moreover, one didn’t need to walk on eggshells around others. As long as one had enough abilities, they could obtain it. Thus, this was also the most commonly used method.
After Ling Han thanked these guards, he entered the City of Death.
First, he had to find a place to settle down.

Previously, the guards had also told him about a very important matter, and that was though there was no difference of day and night in the City of Death, because they were all descendants of outsiders, they were used to the concept of day and night.
At midnight, a terrifying cold wind would blow through the entire city, easily freezing people to death.
Thus, at this time, aside from the Sect Master and Venerate Tier-level great elites, the others could only stay at home obediently. Going out would only be seeking death.
The strange thing was that as long as the structures were built from the stones of the City of Death, no matter how simple and crude they were, they would be able to resist the cold wind.
This kind of stone material had long since been distributed. It was completely impossible for him to get some stones himself to build a simple house.
Thus, he could only find an inn first.
Staying in an inn was paid for in Dao Stones. Of course, you could also use Source Dao Stones, but there shouldn’t be anyone that would be so stupid.
Ling Han followed the information provided by the guards, and soon found an inn.
“The Spiritual Rain Inn.” He glanced at the plaque on the inn’s door, then strode in.
This inn was very big, and had a continuous stretch of rooms. Furthermore, there were also many people living here. People came and went, appearing to be very lively.
Ling Han’s arrival didn’t attract anyone’s attention. In the outside world, he was the renowned freak, and only the Golden Generation, Ding Shu, and a few other people could match his natural talent.
But in this place, no one recognized him.
He was an extremely ordinary person.
Ling Han asked for a guest room. The accommodations here were astonishingly expensive. Staying for a night actually cost a hundred Dao Stones; it was really no different from robbing money.
But there was nothing that could be done. The cold winds could kill, and unless you were Sect Master-level, you could only obediently allow yourself to be slaughtered.
—What, just stay and then run without paying?
Do you know who this inn belongs to?
Crimson Moon Venerate!
To dare to stay and leave without paying at the inn belonging to a Venerate Tier, he was really tired of living.

Ling Han paid for a month of accommodations in advance. What he lacked the least now was the Dao Stones. Although he had used up all the Universe Coins in his Galaxy Network’s account, he still had a lot on him.
After resolving the problem, Ling Han began to find out about the specific situation of the tournament stage battles.

This kind of battle was conducted at a set location. In the Dark Battlefield of the city, participating in the battle did not require any fee, and it was the same for watching the battles. However, whether it was battle or watching the battles, they would all be facing extremely great danger.
That was because there were no restrictions here. If the shockwaves from the attacks blasted out, it was possible that the spectators would be severely injured, or even killed.
And there was no referee in battle. If one wanted to win, the opponent would either have to admit defeat, or one would have to beat his opponent to death.
It was said that this Dark Battlefield was jointly controlled by the five Venerate Tier elites, so no one dared to cause trouble.
This caused Ling Han to feel curious. If there were no benefits to be gained, why would the five Venerate Tier elites do something so superfluous?
Was it just to add a little entertainment for everyone after their meals?
In reality, Ling Han was more interested in finding out where the Source Dao Stones had been mined from. If he knew where it was, he would directly dig it up.
This matter naturally had to be considered at length. However, it was true that one could obtain the Source Dao Stones by fighting on the tournament stage.

Ling Han took a look. Every time he won three battles, he would be able to obtain a Source Dao Stone, which was about the size of a segment of his pinky. It was pitifully little, and if he won ten battles in a row, he would be able to win a fist-sized Source Dao Stone. These two methods could be compounded.

There were two types of tournament stage battles. One was a battle of equal minor level, and the other was a battle of equal cultivation levels. If one could defeat an opponent whose cultivation level was higher than his, he would be able to obtain additional marks, which would increase the size of the Source Dao Stone that he had won.

Additionally, one was allowed to admit defeat in the tournament, but after the number of times he had admitted defeat had accumulated to three times, he would be punished to not be able to fight on the Dark Battlefield again for half a year.
Thus, as long as there was a chance of turning the tables, the participants would also try their best. This undoubtedly increased the risk, causing even more people to be injured or even die.
After Ling Han found out about all this, he took a good rest. On the second day, he rushed to the Dark Battlefield to register.
He chose to battle at the same cultivation level, not minding that his opponent’s cultivation level was higher than his.
In a short while, he received news that he could enter the arena for a battle.

He entered, and saw that this Dark Battlefield was very big, and could accommodate at least ten groups of people battling at the same time. Furthermore, there was not only a one-on-one battle here, there was also a one-on-many battle, and many against many. It was divided into different battle areas.

chapters.title: Chapter 4275: Battle Begins
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

In the short amount of time that Ling Han had walked to his own battle area, he had seen at least three people killed. One had been beheaded, one had been sliced in half, and the last was even worse, directly smashed into a bloody mess.
It was really bloody and cruel.
He stood firmly in his own area of battle, and his opponent had already walked over. He was wearing heavy armour, and appeared to be very clumsy.
“Brat, you’re dead!” the armored man said. He was tall and sturdy, and was at least a head taller than Ling Han.
True Self Tier, fifth form.

Ling Han nodded internally. This meant that he had the potential to break through to Sect Master-level. Of course, having potential was one matter, and being able to become Sect Master was another matter.
“Come on.” He crooked a finger.

This armored man was filled with killing intent, and it was definitely not something that had been formed overnight. Instead, it was an aura that had naturally formed after experiencing who knew how much bloodshed.
It was said that the City of Death was a slaughterhouse, and it was indeed true. He had just entered, and he was already experiencing it for real.
“Die!” The armored man leaped up, brandishing the heavy shield in his hands, and ruthlessly smashed it towards Ling Han.
Peng!
His attack missed its target, yet he simply bared his teeth in a grin. He then charged toward Ling Han like a vicious bear.
This place greatly limited their speed.

Right now, the speed that Ling Han could unleash was only one-ten-thousandth of his usual speed. This was understandable. After all, there was a limit to the space on the arena. If he were to unleash his full speed, he would be able to leave this place in a single stride. That being the case, what was the point of fighting?
Now, everyone’s speed had decreased drastically, and was limited to this.
He temporarily did not counterattack, but rather observed the strength of this opponent.
At the same time, in the VIP seats of the spectators.

“Young Master Yao, your subordinate, this fierce general, has already achieved nine successive wins. If he wins another battle, he would be able to obtain ten consecutive wins, and receive an exorbitant reward,” a young man said. The person he was talking to was also a young man. He was dressed in yellow robes, his face filled with arrogance.
The yellow-robed young man revealed a proud expression, yet deliberately waved his hand, “It’s just a small profit. A mere C-grade Source Dao Stone is not worthy of my notice.”
“Only Young Master Yao would be so generous,” the first young man praised.
The yellow-robed young man was proud, appearing to be in a very good mood.
But very quickly, the smile on his face disappeared.
That was because Ling Han had launched a counterattack.

This armored man’s battle prowess was extraordinary. Being able to advance into the fifth form meant that he had the potential to become a Sect Master elite. “Can I have a word with you?” the young man asked.

The black-robed young man appeared slightly awkward, but very quickly, he said, “I am Gu Xuefeng. Greetings, Brother Ling.”
Ling Han nodded. It was clear that the other party had already obtained his information.
“Alright, then let’s go and meet him.”
Gu Xuefeng couldn’t help but feel pleasantly surprised. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so amicable.
He led the way in front. After taking a few steps, he turned around and said, “To be honest with Brother Ling, I actually only entered here more than twenty years ago.”

“Oh?” Ling Han glanced at him, slightly surprised. That was because this person’s natural talent in cultivation was really not all that impressive. There was not much significance for him to come in to train.

chapters.title: Chapter 4276: Do as he willed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Gu Xuefeng sighed, and continued, “I think that Brother Ling entered into this space to rapidly become stronger, right? This is also the reason why most people have entered into this space, but I... I was forced to flee into this place because I killed an enemy, and to avoid being hunted down.”
Ling Han nodded in understanding. No wonder.

Not everyone would enter the Dark Clouds Hell to become stronger; only those with high natural talent in cultivation would. What was the point of a mediocre person like you coming here? Not only would you not be able to become stronger, you would only be seeking death.
Thus, this Gu Xuefeng could only submit to power and stay alive.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He could understand his actions, but it did not mean that he would agree.
Led by Gu Xuefeng, they soon saw Liu Yao.

“You’re quite bold, aren’t you? You even dare to kill my people?” Liu Yao looked coldly at Ling Han. His cultivation level was clearly much lower than Ling Han’s, yet he still wore a disdainful expression.
It could not be helped. He had a backer.
On the way, Ling Han had already heard Gu Xuefeng mention Liu Yao’s identity. He was merely the son of a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite. What was there to be proud of?
“So what if I kill him?” He raised a brow.

Liu Yao wore a baleful smile as he said, “I can guarantee that you won’t live more than 10 steps after leaving this place. Unless...” He paused for a moment before continuing, “You can help me fight on the tournament stage in the future.”
“Help you fight in the arena?” Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Then what about the Source Dao Stones that I obtained?”
“Of course, it belongs to me,” Liu Yao said with a matter-of-fact expression. “You’re under my protection, so it’s already extremely fortunate that you’re still alive. What else do you want?”

He smiled again, “Don’t ever mention to me how awesome you are outside, and how powerful your backer is. Let me tell you, all of this is useless! Once you enter here, you are a fish on a chopping board, and can only be slaughtered at the mercy of others!”

“You can ask Gu Xuefeng. If he had not had my protection, how many times would he have already died? Furthermore, there are a great many people here that have special fetishes. Hehe, when the time comes, you will not just die. Just look at how fair you are. Who knows, you may even be r@ped, and even be refined into a human tool after death, for others to play with.”
“Look, am I not very benevolent? You killed one of my men, yet I still gave you a way out?”
After saying this, Liu Yao looked at Ling Han smilingly, looking like he was sure that Ling Han would submit.

He had seen too many outsiders suddenly collapse here. Under the pressure of life and death, there were really not many that could hold up. Even if you were a prodigy, your willpower would still crumble under such helpless circumstances.
Meanwhile, Gu Xuefeng said to Ling Han, “Brother Ling, Young Master Yao is right. The City of Death does not have any laws, and elites can do as they please.”
“Can they really do as they please?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“That’s right,” Gu Xuefeng nodded.
“All right.” Ling Han smiled.
Liu Yao was bold and frank, and thought that Ling Han had finally recognized the reality now, and was about to submit to him.
Pa!
Ling Han leaned over and delivered a slap to Liu Yao’s face. The force was so great that Liu Yao was forced to spin seven times on the spot.
Gu Xuefeng immediately gaped, his face filled with shock.
F***, what have you understood?

Liu Yao also stopped spinning. He was a little dizzy, and one of his hands covered his face that had been slapped. Immediately, he groaned in pain. This side of his face was already bulging, and the slightest touch made him feel as if he had been slashed.
“You, you dare to hit me?” He was furious.
Pa, Ling Han sent out another slap, landing on the other half of Liu Yao’s face. This guy was once again spinning in circles on the spot.
No more, no less. It was still seven rounds.
Gu Xuefeng: “...”
Liu Yao once again stopped. He was both shocked and furious, “Ling Han, you’re dead! Dead!”
Meanwhile, Ling Han cracked a smile, “You said it yourself. Elites can do as they please. I am stronger than you, so what if I hit you? Is there any law here that can punish me?”
“You—” Liu Yao was directly rendered speechless.

There were indeed no rules in the City of Death. If there was one, it was that one could not trifle with the five great Venerate Tier elites. Aside from that, if you wanted to kill, you could kill, even if you wanted to kill one or a thousand.

However, murder could not be within the territory of the five Venerate Tier elites. For example, the Spiritual Rain Inn that Ling Han was staying in was in the territory of the Crimson Moon Venerate. If anyone dared to offend it, that would be equivalent to provoking the Crimson Moon Venerate, and they could only wait for death.
Who was Liu Yao?
He belonged to the force under Blood Crow Venerate, and you actually dare to trifle with him?
Ling Han patted Liu Yao’s forehead, and said, “So, behave yourself. Otherwise, I’ll kill you!”
When he spoke of the word ‘kill’, his killing intent circulated, baleful and sinister.
Liu Yao instantly broke out in a cold sweat. He had a feeling that if he dared to exude any kind of hostility at this moment, Ling Han would really kill him without the slightest hesitation.
Seeing him nod like a chick pecking at rice, Ling Han smiled in satisfaction, turned and left.

When Ling Han’s figure had completely disappeared, Liu Yao finally flopped onto the ground. He felt that his undergarment was completely drenched, and even his hair was sticky, as if he had just been fished out of the water.

He panted heavily. Just now, he had actually been so scared that he had even stopped breathing. If it was not for the fact that he had already advanced into Celestial Path, would he have suffocated himself to death?
Then, when his intelligence gradually returned to normal, his expression immediately became incredibly dark.
F***, he actually dared to threaten him?
“I want you to die, die!” he roared lowly, his eyes spitting fire.

“Young Master Yao!” Gu Xuefeng said weakly from the sidelines, “Ma Han is already your number one lackey, and even he died by Ling Han’s hand. There should be no one in the True Self Tier that can deal with that guy.”

Liu Yao’s expression involuntarily froze. He was only the son of a Spirit Transformation Tier. Although he had taken advantage of the situation to take in a few subordinates of True Self Tier, that was all. It was impossible for the a Spirit Transformation True Lord to obey his every command.
However, Ling Han was so powerful that he had killed Ma Han with a single punch. How many True Self Tier cultivators could match such strength?
Thus, if he wanted to kill Ling Han, he would have to send out a Spirit Transformation True Lord. However, how could he mobilize a Spirit Transformation Tier?

“Got it!” His eyes shone brightly. He himself could not mobilize a Spirit Transformation True Lord, but the other second-generation young masters could. He only had to be able to ask this kind of second-generation young master.
Good.
After Ling Han exited the Dark Battlefield, he began to wander around the city. In any case, he only had to return to the inn before midnight.

With such a short amount of time, it was naturally impossible for him to explore the entire city. However, based on what he had seen in this half a day’s time, he did not find a place that sold alchemical pills.

This could be imagined, because those who entered here were usually exiled. Of course, it was not possible that there would be an alchemist like Ling Han — if it was an alchemist, it would be better to lock him up in his own force, and have him continuously concoct alchemical pills as compensation.
And those that took the initiative to enter here were basically prodigies of martial arts. In order to rapidly become stronger, there would definitely be no alchemist among them.
“By the looks of it, if I sell alchemical pills here, would there be a very ‘wealthy’ path?” Ling Han murmured, his eyes slightly bright.

chapters.title: Chapter 4277: Obtaining the Source Dao Stone
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Before entering into the Dark Clouds Hell, Ling Han had already bought a large amount of medicinal ingredients. As an alchemist, he naturally had to make full use of his strengths at all times.
He decided to concoct an alchemical pill that would help him comprehend Dao.
In this place, healing medicine definitely did not have much future prospects.
The reason was very simple. If a battle broke out here, it would either result in death or severe injury.

A dead person naturally did not need any medicine, and in the case of severe injury, it was basically something like a severed arm or leg. Only a Saint-level Great Herb would be able to regrow a severed limb. Ling Han was completely unable to help with this.
Thus, he decided not to concoct any healing medicine.
Those that could increase cultivation... er, the Source Dao Stone here was a saintly item that could increase cultivation level. Otherwise, why would everyone have come here?
Thus, he could only sell alchemical pills that could help in the comprehension of Dao.

Yi?

In this City of Death, there was actually someone who wanted to buy a Four Suns Pill?

Standing in front of his stall was a young man who looked to be in his mid-twenties. He had a lanky figure, and was also extremely handsome. His black hair draped over his shoulders, and his hair glowed faintly, making him appear outstanding.
“No.” Ling Han shook his head.
The young man instantly looked disappointed. He sighed, turned and left.
“However, I can concoct alchemical pills,” Ling Han continued.
Shua, that young man immediately turned around, his face filled with delight, “Really?”
“M-hm.” Ling Han nodded in understanding. The Four Suns Pill was only a five-star alchemical pill, so refining it could not be too easy for him.
“All right, then I’ll have to trouble you to help me concoct it,” the young man said.
“Pay the deposit first. I will go and prepare the ingredients,” Ling Han said. “In three days’ time, come here to collect the medicine.”

The young man hesitated slightly. What if Ling Han accepted the deposit and ran off? But in an instant, he took out a Source Dao Stone and threw it over, “My name is Yuan Bing. If you dare to deceive me, humph!”
This Source Dao Stone was only the size of a finger. Ling Han put it away, and said with a smile, “Don’t worry.”
He could actually refine it on the spot, but there was no need for him to be so high-profile, right?
“That had better be the case.” Yuan Bing nodded, “If you can concoct the Fourth Refinement, then I will befriend you.”
“Sure,” Ling Han said casually. He was completely unconcerned. With his natural talent and abilities, did he still need to rely on the help of others?
Yuan Bing appeared slightly surprised. He had already announced his name, so why was Ling Han not the slightest bit surprised?
Could it be that he didn’t know who he was?
He pondered for a moment, then turned around and left.
He would just wait three days.

chapters.title: Chapter 4278: Sowing Discord
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Yuan Manor.
Yuan Xinrong was a subordinate of the Seven Generals of the Blood Crow Venerate. He could be considered a mighty figure, and he himself was a powerful Sect Master.
Liu Yao was at the door, and he turned to a guard and asked, “Young Master Bing, are you free today?”
“Young Master Bing seems to be in a better mood today,” the guard said with a nod. He accepted the Dao Stone from Liu Yao.
“Then please help me report my visit to him,” Liu Yao appeared to be very polite.
“All right.”
The guard entered, and not long after, he returned, and said, “Young Master Bing has invited you in.”
Liu Yao hurriedly entered, and with the guidance of that guard, he arrived at a study.
A young man was presently drawing on the table. Under his penmanship, a painting of a sun rising over the sea was just about completed.
Liu Yao did not say anything. He merely waved his hand to dismiss the guard, and waited quietly on the sidelines.
If Ling Han was present, he would be able to recognize with a single glance that this young man who was painting was the Yuan Bing that had sought him out to concoct the Four Suns Pill today.
In a short while, Yuan Bing withdrew his brush.
The painting was completed.
“Brilliant! Brilliant! Brilliant!” Liu Yao immediately applauded. “Young Master Bing, your painting skills have improved again. Just look at the Intent Realm. Tsk, tsk, tsk! It’s truly amazing.”
Yuan Bing merely smiled subtly, but there was an unconcealable pride in his expression. Clearly, he was very pleased with Liu Yao’s flattery.
“Young Master Bing, how’s your esteemed mother’s condition?” Liu Yao asked.

He naturally knew that Yuan Bing’s birth mother had always had a weak physique. In the outside world, this wouldn’t be a big problem, as there would naturally be medicines that could heal and nourish the body. However, this was the Dark Clouds Hell, where there was only slaughter. The only specialty was the Source Dao Stone, so where would there be tonic medicine that could nourish the body?
Yuan Bing pondered for a moment, then said, “If everything goes smoothly, after three days, my mother would no longer need to be troubled by this.”

“Congratulations, Young Master Bing! This is a great joy!” Liu Yao hurriedly said. This Yuan Bing was a filial son, so if they wanted to befriend him, they naturally had to accommodate his traits as well. “Young Master Bing’s filial heart for your dear mother has touched heaven and earth, and a miracle finally happened.”

Yuan Bing laughed loudly, and waved his hand, “It was not due to me, but rather my mother has always been kind and merciful. Usually, she would not bear to even stomp an ant to death. It was she who touched the blessing of heaven and earth, and they sent reinforcements.”
Liu Yao hurriedly agreed. ‘You’re the boss, so whatever you say goes.’
After flattering him for half a day, Yuan Bing asked smilingly, “What business do you have with me?”

“Can’t I come see Young Master Bing for no reason?” Liu Yao said with a smile. However, he immediately changed the topic, and said, “Young Master Bing, I truly didn’t want to trouble you with this matter. However, you’re my only boss, so if you don’t stand up for me, I’ll have nowhere to complain.”
Yuan Bing was presently in a good mood, and nodded as he asked, “Speak, what trouble have you encountered?”

“Young Master Bing, I have a subordinate who was beaten to death a few days ago when he was battling on the Dark Battlefield,” Liu Yao said. “Initially, it would have been normal for there to be life and death in a tournament stage. However, that rookie was extremely arrogant. So be it if he won. He actually came to provoke me and called me trash, saying that it was natural that my subordinate was also trash. In fact...”
“In fact?” Yuan Bing asked.
“In fact, he even said that I’m a piece of trash, and my boss must also be a piece of trash!” Liu Yao completely twisted the facts, and began to make a malicious accusation against Yuan Bing.
As expected, Yuan Bing immediately humphed, and said, “Oh, is he really so outrageously bold?”

“Young Master Bing, he is a rookie, so he’s most likely quite famous in the outside world. That’s why he doesn’t know how to behave even after coming here. There’s no need for you to drop to his level,” Liu Yao said in persuasion.
Yuan Bing couldn’t help but sneer, “What do you mean ‘lower myself to the same level’! Humph, where is that person, I would really like to meet him!”
Liu Yao couldn’t help but reveal a proud smile. He had already brought out Yuan Bing, then Ling Han’s only fate would naturally be death.
‘You dare to hit me? F*ck!’
After Ling Han returned, he concocted the Four Suns Pill. For the Alchemy Emperor, this was naturally no big deal.
On the second day, he received a notice from the Dark Battlefield that there would be another battle.
Move out.
He was only going through the motions, so he naturally gained another victory. However, just as he was about to leave, he saw Gu Xuefeng again.
“My Young Master would like to invite you for a while,” Gu Xuefeng said.
Ling Han smiled, “That idiot still hasn’t learnt his lesson?”
Gu Xuefeng shook his head, “This time, Young Master Yao has brought a helper.”
“Is that so?” Ling Han smiled, “All right, then let’s go and see who he has invited.”
This time, he was going to beat Liu Yao into submission, so that he would never bark in front of him again.
Gu Xuefeng led the way ahead, and very soon, they arrived at a private room.
Yi, he had leveled up?
Previously, Liu Yao had only been seated in the VIP seats, but had not reached the level of having a private room.
Gu Xuefeng knocked on the door first, and when the sound of “enter” was heard from inside, he finally pushed open the door.
Ling Han strode in, and as his eyes swept over the surroundings, a strange expression involuntarily appeared on his face.
This world... was too small, wasn’t it?
The reinforcements that Liu Yao had called over were actually Yuan Bing!
Hehe, a smile appeared on his face. Now, there was going to be a good show.
Yuan Bing was also startled. He had not thought that the person he had come to “suppress” today would actually be Ling Han. This was perhaps the only person who could save his mother.
What a joke. For a filial son like him, he would rather suffer a beating, if it meant that his mother would be saved.
All of a sudden, his expression darkened.

How could Liu Yao possibly know so much? He only thought that the expression on Yuan Bing’s face was directed at Ling Han. After all, he had been spreading rumors, saying Ling Han had once called Yuan Bing trash.
“Ling Han, how dare you insult Young Master Bing and call him trash! Now that Young Master Bing is here, are you going to deny it again?”
This was very poisonous.

If Ling Han shook his head, that would be equivalent to admitting to Liu Yao’s accusation, and that he had indeed insulted Yuan Bing previously, but if he nodded... er, that would be even more of an admission.
“What is it? Why are you cowering in front of Young Master Bing?” Liu Yao continued to add fuel to the fire. “Weren’t you extremely bold just then?”
Ling Han merely watched his performance quietly, as if he was a clown.
“Say something, why aren’t you saying anything?” Liu Yao sneered. He couldn’t mobilize Spirit Transformation Tier elites, but Yuan Bing could. Thus, Ling Han was already a corpse.
“What do you want me to say?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“Kneel!” Liu Yao said balefully.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and asked Yuan Bing, “Do I really have to kneel?”
Yi, what was going on here?
Liu Yao suddenly felt like things were about to go out of control. Why did he feel like Ling Han and Yuan Bing seemed to know each other?
But how was this possible?

Ling Han was only a rookie who had just entered this place, while Yuan Bing was a Sect Master-level Young Master. The gap between the two of them could be said to be like the gap between heaven and earth. Thus, it was absolutely impossible for these two people to come into contact with each other.
Yuan Bing looked towards Liu Yao, and stated calmly, “Kneel!”
What?
— New chapter is coming soon —

Now that Young Master Bing is here, are you going to deny it again?”
This was very poisonous.

If Ling Han shook his head, that would be equivalent to admitting to Liu Yao’s accusation, and that he had indeed insulted Yuan Bing previously, but if he nodded... er, that would be even more of an admission.
“What is it?
Why are you cowering in front of Young Master Bing?” Liu Yao continued to add fuel to the fire.
“Weren’t you extremely bold just then?”
Ling Han merely watched his performance quietly, as if he was a clown.
“Say something, why aren’t you saying anything?” Liu Yao sneered.
He couldn’t mobilize Spirit Transformation Tier elites, but Yuan Bing could.
Thus, Ling Han was already a corpse.
“What do you want me to say?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“Kneel!” Liu Yao said balefully.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile, and asked Yuan Bing, “Do I really have to kneel?”
Yi, what was going on here?
Liu Yao suddenly felt like things were about to go out of control.
Why did he feel like Ling Han and Yuan Bing seemed to know each other?

What?

chapters.title: Chapter 4279: Smashed His Own Foot
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Liu Yao was dumbfounded for a second.
Previously, though he had felt that the situation was about to go out of control, it shouldn’t have reached this extent, right?
Kneel?
‘Me?’
‘Hmm?’
Yuan Bing’s gaze turned cold, and he asked calmly, “What is it? Do you not understand?”
Only then did Liu Yao come back to his senses. He looked at Yuan Bing sheepishly, “Young Master Bing, are you joking?”
“Which eye of yours saw that I was joking with you?” Yuan Bing said, “Kneel!” He raised his voice.

In the eyes of a filial son like him, Ling Han, who was perhaps the only person who could save his mother, was naturally 10,000 times, or 100 million times more important than Liu Yao. If he was sure that he could save his mother, he himself would not hesitate to kneel down.
Liu Yao?
They were just friends, and he was very clear about that.
Liu Yao’s face was filled with grievance, and he was even more defiant.
What right did he have?
Yuan Bing was the reinforcement that he had invited, but now, the reinforcement had turned around to deal with him. What was this? Was he shooting himself in the foot?

Meanwhile, Gu Xuefeng was watching from the sidelines. This outsider was too awesome, wasn’t he? He had only entered for a few days, and he had already suppressed Liu Yao. In comparison, he had been in here for more than twenty years, yet could only become a lowly dog. Just how wide was the gap between them?
What Liu Yao wanted to do the most now was to leave with a flourish of his sleeves.
But he did not dare.

His old man was only a soldier under Yuan Bing’s old man. When one had reached the level of Spirit Transformation Tier, they could be considered important, or they could also be considered unimportant.They were completely replaceable.
Thus, if he really angered Yuan Bing, to say nothing of him, even his father would be in trouble!
At that time, there would probably be no need for Yuan Bing to make a move. His old man would first put righteousness before family, and kill him with his own hands.
Pa! Liu Yao’s knees buckled, and he fell to his knees.
“Slap yourself a hundred times!” Yuan Bing stated calmly.
Liu Yao had already knelt, which meant that his will to resist was already dead. Immediately, he raised his right hand, and delivered a harsh slap at his own face.
Pa, pa, pa, one, two, three, four...
Yuan Bing smiled at Ling Han, raised his teacup, and said, “I’ll use tea as wine, and apologize to you on behalf of my underling.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.

He was also very clear that the reason why Yuan Bing placed so much importance on him now was because he wanted the Four Suns Pill, but if he could not produce the Four Suns Pill, he was sure that Yuan Bing would return all this to him in double the amount.
Ling Han naturally didn’t care about this.

In truth, he had already concocted the alchemical pill, but since he said that he would retrieve the alchemical pill three days later, then that would have to be three days later. In terms of alchemy ability, it was better for him to keep a low profile. There was no alchemist here. If others knew that he knew how to concoct Venerable Tier-level alchemical pills, perhaps a Venerate Tier would make a move on him.
He had come here only for the sake of rapidly increasing his cultivation level, and did not want to stay here forever.
“Farewell.” Ling Han turned around and left.
Meanwhile, Yuan Bing stared at Liu Yao, and said, “This is my friend. If you dare to have the slightest bit of malice towards him, I will definitely kill you.”

Liu Yao couldn’t help but shudder, but his hand that was slapping himself did not dare to stop in the slightest. At this moment, his heart was filled with hatred, both towards Ling Han and Yuan Bing. However, he did not dare to show it in the slightest.

Two days’ time passed in the blink of an eye. Ling Han fought a few more battles, and he achieved victories with an overwhelming advantage in all of them. Meanwhile, Yuan Bing had also obtained the Four Suns Pill, and for the moment, there was no further news from him.
Another day later, Yuan Bing came to visit him at the inn, bringing with him a large amount of gifts.
“Thank you, Brother Ling. My mother is already much better,” he said happily.

When Ling Han gave him the alchemical pill, only then did he know that this alchemical pill was for Yuan Bing’s mother. Towards a filial son, Ling Han was still very respectful. He smiled, “That’s good.”
“A little token of my appreciation.” Yuan Bing pushed the gift in front of Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “You gave me Source Dao Stones, and I gave you the Four Suns Pill. It is a fair transaction. There’s no need to thank me.”
“No, no, no. To you, it is only a business deal that has been completed, but to me, the significance is very different,” Yuan Bing insisted.
Ling Han couldn’t convince him otherwise, so he could only accept the gift.
Yuan Bing earnestly invited Ling Han to his residence as a guest.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before agreeing.
He was indeed very interested in this City of Death, and what he wanted to know more was where exactly had the Source Dao Stone come from.
These should be ores, but where had they been mined from?
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t expect Yuan Bing to steal it for him. He only needed some clues.

Yuan Bing also yearned for the outside world, but only Venerate Tier elites could break through the black hole’s gravitational pull and leave here. Thus, Yuan Bing naturally could only think about it, but hearing Ling Han talk about the outside world, he appeared to be extremely yearning.

Ling Han tried to beat around the bush, but Yuan Bing was completely unaware of the location of the Source Dao Stone mine. According to him, this should only be known to the five Venerate Tier elites.
Ling Han naturally didn’t believe him. How could it be that they didn’t need manpower to excavate a mine? How could it be that it could be that Venerate Tier elites would personally excavate a mine?
It was obviously impossible.
However, these Venerate Tier elites really did a good job of keeping secrets. Even a second-generation young master like Yuan Bing actually didn’t know anything.

Ling Han didn’t want to rely on Yuan Bing. He continued to battle on the Dark Battlefield as usual, and very soon, he obtained ten consecutive wins, receiving additional rewards, and next, he obtained another twenty consecutive wins, and thirty consecutive wins.
Following the expansion of his successive victories, his alchemy business also became more and more prosperous, and the amount of Source Dao Stones he earned also became considerable.
Four months later, he had already cultivated all nine Stone Fetuses to Silver Fetus.
He temporarily called a ceasefire, and began to adjust his condition in order to break through to the fourth form of the True Self, Golden Fetus!

He had been battling all these days. Thus, though his cultivation level had increased very quickly, his mental state and appreciation had completely caught up. Thus, he only adjusted for half a month, and began to break through to the fourth form.

There were all kinds of medicinal ingredients and medicinal stones by his side. When he broke through, he needed a huge amount of energy, and he couldn’t rely on himself to supply it. That would extract his life essence and affect his lifespan.
He began to charge forward.
It was still the True Self of Destruction that took the vanguard, being the first to evolve into a Golden Fetus.
Hong long long, an earth-shattering change took place in his body. The Regulations condensed and boosted on the True Self of Destruction, causing the Silver Fetus to vaguely flash with golden light.
For him, this process was already a walk in the park. Though every evolution was slightly different, in terms of quality, it was the same.
Three days later, in Ling Han’s mind, the True Self of Destruction shone with golden light, like a golden Bodhisattva.
He had succeeded in forming the fourth form of the True Self Tier!

Ling Han laughed loudly, and stood up. The reason why he had spent three days was because not only had he pushed the level of mystical power up to the fourth form, he had not missed out on the Body Art either, and was still advancing at the same time.
“Double raw power of 35 Heavens, with the two combined, 40 Heavens!”
In this way, if he channeled the Imperial Technique, Ling Han’s battle prowess could reach up to 51 Heavens.
This was extremely awesome, and was completely capable of defeating a great many Imperial Sons in the Fifth Form.
Ling Han came out of seclusion, and then went to the Dark Battlefield, cancelling his previous battle-free state.

However, he unexpectedly received a piece of news. In the days that he had been in seclusion, a fierce person had come to the Dark Battlefield. He was also a True Self Tier, and was invincible in his sweep. It was as if he was about to overwhelm Ling Han.
This person’s name was... Lin Yun!

chapters.title: Chapter 4280: If I am here, he needs to leave
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
‘Lin Yun?’
The Fire Cloud Imperial Clan’s Lin Yun? The Silver Generation’s Lin Yun?
Why had he come here?

Theoretically speaking, the Imperial Clans possessed the most abundant resources in the world, and the Imperial Son was someone that the Imperial Clan had nurtured with all their might. Was there any need for them to come to the Dark Clouds Hell?

En, the resources of the Imperial Clan should all be leaning towards the Golden Generation. Thus, even if the Silver Generation was still heavily nurtured by the Imperial Clan, it clearly could not compare to the Golden Generation.
Thus, if Lin Yun wanted to contend for the throne, he would definitely have to take an unusual path. Otherwise, he would never be able to surpass the Golden Generation.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. Meeting Lin Yun here was truly heaven’s will.
He looked forward to encountering this opponent on the Dark Battlefield, and dealing with him personally.
This probability was quite high, because both he and Ling Han had the aptitude to be invincible among their peers. Thus, it should not take too long for them to encounter each other.
However, he could not interfere with the arrangement of battles on the Dark Battlefield, so he could only wait now.
When he found out that he had come out of seclusion, Yuan Bing immediately sent out an invitation to him.
His mother had already recovered completely, so he planned to hold a banquet to celebrate, and Ling Han could be considered his mother’s savior. How could he hold it without Ling Han?
Ling Han pondered for a moment before deciding to participate.
The banquet was set for two days later, and Ling Han didn’t waste any time. He continued to sell alchemical pills and fight on the tournament stage. Unfortunately, he never encountered Lin Yun.
In a flash, two days had passed.
This evening, Ling Han set out, heading towards the Yuan Clan.

Previously, he had already gone there once, so it was naturally a walk in the park for him. Very soon, he arrived at his destination. The guards at the entrance had long since been taken care of. When they saw him approach, they immediately invited him in warmly.
Ling Han arrived at the banquet hall, only to see that many people had already arrived. However, he only knew a pitifully small number of people— and that was Liu Yao.
Liu Yao also discovered him, and a vicious glint flashed across his eyes. However, he did not dare to look too long at him, and immediately lowered his head.
He, he had not given up on his evil intentions.
Ling Han thought, ‘Should I kill this guy now?’
Right at this moment, two more people entered the main hall.
They were all young people, and one of them was even more heroic. Stars surged behind him, showing a terrifying phenomenon.
Lin Yun!
Ling Han was surprised. He had not thought that he would actually encounter this Silver Generation elite here.
Lin Yun’s sharp gaze naturally swept over to Ling Han. He couldn’t help but reveal a cold smile, not hiding his killing intent in the slightest.
The way the two of them looked at each other was incredibly conspicuous, causing everyone in the living room to look over.
Yi, weren’t these the two most popular people in the Dark Battlefield? They were already at each other’s throats?
“Hehe, everyone, thank you for coming.” Yuan Bing strode out, his face full of smiles.
“Young Master Bing!”
“Young Master Bing!”
Everyone called out. The elders of these people were all subordinates of the Yuan Clan, so they naturally had the label of the Yuan Clan, and became the lackeys of Yuan Bing.
“Come, come, come, sit!” Yuan Bing appeared very happy.
Everyone sat down, one after another. Meanwhile, Yuan Bing invited Ling Han over, and sat at the main table with him, appearing to hold him in extremely high regard.
This caused everyone to be surprised. They had not thought that Yuan Bing would actually value Ling Han so highly.

Regardless of how well-regarded Ling Han was in the outside world, in this place, everything had to start from scratch for him here. Thus, the fact that Yuan Bing held an outsider in such high regard naturally made them feel surprised.
But this was a matter that concerned Yuan Bing, so who would dare to say anything?
After three rounds of wine, everyone became more talkative.
“Young Master Bing, let me introduce you to a respected guest!” At this moment, a young man stood up and said to Yuan Bing.
This person was the one who had accompanied Lin Yun here.
Yuan Bing was in a good mood, so he nodded, and said, “Alright.”
This young man pointed at Lin Yun and said, “This is Lin Yun, Brother Lin. He’s from the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, and he’s also an Imperial Son!”
Hiss, instantly, exclamations of shock rang out in the surroundings.

Don’t think that just because this was the Dark Clouds Hell, they were cut off from the rest of the world. Wrong, everyone here had come in from outside, or were the descendants of those people. Furthermore, a large number of people entered every year, so they naturally knew the situation outside. It was just that the feedback of the news would be much slower.
However, the Imperial Clan was high and noble, invincible in the world. This was everyone’s consensus, and could not be erased no matter what.
And now, an Imperial Son had arrived, which naturally stunned everyone.
Yuan Bing immediately smiled, and said, “So it is Imperial Son Lin, apologies for not recognizing you.”
Meanwhile, Lin Yun merely smiled reservedly, fully displaying his pride.

As he saw it, a mere Sect Master was so weak that he couldn’t even withstand a single blow. In front of the Imperial Clan, he was completely like an ant. It was only because the force of the Imperial Clan were not powerful enough, that he had to lower himself to come here.

Otherwise, a Sect Master-level force wanted to invite him? What a joke. Even if a Sect Master elite personally made a move, whether he would give them face or not would still have to depend on his mood.
Liu Yao saw this, and couldn’t help but feel hope rise up in his heart.
—Lin Yun clearly did not get along with Ling Han. Furthermore, he was an Imperial Son, so his weight was definitely heavier than Ling Han’s. Thus, Yuan Bing’s choice was naturally very simple.
At that time, he wouldn’t even need to move. Lin Yun would definitely battle Ling Han.

Yuan Bing appeared slightly displeased. In the Dark Clouds Hell, he was a second-generation young master that was only inferior to the descendants of the five great Venerate Tier elites. Usually, who would dare show insolence in front of him? Aren’t you just an Imperial Son? The hands of the Imperial Clan couldn’t extend here, so what do you have to be proud of?
He was just about to speak, when he saw Lin Yun stand up and say, “I gave Brother Qi face by coming here to attend the banquet.”

The Brother Qi he was talking about was precisely the young man that had come with him. This made him feel very awkward, because he was the underling of Yuan Bing, yet the person he had brought over did not take Yuan Bing seriously. Wasn’t this deliberately making things difficult for him?
Lin Yun continued, “However, there is a person here... I despise him very much!”
As he spoke, his eyes turned towards Ling Han, revealing a hint of disdain.
“If he is here, I will leave. If I am here, he needs to leave!” he stated calmly.
Hiss, this was a great humiliation!
If Ling Han was chased out in public, he would be utterly humiliated.
Just how great was the enmity between them? Was there a need to go so far?
However, everyone was clear that Yuan Bing’s choice should be extremely simple.
—An Imperial Son, and a non-Imperial Son, wasn’t that simple enough?
Indeed, the Imperial Clan had never interfered before. However, this did not mean that they would not in future. It was just a matter of how much they would have to sacrifice.

It was said that the higher one’s cultivation level was, the more dangerous the process of entering this place would be. Thus, those who came in were usually Core Formation Tiers, True Self Tiers, and Spirit Transformation Tiers at most. The five Venerate Tier elites here actually cultivated to this cultivation level after coming in.
But if the Imperial Clan was determined to forcibly break in, it may really be possible that they would destroy the Dark Clouds Hell.
Even if there was only a sliver of a chance, there was no need for him to take the risk for a minor character, right?
Everyone was looking at Yuan Bing, waiting for him to announce that Ling Han would be chased out.
Yuan Bing sighed, and asked, “Is Imperial Son Lin so determined?”
“Of course,” Lin Yun said proudly.
“Then please leave, Imperial Son Lin!”

Regardless of how well-regarded Ling Han was in the outside world, in this place, everything had to start from scratch for him here.
Thus, the fact that Yuan Bing held an outsider in such high regard naturally made them feel surprised.
But this was a matter that concerned Yuan Bing, so who would dare to say anything?
After three rounds of wine, everyone became more talkative.
“Young Master Bing, let me introduce you to a respected guest!” At this moment, a young man stood up and said to Yuan Bing.
This person was the one who had accompanied Lin Yun here.
Yuan Bing was in a good mood, so he nodded, and said, “Alright.”
This young man pointed at Lin Yun and said, “This is Lin Yun, Brother Lin.
He’s from the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan, and he’s also an Imperial Son!”
Hiss, instantly, exclamations of shock rang out in the surroundings.
Don’t think that just because this was the Dark Clouds Hell, they were cut off from the rest of the world.
Wrong, everyone here had come in from outside, or were the descendants of those people.
Furthermore, a large number of people entered every year, so they naturally knew the situation outside.
It was just that the feedback of the news would be much slower.
However, the Imperial Clan was high and noble, invincible in the world.
This was everyone’s consensus, and could not be erased no matter what.
And now, an Imperial Son had arrived, which naturally stunned everyone.
Yuan Bing immediately smiled, and said, “So it is Imperial Son Lin, apologies for not recognizing you.”
Meanwhile, Lin Yun merely smiled reservedly, fully displaying his pride.
As he saw it, a mere Sect Master was so weak that he couldn’t even withstand a single blow.
In front of the Imperial Clan, he was completely like an ant.
It was only because the force of the Imperial Clan were not powerful enough, that he had to lower himself to come here.
Otherwise, a Sect Master-level force wanted to invite him?
What a joke.
Even if a Sect Master elite personally made a move, whether he would give them face or not would still have to depend on his mood.
Liu Yao saw this, and couldn’t help but feel hope rise up in his heart.
—Lin Yun clearly did not get along with Ling Han.
Furthermore, he was an Imperial Son, so his weight was definitely heavier than Ling Han’s.
Thus, Yuan Bing’s choice was naturally very simple.
At that time, he wouldn’t even need to move.
Lin Yun would definitely battle Ling Han.
Yuan Bing appeared slightly displeased.
In the Dark Clouds Hell, he was a second-generation young master that was only inferior to the descendants of the five great Venerate Tier elites.
Usually, who would dare show insolence in front of him?
Aren’t you just an Imperial Son?
The hands of the Imperial Clan couldn’t extend here, so what do you have to be proud of?
He was just about to speak, when he saw Lin Yun stand up and say, “I gave Brother Qi face by coming here to attend the banquet.”
The Brother Qi he was talking about was precisely the young man that had come with him.
This made him feel very awkward, because he was the underling of Yuan Bing, yet the person he had brought over did not take Yuan Bing seriously.
Wasn’t this deliberately making things difficult for him?
Lin Yun continued, “However, there is a person here...
I despise him very much!”
As he spoke, his eyes turned towards Ling Han, revealing a hint of disdain.
“If he is here, I will leave.
If I am here, he needs to leave!” he stated calmly.
Hiss, this was a great humiliation!
If Ling Han was chased out in public, he would be utterly humiliated.
Just how great was the enmity between them?
Was there a need to go so far?
However, everyone was clear that Yuan Bing’s choice should be extremely simple.
—An Imperial Son, and a non-Imperial Son, wasn’t that simple enough?
Indeed, the Imperial Clan had never interfered before.
However, this did not mean that they would not in future.
It was just a matter of how much they would have to sacrifice.
It was said that the higher one’s cultivation level was, the more dangerous the process of entering this place would be.
Thus, those who came in were usually Core Formation Tiers, True Self Tiers, and Spirit Transformation Tiers at most.
The five Venerate Tier elites here actually cultivated to this cultivation level after coming in.
But if the Imperial Clan was determined to forcibly break in, it may really be possible that they would destroy the Dark Clouds Hell.
Even if there was only a sliver of a chance, there was no need for him to take the risk for a minor character, right?
Everyone was looking at Yuan Bing, waiting for him to announce that Ling Han would be chased out.
Yuan Bing sighed, and asked, “Is Imperial Son Lin so determined?”
“Of course,” Lin Yun said proudly.
“Then please leave, Imperial Son Lin!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4281: Zuwa An
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Everyone was stunned.
What was going on?
Why was it Lin Yun who had been invited out?
That was an Imperial Son, and he was not giving him any face at all?

However, upon further thought, this was not a big deal. He had only invited the Imperial Son out, and had not killed the Imperial Son. If it was claimed that the Imperial Clan would launch an all-out war because of this, and charge into the Dark Clouds Hell at all costs, who would believe that?
A powerful dragon couldn’t suppress a snake in its lair. Now, even if Lin Yun was a dragon in the sky, he would still have to lower himself to the ground here!
In terms of abilities, he was only a True Self Tier.
Lin Yun hadn’t expected this either. Embarrassment was written all over his face.

‘F*ck! I’m a respected Imperial Son, a member of the Silver Generation, and I’m a respected guest wherever I go. In fact, whether I go or not depends on my mood. Why have I been kicked out of this place?’
What justice was there left in this world?

“Yuan Bing, don’t you regret this!” Lin Yun’s eyes sharpened. He had never cowered before. The status of Silver Generation and Imperial Son had bestowed too much pride on him, so how could he possibly bow his head?
Yuan Bing humphed, and said, “Are you threatening me?”
Lin Yun felt an urge to attack, but he forcefully suppressed this urge.
This was the Dark Clouds Hell, and there was also a Sect Master elite behind Yuan Bing, which was enough to suppress him.
As long as he wasn’t killed or crippled, would the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan forcibly conquer the Dark Clouds Hell for him?
They wouldn’t!
Facts had proven that this place was extremely strange. Even if a Saint wielded an Imperial Weapon, they still wouldn’t be able to overwhelm this place. This was a terrifying place!

This wasn’t strange. There were dangerous places in the world, that even the Great Emperor would have to be careful when entering. How could the combination of a Saint and the Imperial Weapon be comparable to a Great Emperor? It was far inferior.

Thus, the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan couldn’t possibly send elites over for such a small matter like this, such as Sect Master-level or Venerates. Here, the higher one’s cultivation level, the more likely it was to suffer calamity—this was proven by history.
Lin Yun took a deep breath before turning around to leave.
“Wait,” Yuan Bing spoke up.
Lin Yun paused, a hint of pride on his face.
He had to be afraid now, and must be regretting it now.
“If you’re willing to offer a cup of tea to Brother Ling, I won’t mind giving you some food,” Yuan Bing said calmly.
‘F*ck!’
Lin Yun almost spat out a mouthful of blood. Asking him to serve tea and apologize to Ling Han?
‘F*ck off!’
He was furious, and left with a flourish of his sleeves.
Yuan Bing looked at Ling Han, and the two of them broke into laughter.

Hearing Ling Han’s laughter, Lin Yun really wanted to turn around and start a fight, but if he made a move in Yuan Manor, that would be equivalent to provoking Yuan Xinrong, and would be disrespecting the Blood Crow Venerate. Even if he could not die due to his identity as an Imperial Son, he would definitely not be able to escape punishment.
I’ll endure, I’ll endure!
Lin Yun clenched his fists. This was a great humiliation that he had never experienced before. He would definitely get his revenge.
Ling Han, see you on the battlefield!
“Thank you.” Ling Han nodded at Yuan Bing. The latter actually didn’t need to face off against Lin Yun.
Yuan Bing smiled and said, “We are friends, aren’t we?”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “That’s right, friend.”
Previously, Yuan Bing had also said that as long as Ling Han could save his mother, he would befriend Ling Han. However, in Ling Han’s eyes, this friendship was naturally nothing.
This time was different. Yuan Bing clearly supported him. This also needed courage and resolution.
Everyone looked at each other, appearing very dumbfounded, especially that “Young Master Qi” who had brought Lin Yun here. He was the most embarrassed.
As for Liu Yao, he was extremely disappointed.
He had never imagined that Yuan Bing would actually choose to support Ling Han. Thankfully, he had not jumped out to be a clown just now. Otherwise, he would definitely be disliked by Yuan Bing now.
“This Lin Yun’s abilities are extraordinary,” Yuan Bing said with a serious expression. “Sooner or later, you and he will have to battle on the battlefield. Are you confident?”
Ling Han smiled and said, “I’m very expectant!”
Seeing how confident Ling Han was, Yuan Bing felt much more at ease.
At first, he had thought that the next step would be a true battle on the Dark Battlefield, but he had never imagined that there would actually be a slight accident in this matter.
In less than two days, Yuan Bing came to find Ling Han.
“Do you know Young Master An?” he asked.
“What Young Master An?” Ling Han looked at Yuan Bing in surprise. ‘You’re already a top-notch second-generation young master, yet you still call others “Young Master”?’

Yuan Bing frowned, appearing to be very confused, “Zuwa An, the grandson of the Blood Crow Venerate. Because Lord Blood Crow’s sons are all worthless, yet Zuwa An’s natural talent in martial arts is extremely high, so he is deeply loved by Lord Blood Crow.”
“Strange, since you don’t know him, why did he ask me to bring you to see him?”
Ling Han smiled and said, “We’ll know if we go and take a look.”

“En.” Yuan Bing nodded. He was a top-notch second-generation young master, but Zuwaan was a super second-generation young master. In the City of Death, there were still four people that could stand on equal footing with him. Furthermore, Yuan Xinrong was a subordinate of the Blood Crow Venerate. Correspondingly, Yuan Bing could also be considered Zuwa An’s underling.
“When are we setting off?” Ling Han asked.
“If you’re free, let’s go now.”
“All right.”
The two of them set out, heading towards where Zuwa An was staying.
This was the cherished grandson of the Blood Crow Venerate. However, he didn’t live with the Blood Crow Venerate. Instead, he lived alone outside, probably because he didn’t want to be controlled.
When they arrived at the door, the guards immediately smiled when they saw Yuan Bing, welcoming the two of them in.
This place was decorated very beautifully. There were towers, pavilions, and everything else. If one didn’t raise his head to look, he wouldn’t be able to tell that this was the City of Death.
This manor was very big. In fact, it was slightly larger than even Yuan Manor. After circling around for a while, they finally arrived at the backyard. Zuwa An was here.

The two of them entered the garden, and saw a gazebo inside. There were two people drinking. They clearly saw Ling Han and Yuan Bing out of the corner of their eyes, but they acted as if they didn’t see them, and were still drinking.
Yi?
Ling Han and Yuan Bing looked at each other, and couldn’t help but reveal an astounded expression, because one of these two people was actually Lin Yun!
This guy really had some tricks up his sleeve. In just a few days, he had managed to get acquainted with Zuwa An!
Of course, if it was Lin Yun who said this, it would definitely be Zuwa An who was out of his league. He was the dignified Imperial Son, so who in this world was worthy of him clinging to?
Hehe, was this considered revenge?
“Young Master An!” Yuan Bing shouted loudly. He couldn’t just stand there and be ignored, right?
The other young man put down his wine cup, glanced at Yuan Bing, and nodded slightly, “So it’s Yuan Bing.”
‘Nonsense, didn’t you call us over? Is it fun to pretend that you just realized we are here?’

Ling Han sized up this Zuwa An. The Blood Crow Venerate was a member of the Demon Race, and came from the Blood Crow Tribe. Thus, Zuwa An naturally inherited this bloodline as well. A pair of blood-colored wings grew on his back, and there were golden veined patterns that glowed faintly, making him appear extremely extraordinary.
Aside from that, he actually had a long tail, and his ears were also furry, like dogs and wolves.
He transmitted a question to Yuan Bing through divine sense. Yuan Bing told him that Zuwa An’s mother was a Wolf Tribe member, so he had mixed blood.
Realization dawned on Ling Han. No wonder this guy had a tail, and furry ears.
Yuan Bing clasped his hands and said, “Greetings, Young Master An.”
However, Zuwa An ignored him, and merely looked at Ling Han. A cold smile gradually appeared on his lips, “Bring me a cup of tea!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4282: The proper use of the horn?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Serving tea?
Previously, Yuan Bing had targeted Lin Yun like this, and now... it was the other way around.
Lin Yun only sipped his wine, and acted as if he had not seen anything. It was as if Ling Han was only a cat or dog in his eyes, and was not worth his attention at all.
Yuan Bing looked furious. Ling Han was his friend, and Zuwa An actually dared to humiliate Ling Han like this. That was equivalent to not giving him any face at all.
But what could be done?
Just like how he had been able to humiliate Lin Yun before, now that Zuwa An’s status was slightly higher than his, he naturally could do as he pleased.
The City of Death’s rules were that there were no rules, and elites with abilities could do as they liked!
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “Can you afford to have me serve you tea?”
Zuwa An couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “What a joke, is there anyone in this world that I can’t accept tea from?”

These words were too pretentious. He was only the grandson of a Venerate Tier elite, and in the outside world, he could indeed be considered a prominent figure, but to say that his status was high and noble, that was too much of an exaggeration.
There were Saints above Venerate Tier, and although there was no Emperor in this world, the Imperial Clan was not to be trifled with either.
“Hehe, then we can only take our leave.” Ling Han turned around. He naturally could not lower himself to speak.
“Did I allow you to leave?” Zuwa An asked coldly.
Who asked you to be so arrogant?
Ling Han retrieved the Great Emperor Horn and blew it as he walked.
Spiritual Power instantly decreased by a significant amount, and a soundless shockwave also spread out, but it was only directed at Zuwa An.
Heh, just obediently raise your head and bark like a wolf.
“Ao!” Sure enough, a wolf’s howl traveled over from behind him.
What was going on?
Yuan Bing was dumbfounded, and saw that Zuwa An was actually howling like a wolf with his head held high.
Lin Yun was also taken aback. Although he didn’t take Zuwa An seriously, why did you suddenly bark like a wolf?
It was not just that either!
Zuwa An discovered that his Wolf Tribe bloodline had awakened uncontrollably, and instantly, thick and long wolf fur wormed out of his pores. In an instant, his whole body was covered with black fur.
His head had also completely turned into the head of a wolf. His limbs were thick, and his claws were sharp and long.
Now, if it was not for the fact that he had a pair of blood wings on his back, what difference was there between him and a wolf?

Though Ling Han hadn’t looked at him, under the cover of his divine sense, this wasn’t much different from seeing it with his own eyes. He couldn’t help but feel surprised. The bugle horn could actually allow one to transform?
Hold on, Zuwa An had the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe. Could it be because of this?
Ling Han stowed the bugle horn away without batting an eyelid. This thing didn’t make any sound, and his actions just now had been extremely covert, so no one had discovered it.
“Ao!” With a leap, Zuwa An had already landed in front of Ling Han. Then, he turned his head, and bared his mouth, revealing two rows of ghastly white sharp teeth.
Yuan Bing, meanwhile, felt a chill in his heart. Were they going to become hostile?

He couldn’t help but feel a headache coming on. Zuwa An was the grandson of the Blood Crow Venerate. If he was determined to target Ling Han, then there would be no place for Ling Han, and could only flee for his life.
Although Lin Yun also found this strange, he was also happy to see Zuwa An personally deal with Ling Han.
Whether Ling Han made a move or not, this guy would not get off lightly.

—If he made a move, that would be equivalent to offending a Venerate Tier elite. This was the Dark Clouds Hell, and Venerate Tier was the strongest! And if he did not make a move, Ling Han would naturally be completely humiliated. With such humiliation, how could he still have the nerve to contest for the throne?
However, right at this moment, Zuwa An suddenly wagged his tail, and stuck out his long tongue, looking at Ling Han with an eager gaze.
F***, what was going on here?
Was this still a proud Young Master? He was clearly a pug, begging for his master’s love.
Yuan Bing and Lin Yun were both frozen, feeling as if their outlook on life had been slightly turned upside down.
Though Ling Han was also stunned, he had a vague understanding that this should be the effect of the horn of the Great Emperor.
Could it be that it was only a prank for this thing to make others howl, and its true use was to make the Wolf Tribe submit?
This... was too coincidental!
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and the black wolf that Zuwa An had turned into immediately leaned its head over obediently, allowing Ling Han to rub his head.
Hiss!
Among the Wolf Tribe, this represented absolute obedience.
Yuan Bing’s jaw dropped, completely stupefied.
‘What’s going on? Have you come to recognize someone as your master?’
Ling Han smiled, and said to Lin Yun, “Looks like you’ve lost again.”
In this battle, Lin Yun was defeated in a baffling manner.
How could he have imagined that Zuwa An would suddenly become subservient?

He successfully made Zuwa An feel the desire to leave this place, and promised the latter that after leaving the Dark Clouds Hell, he would take care of him. Thus, the two of them happily reached an agreement, and became friends.
But what’s going on here? Have you suddenly awakened your ancestral bloodline?
But even if you wanted to awaken your ancestral bloodline, you are still a wild wolf, so why do you have to act like a dog?
Lin Yun was speechless. He humphed, stood up and left.
“If we meet on the battlefield of blood and steel, that would be the time of your death!” he declared balefully.
“Little wolf!” Ling Han pointed at Lin Yun, “Bite!”
“Ao!” Zuwa An immediately charged out, opening his bloody mouth and biting at Lin Yun.

He was only a True Self Tier cultivator, so his battle prowess was naturally far inferior to the Imperial Son. However, he was under someone else’s roof, so Lin Yun naturally didn’t dare to truly wound Zuwa An. Otherwise, he would also be in deep trouble.
Thus, it could only be Zuwa An that attacked madly, and Lin Yun parried his blows.
Thankfully, he was a Silver Generation elite, and his battle prowess far surpassed that of Zuwa An, so there was not much danger.
However, there was no benefit to be gained from fighting like this. Lin Yun roared furiously, and after forcing Zuwa An to retreat with a single palm strike, he immediately withdrew and left.
How could Zuwa An be willing to give up? With a roar, he chased after Lin Yun.
“Er, am I dreaming?” Yuan Bing rubbed his forehead, still feeling like he was in a dream.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Do you want me to slap you?”
“Then forget it.” Yuan Bing hurriedly shook his head.
“Let’s go.”
“O-Okay.”
The two of them left. On the way, Yuan Bing was still in a daze. He really couldn’t figure it out.
“Ling Han, is this related to you?” Yuan Bing asked.
Ling Han spread out his hands, “How is that possible?”
Yuan Bing also felt the same, but if it had nothing to do with him, then why did Zuwa An treat Ling Han as his master after transforming into a black wolf?

Merely a day had passed, and the news that Zuwa An’s ancestral bloodline from the Wolf Tribe had gone out of control, and the entire city was hunting down Lin Yun had spread out, becoming a topic of conversation for everyone. It was said that this made the Blood Crow Venerate extremely furious.
He was a Venerate Tier elite, but in his beloved grandson’s body, it was actually the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe that had the upper hand. How could he endure this?

What made him even angrier was the fact that after this incident, the Wolf Tribe bloodline of Zuwa An had actually overwhelmed the Blood Crow bloodline, and strengthened greatly. In future cultivation, he would benefit greatly.
Was this a good thing or a bad thing?
However, awakening one’s bloodline was a very normal thing, so who could they blame?
Thus, the Blood Crow Venerate didn’t summon Yuan Bing, Ling Han, or Lin Yun for questioning.
Right at this moment, a message came from the Dark Battlefield. Ling Han had a match.
Time was two days later; opponent was Lin Yun!
