Just like how he had been able to humiliate Lin Yun before, now that Zuwa An’s status was slightly higher than his, he naturally could do as he pleased.
The City of Death’s rules were that there were no rules, and elites with abilities could do as they liked!
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “Can you afford to have me serve you tea?”
Zuwa An couldn’t help but laugh loudly, “What a joke, is there anyone in this world that I can’t accept tea from?”
These words were too pretentious.

He was only the grandson of a Venerate Tier elite, and in the outside world, he could indeed be considered a prominent figure, but to say that his status was high and noble, that was too much of an exaggeration.
There were Saints above Venerate Tier, and although there was no Emperor in this world, the Imperial Clan was not to be trifled with either.
“Hehe, then we can only take our leave.” Ling Han turned around.
He naturally could not lower himself to speak.
“Did I allow you to leave?” Zuwa An asked coldly.
Who asked you to be so arrogant?
Ling Han retrieved the Great Emperor Horn and blew it as he walked.
Spiritual Power instantly decreased by a significant amount, and a soundless shockwave also spread out, but it was only directed at Zuwa An.
Heh, just obediently raise your head and bark like a wolf.
“Ao!” Sure enough, a wolf’s howl traveled over from behind him.
What was going on?
Yuan Bing was dumbfounded, and saw that Zuwa An was actually howling like a wolf with his head held high.
Lin Yun was also taken aback.
Although he didn’t take Zuwa An seriously, why did you suddenly bark like a wolf?
It was not just that either!
Zuwa An discovered that his Wolf Tribe bloodline had awakened uncontrollably, and instantly, thick and long wolf fur wormed out of his pores.
In an instant, his whole body was covered with black fur.
His head had also completely turned into the head of a wolf.
His limbs were thick, and his claws were sharp and long.
Now, if it was not for the fact that he had a pair of blood wings on his back, what difference was there between him and a wolf?
Though Ling Han hadn’t looked at him, under the cover of his divine sense, this wasn’t much different from seeing it with his own eyes.
He couldn’t help but feel surprised.
The bugle horn could actually allow one to transform?
Hold on, Zuwa An had the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe.
Could it be because of this?
Ling Han stowed the bugle horn away without batting an eyelid.
This thing didn’t make any sound, and his actions just now had been extremely covert, so no one had discovered it.
“Ao!” With a leap, Zuwa An had already landed in front of Ling Han.
Then, he turned his head, and bared his mouth, revealing two rows of ghastly white sharp teeth.
Yuan Bing, meanwhile, felt a chill in his heart.
Were they going to become hostile?
He couldn’t help but feel a headache coming on.
Zuwa An was the grandson of the Blood Crow Venerate.
If he was determined to target Ling Han, then there would be no place for Ling Han, and could only flee for his life.
Although Lin Yun also found this strange, he was also happy to see Zuwa An personally deal with Ling Han.
Whether Ling Han made a move or not, this guy would not get off lightly.
—If he made a move, that would be equivalent to offending a Venerate Tier elite.
This was the Dark Clouds Hell, and Venerate Tier was the strongest!
And if he did not make a move, Ling Han would naturally be completely humiliated.
With such humiliation, how could he still have the nerve to contest for the throne?
However, right at this moment, Zuwa An suddenly wagged his tail, and stuck out his long tongue, looking at Ling Han with an eager gaze.
F***, what was going on here?
Was this still a proud Young Master?
He was clearly a pug, begging for his master’s love.
Yuan Bing and Lin Yun were both frozen, feeling as if their outlook on life had been slightly turned upside down.
Though Ling Han was also stunned, he had a vague understanding that this should be the effect of the horn of the Great Emperor.
Could it be that it was only a prank for this thing to make others howl, and its true use was to make the Wolf Tribe submit?
This... was too coincidental!
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and the black wolf that Zuwa An had turned into immediately leaned its head over obediently, allowing Ling Han to rub his head.
Hiss!
Among the Wolf Tribe, this represented absolute obedience.
Yuan Bing’s jaw dropped, completely stupefied.
‘What’s going on?
Have you come to recognize someone as your master?’
Ling Han smiled, and said to Lin Yun, “Looks like you’ve lost again.”
In this battle, Lin Yun was defeated in a baffling manner.
How could he have imagined that Zuwa An would suddenly become subservient?
He successfully made Zuwa An feel the desire to leave this place, and promised the latter that after leaving the Dark Clouds Hell, he would take care of him.
Thus, the two of them happily reached an agreement, and became friends.
But what’s going on here?
Have you suddenly awakened your ancestral bloodline?
But even if you wanted to awaken your ancestral bloodline, you are still a wild wolf, so why do you have to act like a dog?
Lin Yun was speechless.
He humphed, stood up and left.
“If we meet on the battlefield of blood and steel, that would be the time of your death!” he declared balefully.
“Little wolf!” Ling Han pointed at Lin Yun, “Bite!”
“Ao!” Zuwa An immediately charged out, opening his bloody mouth and biting at Lin Yun.
He was only a True Self Tier cultivator, so his battle prowess was naturally far inferior to the Imperial Son.
However, he was under someone else’s roof, so Lin Yun naturally didn’t dare to truly wound Zuwa An.
Otherwise, he would also be in deep trouble.
Thus, it could only be Zuwa An that attacked madly, and Lin Yun parried his blows.
Thankfully, he was a Silver Generation elite, and his battle prowess far surpassed that of Zuwa An, so there was not much danger.
However, there was no benefit to be gained from fighting like this.
Lin Yun roared furiously, and after forcing Zuwa An to retreat with a single palm strike, he immediately withdrew and left.
How could Zuwa An be willing to give up?
With a roar, he chased after Lin Yun.
“Er, am I dreaming?” Yuan Bing rubbed his forehead, still feeling like he was in a dream.
Ling Han shrugged and said, “Do you want me to slap you?”
“Then forget it.” Yuan Bing hurriedly shook his head.
“Let’s go.”
“O-Okay.”
The two of them left.
On the way, Yuan Bing was still in a daze.
He really couldn’t figure it out.
“Ling Han, is this related to you?” Yuan Bing asked.
Ling Han spread out his hands, “How is that possible?”
Yuan Bing also felt the same, but if it had nothing to do with him, then why did Zuwa An treat Ling Han as his master after transforming into a black wolf?

Merely a day had passed, and the news that Zuwa An’s ancestral bloodline from the Wolf Tribe had gone out of control, and the entire city was hunting down Lin Yun had spread out, becoming a topic of conversation for everyone.
It was said that this made the Blood Crow Venerate extremely furious.
He was a Venerate Tier elite, but in his beloved grandson’s body, it was actually the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe that had the upper hand.
How could he endure this?
What made him even angrier was the fact that after this incident, the Wolf Tribe bloodline of Zuwa An had actually overwhelmed the Blood Crow bloodline, and strengthened greatly.
In future cultivation, he would benefit greatly.
Was this a good thing or a bad thing?
However, awakening one’s bloodline was a very normal thing, so who could they blame?
Thus, the Blood Crow Venerate didn’t summon Yuan Bing, Ling Han, or Lin Yun for questioning.
Right at this moment, a message came from the Dark Battlefield.
Ling Han had a match.
Time was two days later; opponent was Lin Yun!

chapters.title: Chapter 4283: Fighting Lin Yun
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
He was finally going to battle Lin Yun.

Ling Han couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation. Being oppressed by the five great Imperial Clans, although the Nine Mountains Saint managed to turn the tables, Ling Han was still extremely displeased. Of course, it would be best for him to avenge himself.

Now, he would first kill Lin Yun, and in the future, he would also kill that so-called Imperial Son Xuan and so on. He would defeat all those Golden Generation elites, and finally, he would raze the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan to the ground, and see if they could still do as they liked.

Ling Han adjusted his condition. After all, he was battling against the Silver Generation, and Lin Yun’s cultivation level was higher than his. He had a rare treasure on him, so he wouldn’t be affected by the negative effects. Thus, this opponent was still a little difficult to deal with.
Two days quickly passed, and Ling Han arrived at the Dark Battlefield.

It was clear that the Dark Battlefield also placed great importance on this battle. They actually closed off the other areas of battle, and opened up the entire battlefield to Ling Han and Lin Yun as the stage for their battle.
After all, these two people represented the strongest battle prowess of the True Self Tier.

There were countless spectators, and second-generation young masters like Zuwa An had also arrived. In his private room, there were also four young people seated, three men and one woman respectively.
Zuwa An’s expression was ugly, and he asked angrily, “It’s not like you guys don’t have private rooms. Why have you all come to my place?”
From the tone of his voice, it was clear that the status of these four people was not inferior to his.
Thus, it was very easy to guess the identities of these four people. They were the most doted descendants of the other four Venerate Tier elites.

“I heard that you awakened your Wolf Tribe bloodline a few days ago, and ran around the city naked. Thus, I’ve especially come to congratulate you,” a purple-robed young man said with a smile. “I heard grandpa say that your Wolf Tribe bloodline is also very high grade, suppressing the Blood Crow bloodline.”

This was really touching a sore spot. Zuwa An’s expression was livid. He had turned into a black wolf, and his whole body was covered with long fur. Actually, he had not exposed anything, but strictly speaking, this was indeed naked. How embarrassing.
“Ziming, don’t provoke him anymore,” the only woman said. She was dressed in green, and her red lips were as red as blood. She was extremely beautiful.
“Hahaha!” The three men all laughed exaggeratedly.

Zuwa An was both furious and enraged. He didn’t know why his Wolf Tribe bloodline had suddenly awakened, but he blamed this on Ling Han and Lin Yun. Perhaps the outsiders had something that stimulated his bloodline, causing him to suddenly awaken.

This Wolf Tribe bloodline was extremely noble, and this was originally a good thing. However, it should be known that his grandfather was the Blood Crow Tribe bloodline, while it was the Wolf Tribe bloodline that had suppressed the Blood Crow bloodline. Wouldn’t this cause him to fall out of favor?
“Get lost, all of you get lost quickly!” He was about to lose his temper.
“All right, all right, all right.” The three men and one woman all left smilingly.
Zuwa An stared at the battlefield, and the image of Ling Han flashed through his mind. He couldn’t help but shudder.
For some reason, when he thought of Ling Han, he felt a strong sense of reverence. In fact, it even surpassed the Blood Crow Venerate.
It could be said that even if Ling Han stood in front of him and allowed him to kill him, he would not be able to bring himself to do it.

“It would be best if the two of you die together,” Zuwa An said. At present, it was impossible for him and Lin Yun to return to their previous relationship. Furthermore, the awakening of his bloodline could also be related to Lin Yun. Thus, he hoped that Ling Han and Lin Yun would die together.
Time slowly crept by, and it wasn’t long before Ling Han and Lin Yun both appeared on stage.
Instantly, a tsunami of cheers rang out from the spectators’ seats.

Most of the people here had been banished, and there was no shortage of vicious and depraved people. Furthermore, there were no rules here, and murder and robbery would happen at any time. Thus, everyone was naturally bloodthirsty.
Ling Han and Lin Yun faced each other.
“Ling Han, this time, you won’t be able to escape death!” Lin Yun said balefully.
“Oh?” Ling Han smiled faintly, “You’re that confident?”

“I’ve already cultivated the fifth form of the True Self Tier to its limit. I’m only a step away from advancing into the sixth form,” Lin Yun said proudly. “If you had met me a few days later, humph! You wouldn’t have been able to withstand even a single strike!”
He indeed had the right to be arrogant. As an Imperial Son at the end of the fifth form, just how terrifying would his battle prowess be?
“Since that’s the case, I’ll oblige you. Let’s have a mortal duel!” Ling Han said.
In the Dark Battlefield, there were two ways to determine the victor. The first was to admit defeat, and the second was to beat someone to death.
If it was a mortal duel, it would be useless even if he admitted defeat. The battle would not end, and someone had to die.
“Sure!” Lin Yun nodded. There were no ley lines here that could be mobilized, so Ling Han was equivalent to having lost the ability to escape. He could take this opportunity to kill him.
Their application was quickly approved, and the tournament stage battle was changed to a mortal duel.
Only one person could survive!

“Ling Han, you are truly extraordinarily stupid.” Now that things had come to this, there was nothing that could be changed. A twisted expression appeared on Lin Yun’s face, “What made you so confident that you would dare to fight a mortal duel with me?”
Ling Han smiled faintly, and raised his fist, “Naturally, it is my abilities.”
“Laughable, this is really too laughable.” Lin Yun laughed loudly, “Foolish man, I’ll send you on your way now!”
He immediately raised his hand, and sent out a palm strike with his right hand. The Regulations of heaven and earth transformed into a massive palm that descended down on Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed, and shot out a punch, greeting that giant palm in the skies.
Peng!
The gigantic palm was instantly shattered by the force of the punch.
“Hmm?” A look of surprise appeared on Lin Yun’s face. Although he hadn’t used any celestial technique, his raw power had already reached 43 Heavens. How could he be underestimated?
“The Fourth Form of the True Self Tier!” He stared at Ling Han closely for a while, and using some kind of Mystical Power, finally managed to clearly see Ling Han’s cultivation level.
“Surprised?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“A little, but so what!” Lin Yun charged out, his figure turning into a fire dragon, brandishing the boundless Regulations.
He was getting serious now. The Imperial Technique channelled, and his battle prowess instantly soared to 52 Heavens!
Ling Han showed no weakness, and began exchanging blows with Lin Yun.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The Regulations collided, turning into countless shards of brilliance. The aftermath of energy boiled, like boiling water.
The two young prodigies continued to exchange blows, unleashing their battle prowess to their heart’s content.
It was hard to determine the victor.

In terms of battle prowess, Ling Han was actually slightly inferior. However, he could automatically disperse attacks within six Heavens. Thus, so what if Lin Yun’s battle prowess was stronger than his by one Heaven? This was only a slight advantage, and could not be converted into a victory.
However, all the spectators were dumbfounded. They could never imagine that a True Self Tier cultivator could actually possess such terrifying battle prowess.
Heavens, was this the prodigy of the outside world?

Lin Yun frowned deeply. At first, he had thought that his battle prowess would be able to firmly suppress Ling Han, but he did indeed have a certain advantage in battle prowess, but it was completely insufficient to turn it into a victory. This was something he could not accept.
Moreover, the strength of Ling Han’s endurance was well-known. If they fought a drawn-out battle, he would lose.
“Die!” Lin Yun summoned the Jade Water Sword. With a wave of the sword, waves instantly appeared in the blue sea, and endless tsunami waves surged over.
This was formed from the Regulations of Water, possessing astonishing destructive power.
Yet Ling Han merely brandished his fists. He walked the path of his own strength, and his fists could flatten the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 4284: Intimidation is ineffective
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Although Lin Yun’s Jade Water Sword wasn’t an Imperial Weapon, how could a replica Tool produced by the Imperial Clan be ordinary? This was especially the case since he was the Imperial Son. The materials he used were top-notch.

As the sword swept out, not only were there multiple seals, they were boosted with the Regulations of heaven and earth, as well as the might of the Divine Metal itself, which increased its destructive power.
Boom! The Sword Qi tore through the air, and it was as if even planets could be shattered.
Ling Han was completely unafraid. He brandished his fists to parry, directly blocking the Jade Water Sword.
He could absorb all power within six Heavens, so this kind of defense was naturally awesome. However, he had another disadvantage, and that was he would be wounded by sharp weapons.
However, after he cultivated the Body Art, this shortcoming no longer existed.
His physique could completely be treated as the sturdiest Divine Metal among his peers, allowing him to truly possess the confidence to face a Celestial Tool head-on with his bare hands.
Come.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them continued to exchange blows. The Regulations exploded, and even if it was just a shockwave, it was still extremely destructive.
The spectators at the outer circle hurriedly retreated. They couldn’t withstand the aftermath, so they had to retreat. Otherwise, they would either die or be injured.

“The top prodigies of the outside world are indeed as awesome as the legends say!” In the private room, a red-haired woman’s eyes lit up. She was Crimson Moon Venerate’s granddaughter, Mi Qingdie. She was also the descendant that Crimson Moon Venerate liked the most in this generation.
Thus, Mi Qingdie was also one of the top-notch second-generation young masters of the City of Death. It was because of this that she had dared to watch Zuwa An make a fool of himself.
“This kind of man, I should try to see how fierce he can be in bed.” She smiled, her bearing seductive and alluring.

And in the other private rooms, those like Zuwa An and the others were frowning deeply. They had no intention of “playing around”. The stronger Ling Han and Lin Yun were, the more uneasy they would be.
They were still young, and did not want to stay here forever. Hence, they wanted to leave, and enter into a real great world, to start a new life for themselves.
However, if the people outside were all so awesome, then wouldn’t they be asking for a beating if they went out?
Fight, fight, fight.

Ling Han was filled with heroic spirit. Though the Imperial Son was not affected by any negative effects, he did not take it to heart. He was confident that he was invincible. Even if he could not use a few abilities, he would still be able to kill Lin Yun.
On the other hand, the more Lin Yun fought, the less confident he became.
It couldn’t be helped. His battle prowess was only superior to Ling Han by one Heaven, but in terms of endurance, how could he compare to Ling Han?
There was no way to take Ling Han down in a short period of time. If this dragged on for too long, he would definitely lose.
It should be known that they were fighting a mortal duel, and the losing side... meant death.
Die?

This was something that Lin Yun had never considered before, at least until his lifespan dried up. He was destined to become a Saint, and his brilliant life had just begun. How could he have imagined that he would die?
However, this word was now churning in his mind, causing him to feel fear.
“Afraid?” Ling Han asked calmly. He could already clearly sense that his opponent’s battle prowess had weakened slightly.

Lin Yun remained silent. He naturally knew himself well, and merely attacked madly. His right hand slashed through the air, while his left hand grabbed tens of thousands of Regulations, turning them into Divine Swords to attack Ling Han.
He still had a trump card up his sleeve. In truth, his power had not truly begun to decline. He was laying a trap for Ling Han.
However, with Ling Han’s battle experience, how could he not tell?
He didn’t give Lin Yun any chance at all. Every punch was violent, forcing Lin Yun to parry with all his might. Mystical power flowed out of him like water.
After battling for another half an hour, Lin Yun finally felt panic.

That was because his power had really begun to decline, and Ling Han had completely leveled the playing field, and if this continued, it would not be difficult to foresee that he would fall into a disadvantage, and be killed by Ling Han in the end.
He had come here to rapidly increase his cultivation level in order to catch up to the Golden Generation, not to seek death!
He was the Imperial Son, and he had a bright future ahead of him. How could he be willing to die here?
“Stop!” he shouted loudly.
How could Ling Han possibly listen? His fists continued to rain down.
When he called out loudly, what Imperial Clan was willing to listen to him?
Lin Yun frowned, and after feigning a move, he immediately turned around and left.

“Humph, you’ve activated the mortal duel, and you actually think of forfeiting the battle?” With a cold humph, an elite moved. Weng, weng, weng! Innumerable Regulations appeared, turning into a massive cage that enshrouded the entire battlefield.
Lin Yun brandished his sword in a slash, but light blazed, and the cage was completely unmoved.
It could not be broken through!
Lin Yun was both anxious and furious. He shouted loudly, “I am the Fire Cloud Imperial Clan’s Lin Yun. If anything happens to me here, all of you will die!”
Instantly, boos rang out.
This place was filled with mad men, bloodthirsty and yearning for battle. Lin Yun actually used his background to suppress others, so they naturally looked down on him.
Was a mortal duel a joke?
Lin Yun waited for a while, but the Regulations that had sealed him showed no signs of dispersing.
This!

“Humph, don’t use the Imperial Clan as a scare tactic,” the elite said calmly. “The Imperial Clan can’t enter, so just give up! I might as well tell you. A very, very long time ago, a Saint brought the Imperial Weapon and attempted to force his way in, but what happened?”
“The Saint has died, and only the Imperial Weapon streaked through space and left.”
Lin Yun couldn’t help but feel his heart clench. Why didn’t he know about this part of history?

He suddenly recalled that a Saint of the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan had once passed away in an accident. It was announced to the outside world that he had gone mad from cultivating. This had once confused the Saint of the Lin Clan, and he thought that the Thousand Spirit Imperial Clan had deliberately concealed the truth.
Could it be that it was here that the Saint had died?
He might have solved a mystery, but his heart was getting colder and colder.
In this place, even the hands of the Imperial Clan were unable to reach out. Then what meaning did his identity as an Imperial Son have?
“Lin Yun, come fight me!” Behind him, Ling Han said calmly. He didn’t take advantage of the opening to attack.
Lin Yun turned around, his eyes filled with viciousness.
Fine, then he would put his life on the line.
Boom!
He ignited his Imperial Bloodline, and his battle prowess instantly returned to its peak. Furthermore, there was still some improvement, though it was pitifully small.
This was natural. The Silver Generation was already not much inferior to the Great Emperors in their youth. Even if he ignited the Imperial Bloodline, his improvement would not be very great.
“You want to kill me? Humph, then I’ll kill you even if it means shattering my foundations!” Lin Yun said resolutely. His right hand formed into a claw and ruthlessly pressed down on his chest.
Pu, his chest immediately split open, and blood gushed out. However, not a single drop fell. Instead, it turned into a ball of flames.
Ling Han saw very clearly that these flames actually contained terrifying Regulations, which made him feel wary.
This was Imperial Blood!
This ball of fire turned into a sword. Its shape was similar to the Jade Water Sword, but the aura it exuded was countless times more terrifying.

“Die!” Lin Yun’s expression was twisted. Not only did this Imperial Blood Spirit Tool have to extract all his Imperial Blood, it would also damage his dao foundations, and only then would he be able to deliver an attack that surpassed his cultivation level.
However, if his dao foundatios were damaged, he could still rebuild it. However, if he died, everything would be for naught.
Hence, he did not hesitate to take a gamble.
Shua! The flaming sword slashed over, bringing with it Lin Yun’s boundless killing intent and hatred.

Although Lin Yun’s Jade Water Sword wasn’t an Imperial Weapon, how could a replica Tool produced by the Imperial Clan be ordinary?
This was especially the case since he was the Imperial Son.
The materials he used were top-notch.

As the sword swept out, not only were there multiple seals, they were boosted with the Regulations of heaven and earth, as well as the might of the Divine Metal itself, which increased its destructive power.
Boom!
The Sword Qi tore through the air, and it was as if even planets could be shattered.
Ling Han was completely unafraid.
He brandished his fists to parry, directly blocking the Jade Water Sword.
He could absorb all power within six Heavens, so this kind of defense was naturally awesome.
However, he had another disadvantage, and that was he would be wounded by sharp weapons.
However, after he cultivated the Body Art, this shortcoming no longer existed.
His physique could completely be treated as the sturdiest Divine Metal among his peers, allowing him to truly possess the confidence to face a Celestial Tool head-on with his bare hands.
Come.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them continued to exchange blows.
The Regulations exploded, and even if it was just a shockwave, it was still extremely destructive.
The spectators at the outer circle hurriedly retreated.
They couldn’t withstand the aftermath, so they had to retreat.
Otherwise, they would either die or be injured.
“The top prodigies of the outside world are indeed as awesome as the legends say!” In the private room, a red-haired woman’s eyes lit up.
She was Crimson Moon Venerate’s granddaughter, Mi Qingdie.
She was also the descendant that Crimson Moon Venerate liked the most in this generation.
Thus, Mi Qingdie was also one of the top-notch second-generation young masters of the City of Death.
It was because of this that she had dared to watch Zuwa An make a fool of himself.
“This kind of man, I should try to see how fierce he can be in bed.” She smiled, her bearing seductive and alluring.
And in the other private rooms, those like Zuwa An and the others were frowning deeply.
They had no intention of “playing around”.
The stronger Ling Han and Lin Yun were, the more uneasy they would be.
They were still young, and did not want to stay here forever.
Hence, they wanted to leave, and enter into a real great world, to start a new life for themselves.
However, if the people outside were all so awesome, then wouldn’t they be asking for a beating if they went out?
Fight, fight, fight.
Ling Han was filled with heroic spirit.
Though the Imperial Son was not affected by any negative effects, he did not take it to heart.
He was confident that he was invincible.
Even if he could not use a few abilities, he would still be able to kill Lin Yun.
On the other hand, the more Lin Yun fought, the less confident he became.
It couldn’t be helped.
His battle prowess was only superior to Ling Han by one Heaven, but in terms of endurance, how could he compare to Ling Han?
There was no way to take Ling Han down in a short period of time.
If this dragged on for too long, he would definitely lose.
It should be known that they were fighting a mortal duel, and the losing side... meant death.
Die?
This was something that Lin Yun had never considered before, at least until his lifespan dried up.
He was destined to become a Saint, and his brilliant life had just begun.
How could he have imagined that he would die?
However, this word was now churning in his mind, causing him to feel fear.
“Afraid?” Ling Han asked calmly.

In truth, his power had not truly begun to decline.

Every punch was violent, forcing Lin Yun to parry with all his might.
Mystical power flowed out of him like water.

chapters.title: Chapter 4285: Killing Lin Yun
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The might of this strike was too terrifying.
60 Heavens? 70 Heavens?

Ling Han had never attained such high battle prowess before, nor had he seen anyone reach it before. Thus, he had no way to judge. However, there was one thing he was certain of. If he still threw a punch to take it head-on, his fist would definitely be severed, and his body would also be split into two.
Furthermore, this strike was too fast, so fast that even he could not dodge.
Using the Great Emperor Horn?

Thoughts flashed through Ling Han’s mind like lightning. No, he immediately denied it. With the speed of this strike, even if he made Lin Yun lose control and howl like a wolf, it was not enough to affect the course of the Blazing Flame Blood Sword. Thus, he would still be hit.
There was nothing else that could be done.
Ling Han sighed, and with a thought, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower immediately appeared.
However, the precious tool kept a low profile, and did not show any brilliance. Even the air of Primal Chaos did not descend.
Pu!

The Blazing Flame Blood Sword arrived, and struck the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The impact was so great that even the precious tool trembled. Meanwhile, Ling Han and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower were connected mentally, and felt his chest boil as he immediately spluttered out a mouthful of blood.

F***, this strike was really very powerful. He had used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower as a shield, yet was still unable to completely block it. Its destructive power was really too terrifying.
However, he didn’t know that Lin Yun really wanted to cry at this moment.
This strike had been delivered at the cost of damaging his dao foundations, and had also exhausted all the Imperial Blood. Just how terrifying would the might of this strike be?
Yet Ling Han had actually blocked it!
This caused his vision to darken, and he almost fainted.
Hold on, he looked at Ling Han. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had already been stored away, but with his memory, he would naturally be able to remember it with a single glance.
This was... the Imperial Weapon of Nine Mountains Saint!

He was certain of it. The scene of the Nine Mountains Saint confronting the five Saints with the “Imperial Weapon” was broadcasted live by the entire Galaxy Network. Even if he didn’t have a connection device, he still had the means to see it.
This Imperial Weapon was actually in Ling Han’s possession?

Hold on, this was definitely impossible. Furthermore, the Imperial Weapon wasn’t that weak, and would actually tremble after taking a blow from him. In fact, it even made the owner throw up blood — even if it hadn’t awakened, the Imperial Weapon was still the Imperial Weapon, capable of killing him with a single rebound.
Thus!

Realization suddenly dawned on him. This was not an Imperial Weapon, but merely a piece of Origin Gold! The reason why even Saints had been apprehensive at that time was because what Saint would dare to use their divine sense to examine an Imperial Weapon?
With this backlash, the Saint would definitely be in deep trouble.
Thus, the Nine Mountains Saint actually managed to scare the five Imperial Clans into retreat with this fake Imperial Weapon.
The whole world had been deceived by these two people!
“So that’s how it is!” Lin Yun gritted his teeth, his eyes spitting fire.
If the five Saints had insisted, then the Nine Suns Holy Land would have long since been destroyed, and Ling Han would naturally have long since died as well. How could he possibly appear here?
Ling Han had long since died, so he definitely wouldn’t have to die.
Ah!
He was mad with fury. As Imperial Son, a Silver Generation elite, his luck was actually so bad?
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Suddenly understand? However, you won’t have the chance to tell anyone!”
He charged over. Boom! He unleashed his full battle prowess.

Lin Yun parried the attack. Peng, it was only a single blow, and he was sent flying. His body crashed heavily into the cage of Regulations, and then bounced back. Not only was he throwing up blood madly from his mouth, the wound on his chest had also reopened, blood gushing out madly.
His dao foundation had been destroyed, and his battle prowess was beginning to decline in all directions. Naturally, he was no longer a match for Ling Han.

“The Spirit Tool in Ling Han’s hands is...” Lin Yun roared through divine sense. He was going to reveal Ling Han’s greatest secret and make him become the target of all the great elites of the City of Death. In that way, Ling Han would also have to die with him.
Peng!
Ling Han’s fist had already smashed down, interrupting his divine sense transmission.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
His punches became fiercer and fiercer, and with each punch, a burst of blood would explode from Lin Yun’s body. In just a few punches, Lin Yun had already become a bloody figure.

Lin Yun was unwilling to give up. He hadn’t dug a huge trap for Ling Han yet, so he was willing to risk everything. Even if it meant death, he was going to expose the secret of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“Origin—” he called out another word.
Peng!

Ling Han threw another punch, and Lin Yun’s divine sense transmission came to an abrupt stop again. The word “Gold” finally didn’t spread out, and could only reverberate in his mind. Meanwhile, his mind... was already beginning to shatter.
Lin Yun stared fixedly at Ling Han, filled with resentment and defiance.
The majestic Imperial Son was actually going to die here?
—There was a special suppression here, and even the Substitution Seal was ineffective.

But no matter how unwilling he was, so what? Ling Han was ruthless, and directly destroyed his mind. One after another, the True Selves shattered, and his consciousness was presently being rapidly destroyed.
Pa! His body weakened, and he collapsed to the ground. His life essence rapidly disappeared.
Instantly, the whole area was filled with cheers.
This kind of battle was exciting! And in the end, one person had lost his life, satisfying their thirst for blood. Naturally, they were satisfied.
The Regulations prison had also been removed, which meant that Ling Han could now leave.
Ling Han composed himself and left.
Merely killing Lin Yun wasn’t enough to make him happy. Moreover, he was still recalling Lin Yun’s final attack.

This attack was extremely powerful, and the current him was completely unable to block it. Even if he used the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he was still wounded to the point of throwing up blood.
The Imperial Son was not to be underestimated, especially after he had advanced into the True Self Tier, and could use the Regulations. There were too many tricks up his sleeve.

But there was nothing that could be done. Imperial Blood flowed in the Imperial Son’s veins. This was the blessing of his ancestor, and had nothing to do with natural talent or hard work. He could not be envious of this.
Ling Han continued to cultivate diligently. He had come here to rapidly increase his cultivation level. Everything else could be discussed after he left.
After one battle after another, Ling Han obtained more and more Source Dao Stones. However, he still couldn’t find any clues as to where the Source Dao Stone originated from.

His successive victories had already expanded to a hundred, creating a new record. Thus, the Dark Battlefield especially gifted him a suit of Battle Armor. It did not have the effect of increasing battle prowess, and merely looked heroic and good.
Under the request of the Dark Battlefield, he would wear this Battle Armor every time he appeared, and was bestowed the title of One Punch King.
—Because in the following battles, he had defeated his opponents with a single punch.
On this day, his battle ended. He changed his clothes backstage, then left.

However, he had just removed the armor he was wearing, when he discovered that someone had entered quietly. He turned his head, and saw that there was a red-haired woman standing near the entrance. Her starry eyes were like water, and her charm was bone-deep.
“My name is Mi Qingdie,” the red-haired woman introduced herself. Then, she stared at Ling Han’s chest, and actually licked her lips, looking perverted.
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and he already knew the identity of this woman.
...Crimson Moon Venerate’s granddaughter.
F***, why didn’t Yuan Bing tell him that this woman seemed to be a love-struck fool?
“Lady Mi.” Ling Han nodded as he quickly put on his shirt.

Mi Qingdie couldn’t help but swallow again, and said, “Aren’t you fighting to the death here for the sake of the Source Dao Stone? Come, as long as you follow Big Sister, Big Sister will give you as many Source Dao Stones as you want in the future.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4286: Clues
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Er, was she planning to make him a kept man?
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. There would actually come a day when he would become someone’s kept man.
“Little brother, your smile is truly captivating!” Mi Qingdie licked her lips, looking like she wanted nothing more than to swallow Ling Han whole.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, and said, “Apologies, I only sell my skill, not my body.”
“If Big Sister doesn’t pay money, then it can’t be considered as selling body,” Mi Qingdie said shamelessly.
Ling Han was almost rendered speechless. This woman was truly shameless.
He pulled out his sleeve, and was just about to leave.
“What’s the hurry?” Mi Qingdie’s figure swayed, blocking the entrance.
Ling Han merely smiled. Xiu, he had already brushed past her. This was no big deal.
“Little brother!” Mi Qingdie hurriedly chased after him, “Wait for Big Sister.”
Ling Han naturally ignored her. He strode off, his speed extremely fast.
Mi Qingdie set off in hot pursuit. It had not been just one or two days since she had coveted Ling Han’s “strength”.
Ling Han ignored her, and strode forwards.
Yi?
Just as he stepped out of the battlefield, he saw a person.
Little Lord Wolf, Zuwa An.

That’s right. This top-notch second-generation descendant of the Wolf Tribe had now gained another nickname. Naturally, it was because he had “awakened” the Wolf Tribe bloodline, and had obtained it by running naked all over the city in pursuit of Lin Yun.
“Little Lord Wolf!” Ling Han called out.

Zuwa An instantly felt an urge to smack him. In his eyes, this nickname was a great humiliation, but when he saw Ling Han, a feeling of reverence rose up from the bottom of his heart. That was a fear and obedience that came from deep within his bones.
“What, what’s the matter?” He pretended to be calm.
“Help me block the lunatic behind me,” Ling Han said. With a flash, he had passed them.

Zuwa An could already see Mi Qingdie behind him. He wanted nothing more than for her to swallow Ling Han whole and skin him alive. However, he couldn’t resist Ling Han’s command from the bottom of his heart, so he could only step out to block her.
“Zuwa An, don’t ruin my business!” Mi Qingdie said in displeasure. Seeing that Ling Han would soon disappear without a trace, she felt irritated.
Zuwa An humphed, and said, “Scram, don’t trifle with me!”
“Heh, after awakening your bloodline, even your temper has become hot.” Mi Qingdie was also very angry.
Boom!
The two of them immediately began fighting, and for a moment, it was incredibly intense.
Ling Han didn’t walk too far. Instead, he stopped after turning a corner, and began to watch the show from the shadows.
He was observing just how great the influence of the Great Emperor Horn was on Zuwa An.
“It seems like this can really command the Wolf Tribe, even if it is only a half-assed Wolf Tribe like Zuwa An.”
“Hehe, this seems to be useful.”
Ling Han turned around and left. A day later, he paid a visit to this Little Lord Wolf.
After receiving the report, Zuwa An reluctantly invited Ling Han in.
“What are you doing here?” he asked, putting on a fierce appearance but actually feeling cowardly.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “I’m here to see a friend.”
Who is your friend? Who the hell is your friend?
Zuwa An mocked internally, but did not dare show it on his face. He merely humphed.
After Ling Han rambled on for a while, he began to beat around the bush, probing to see if Zuwa An knew any secrets regarding the Source Dao Stone mine.
He was the most beloved grandson of a Venerate Tier elite, so there was a chance that he could win.
It wasn’t long before a smile spread across his face. Zuwa An actually knew about this.
It was extremely likely that the Source Dao Stone mine was located in the Black Cloud Mountain outside the city.
The news was not absolute, because Zuwa An only knew that the Blood Crow Venerate would make a trip to the Black Cloud Mountain every once in a while.
Going by this deduction, it was somewhat possible that the Black Cloud Mountain was the location of the Source Dao Stone mine.

He did not move at the first instant, but rather continued to battle in the Dark Battlefield, earning Source Dao Stones. He had already entered this space for a year, and his cultivation level had also reached the middle stage of the Fourth Form. His improvement could be considered quite astonishing.
However, it was not that he had not paid a price, sacrificing more than three hundred years of his lifespan.
A True Self Tier possessed a theoretical lifespan of 10,000 years, so he could still afford expending a lifespan of 300 years.
After all, once he broke through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, his lifespan limit would be increased to 20,000 years.

Practically every few days, there would be people arriving at the City of Death. They were either exiles or people who had come here to train, and recently, there had been a wave of people entering. People arrived almost every day.
And a rookie very quickly rose to fame, and was very forceful.
When this person’s name reached Ling Han’s ears, he couldn’t help but feel surprised, because it was actually Ding Shu.
Why had this guy come here?

Ling Han pondered for a moment. Perhaps it was because the Buddhist Race of the North Heavenly Realm no longer had enough resources to support the advancement of his cultivation level. For super geniuses like them, their ability to comprehend Dao was spine-chillingly strong. As long as there was endless cultivation resources, their cultivation level would soar.

On the other hand, for ordinary prodigies, even if they had Source Dao Stones, they wouldn’t be able to. If they weren’t skilled enough in comprehending Dao, forcibly raising their cultivation level would only result in their own demise.
Thus, Ding Shu’s choice was the same as his.
Ling Han thought for a moment, and ignored this.
After being silent for so many days, it was time for him to go to the Black Cloud Mountain to take a look.
He quietly left the city, and soon arrived at his destination.
This was an incredibly tall mountain, like a great sword that pierced directly into the clouds.
Ling Han searched in the mountains, releasing his divine sense to search inch by inch.
Unfortunately, there were no ley lines here that he could borrow. Otherwise, the speed of his exploration could be increased tenfold, or even a hundredfold.
As long as there was no battle, he would explore here, but after half a month, he still did not find any clues.
He made another trip to Zuwa An’s place to find out more about the situation. Then, he went to the Black Cloud Mountain again.
—The Blood Crow Venerate would be coming here recently.
He waited, and true enough, only two days later, an elite appeared, landing at the summit.
Was it the Blood Crow Venerate?
Ling Han had never seen him before, but he could sense his terrifying aura. He was indeed a Venerate Tier elite.
He took out the Void Beast hide, and used the Strange Shadow Steps. Under the double cover, he finally headed towards the summit.
Xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu! Just as he was climbing to the summit, another four powerful figures actually streaked across the skies, and landed on the summit.
Yi?
The five people who arrived one after another were extremely powerful, all of them exuding the aura of Venerate Tier.
The five Venerate Tier elites of the City of Death?
In other words, the first Venerate to arrive might not be the Blood Crow Venerate.
Were these five Venerate Tier elites here to divide the Source Dao Stones among themselves?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, and he couldn’t help but speed up.
Very quickly, he arrived at the summit, and saw that the five Venerate Tier elites were all sitting cross-legged, as if they were stone statues.
They definitely didn’t come out of the city for a visit. Instead, they were probably communicating with their divine sense, right?
Weng, a terrifying divine sense swept past, passing over Ling Han’s body.
A sturdy old man suddenly stood up, a suspicious expression on his face.
“Crimson Moon, you’re being paranoid again,” an elder with a pair of blood-colored wings on his back said with a smile. Needless to say, he was definitely the Blood Crow Tier Venerate.
This sturdily-built old man was naturally Crimson Moon Venerate. He swept his divine sense over again, and said, “I’m not being paranoid here. I’m just being careful!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4287: Conjecture
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Two of them had already spoken, and the remaining three Venerate Tier elites didn’t communicate with their divine sense anymore. Instead, they started to speak as well.

“Everyone, there are no Saint-level Regulations here. Furthermore, the people of the City of Death only know slaughter, and have no faith.” The Brahman Sea Bodhisattva said, “Thus, we cannot become Saints here, and must go to the outside world.”

“Who doesn’t want to become a Saint? But the question is, how did we enter into this place in the first place?” The Nine Palace Venerate said, “When those people, or rather, those forces find out that we had exited the Dark Clouds Hell, how could they sit by and watch us break through to Saint Tier?”

In the past, they had not entered this place willingly, but had rather been exiled. Thankfully, they were very fortunate. Not only had they not died here, they had instead grown step by step into Venerate Tier-level great elites.
However, Venerate Tier elites could be regarded as kings in this place, but if they ran outside, they would still be suppressed by Saints.
“Furthermore, how could it be that we would give up our base here just like that?” the Ice Silkworm Venerate said.
These words silenced the five Venerate Tier elites. They naturally couldn’t let go of everything here.

The Source Dao Stone was too useful. Though it was actually an equivalent exchange with the price of lifespan, it was believed that there were a great many people in this world that were willing to spend great amounts of money to obtain it.
With such resources in hand, it was enough to become a powerful force!

“After so many years of preparation, how could it be that you all are still not satisfied?” The Blood Crow Venerate said calmly, “Furthermore, do you all still not know the current trend of the world? The True Dragon Abyss has opened, and the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor has appeared. All this indicated one truth.
“The time to become Emperor has arrived!”
“If we don’t seize this opportunity, hoho, won’t you all regret it?”

The four Venerate Tier elites were all moved by his words. As long as they were cultivators, which one of them didn’t have the ambition of becoming Emperor? However, due to the limitations of natural talent, resources, and various other conditions, most people would definitely know their own limitations.
However, being able to become a Venerate, this in itself represented a powerful natural talent in cultivation. How could the five Venerate Tier elites not have designs on it?
“All right, I agree to leave.” The Nine Palace Venerate nodded, “However, how do we continue to control this space? We have to think of a suitable way.”

“For people with low cultivation levels, it’s easy to come in here and difficult to leave, but for us, it’s easy to leave, but it’s difficult to come back in.” The Brahman Sea Bodhisattva looked at the other four people, “How about staying for another three years?”
The Blood Crow Venerate and the others exchanged looks before nodding slowly, saying, “Alright, we’ll wait another three years.”
“Three years later, let go of everything else, rush out of this space, and take a gamble for the sake of becoming Emperor.”
After saying this, the five Venerate Tier elites all tore through the air and left.
Ling Han didn’t move. After a long while, Crimson Moon Venerate’s figure appeared before him. He looked around in confusion, and murmured, “Could it be that I’ve been overly suspicious?”
After saying this, he left again.
Ling Han still didn’t move. After at least half a day, the figure of Crimson Moon Venerate appeared once more.
The old geezer was indeed very suspicious. Just because he had suspicions, he actually pretended to leave twice.
Ling Han left quietly. ‘You can come as many times as you like. I’m not playing with you anymore.’
He was already certain that this Black Cloud Mountain was not the mine that produced the Source Dao Stones, but rather the meeting place of the five Venerate Tier elites.
As for why they had to leave the city and come here, Ling Han didn’t know, nor was he interested in finding out.
“If the Source Dao Stone isn’t here, then where is it?”
“There’s another thing that’s suspicious. This City of Death has already existed for many, many years. What mine is so durable that it still hasn’t been emptied?”
“From the tone of those five Venerate Tier elites, it seems like there’s an inexhaustible supply of Source Stones. That’s why they want to eternally control this place.”
“This doesn’t make sense.”
“Could it be that my previous judgement was wrong? In truth, the Source Dao Stone wasn’t mined?”
As for ores, thinking about it, they must have come from a mine. This was something to be expected.
However, the Dao Stone wasn’t harvested from the mine, but refined by elites.
Thus, this Source Dao Stone might not have been mined.

Ling Han wracked his brains. Firstly, this was definitely not refined. Otherwise, it could not possibly become a specialty of the City of Death. Secondly, this kind of resource must have been jointly grasped by the five Venerable Tier elites, or their relationship would not have been so harmonious.
Then, what place would be jointly owned by five Venerate Tier elites?
Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. Dark Battlefield!
That’s right. As far as he knew, this place was jointly owned by the five Venerate Tier elites.
Ling Han had a question before, and that was what was the point of hosting this kind of tournament?
Could the five Venerate Tier elites obtain benefits?
If there were no benefits to be gained, why would a Venerate Tier cultivator do such a thing?
Now, linking the two together, Ling Han felt like he was about to find the truth.
Ling Han decided to investigate the place where he had battled countless times.
He returned to the City of Death and went to the Dark Battlefield.
This time, he had come in a completely different mood.
Every day, there would be a sea of people here. Could the secret of the Source Dao Stone be hidden here?
Thinking about it, this was too impossible, wasn’t it?

But if this was really the birthplace of the Source Dao Stone, then it really lived up to the saying that the most dangerous place was the safest place. Who would have thought that the Source Dao Stone would actually be here?
His mentality was different, and Ling Han immediately discovered what was strange.

This place actually did not just comprise of only the spectators’ seats, the battle area, and the backstage area. Ling Han discovered that there was another passageway that should lead underground, but this passageway had been sealed off, and a very powerful restriction had been placed.
Usually, there would be people coming and going here, and Ling Han would not have the time to decipher it at all, and at night, this place would be sealed off, and heavily guarded.

After midnight, Ling Han sneaked in with the Strange Shadow Steps. He carefully studied the restriction, but soon shook his head. This was set by a Venerate Tier, and there was no way he could break through it.

—Even if one had the ability to forcibly break through, it would immediately alert the Venerate Tier that had set up the restrictions. With the size of the City of Death, those five big shots would immediately arrive.
Was there really no other way?
Ling Han returned, racking his brains for ideas.

In these two months, he had obtained another pile of Source Dao Stones. Because the number of consecutive wins was continuously increasing, he had also obtained rich rewards, pushing his cultivation level to the end of the fourth form.
He first set aside the matter of breaking through the restrictions, and began to charge towards the fifth form with all his might.
The fourth form was the Golden Fetus, then what was the fifth form?
It was indefinite.

Every person who broke through their limits would form a different fifth form. Some could possibly be Purple Qi Origin Fetus, while some could be Glass Jade Fetus. Thus, before breaking through, Ling Han didn’t know what he would form.
Come, begin the barrage.
Ling Han went into seclusion to attempt the fifth form.
He was naturally very confident in breaking through his limits. For others, the Fifth Form was their limit, but for him, wasn’t that natural?

It was said that the Golden Generation had once reached the Eighth Form, so his target was naturally the Ninth Form. He couldn’t be on an equal footing with those guys, or even in fact, inferior to them, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 4288: Finding Helpers
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han began to charge towards the fifth form.

After the True Self underwent multiple transformations, it had accumulated more and more Dao. If one wanted to make it undergo another transformation, the difficulty level was naturally increasing further and further.

Thus, for the majority of cultivators, the Fourth Form was the end, and they could now attempt to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier. Meanwhile, the Spirit Transformation Tier would also become their end, and it was impossible for them to advance any further.
If he wanted to have hopes of breaking through to Sect Master Tier, he would have to break through his limits and reach the Fifth Form.
From this aspect, every Sect Master was very valuable, and there was no longer any mediocre talent among them.

Ling Han’s finishing line naturally wasn’t limited to the Sect Master-level. Thus, the fifth form was only the beginning. If even breaking through to the fifth form was filled with difficulties, then he might as well give up and become a full-time daddy.
He continued to gain enlightenment. In his mind, the True Self of Destruction was exuding golden light. This was a Golden Fetus, but he clearly couldn’t tell what state it was evolving into yet.
Ling Han was in no hurry. He merely settled his accumulation, turning it into his appreciation of the Dao of heaven and earth.
In his mind, indescribable Regulations surged, exuding a supreme aura.

This didn’t originate from Ling Han, but from the nine True Selves. These True Selves were basically formed from a core of nine-star high-level energy. Now, it was as if the cores of these True Selves had awakened, stimulating mysterious Regulations.
Ling Han extracted these Regulations and boosted them on the True Self, using them to advance the evolution of the True Self.
However, the ‘true self’ had already transformed into the fourth form, and was filled with repulsive properties. When the Regulations boosted it, they were easily shattered and bounced back.

Ling Han could only take things slowly, bit by bit. This was both a change to his mind, and also an improvement to his level of being. He was sure that when he advanced into the fifth form, the upper limit of his Body Arts would also be unlocked.
With his continuous efforts, the repulsion from the True Self of Destruction became smaller and smaller. Finally, it began to transform into the fifth form.
Boom!
A great commotion arose in his mind. The golden light emitted by the True Self of Destruction suddenly dimmed, but only an instant later, three-coloured light blazed.
Success.

A smile appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips, but he did not look like he was going to stop at all. Now that the upper limit of his evolution had just been unlocked, the heaven and earth would bestow a boost, and this was the best time to increase his cultivation level. How could he stop at this moment?
Moreover, he had never imagined that his fifth form would actually be a Tricolor Fetus.

It seemed that only when someone had cultivated to the sixth form, or even the seventh form in fact, would it be possible to nurture a three-coloured Fetus, but Ling Han had just advanced into the fifth form, and had already formed a three-coloured Fetus. Then, what about when he cultivated to the sixth or seventh form in future?
Four-coloured Fetus, five-coloured Fetus?
Ling Han couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation. This was a massive leap.
He suppressed his excitement and continued to cultivate.

The True Self of Destruction was being reconstructed, and the tri-coloured light became brighter and brighter. Though it was only one, it was even more dazzling than the other eight True Selves added together.
Because this was a qualitative evolution, it was completely different.
Three days later, Ling Han finally stopped.

The True Self of Destruction had already completely evolved into a three-colored fetus, and the upper limit of his Body Art had also been lifted. It could support him to continue improving, and not fall behind his mystical power.
“If I were to battle Lin Yun again now, I would be able to destroy him at any time,” Ling Han said with a smile as he sensed his own power.

Double raw powers of 45 Heavens burst forth at the same time, and merely pure power alone could reach 50 Heavens. Then, when Imperial Technique was unleashed, the limit of battle prowess could reach 6 Heavens.

Ling Han nodded, and murmured, “For ordinary people, celestial techniques are the true way to go. After all, even those who have reached the consummate level of the True Self Tier are only at the power of 12 Heavens. However, an Imperial Technique can increase one’s battle prowess by as many as 9 Heavens.”
“However, to me, power is the way to go.”
“Without the support of power, Imperial Techniques would not be enough.”
He came out of seclusion, and surveyed the Dark Battlefield. He focused his energy back on how he was going to break through the restrictions of the Dark Battlefield.
However, he still had to earn the Source Dao Stones.

Ling Han went to the Dark Battlefield and canceled his ceasefire. Of course, only people with merits like him could enjoy such treatment. If others did this, they would be seen as forfeiting the battle. Then, after accumulating three times, they would not be able to battle in the Dark Battlefield for three years.
He took the chance to study it again, but even if his cultivation level had increased to another level, he was still unable to resolve the restrictions.
Could he... find external help?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. After some thought, he decided to find someone.
Ding Shu.
Very soon, he found this person that was very similar to him in an inn. This guy was currently courting women, one against three. He was really too carefree.
Upon seeing Ling Han, Ding Shu smiled and waved his hand, saying, “Beauties, I have guests now. Let’s chat again next time.”
The three beauties all giggled, stood up and left.
Ding Shu pointed at the empty spot, and said, “You’re disturbing me from courting women, so you’d better have something important. Otherwise, I’ll be very angry.”
Ling Han smiled, “What is it? Not going to be Buddha Son anymore?”
“Tsk, there’s no profit to be had, and Buddhist Land actually sent someone to make things difficult for me. Do they really think I’m a pushover?” Ding Shu sneered.
Ling Han’s curiosity was piqued, and he asked, “Are you Origin, Myriad Dao or the other?”

Ding Shu looked at Ling Han, and after a while, he finally said, “No! However, as I see it, those few people only have undeserved reputation, especially that ‘Number One in the Galaxy’. Haha, I’m really about to laugh my head off. He actually dares to praise himself like this. I really want to meet him and beat him up.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but rub his chin. Someone wanted to beat him up, so shouldn’t he teach them a lesson?
However, Ding Shu wasn’t one of the three monsters that included Origin?
Ling Han had battled with them before. Although he had only battled through the Galaxy Network and it couldn’t represent actual battle, those three people were truly powerful.
Thus, Ling Han was very surprised that Ding Shu wasn’t one of these three people.
“That’s right, what exactly do you want?” Ding Shu asked.

Ling Han set aside the question of the true identities of Origin and the others, and got down to business. He said, “You have naturally come here for the sake of the Source Dao Stone. Thus, I may have discovered a place that produces Source Dao Stones. Would you be interested in challenging it with me?”
“Oh?” Ding Shu’s interest was instantly piqued, and his eyes lit up. “Of course I’m interested.”
Ling Han smiled and said, “However, that place has been sealed. Even if I’m a formation grandmaster, I still can’t break through it. Do you have any treasures that can instantly break through it?”
Ding Shu squinted his eyes, and looked at Ling Han for a while. He remained silent.
He indeed had this kind of treasure, but it was too precious. At the most crucial moment, it could save his life.
What if Ling Han made a mistake? That would be a great loss to him.
“If we really find the Source Dao Stone, how should we divide it?” Ding Shu asked.
“Of course, we’ll split it evenly,” Ling Han said.
One provided the location, while the other brought the two of them in. Thus, the merits were equal, so it was naturally shared equally.
Ding Shu only hesitated for a moment, then replied, “All right!”
He was also an overlord of the Genesis World, so he naturally had no lack of decisiveness.
“When do we move?”
“Tomorrow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4289: Careless Ending
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The exploration this time could possibly go very smoothly. After undoing the restrictions, there was a large storehouse of Source Dao Stones inside. They would divide it up and then flee. However, there could also be twists and turns, and who knew what kind of dangers they would encounter.
Thus, Ling Han and Ding Shu both decided to suspend accepting battles. If anything really happened, they could use “seclusion” as an excuse to draw a clear dividing line between them and the matter.
However, they had just gone to the Dark Battlefield, and had not even applied for an application, when they received a battle notification.
Their next opponent... was actually each other!
“Interesting,” Ding Shu said with a smile. “Ling Han, I’ve always wanted to spar with you.”
Ling Han put away the notice. If he continued to call a ceasefire at this time, it would be considered as deliberately avoiding battle, and would be counted into those three times.
“Sure,” he nodded. In any case, he did not lack the time for a battle.
“Oh, it’s this afternoon.” Ding Shu patted Ling Han’s shoulder, and said, “I won’t go easy on you. If you’re too weak, you’ll lose very badly.”
“Don’t worry, the one who will lose will definitely be you.” Ling Han also patted Ding Shu’s shoulder.

The two of them were now in a cooperative relationship, but with their high natural talent, they would definitely be the strongest opponents in the competition for the imperial throne in future. Perhaps, their battle would last their whole life, right until someone became Emperor.

Just like how the Ancestral King Lingtian and the Nine Suns Sainthad fought to the end all those years ago. They had both won and lost, and until the last moment, it was really unknown who would emerge victorious.
“Then I shall anticipate the battle in the afternoon.”
“Same to you.”
The two of them did not return. They merely rested for a short while in the Dark Battlefield, to adjust their condition. After all, it could not be said that their opponent was not strong.
It wasn’t long before afternoon arrived.
The Dark Battlefield also placed a considerable amount of importance on these two people, vacating the other areas of battle, allowing the two of them to attack as much as they liked.
And when they received the news, the spectators also gathered.

Ling Han’s strength had long since been proven through battle merits. In fact, he had even gained the title of “One Punch King”, and as for Ding Shu, he was also extraordinary. After entering into the Dark Battlefield, he had never lost.
However, now that the two of them had met today, it was destined that one of them would be defeated, and their record of being unbeatable would be broken.
On the spectators’ seats, everyone was cheering as if they had been pumped full of adrenaline.
Zuwa An, Mi Qingdie, and the other second-generation young masters all arrived to watch the battle, each with their own thoughts.
Meanwhile, Ling Han and Ding Shu stood 30 meters away from each other. They both appeared calm and composed, not showing any signs of anger.

“Come,” Ding Shu said. Then, he changed his sloppy attitude, and exuded a blazing fighting spirit. The Regulations materialized, turning into a giant tree that reached the heavens behind him, possessing a terrifying intimidation.
They hadn’t even made a move yet, and merely the suppression of their aura was enough to make countless people’s expressions turn ugly, and they almost vomited blood.
Too strong!

Ling Han was naturally unmoved. He activated his eye technique, and swept his gaze over Ding Shu’s body. Only by knowing one’s own strength and the strength of one’s enemy would one be able to win a hundred battles.
Very soon, a strange smile appeared on his face.
Because... Ding Shu was in the fourth form of the True Self Tier!
Why was there a gap of a minor level between them?

This was very normal. This was because Ling Han had entered this place a year before Ding Shu had, and this one year had allowed him to advance from the Third Form to the Fourth Form. In the outside world, just how many natural treasures would you have to refine to be able to advance so quickly?

Perhaps even the Imperial Clan would have to give it their all to be able to do so, but the Buddhist Race of the North Heavenly Realm could only be considred a Saint-level force, so they naturally could not accomplish that.
Thus, Ding Shu’s cultivation level was left behind by Ling Han, even though it was only a minor level.
His cultivation level was even lower than Ling Han, and he still wanted to defeat him. Wasn’t that a joke?
Forget it.
Ling Han suppressed his cultivation level for a moment. He couldn’t bully others, so he might as well suppress his raw power to the same level as Ding Shu before battling.
“Come!” Ding Shu moved, and the Tree of Regulations behind him swayed. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Countless leaves shot out like darts towards Ling Han.
These leaves were formed by Regulations. If one was cut, it would definitely cause serious injury.
The spectators were all on edge. If these “leaves” were blasted to their side, it would lead to a great catastrophe.
Under the Spirit Transformation Tier, there was absolutely no one that could block it.
However, Ling Han crossed his arms behind his back and simply propped up the Starlight Screen.
Hiss, you want to block it just like that?
Everyone was surprised. This was too conceited, wasn’t it?

Xiu, xiu, xiu! The leaves of Regulations landed on the shield, and instantly exploded with endless light. Sure enough, though the Starlight Screen was awesome, it could not withstand such a mad barrage of attacks, and was soon shattered.
The remaining power was boundless, and it continued to blast towards Ling Han. Peng, peng, peng! Light exploded chaotically.
‘What?’

Everyone’s mouths were wide open, and they could see that Ling Han was standing proudly and motionless, as if that was not a terrifying attack that had been formed by Regulations, but merely a gentle breeze.
With the help of the Starlight Screen, how could a power attack within six Heavens possibly hurt Ling Han?
Ding Shu naturally wouldn’t care. If Ling Han couldn’t even block such a simple attack from him, then what right did he have to treat him as a rival?
‘Die!’
He leaped out, and charged towards Ling Han.
Peng!
Ling Han took this blow head-on, yet his figure suddenly swayed, and took a few steps back.
“Haha, you didn’t expect this, did you?” Ding Shu laughed loudly.
Ling Han nodded and said, “Who would’ve thought? You’ve also completed Body Arts!”
He had not thought that Ding Shu’s Body Art had already caught up to his cultivation level. Thus, the power that he delivered was slightly weaker, and he was no match for Ding Shu.

“If that wasn’t the case, how could my cultivation speed have slowed down so much!” Ding Shu said. Then, he frowned, “Why is your power weaker than mine? Yi, you didn’t deliberately suppress your power, right?”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Apologies, I am already in the fifth form.”
Ding Shu couldn’t help but feel gloomy. What he wanted was a battle to his heart’s content, but Ling Han had suppressed his cultivation level, so what meaning was there to it?
“I’m not fighting anymore.” He was very willful, and directly turned around and left. “I’ve lost this battle. When our cultivation levels are equal, we’ll fight again!”

Ling Han sighed. At first, he had wanted to suppress his cultivation level and spar with Ding Shu. He had not thought that the latter would actually have finished mending the shortcoming in his Body Art, causing him to make an error in his estimation. He was done after only two moves.
Forget it, they would battle again in the future.
Ling Han shook his head, and also exited the Dark Battlefield, leaving behind the dumbfounded spectators.
It ended just like that?
‘Are you guys playing house?’

And precisely because of this, Ling Han and Ding Shu’s request for a ceasefire was not approved. Instead, they were subjected to a war of attrition. If they called a ceasefire, then there was no longer any need for them to appear in the Dark Battlefield again in future. In fact, they would be chased out of the City of Death.
There was nothing else that could be done. Ling Han and Ding Shu could only decide to postpone their plans.
Right at this moment, another supreme prodigy entered the City of Death.
Jade Drop Imperial Clan, Han Di
This was one of the well-known members of the Silver Generation. The moment he entered into the Dark Battlefield, he challenged Ling Han to a mortal duel, his words filled with extreme contempt.
Han Di, named as Emperor, his confidence and arrogance was clear for all to see1.
