At first, he had wanted to suppress his cultivation level and spar with Ding Shu.
He had not thought that the latter would actually have finished mending the shortcoming in his Body Art, causing him to make an error in his estimation.
He was done after only two moves.
Forget it, they would battle again in the future.
Ling Han shook his head, and also exited the Dark Battlefield, leaving behind the dumbfounded spectators.
It ended just like that?
‘Are you guys playing house?’
And precisely because of this, Ling Han and Ding Shu’s request for a ceasefire was not approved.
Instead, they were subjected to a war of attrition.
If they called a ceasefire, then there was no longer any need for them to appear in the Dark Battlefield again in future.
In fact, they would be chased out of the City of Death.
There was nothing else that could be done.
Ling Han and Ding Shu could only decide to postpone their plans.
Right at this moment, another supreme prodigy entered the City of Death.
Jade Drop Imperial Clan, Han Di
This was one of the well-known members of the Silver Generation.
The moment he entered into the Dark Battlefield, he challenged Ling Han to a mortal duel, his words filled with extreme contempt.
Han Di, named as Emperor, his confidence and arrogance was clear for all to see1.

chapters.title: Chapter 4290: A windfall
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
An Imperial Son of the Silver Generation was naturally powerful. He swept aside all opposition in his path, and was completely unmatched.
It wasn’t long before the Dark Battlefield’s representatives made arrangements for Han Di to battle against Ding Shu.

This was an ordinary tournament stage battle. Before knowing the specific abilities of his opponent, Ding Shu naturally wouldn’t participate in a mortal duel. As experienced as an overlord of the Genesis World, how could he possibly make such a low-level mistake?
Facts proved that this was a very wise move.

Han Di... was actually in the Seventh Form of the True Self Tier. Though he had only just advanced into this level, he had crushed Ding Shu by close to three minor levels of cultivation level. Even Ding Shu, no matter how freakish his natural talent was, was completely suppressed.

This battle naturally ended with Ding Shu’s defeat, and the killing intent of Han Di was extremely strong. If it was not for the fact that Ding Shu had admitted defeat and managed to escape in time, he would even have been killed on the spot.
“This b@stard!”
After the competition, Ling Han went to the inn to visit Ding Shu. The two of them had reached an agreement after all, and were allies. The moment he entered, he heard Ding Shu cursing.

“If our cultivation levels were equal, or even in fact, even if my cultivation level was lower by a minor level, I would still be able to kill him!” Ding Shu was still calling out, his face filled with defiance.

Ling Han also believed that if Genesis World elites like them dominated a battle of equal cultivation levels, they would definitely suppress the Silver Generation. In fact, they might even be able to trample over the Golden Generation.
There was nothing that could be done. The gap in cultivation level was too wide, so Ding Shu could only swallow this bitter pill.
“Thankfully, you managed to escape with your life,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Are you trying to comfort me?” Ding Shu glared at him.
“If you say so, I am.”
“How is it? When are we going to retrieve the Source Dao Stone?” Ding Shu asked.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before replying, “Tonight.”
“En?” Ding Shu looked towards him, “So urgent?”
“Do you still want to be beaten up again?” Ling Han asked with a smile. “Don’t you want to immediately increase your cultivation level?”

“Hehe, you’re probably even more anxious than me, right?” Ding Shu said slowly. “Han Di’s next target is you, and you’re known as the ‘Imperial Son Killer’. I’m sure that once this Han Di catches you, he’ll definitely kill you.”
Han Di’s cultivation level was two minor levels higher than Ling Han’s. If he unleashed a powerful attack from the very beginning, it was really possible that he could kill Ling Han on the spot.
Of course, Ling Han still couldn’t confirm the extent of Han Di’s battle prowess before they truly battled.
Ling Han didn’t refute this, and he simply said, “Are you going to do it or not?”
“Let’s do it!” Ding Shu nodded. He was currently filled with anger.
“Then can you still withstand your injuries?” Ling Han asked.
“No problem,” Ding Shu said nonchalantly.
Ling Han simply didn’t leave. When night fell, the two of them set off. Naturally, it was Ling Han leading the way.
“Yi?” When they arrived at the Dark Battlefield, Ding Shu couldn’t help but look surprised. “You’re not going to take advantage of me being injured to bully me at this time, are you?”
“Am I that kind of person?” Ling Han rolled his eyes.
“Looks like it to me.” Ding Shu nodded without any reservations.
“It’s right here,” Ling Han said.
“Ah!” Ding Shu was shocked again.
Ling Han took out the Void Beast hide, and wrapped Ding Shu inside as well. The two of them then quietly headed towards the Dark Battlefield.
“Tsk, this is really a good thing.” Ding Shu was envious, and rubbed the animal hide with his hand, “Lend it to me for a few days?”
“Get lost!”

Ding Shu was also an overlord of the Genesis World, but after coming to this great world, his former glory was like passing clouds and mists. Any rare treasure would not be worth a single cent in this great world, and after they appeared in this world, it was clear that their fated encounters were also different.

Thus, Ling Han obtained the Origin Gold, the Void Beast hide, and the Great Emperor Horn. He was sure that Ding Shu definitely didn’t have these. However, Ding Shu had also obtained the Imperial Scroll long ago. This was another good fortune that Ling Han didn’t have.

The two of them quietly arrived at the place where the restriction was placed. There was no one here. Obviously, a Venerate Tier had placed the restriction here, so was there any need to set up additional guards?
It was an unnecessary move. Furthermore, it would instead draw the attention of others.

“Yi, I never thought that there would be such a place.” Ding Shu had been under the light, but left in the dark1. He had not thought that there would actually be such a place in the Dark Battlefield. Previously, he had not thought of it at all, so he naturally would not be searching everywhere here.
Even Ling Han had only become suspicious after receiving inspiration, and thus began his search here.
“It’s up to you now,” Ling Han said.

“This place is indeed worthy of suspicion.” Ding Shu nodded. He took out a brownish-yellow talisman paper, and showed a hint of heartache, “If there is no Source Dao Stone inside, be careful that I will fight you to the death.”
“Hehe, cut the crap.”
Ding Shu waved his hand, and xiu, the talisman paper was shot out. Boom, that restriction was instantly like snow that had encountered boiling water, instantly disappearing without a trace.
“This is a Forbidden Talisman refined by the Great Emperor, and I spent a lot of effort to obtain it. I only have this one.” Ding Shu looked like he was about to cry.

“Let’s go.” Ling Han was the first to enter, and after Ding Shu entered as well, he reset the restrictions. Naturally, they were not on the level of the Venerate Tier, but with the addition of disguise, they did look a bit like the aura of Venerate Tier. Of course, it was a paper tiger that would fall apart at the slightest touch.
The Great Emperor Tier-level Forbidden Talisman was too awesome. Though it had broken through the restrictions, it still did not alert any Venerate Tier.
Ling Han and Ding Shu exchanged a glance before immediately walking toward the depths of the passageway.

The passage went downwards, and after walking for a while, the environment became even gloomier. There was a kind of terrifying aura, and even Ling Han and Ding Shu, with their mental states and cultivation levels, felt slightly uneasy.
Thankfully, it wasn’t long before the path ahead of them suddenly opened up.
“We’re rich!” Ding Shu’s eyes immediately lit up.
This was a massive treasure storage, filled with Source Dao Stones.
“Haha.” Ding Shu immediately began to put away the Source Dao Stones. “The left side belongs to you, and the right side belongs to me.”

Ling Han also didn’t expect things to go so smoothly this time. Although he guessed that the Source Dao Stone might have been produced on the Dark Battlefield, seeing so many Source Dao Stones still made his heart beat wildly.
“All right.”
The two of them began to put away the Source Dao Stones. They had brought their Spatial Spirit Tool with them. No matter how many there were here, they could still be easily stored away.
It wasn’t long before the large treasure storage was emptied out by the two of them.
Ding Shu pointed at a corner, and said, “Yi, there’s another piece here. You’ve missed it.”
Ling Han was surprised. He was certain that under his sweep, he would definitely not leave anything out. He could swear on the large black dog’s iron underwear that this was the case.
However, there was indeed a Source Dao Stone there. It lay there all by itself, and was very obvious.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and put away this Source Dao Stone.
“Let’s go,” Ding Shu said. This was looting the wealth of five Venerate Tier elites; it would be too dangerous to stay here.
“Wait.” Ling Han waved his hand, and merely stared ahead.
“Hey, do you want to be caught red-handed?” Ding Shu urged.
“Wait for a while longer. I guarantee that you won’t be disappointed,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“... All right.” Ding Shu chose to believe Ling Han.
Could anyone who could become the overlord of the Genesis World be an idiot?
The two of them were like fools as they stared ahead. After two hours, a Source Dao Stone appeared out of thin air.

chapters.title: Chapter 4291: Huge Rewards
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“F***!” Ding Shu immediately shouted loudly.

Ling Han also very much wanted to lean against something. Previously, he had already found it strange. He had clearly swept through this place completely, so how could there be anything that had slipped through his net?
Thus, he decided to observe for a while longer.
“I understand now. So that’s how the Source Dao Stone came to be.” Ding Shu slapped his thigh.
That’s right. As it turned out, the Source Dao Stone was produced like this, but why? This was still a huge question mark.
This wasn’t like an old hen laying eggs. With a pa, a Source Dao Stone would fall onto the ground.
“It’s very strange,” Ling Han said slowly.
“That’s true,” Ding Shu said with a nod.
“Unfortunately, there is no time to study it further.”
“Let’s go. By now, we should have fled as far away as possible.”
The two of them left. They didn’t even return to the inn, and directly left the city.

Perhaps the five Venerate Tier elites wouldn’t go to the Dark Battlefield to investigate in the near future, but as long as they went to take a look, they would immediately discover that a large number of Source Dao Stones had been stolen.

Though this Source Dao Stone would appear out of thin air, to reach the amount that Ling Han and Ding Shu had stolen, it was impossible without a few hundred years. Moreover, the daily expenditure of Source Dao Stones by the City of Death was also an astronomical figure, so saving up this amount would probably need a few thousand years.
After leaving the city, Ling Han and Ding Shu went their separate ways.

Ling Han followed the course of that eerie river. He planned to go into seclusion in the stone house in the forest, refine the large amount of Source Dao Stones, and increase his cultivation level as soon as possible.
He might as well just stay there for 10 years, and then wait for the Nine Mountains Saint to break open the black hole and bring him away.
As he walked, his thoughts were also wandering.
Why was the place that produced the Source Dao Stone under the Dark Battlefield?
Had they been using the Dark Battlefield to hide this place?
But was there any need for that?
The five Venerate Tier elites had joined forces, so what need was there for them to worry about this and that? It was impossible for external forces to interfere.

Additionally, this place had existed for as long as millions and millions of years, which also meant that the Dark Battlefield had long since been there. The five Venerate Tier elites had only taken advantage of the efforts of their predecessors.
The Dark Battlefield was a place of battle, so what did it have to do with the Source Dao Stone?

Ling Han felt a headache coming on. There were a great many things in this world that could not be explained with common sense. For example, that sea of blood that had buried innumerable Saints. That was definitely the deaths of Saints, but there had never been such records in history.
“It’s all because I’m too weak, so I can only be curious. I can’t get an answer.”

Ling Han set these doubts aside. This place was very strange in the first place, and Saints would encounter great calamities even if they brought an Imperial Weapon in. Yet, a measly True Self Tier cultivator like him wanted to find out the truth?
A few days later, Ling Han returned to the forest. Then, he found a stone house to stay in.

He had the Strange Shadow Steps, as well as the Void Beast hide. Even if the five Venerate Tier elites discovered that the Source Dao Stones had been stolen and chased after him, the chances of them finding him were close to zero.
How was Ding Shu doing?
But this guy dared to part ways with Ling Han, so he should also have a rare treasure in his possession, which was enough to ensure his safety.

Moreover, this was a strange place. The higher one’s cultivation level, the more dangerous it would be. If the five Venerate Tier elites really chased after them, they might encounter a great calamity. This was enough for them to reconsider.
Ling Han took out the Source Dao Stones, and began to concentrate on cultivating..
He wrapped himself in the Void Beast hide. Because there were outsiders entering this place practically every day, it was best not to bring news about him back to the City of Death.
One Source Dao Stone after another was consumed, and Ling Han’s cultivation level improved rapidly.
More than a month later, the second True Self evolved from Golden Fetus to Tricolor Fetus.
Continue.
A year passed, and Ling Han successfully reached the end of the fifth form. He began to stabilize and polish his cultivation level, preparing to break through to the sixth form.
This took him a whole two months’ time, and only then did he manage to compact his cultivation level to perfection. Then, he began to charge towards the sixth form.
It could not be helped. The fifth form was already breaking limits, and it was naturally difficult to break through further on top of that.

Furthermore, this was still because Ling Han was in the forest. If he wanted to battle, he only had to step out. There were a great number of three-headed strange birds, Tree Demons, as well as ghostly shadows in the darkness. This was even better than the Dark Battlefield, and allowed him to battle to his heart’s content.
The fifth form was a Tricolor Fetus, then what was the sixth form?
Ling Han mumbled to himself as he started to break through.
Because he had accumulated enough power, it was only a matter of course for him. The True Self of Destruction was still in the vanguard, and began the sixth evolution.
Three days later, he completed his breakthrough.
The sixth form was... a Five Coloured Fetus.
His rate of advancement was truly rapid, surpassing any Imperial Son.
“But the price is also huge!” Ling Han exclaimed ruefully. He had expended a lot of his life essence, and by estimation, he had probably decreased his lifespan by around 600 years.
“Fortunately, it’s not too ridiculous. Otherwise, without waiting for me to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, my lifespan would have directly dried up and died.”

“When I get out, I have to find Great Herbs to compensate for the life essence that I have expended. Though my lifespan can’t be replenished, I can’t damage my foundations either, or there would be hidden dangers.”
Ling Han sighed ruefully, and immediately began to refine the Source Dao Stones again.
Another year passed, and he had reached the end of the sixth form. He settled again for three months, and he began to break through to the seventh form.
To Ling Han, this was still not too difficult, but it took a little longer. After five days, he successfully broke through.
A Seven-colored Fetus.
“I’ve lost another two hundred years of life.” Ling Han sighed, but continued to refine the Source Dao Stones without hesitation.
After about half a year had passed, he discovered that some people had come against the flow, and was searching everywhere.
He knew that now that the secret had been exposed, and the five Venerate Tier elites had finally discovered that the Source Dao Stones had been stolen.
Why had it taken so long?

They had probably prepared a portion of Source Dao Stones in the first place, so there was no need for them to go to the Dark Battlefield to retrieve them every day. Furthermore, they had previously discussed that they would leave the Dark Clouds Hell three years later, and go to the outside world to take a gamble on becoming Emperor.
Thus, it was only now that they had gone to the Dark Battlefield, planning to leave this place after retrieving the Source Dao Stones.
But when they opened the seal, they realized that the situation was not good. This was not something that they had set up!
Not good.
True enough, when they entered, though it was not completely empty, there were only a few thousand Source Dao Stones left, which was pitifully few.
‘We’ve been robbed!’
Thus, the five Venerate Tier elites were enraged, and began to scour the entire city, sending people out of the city. Whether it was useful or not, they had to search first.
Ling Han didn’t make any sound. He quietly cultivated, and his priority now was to increase his cultivation level.

And in the City of Death, the five Venerate Tier elites were all furious. On one hand, they were searching for the whereabouts of the thief, and on the other, they were suspicious of each other, and thought that it was very possible that one of them was a thief that cries to “stop the thief!”1.
Otherwise, who would be able to break through the restrictions they had set up?

The five Venerate Tier elites already had conflicts among themselves, and after this matter, the conflict naturally intensified, and became even more intense. The entire City of Death was also on the verge of a storm, and a great battle could break out at any moment.
In the Dark Battlefield, Han Di had also obtained a thousand successive victories, leaving Ling Han’s record of successive victories far behind.

He kept saying that Ling Han was a coward, and because Ling Han had not appeared all this while, his supporters were greatly disappointed. The so-called “One Punch King” was basically trash that would be destroyed with a single punch.

One Source Dao Stone after another was consumed, and Ling Han’s cultivation level improved rapidly.
More than a month later, the second True Self evolved from Golden Fetus to Tricolor Fetus.
Continue.
A year passed, and Ling Han successfully reached the end of the fifth form.
He began to stabilize and polish his cultivation level, preparing to break through to the sixth form.
This took him a whole two months’ time, and only then did he manage to compact his cultivation level to perfection.
Then, he began to charge towards the sixth form.
It could not be helped.
The fifth form was already breaking limits, and it was naturally difficult to break through further on top of that.
Furthermore, this was still because Ling Han was in the forest.
If he wanted to battle, he only had to step out.
There were a great number of three-headed strange birds, Tree Demons, as well as ghostly shadows in the darkness.
This was even better than the Dark Battlefield, and allowed him to battle to his heart’s content.
The fifth form was a Tricolor Fetus, then what was the sixth form?
Ling Han mumbled to himself as he started to break through.
Because he had accumulated enough power, it was only a matter of course for him.
The True Self of Destruction was still in the vanguard, and began the sixth evolution.
Three days later, he completed his breakthrough.
The sixth form was... a Five Coloured Fetus.
His rate of advancement was truly rapid, surpassing any Imperial Son.
“But the price is also huge!” Ling Han exclaimed ruefully.
He had expended a lot of his life essence, and by estimation, he had probably decreased his lifespan by around 600 years.
“Fortunately, it’s not too ridiculous.
Otherwise, without waiting for me to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, my lifespan would have directly dried up and died.”
“When I get out, I have to find Great Herbs to compensate for the life essence that I have expended.
Though my lifespan can’t be replenished, I can’t damage my foundations either, or there would be hidden dangers.”
Ling Han sighed ruefully, and immediately began to refine the Source Dao Stones again.
Another year passed, and he had reached the end of the sixth form.
He settled again for three months, and he began to break through to the seventh form.
To Ling Han, this was still not too difficult, but it took a little longer.
After five days, he successfully broke through.
A Seven-colored Fetus.
“I’ve lost another two hundred years of life.” Ling Han sighed, but continued to refine the Source Dao Stones without hesitation.
After about half a year had passed, he discovered that some people had come against the flow, and was searching everywhere.
He knew that now that the secret had been exposed, and the five Venerate Tier elites had finally discovered that the Source Dao Stones had been stolen.
Why had it taken so long?
They had probably prepared a portion of Source Dao Stones in the first place, so there was no need for them to go to the Dark Battlefield to retrieve them every day.
Furthermore, they had previously discussed that they would leave the Dark Clouds Hell three years later, and go to the outside world to take a gamble on becoming Emperor.
Thus, it was only now that they had gone to the Dark Battlefield, planning to leave this place after retrieving the Source Dao Stones.
But when they opened the seal, they realized that the situation was not good.
This was not something that they had set up!
Not good.
True enough, when they entered, though it was not completely empty, there were only a few thousand Source Dao Stones left, which was pitifully few.
‘We’ve been robbed!’
Thus, the five Venerate Tier elites were enraged, and began to scour the entire city, sending people out of the city.
Whether it was useful or not, they had to search first.
Ling Han didn’t make any sound.
He quietly cultivated, and his priority now was to increase his cultivation level.
And in the City of Death, the five Venerate Tier elites were all furious.

On one hand, they were searching for the whereabouts of the thief, and on the other, they were suspicious of each other, and thought that it was very possible that one of them was a thief that cries to “stop the thief!”1.
Otherwise, who would be able to break through the restrictions they had set up?
The five Venerate Tier elites already had conflicts among themselves, and after this matter, the conflict naturally intensified, and became even more intense.
The entire City of Death was also on the verge of a storm, and a great battle could break out at any moment.
In the Dark Battlefield, Han Di had also obtained a thousand successive victories, leaving Ling Han’s record of successive victories far behind.
He kept saying that Ling Han was a coward, and because Ling Han had not appeared all this while, his supporters were greatly disappointed.
The so-called “One Punch King” was basically trash that would be destroyed with a single punch.

chapters.title: Chapter 4292: Rapid Progress
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han naturally didn’t know about all this. He was still continuously cultivating, cultivating, and cultivating.

Every day, if he wasn’t refining the Source Dao Stones, he would be battling with the Demonic Beasts and Demonic Trees in the forest. Merely increasing his cultivation level and not adapting to his own power was a very dangerous thing.
His advancement was astonishing, so fast that it was inconceivable, enough to make anyone exclaim that it was impossible.

However, this price was also exorbitant. Ling Han had also sacrificed his life essence. The lifespan loss was real. Even if he could find a Great Herb that could extend his lifespan, the lifespan loss would still be lost. No matter what, there was no way he could make up for it.
Another year passed, and Ling Han had already cultivated to the end of the seventh form.
This time, he settled down for a whole half year’s time.

The Eighth Form, even for Imperial Sons, was an incredibly difficult gulf to breach. It was said that only the Golden Generation had reached this kind of height, and presently, among the Silver Generation that had broken through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, there were very few that had done so. Furthermore, those that did had all obtained great fortune, and only then could they succeed.
From this, it could be seen how difficult it was to let the True Self complete eight evolutions.
Thus, Ling Han chose to settle down for half a year.
It was about time.

Ling Han began to break through to the eighth form, and tempestuous waves instantly rose up in his mind. The True Self of Destruction was exuding seven-coloured light, as if it had a life of its own. It actively began to grab the Regulations of heaven and earth to solidify itself.
However, the Regulations of heaven and earth had just adhered onto the True Self, when the seven-coloured brilliance flickered, immediately shaking off these Regulations.
Again and again, it was the same.
Looks like the previous trick was useless.
Ling Han suppressed the True Self of Destruction and tried his best to calm it down. Then, he summoned the Regulations again to stimulate the evolution of the True Self of Destruction.
He was faced with many difficulties, and his progress was slow, but he was indeed improving.
A look of delight appeared on Ling Han’s face. Looks like this would work.
‘Come, let’s continue.’
In his mind, the eight True Selves all helped, grabbing the Regulations to strengthen the True Self of Destruction.

One day, two days, three days... this progress was really slow. Right until the ninth day, the light exuded by the True Self of Destruction finally dimmed, completely concealed by the new Regulations.
But in the next instant, endless light shone brilliantly, and the True Self of Destruction exploded with dazzling light again.
It was not seven colours, but rather... eight colours!
Ling Han laughed loudly. Success, the True Self of Destruction had already taken the most crucial step, and advanced into the eighth form.

He continued to sit in a cross-legged position. Endless power of heaven and earth was surging towards him. Now was the best time to increase his cultivation level. This was bestowed by the power of heaven and earth, and there would definitely be no aftereffects.
Half a day later, Ling Han finally stopped.
The Eighth Form of the True Self Tier!
Right now, did he have the ability to battle against Spirit Transformation Tier elites?
Ling Han tested his strength. Double powers of 75 Heavens, and his explosive power could reach 85 Heavens. Just how terrifying was this?
Faced with this kind of power, the Imperial Technique was practically negligible.
However, whether it could match a Spiritual Transformation Tier elite or not would only be known after a battle.
“Sigh, cultivating to such great power, yet having no opponent to test out my skills, it’s really a bit like wearing embroidered clothes at night. It’s too wasteful.”
“Then I might as well cultivate to the end of the ninth form in one go!”

According to legends, the ninth form only existed in theory. The extreme number in the heaven and earth was nine, so this should be possible. However, according to the known information, no one had ever cultivated it.

Of course, for example, the successive generations of Ancestral Kings might have kept a low profile, and did not speak of their achievements. They did not care about this kind of reputation at all. With how high and noble an Emperor was, what need was there for him to care about this kind of glory?
Ling Han was still the same as before, cultivating, battling, battling, cultivating.
The searchers gradually decreased. When Ling Han had also cultivated the Eighth Form to the end, there was already no one that came out to look for him.
By the looks of it, the five Venerate Tier elites had given up, knowing that they couldn’t find Ling Han.
However, it was not definite that they had really given up. They were probably waiting for someone to walk right into their trap.
Ling Han was neither happy nor sad. He turned back to stabilizing his cultivation level, cultivating every True Self to perfection.
This time, it actually took a year’s time.

Ling Han wasn’t in a rush. Firstly, the speed of his improvement could already be described as freakish, and secondly, as the saying went, longer accumulation would lead to greater improvement[1.one should never seek quick results; rather, one should pay attention to accumulating strength and making full preparations before making advances.]. The longer he accumulated, the more energy he would naturally have by then.
Now, it was about time. He could finally do it.

Ling Han suppressed the True Self of Destruction as usual, while the other eight True Selves summoned the Regulations of heaven and earth to advance the ninth transformation of the True Self of Destruction.
But this time, he could not suppress it.
This repulsive force was too strong. Even if more than half of it was suppressed, it could still easily destroy the ninth evolution of the True Self of Destruction.
What could they do?

Ling Han thought of the Power of Dimension in his body. This was an ultimate move that he had tried time and time again to break through his limits, and with the suppression of the Power of Dimension, it should not be a problem for the True Self of Destruction to complete the ninth evolution.
But what if there was still the Tenth Form?

He had once obtained the notebook of a genius freak, and it deduced that there was still the existence of the tenth form above the ninth form. Only by breaking past the ninth form could he truly break through his limits.
But the problem was that the ninth form only existed in theory, and the tenth form was like the stuff of illusions.

Yet Ling Han did not dare to easily deny it. What if there was a Tenth Form? Then he would have used up his trump card for the Ninth Form, so what would he depend on to break through to the Tenth Form?
“I’ll try it out with the Imperial Weapon.”

Ling Han suddenly had an idea. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn’t the real Imperial Weapon, but its benefits were here. He didn’t need to worry about losing control of its explosive power and killing himself.
Let’s give it a try.

Weng, in his mind, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower vibrated lightly, sending streaks of Primal Chaos Qi towards the True Self of Destruction. The might of Origin Gold surged, suppressing this True Self.
Meanwhile, Ling Han took advantage of the opening to grab the Regulations of heaven and earth to advance the ninth evolution of the True Self of Destruction.
However, the Primal ChaosQi blocked almost all Regulations. After a day, Ling Han did not discover any progress.
He naturally would not give up so easily, and would not waver in the slightest.

Two days, five days, ten days, and there was still not the slightest bit of improvement. However, Ling Han’s stubbornness was also revealed at this moment. He still had no intention of stopping, as if he would not turn back even if he broke through the southern wall1.
A whole month had passed, and the light exuded by the True Self of Destruction finally dimmed a little.
There was improvement!
Ling Han really wanted to laugh out loud. He had also thought of giving up, but he had suppressed this thought with his strong determination.
Since this was his choice, he would rather wait until the ten years’ time was up than give up halfway.
Thankfully, he had succeeded in just a month.
However, this was only the beginning. Again, again.
Ling Han continued. A whole year had passed, and he had finally succeeded.
The True Self of Destruction glowed with nine colours!
“Hahaha!” He stood up, incredibly pleased.
This was a victory of self-persistence, which made him feel especially accomplished.

chapters.title: Chapter 4293: A battle that came late
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The ninth form of the True Self!

Ling Han was extremely pleased. This trip to the Dark Clouds Hell could be said to have been a very satisfactory trip. If he had cultivated outside, even with the support of alchemical pills, he wouldn’t be able to reach this kind of height without more than a thousand years.
Furthermore, this was the ninth form, and even the Golden Generation could only look up to it.

Of course, perhaps there were some Golden Generation elites that were very low-key. They had clearly broken through to the Ninth Form, yet kept it a secret, to avoid being targeted. Breaking through to the Imperial Path was not just a competition of natural talent and fated opportunities. Intelligence was similarly important.
Right now, Ling Han didn’t need to worry about this. He could enjoy himself for a while.

“In any case, I’ve already cultivated here for so many years, so a few more years won’t matter.” Ling Han continued to refine the Source Dao Stones. “I’ll think about it after I reach the end of the ninth form.”
With such cultivation, another year quickly passed.
After expending a large amount of Source Stones, he charged to the end of the ninth form.
“Hiss, I didn’t expect to expend the Source Dao Stones like this. There’s only half left now.”
Ling Han sighed ruefully. Calculating the time, he had already been here for about nine years.

“If I want to break through to the next major tier, it definitely has to be carried out in the outside world. With the perfect Regulations, I can perfect my dao foundation,” he murmured. “Furthermore, I feel like I’ve already touched the ceiling. If I still want to break through to the tenth form, that is definitely not something that can be achieved through cultivation in seclusion.”
“There’s still a year left. How should I spend it?”
“Go back to the City of Death?”

A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Previously, when Han Di had entered into the city, he had provoked Ling Han in all ways just because his cultivation level was high. Should he teach this kind of person a lesson?

He naturally couldn’t just swagger in. Having disappeared for eight years, he suddenly appeared, and his cultivation level had increased greatly. Wasn’t this telling the five Venerate Tier elites that it was he who had robbed the Source Dao Stone’s treasury?
It was fine. He only had to change his appearance. With the existence of the Soul Forming Technique, even Venerate Tier elites would find it very difficult to discover his disguise.
All right, he would go to the City of Death to take a look at the situation.

With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance immediately changed. He strode out of the forest, and walked in the opposite direction of the flow of the great river. Several days later, the City of Death was within sight.
He had returned again.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and easily found the city gates.
After registering his information, he entered into the city, then went to the Dark Battlefield to register himself.

He even deliberately investigated the situation. Han Di had long since become an invincible God of War of True Self Tier, but for some reason, he had never broken through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.
Ling Han guessed that Han Di was probably aiming to break through to the Eighth Form. Without achieving this goal, he wouldn’t easily break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.
After all, breaking through to the Spirit Transformation Tier was easy for him. However, without reaching the Eighth Form, what right did he have to compete for the throne with the Golden Generation?

Eight years had passed, and it was unknown how many people had entered this place. At least half of them had already died, and among the remaining people, the majority were barely surviving. Only a few were very nourished, and their cultivation level had increased by leaps and bounds.
Cultivation was always pyramid-shaped, and there were only a small number that could truly be superior to everyone else.

Ling Han did not manage to find out any information about Ding Shu. He did not know where this guy had gone. Perhaps, he was still cultivating earnestly. After all, Ding Shu’s previous cultivation level was slightly weaker than Ling Han’s. Thus, if he similarly wanted to reach the end of the ninth form, it would definitely take him even longer.
Regarding whether Ding Shu could reach the ninth form or not, Ling Han was naturally certain. If the overlord of a Genesis World couldn’t even do this, then that would really be funny.
Although the five Venerate Tier elites didn’t become hostile with each other, there was endless friction between them, and conflicts would break out between their subordinates every few days.
Ling Han was naturally unconcerned. He found an inn to stay in, and waited for the notification from the Dark Battlefield.
In just one day, he received a notification that he could go and fight.

The tournament stage battle would be held that afternoon, and Ling Han would be participating in the tournament battle. His opponent was at the fourth form of the True Self Tier. In front of him, this was naturally not enough. Ling Han defeated him with a single punch, but Ling Han did not deliver a fatal strike. Instead, he only used a sliver of his power.
There was a haughty expression on his face, and he asked, “Where is Han Di? Do you dare to battle me?”
It was naturally impossible for Han Di to appear. Ling Han only wanted to send out this kind of message. If Han Di would take the initiative to accept the challenge, that would naturally be best.
However, Han Di had already established his reputation of being invincible in the Dark Battlefield, so Ling Han’s provocation naturally only made him snort in disdain. He couldn’t care less.
Ling Han didn’t mind this. As long as he won more battles, it would only be a matter of time before he and Han Di would come across each other and battle.
He continued to participate in the battles, and the number of consecutive victories quickly expanded. Ten wins, a hundred wins, his momentum flourishing.

Though his successive victories were far from being comparable to Han Di, he was already the person with the second highest number of victories in the entire Dark Battlefield. This made the masses excited, and they hoped that Ling Han would battle against Han Di. They wanted to see if Ling Han could shake Han Di’s invincible battle merits.
The Dark Battlefield soon responded, sending out notifications to Ling Han and Han Di respectively, arranging for them to battle, and the time was set to be two days later.
This day had finally come.
Ling Han looked at the notice in his hand. Eight years ago, it was Han Di who wanted to challenge him, and now, it was the other way around. However, this battle had still happened in the end.
Two days quickly passed, and Ling Han arrived at the Dark Battlefield.
He had finally met with Han Di, one of the most powerful members of the Silver Generation.
This person was extremely handsome, with a slender figure and thick black hair, exuding a gentle light. Behind him, there was the shadow of a giant fish, as if it was breathing in and out.
Every time the giant fish breathed, the energy of heaven and earth in the surroundings would be absorbed, which was extremely shocking.
He was surrounded by such top-notch second-generation young masters like Mi Qingdie and Zuwa An, dazzling and resplendent.
By the looks of it, his identity as Imperial Son had given him quite a bit of extra credit. Even Zuwa An and the others were circling around him.
True, as long as one wanted to leave the Dark Clouds Hell, who would be able to get around the Imperial Clans?

Han Di did not put on too much airs, and chatted cheerfully with Zuwa An and the others. After all, this was their territory, and even the members of the Imperial Clans could not extend their influence here.

He appeared extremely relaxed. After all, in his eyes, he had already reached the pinnacle of the True Self Tier. Unless one had aptitude like the Golden Generation, only then was it possible that they could surpass him, but now, was there any Golden Generation member that was in the True Self Tier?
The lowest cultivation level among them had already reached Spirit Transformation Tier, Seventh Transformation!
As for this opponent, hehe, though he had obtained a very long streak of successive victories, it was completely not enough in front of him.
After waiting for a while longer, the battle was finally about to begin.

The contestants from both sides entered the arena. This time, the Dark Battlefield still placed a lot of importance on this battle. They cleared out the other battle areas, allowing Ling Han and Han Di to battle freely.
When Han Di entered the arena, a tsunami of cheers instantly erupted.

It had been a long time since they had last seen Han Di make a move. Previously, whenever anyone was arranged to fight Han Di, they would immediately admit defeat. Furthermore, since Ling Han dared to take the initiative to provoke him, they were sure that he would not be so cowardly.
Meanwhile, Han Di crossed his arms behind his back, and slowly strode into the battlefield, looking extremely casual.
For him, this was only going through the motions.

Having disappeared for eight years, he suddenly appeared, and his cultivation level had increased greatly.
Wasn’t this telling the five Venerate Tier elites that it was he who had robbed the Source Dao Stone’s treasury?
It was fine.
He only had to change his appearance.
With the existence of the Soul Forming Technique, even Venerate Tier elites would find it very difficult to discover his disguise.
All right, he would go to the City of Death to take a look at the situation.
With a thought from Ling Han, his appearance immediately changed.
He strode out of the forest, and walked in the opposite direction of the flow of the great river.
Several days later, the City of Death was within sight.
He had returned again.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and easily found the city gates.
After registering his information, he entered into the city, then went to the Dark Battlefield to register himself.
He even deliberately investigated the situation.
Han Di had long since become an invincible God of War of True Self Tier, but for some reason, he had never broken through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.
Ling Han guessed that Han Di was probably aiming to break through to the Eighth Form.
Without achieving this goal, he wouldn’t easily break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier.
After all, breaking through to the Spirit Transformation Tier was easy for him.
However, without reaching the Eighth Form, what right did he have to compete for the throne with the Golden Generation?
Eight years had passed, and it was unknown how many people had entered this place.
At least half of them had already died, and among the remaining people, the majority were barely surviving.
Only a few were very nourished, and their cultivation level had increased by leaps and bounds.
Cultivation was always pyramid-shaped, and there were only a small number that could truly be superior to everyone else.
Ling Han did not manage to find out any information about Ding Shu.
He did not know where this guy had gone.
Perhaps, he was still cultivating earnestly.
After all, Ding Shu’s previous cultivation level was slightly weaker than Ling Han’s.
Thus, if he similarly wanted to reach the end of the ninth form, it would definitely take him even longer.
Regarding whether Ding Shu could reach the ninth form or not, Ling Han was naturally certain.
If the overlord of a Genesis World couldn’t even do this, then that would really be funny.
Although the five Venerate Tier elites didn’t become hostile with each other, there was endless friction between them, and conflicts would break out between their subordinates every few days.
Ling Han was naturally unconcerned.
He found an inn to stay in, and waited for the notification from the Dark Battlefield.
In just one day, he received a notification that he could go and fight.
The tournament stage battle would be held that afternoon, and Ling Han would be participating in the tournament battle.
His opponent was at the fourth form of the True Self Tier.
In front of him, this was naturally not enough.
Ling Han defeated him with a single punch, but Ling Han did not deliver a fatal strike.
Instead, he only used a sliver of his power.
There was a haughty expression on his face, and he asked, “Where is Han Di?
Do you dare to battle me?”
It was naturally impossible for Han Di to appear.
Ling Han only wanted to send out this kind of message.
If Han Di would take the initiative to accept the challenge, that would naturally be best.
However, Han Di had already established his reputation of being invincible in the Dark Battlefield, so Ling Han’s provocation naturally only made him snort in disdain.
He couldn’t care less.
Ling Han didn’t mind this.
As long as he won more battles, it would only be a matter of time before he and Han Di would come across each other and battle.
He continued to participate in the battles, and the number of consecutive victories quickly expanded.
Ten wins, a hundred wins, his momentum flourishing.
Though his successive victories were far from being comparable to Han Di, he was already the person with the second highest number of victories in the entire Dark Battlefield.
This made the masses excited, and they hoped that Ling Han would battle against Han Di.
They wanted to see if Ling Han could shake Han Di’s invincible battle merits.
The Dark Battlefield soon responded, sending out notifications to Ling Han and Han Di respectively, arranging for them to battle, and the time was set to be two days later.
This day had finally come.
Ling Han looked at the notice in his hand.
Eight years ago, it was Han Di who wanted to challenge him, and now, it was the other way around.
However, this battle had still happened in the end.
Two days quickly passed, and Ling Han arrived at the Dark Battlefield.
He had finally met with Han Di, one of the most powerful members of the Silver Generation.
This person was extremely handsome, with a slender figure and thick black hair, exuding a gentle light.
Behind him, there was the shadow of a giant fish, as if it was breathing in and out.
Every time the giant fish breathed, the energy of heaven and earth in the surroundings would be absorbed, which was extremely shocking.
He was surrounded by such top-notch second-generation young masters like Mi Qingdie and Zuwa An, dazzling and resplendent.
By the looks of it, his identity as Imperial Son had given him quite a bit of extra credit.
Even Zuwa An and the others were circling around him.
True, as long as one wanted to leave the Dark Clouds Hell, who would be able to get around the Imperial Clans?
Han Di did not put on too much airs, and chatted cheerfully with Zuwa An and the others.
After all, this was their territory, and even the members of the Imperial Clans could not extend their influence here.
He appeared extremely relaxed.
After all, in his eyes, he had already reached the pinnacle of the True Self Tier.
Unless one had aptitude like the Golden Generation, only then was it possible that they could surpass him, but now, was there any Golden Generation member that was in the True Self Tier?
The lowest cultivation level among them had already reached Spirit Transformation Tier, Seventh Transformation!
As for this opponent, hehe, though he had obtained a very long streak of successive victories, it was completely not enough in front of him.
After waiting for a while longer, the battle was finally about to begin.
The contestants from both sides entered the arena.
This time, the Dark Battlefield still placed a lot of importance on this battle.
They cleared out the other battle areas, allowing Ling Han and Han Di to battle freely.
When Han Di entered the arena, a tsunami of cheers instantly erupted.
It had been a long time since they had last seen Han Di make a move.
Previously, whenever anyone was arranged to fight Han Di, they would immediately admit defeat.
Furthermore, since Ling Han dared to take the initiative to provoke him, they were sure that he would not be so cowardly.
Meanwhile, Han Di crossed his arms behind his back, and slowly strode into the battlefield, looking extremely casual.
For him, this was only going through the motions.

chapters.title: Chapter 4294: Seen through
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Han Di!” On the spectators’ seats, cheers erupted like thunder

“Hehe, has this person eaten the courage of a Saint? He actually dares to challenge Han Di?” Mi Qingdie scoffed. She was presently passionately courting Han Di, but it was a shame that Han Di paid her no regard at all.
“You have an exaggerated opinion of your own abilities!” Wan Yulong said with a smile. He was a descendant of the Nine Palace Venerate. He was one of the top-notch second-generation young masters.
“How many strikes do you think Han Di needs to deal with him?” Sha Tianlei asked. He was the descendant of the Ice Silkworm Venerate.
“At most, three moves,” Wan Yulong said.
“Hehe, I’ll relax it a bit, ten moves,” Gongyang Bo said. He was Brahman Sea Bodhisattva’s little disciple.
“One strike.” Mi Qingdie was brimming with confidence in Han Di.
“Little Lord Wolf, what do you think?” Wan Yulong looked towards Zuwa An.
Meanwhile, Zuwa An was slightly distracted. He had been staring at Ling Han all this while, and had an inexplicable feeling that he seemed to be afraid of this person.
How was this possible?

He had never met this person before. Moreover, he was the descendant of the Blood Crow Venerate. Not long ago, he had even broken through to the Spirit Transformation Tier. With a single hand, he could crush a True Self Tier cultivator, no matter how freakish he was.
Thus, this feeling was too strange.
“Little Lord Wolf!” Wan Yulong raised his voice.
Only at this moment did Zuwa An come to his senses. He pondered for a moment, before saying, “I’ll also guess ten moves.”
“Humph, you guys actually have so much confidence in that guy?” Mi Qingdie said in displeasure, “Why don’t we make a bet?”
“Sure,” Sha Tianlei said. “We’ll each bet ten Source Dao Stones. The person with the closest answer can obtain it.”
“Deal.”
The five second-generation young masters nodded one after another. To them, they were already tired of watching such battles, and needed something else to stimulate them.
Meanwhile, on the battlefield, Han Di stood still, looking at Ling Han with a disdainful expression.
“Admit defeat,” he said calmly.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “What if I say no?”
“Then your only fate is death!” Han Di was not in a rush to make a move.
The smile at the corners of Ling Han’s lips involuntarily widened, “Are all members of the Imperial Clans all so overbearing?”
Meanwhile, Han Di smirked coldly, “You actually dare to order around the Imperial Clans? How dare you! Now, if I don’t kill you, won’t others think that the Imperial Clans ares pushovers?”
“You really know how to pin blame.” Ling Han shook his head, “Enough with the nonsense. Come on!”
He crooked a finger, and began to provoke Han Di.
This hook of his finger instantly stirred up the emotions of those spectators. All of them could not hold themselves back, and called out one after another.
“Han Di, kill him!”
“Kill this brat!”
However, these people were all on Han Di’s side, and it was as if they had been pumped full of adrenaline.

Han Di was unmoved. He was the Imperial Son, so how could the emotions of others affect him? However, Ling Han’s disrespectful attitude had indeed angered him. The Imperial Clan was high and noble, and was the ruler of the world. Who could slight them?
“You’re seeking death!” Han Di pointed a finger at Ling Han. Boom, a terrifying energy transformed into a sword that shot towards Ling Han.
Ling Han merely gathered the power of 60 Heavens, and shot out a palm strike. The energy turned into a massive palm that counterattacked Han Di.
Peng!
The sword of energy immediately crumbled under Ling Han’s strike. However, the large hand didn’t dissipate, and it continued to slam toward Han Di.
‘What?’

Everyone was dumbfounded upon seeing this. They couldn’t believe this at all. Even if Han Di hadn’t unleashed his full power, with his strength, he should have been able to overturn rivers and create chaos with a wave of his hand.
Hiss, this opponent was indeed very strong!
“Huang Tian!”
“Huang Tian!”
Instantly, quite a few people called out Ling Han’s alias. Han Di had already reigned supreme for too long, and everyone longed to see someone appear and knock him off his horse.
“There’s no need to have any expectations of him.”
“That’s right. That is Han Di, and he has not been defeated for eight years. Before this, there has never been anyone that could do it!”
“It is said that he is known as the Silver Generation in the outside world. That is an existence that is even stronger than ordinary Imperial Sons.”
“As long as he is slightly more serious, this Huang Tian would only be able to kneel.”

However, there were even more people that were siding with Han Di, and thought that Ling Han had absolutely no chance of winning. Now, it looked like Ling Han was on the upper hand, but in truth, it was Han Di that had not gotten serious at all.
Peng! Han Di shot out another finger, and shattered this giant hand that was swatting at him.
A hint of surprise appeared on his face, and he felt that Ling Han’s strength was inconceivable.

He had indeed not used his full power in that attack just now. In fact, he had not even used the celestial technique, but his base power was close to sixty Heavens. This was enough to crush any True Self Tier.
This opponent... who exactly was it?
A rising star of the Imperial Clan?

That’s right. The Imperial Sons of the third generation could not compare to the Silver Generation, but at the very least, he was still an Imperial Son. If there were freaks that could cultivate to the seventh form, then it would be possible for their battle prowess to soar up to 60 Heavens.
“Which Imperial Son are you?” Han Di asked, his expression very certain.
—Aside from the Imperial Clan, what other force could nurture out such a terrifying prodigy?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I’m the Imperial Son of the Invincible Imperial Clan. My nickname is Emperor Destroyer.”

Han Di’s expression immediately darkened. “Emperor Destroyer”, wasn’t this deliberately targeting him1? Furthermore, how could there be an Ancestral King in this world with the title of Invincible? Naturally, there could not possibly be an Invincible Imperial Clan.
This guy was teasing him.
Hold on.

He suddenly recalled that wasn’t Ling Han skilled in disguising his identity? If it had to be claimed that he was so hostile towards the Imperial Clan, and if it had to be claimed that his natural talent was freakish to the point of being comparable to the Imperial Son, or even surpassed the Imperial Son, who else could it be but Ling Han?
Great, you have finally appeared.

Han Di smirked coldly. All the great Imperial Clans had deduced that Ling Han had obtained the inheritance of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. Thus, that was why the Nine Mountains Saint had been able to obtain the Imperial Scroll and take the step to become a Saint.
Thus, Ling Han definitely had the Imperial Scroll on him.

Very good. If he killed this person, all the great Imperial Clans would owe him a favor, and he would be able to obtain an Imperial Scroll. Then, he could possibly be the only person in the world that had simultaneously cultivated two Imperial Scrolls.
In this way, would it still be a problem to surpass the Golden Generation?
“Do you dare to engage in a mortal duel?” he asked. He didn’t reveal Ling Han’s identity.
This was called luring the enemy.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Sure!”
If you are so determined to seek death, then I will oblige you.
When they heard that the two of them were going to have a mortal duel, the spectators were in an uproar.
They actually wanted to have a mortal duel?
Hiss, then it was destined that one of the two of them would die. This was exciting.
“Haha, he actually dares to have a mortal duel with Han Di. He’s really tired of living,” Mi Qingdie said coldly.
Meanwhile, Wan Yulong showed a hint of deep thought, “No one is an idiot, especially this kind of elite. Thus, this Huang Tian must have something to rely on.”
“You’re not saying that he can compare to the Imperial Son, or even the Silver Generation, right?” Mi Qingdie retorted. It couldn’t be helped. She was already completely captivated by Han Di.
Gongyang Bo said calmly, “More than eight years ago, didn’t an Imperial Son also die here?”
When these words fell, the surroundings instantly fell silent.

“Humph, how could Lin Yun compare to Han Di!” Very soon, Mi Qingdie spoke again, “Han Di is at the Seventh Form of True Self Tier. At that time, didn’t Ling Han forfeit the battle repeatedly because he was afraid, and even escaped from the City of Death?”

chapters.title: Chapter 4295: Eighth Form!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
When they said this, Wan Yulong and the others all nodded.
That’s right. Han Di was not Lin Yun. He was much, much stronger.
This was the Seventh Form of the True Self Tier, breaking the limit of three times. Ordinary people wouldn’t even dare to imagine it. How could such a being possibly lose?
“Then, it can only be said that this Huang Tian’s brain has been damaged.”
“He’s far too arrogant! Does he think that he can rival Han Di, just by being able to oppose a single strike?”

These five top-notch second-generation young masters reached a consensus, and thought that Ling Han was completely overestimating his own abilities, and did not really have the strength to stand against Han Di.
The Dark Battlefield soon approved Ling Han and Han Di’s request to change the normal tournament stage battle to a mortal duel.
In this way, only one of them would be able to leave alive.
A cold smile appeared on Han Di’s face, and he said, “You’re truly stupid!”
“Hehe.” Ling Han ignored him.
Han Di had no interest in speaking any further. He charged out, wanting to kill Ling Han and snatch the Imperial Scroll.

Boom, the power of the seventh form was released to his heart’s content. He had been here for so many years, so he must have reached the end of the seventh form long ago. Endless power surged out, terrifying beyond description.
Ling Han brandished his fists, and delivered a punch at Han Di.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and both of their figures swayed, retreating backwards.
“Yi?” A hint of surprise appeared on Han Di’s face. This was really beyond his expectations. Ling Han’s strength was actually capable of matching him?
However, he immediately became arrogant again. So what?
He communicated through divine sense, “I never thought that after you disappeared for a few years, your cultivation level would actually have such great improvement!”
In any case, the mortal duel had already begun, so he was not afraid that Ling Han would go back on his word.
Ling Han smiled faintly. Han Di should have guessed his identity by now.
“There are a lot of things that you can’t imagine.”
Han Di charged over again, his hands like axes. Boom, as he delivered palm strikes, energy interwove with Regulations, turning into multiple Divine Axes that slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han clenched his hands into fists, and attacked repeatedly. Peng, peng, peng, every single Divine Axe was shattered by him.
The two of them used their respective Mystical Powers, and for a short period of time, it was hard to decide the victor. Their battle was incredibly intense.
Everyone was transfixed with shock. They hadn’t imagined that Ling Han would be so powerful. He was genuinely able to exchange blows with Han Di.
“Hiss, who exactly is this Huang Tian?” In the private room, Wan Yulong and the others were also very stunned.

They had all broken through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier a few years ago, and with their superior cultivation level, they could naturally see clearly that Han Di had definitely unleashed all his battle prowess at the peak stage of the seventh form.
In other words, this “Huang Tian” should also be at the peak stage of Seventh Form.
Heavens!
At this moment, they no longer had any confidence that Han Di would win.
Fight, fight, fight. Ling Han and Han Di exchanged blows, incredibly intense.

However, this kind of intensity was only relative to Han Di and the spectators. Ling Han’s cultivation level had long since surpassed the Seventh Form, and he had not used his full strength at all. He only wanted to see the ultimate technique of the Han Clan.
“I really can’t underestimate you,” Han Di said coldly. Suddenly, he sent out a palm strike. Boom, the might actually increased inconceivably by a whole lot.
Peng! With a single strike, Ling Han was instantly sent backwards.
“You didn’t expect this, did you?” A hint of pride appeared on Han Di’s face, and he slowly withdrew his palm, “I am not the Seventh Form, but rather... the Eighth Form of the True Self Tier!”
Hearing these words, the whole grandstand fell silent.
What? Han Di had actually broken through? Not the Seventh Form, but the Eighth Form!
Heavens, heavens, this was the Imperial Son, and this was the Silver Generation?
The Eighth Form of the True Self Tier was the true limit.
“Haha!” Mi Qingdie jumped up in excitement. “This is my Han Di!”

Wan Yulong and the others didn’t refute the question of whether Han Di was hers or not. They were still in a state of shock. Han Di had actually broken through to the Eighth Form. This was really too shocking.

“The present me is no longer inferior to the Golden Generation,” Han Di declared proudly. Every day, he would fight bloody battles here, and in fact, he would frequently enter into the forest to battle those terrifying Demonic Beasts, which finally allowed him to take the step that would lead him to the ultimate path of heaven.
“However, being able to force me to use the power of the Eighth Form, you should be proud of yourself.”
Ling Han was astonished. This person had actually broken through to the Eighth Form?
As expected, the Imperial Son could not be underestimated.
“Hehe, congratulations.” He smiled faintly.
Yi, why would he have such a reaction?

Han Di was slightly confused. He was the Eighth Form, and even the Golden Generation was nothing more than this. It could be claimed to be the strongest level of the True Self Tier. The Ninth Form only existed in legends, like a fantasy story.
But why was Ling Han still so unconcerned?
Whatever, he would kill him, search his soul, and snatch the Imperial Scroll.
Han Di quickly pushed his confusion aside. He didn’t need to know the answer. He only needed to believe in his own strength.
Xiu, he charged out again, and the power of the eighth form completely burst forth.
“Die!” He stimulated this terrifying attack, which surged majestically towards Ling Han.
Ling Han had absolutely no intention of dodging, and responded with a punch of his own.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and an inconceivable scene appeared. Han Di was actually sent flying.
Everyone wanted nothing more than to rub their eyes. They must have seen wrongly; how could it be like this?
Han Di’s figure landed on the ground. He turned around and steadied his footing, his face filled with shock and confusion.
How was this possible?
Ling Han’s power was actually superior to his?
“How is it possible that you have also cultivated to the Eighth Form!” Han Di shouted loudly. He could not believe it, nor did he want to believe it.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “You can cultivate to the eighth form, so why can’t I?”
How could you compare to me?
He was the Imperial Son, a Silver Generation elite who was doted on by the heavens. From birth, he was practically standing at the finishing line. Who could outrun him?
He glared hatefully at Ling Han, and the projection of the giant fish behind him gradually solidified, its size unknown.
“Swallowing Heaven Technique!” he shouted loudly. The giant fish also wagged its tail, and swam towards Ling Han. It opened its mouth, instantly creating a boundless suction force.
Ling Han’s mind trembled slightly, as if his soul was about to be extracted.
Yi?

This was an attack aimed at the soul. If his body and soul were separated, the physical body without the control of the soul would be an empty shell, and without the protection of the physical body, the soul would naturally be extremely fragile.
Ling Han humphed, and the nine True Selves in his mind all lit up, stabilizing his soul.

Han Di frowned. This was a Mystical Power that he had awakened by nature. Even the Golden Generation would suffer a little if they were caught off guard. He had not thought that he would not be able to get the slightest advantage over Ling Han.
He roared loudly, and that giant fish actually sprouted a pair of wings.
A Roc!
The Roc spread its wings, and once again opened its mouth to swallow Ling Han. The effect of extracting the soul instantly increased to tons.
But so what? With nine True Selves standing guard, his mind was completely calm.
One had to realize that Ling Han wasn’t at the Eighth Form. Instead, he was at the Ninth Form.
“Do you have any more moves?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

When they said this, Wan Yulong and the others all nodded.
That’s right.
Han Di was not Lin Yun.
He was much, much stronger.
This was the Seventh Form of the True Self Tier, breaking the limit of three times.
Ordinary people wouldn’t even dare to imagine it.
How could such a being possibly lose?
“Then, it can only be said that this Huang Tian’s brain has been damaged.”
“He’s far too arrogant!
Does he think that he can rival Han Di, just by being able to oppose a single strike?”

These five top-notch second-generation young masters reached a consensus, and thought that Ling Han was completely overestimating his own abilities, and did not really have the strength to stand against Han Di.
The Dark Battlefield soon approved Ling Han and Han Di’s request to change the normal tournament stage battle to a mortal duel.
In this way, only one of them would be able to leave alive.
A cold smile appeared on Han Di’s face, and he said, “You’re truly stupid!”
“Hehe.” Ling Han ignored him.
Han Di had no interest in speaking any further.
He charged out, wanting to kill Ling Han and snatch the Imperial Scroll.
Boom, the power of the seventh form was released to his heart’s content.
He had been here for so many years, so he must have reached the end of the seventh form long ago.
Endless power surged out, terrifying beyond description.
Ling Han brandished his fists, and delivered a punch at Han Di.
Peng!

“Yi?” A hint of surprise appeared on Han Di’s face.
This was really beyond his expectations.
Ling Han’s strength was actually capable of matching him?
However, he immediately became arrogant again.
So what?
He communicated through divine sense, “I never thought that after you disappeared for a few years, your cultivation level would actually have such great improvement!”
In any case, the mortal duel had already begun, so he was not afraid that Ling Han would go back on his word.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
Han Di should have guessed his identity by now.
“There are a lot of things that you can’t imagine.”
Han Di charged over again, his hands like axes.
Boom, as he delivered palm strikes, energy interwove with Regulations, turning into multiple Divine Axes that slashed towards Ling Han.
Ling Han clenched his hands into fists, and attacked repeatedly.
Peng, peng, peng, every single Divine Axe was shattered by him.
The two of them used their respective Mystical Powers, and for a short period of time, it was hard to decide the victor.
Their battle was incredibly intense.
Everyone was transfixed with shock.

He was genuinely able to exchange blows with Han Di.
“Hiss, who exactly is this Huang Tian?” In the private room, Wan Yulong and the others were also very stunned.

They had all broken through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier a few years ago, and with their superior cultivation level, they could naturally see clearly that Han Di had definitely unleashed all his battle prowess at the peak stage of the seventh form.
In other words, this “Huang Tian” should also be at the peak stage of Seventh Form.
Heavens!
At this moment, they no longer had any confidence that Han Di would win.
Fight, fight, fight.
Ling Han and Han Di exchanged blows, incredibly intense.
However, this kind of intensity was only relative to Han Di and the spectators.
Ling Han’s cultivation level had long since surpassed the Seventh Form, and he had not used his full strength at all.
He only wanted to see the ultimate technique of the Han Clan.
“I really can’t underestimate you,” Han Di said coldly.
Suddenly, he sent out a palm strike.
Boom, the might actually increased inconceivably by a whole lot.
Peng!
With a single strike, Ling Han was instantly sent backwards.
“You didn’t expect this, did you?” A hint of pride appeared on Han Di’s face, and he slowly withdrew his palm, “I am not the Seventh Form, but rather... the Eighth Form of the True Self Tier!”
Hearing these words, the whole grandstand fell silent.
What?
Han Di had actually broken through?
Not the Seventh Form, but the Eighth Form!
Heavens, heavens, this was the Imperial Son, and this was the Silver Generation?
The Eighth Form of the True Self Tier was the true limit.
“Haha!” Mi Qingdie jumped up in excitement.
“This is my Han Di!”
Wan Yulong and the others didn’t refute the question of whether Han Di was hers or not.
They were still in a state of shock.
Han Di had actually broken through to the Eighth Form.
This was really too shocking.
“The present me is no longer inferior to the Golden Generation,” Han Di declared proudly.

Every day, he would fight bloody battles here, and in fact, he would frequently enter into the forest to battle those terrifying Demonic Beasts, which finally allowed him to take the step that would lead him to the ultimate path of heaven.
“However, being able to force me to use the power of the Eighth Form, you should be proud of yourself.”
Ling Han was astonished.
This person had actually broken through to the Eighth Form?
As expected, the Imperial Son could not be underestimated.
“Hehe, congratulations.” He smiled faintly.
Yi, why would he have such a reaction?
Han Di was slightly confused.
He was the Eighth Form, and even the Golden Generation was nothing more than this.
It could be claimed to be the strongest level of the True Self Tier.
The Ninth Form only existed in legends, like a fantasy story.
But why was Ling Han still so unconcerned?
Whatever, he would kill him, search his soul, and snatch the Imperial Scroll.
Han Di quickly pushed his confusion aside.
He didn’t need to know the answer.
He only needed to believe in his own strength.
Xiu, he charged out again, and the power of the eighth form completely burst forth.
“Die!” He stimulated this terrifying attack, which surged majestically towards Ling Han.
Ling Han had absolutely no intention of dodging, and responded with a punch of his own.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and an inconceivable scene appeared.
Han Di was actually sent flying.
Everyone wanted nothing more than to rub their eyes.
They must have seen wrongly; how could it be like this?
Han Di’s figure landed on the ground.
He turned around and steadied his footing, his face filled with shock and confusion.
How was this possible?
Ling Han’s power was actually superior to his?
“How is it possible that you have also cultivated to the Eighth Form!” Han Di shouted loudly.
He could not believe it, nor did he want to believe it.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “You can cultivate to the eighth form, so why can’t I?”
How could you compare to me?
He was the Imperial Son, a Silver Generation elite who was doted on by the heavens.
From birth, he was practically standing at the finishing line.
Who could outrun him?
He glared hatefully at Ling Han, and the projection of the giant fish behind him gradually solidified, its size unknown.
“Swallowing Heaven Technique!” he shouted loudly.
The giant fish also wagged its tail, and swam towards Ling Han.
It opened its mouth, instantly creating a boundless suction force.
Ling Han’s mind trembled slightly, as if his soul was about to be extracted.

Instead, he was at the Ninth Form.
