chapters.title: Chapter 4296: Pseudo Ninth Form versus True Ninth Form
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Han Di didn’t dare to believe this, and shock was written all over his face.
His original name was not Han Di, and the word “Di” represented a special meaning. Who would dare to randomly take this name?
This was a name that he had changed for himself after displaying his powerful natural talent in cultivation. It contained his great ambition, and his hopes of becoming Emperor one day.

His natural talent was only a tiny bit inferior to the Golden Generation, and now, with his own efforts, he had advanced into the Eighth Form. It could be said that aside from the fact that his cultivation level was still slightly inferior, he was really not inferior to the Golden Generation.
But now? There was actually someone that could surpass him in a battle of equal cultivation levels.
Hiss!
Han Di’s pride had been shattered into pieces. In this instant, he became very confused.
How was this possible? Absolutely impossible!

“Die!” Han Di roared loudly. He charged out again. The projection of the Roc surged, swallowing heaven and earth, and he himself also pounced. The Regulations burned, turning into world-destroying flames that were boundlessly terrifying.
Yet Ling Han was indifferent. As an elite that was very possibly the only Ninth Form in this world, what need was there for him to be concerned?

In the past, it had only ever been him that had won with a disadvantage in cultivation level. Now, his cultivation level was superior to Han Di, so no matter how stunningly talented you were, so what if you put your life on the line? It was completely ineffective.
However, Ling Han was quite interested in this projection of the Roc. It was actually capable of shaking the soul. This was probably a soul-level celestial technique.

This had the same effect as the barrage of murderous aura. It was a pity that the Imperial Son had a rare treasure on him, which could block negative effects. Otherwise, Ling Han could compete with the Imperial Son in terms of whose spiritual attack was more kickass.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Han Di tried his best, but so what? Even in a battle of equal cultivation levels, his strength was still much inferior to Ling Han, what more when there was still a gap of a minor level between them.
In just a few moves, he was suppressed, and had fallen into an absolute disadvantage.
What could he do?
Han Di gritted his teeth internally. He knew the rules of the Dark Battlefield. Once the mortal duel was activated, there was no way it would stop. One person had to die in battle.
Lin Yun was a precedent. So what if he was the Imperial Son? They didn’t give him any face at all.
Thus, he could only depend on himself.
Was he going to fight to the death?

Han Di was a little reluctant. He had cultivated to the eighth form with great difficulty. Only when he had truly reached this kind of height would one know how difficult it was. If he had to start again, he was not at all sure that he could succeed again.
However, if he didn’t put his life on the line, his only fate would be death.
He was going to give it his all.

Han Di roared. Boom! A devastating aura burst from his body, and his power surprisingly increased again. His power surged like boiling water, and the spectators all felt a suffocating feeling in their chests. Their faces became as white as a sheet, and their expressions were as ugly as could be.

“This is... Spirit Transformation Tier-level power!” In the private room, Wan Yulong and the others all exclaimed in shock. They were Spirit Transformation Tier elites, so they only had to sense it for them to understand.

But how could this be possible? Though Han Di had reached the Eighth Form, and completely crushed them in the past, and once he advanced into Spirit Transformation Tier, he would also be able to insta-kill them into dust.
However, as long as he didn’t reach the Spirit Transformation Tier, he would only be a True Self Tier in the end. He couldn’t compare to Spirit Transformation Tier.
“Could it be that it is... the ninth form!” Gongyang Bo said, his voice trembling slightly.
He was really envious, jealous, and hateful. The ninth form, the cultivation level that only existed in legends!

Mi Qingdie had initially been extremely worried, but now, she was elated. A proud expression appeared on her face, “Han Di is indeed worthy of being the Silver Generation. Next, he will show his might and kill that Huang Tian or whatever!”

Sha Tianlei had been silent all this while, and only then did he speak, “Heavenly Emperor should not have reached the ninth form, but rather used the combustion of his Imperial Blood to forcibly shatter a True Self, and only then did he manage to temporarily rush up to the ninth form.”

“The price for this is very heavy. Afterwards, his cultivation level will fall back to the Seventh Form. If he wants to recreate a True Self, this is not re-cultivating his own cultivation level, but going through all his previous cultivation levels.”
Yi, was that the case?
However, everyone knew that Sha Tianlei was the most knowledgeable. Since he had said so, it was probably true.
Moreover, this was the only logical explanation.

Mi Qingdie’s pride instantly crumbled. However, after only a short while, she immediately continued, “Even if Han Di falls back to the seventh form, he would still be the top prodigy in the world. Practically no one can compare to him!”

“Furthermore, since he has been able to cultivate to the Eighth Form, and this time, he has also temporarily touched the Ninth Form. Who knows, he may be able to rebuild after destruction. In future, he would really be able to cultivate to the Ninth Form!”
Was this possible?
Destruction followed by construction. This sounded very inspirational, but most people would be directly crippled after destruction, and there would be no possibility of rebuilding.
“However, this time, it should be a sure victory for Han Di,” Zuwa An said with a smile. He had an indescribable hatred for Ling Han.
“En.” On this point, the five second-generation young masters all had the same understanding, and nodded in unison.
The ninth form... could only exist in legends.
Boom! Meanwhile, Han Di unleashed a devastating power that blasted toward Ling Han. The Regulations transformed into countless divine weapons that blotted out heaven and earth.
Ling Han was astonished. “How resolute. You could bear to self-destruct even a True Self.”

“Die!” Han Di’s expression was twisted. Even though he now had battle prowess that had advanced into the ninth form, for the sake of this moment of might, he had paid a heavy price. In future, it would be a big problem whether he would be able to charge up to the eighth form again.
Thus, even if he obtained the Imperial Scroll from Ling Han, it may not be able to compensate for his losses.
This time, it was really a great loss.
Precisely because of this, he was even more eager to kill Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head before throwing another punch. A heavenly saber materialized in the air and slashed down at Han Di.
“Break!” Han Di naturally would not cower. He presently had battle prowess of the ninth form, so who in this world could stop him?
However, he immediately looked stunned — the number of times he was shocked today was probably comparable to the total number of times he had been shocked in his whole life before today.
Boom, under the strike of the heavenly saber, whatever Regulations, whatever mass of energy, they were all shattered, and were completely unqualified to resist!
W-what!

Han Di didn’t dare to believe this. He was at the ninth form now, and his battle prowess had actually broken through the barrier of the Spirit Transformation Tier and reached a completely new height. However, faced with Ling Han’s heavenly saber, his attack was actually destroyed?
How was this possible!
“Ah!” Han Di screamed in agony. He was sent backwards by the heavenly saber, and instantly, blood burst forth from his body.
Thankfully, he also had the battle prowess of the ninth form. Otherwise, he would definitely have been killed by this heavenly saber.
“That’s strange, isn’t it?” Ling Han said with a faint smile. “You only relied on self-destructing your True Self to temporarily rush up to the ninth form, but I... am the true ninth form!”
‘F*ck! F*ck! F*ck!’

Han Di felt as if the sky had collapsed. He had advanced to the Eighth Form with great difficulty, and thought that he could look down on the rest of the world, catching up to the Golden Generation, and truly possess the qualifications to attempt breaking through to the imperial throne from now onwards.
But now?
A monster had appeared, and he had actually reached the ninth form.
Heavens, was this possible? How could there be such a freak?
“Alright, you can go on your way now!” Ling Han said balefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 4297: If I say it ends, only then is it the end
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han moved, his might soaring to the heavens.

He was not as simple as the ninth form, but rather the peak stage of the ninth form. The strength of his battle prowess was something that even Han Di could only look up to. The gap was not just a little bit.
Boom!
Under his frenzied barrage of attacks, Han Di couldn’t block them at all. He vomited blood repeatedly, and he was constantly on the verge of death.

However, Han Di could also be considered the ninth form at present, and he was a Silver Generation elite at that. His natural talent was indeed outstanding, and that was why he could just barely hold on.
However, this was only struggling at death’s door, and could not last for very long.
“Stop!” Right at this moment, a soft rebuke was heard. Mi Qingdie directly broke out of the window of the private room, and landed on the battlefield, as she shouted coldly at Ling Han.
“Hehe, this is a mortal duel!” Ling Han’s killing intent was baleful and menacing.
“So what!” Mi Qingdie said proudly, “If I tell you to stop, you have to stop!”
This was against the rules, but so what? She was the Crimson Moon Venerate’s most beloved granddaughter, so she could be so arrogant.

Han Di’s heart calmed slightly. Though he was also very sullen, to actually have a woman come to save him, he did not care too much about his pride at this moment. After all, life was the most beautiful thing in this world.
As long as he was alive, he could get his pride back.
Mi Qingdie pointed at Ling Han, and said coldly, “Now, get lost!”
Boos rang out.
Though the City of Death had never had any rules, in truth, it was not that there was no order.
For example, in the Dark Battlefield, one person had to die in a mortal duel. No one could be exempted, and it was the same for Imperial Son Lin Yun.
Because this was a tradition that had been passed down since ancient times. It had been like this for generations, and no one could break it.
But now?
Mi Qingdie publicly trampled on this ancient tradition, which naturally incited public indignation.

“Shh, shh, shh. If anyone dares to make the slightest noise, I’ll kill him!” Mi Qingdie was extremely domineering. She herself was a Spirit Transformation Tier elite, and added with her grandfather who was a Venerate Tier, this intimidation was naturally very strong.
Instantly, the whole area fell silent.
“Hehe.” Ling Han’s cold laugh suddenly rang out, “The mortal duel is not over yet. One person must die!”
“Alright, then I’ll kill you!” Mi Qingdie said. Her seductive eyes were fixed on Ling Han, her killing intent blazing.
“Humph!” Ling Han charged over.
“You don’t know what’s good for you!” Mi Qingdie countered, blasting towards Ling Han.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, instantly triggering a massive explosion of energy. The boiling energy spread out in all directions, indescribably terrifying.
At this moment, a figure flew out of the ball of energy.
That was... Mi Qingdie!
Pu!
Seeing this scene, everyone spluttered.
What, Ling Han was actually strong to this extent? Even a Spirit Transformation Tier was no match?
Xiu, Ling Han also charged out, his black locks soaring into the skies, exploding with fury.
In the outside world, he had had enough of oppression. Weren’t those Imperial Clans all unreasonable and forceful because they had many elites?
And now, in this place, he actually still suffered such injustice?
‘F*ck! I’m definitely going to kill Han Di today!’
Ling Han brandished his fists, and the Destructive Energy had already been activated. He charged towards Han Di.

“You dare?!” Mi Qingdie was both shocked and furious. She had never imagined that Ling Han’s strength would actually reach such a terrifying extent. Even she was no match for him—was he really a True Self Tier cultivator?
The ninth form... was that so terrifying?

This was natural. Originally, the fourth form was enough to break through to the Spirit Transformation Tier, but Ling Han actually cultivated another five minor levels. Added together, this naturally far surpassed the gap of a major tier.
Even if Mi Qingdie had broken through in the sixth form, she was still no match for Ling Han. It was just that the gap between them was very small.
She hurriedly charged back. Naturally, she could not just sit by and watch as her beloved was killed by Ling Han.
As she battled, she called out, “Guards, quickly apprehend this mad man.”
However, no one responded.

—You are the granddaughter of Crimson Moon Venerate. Indeed, you are awesome. Even if you interfered in a mortal duel, no one would dare stop you. However, you still want others to help you? Hehe, that is also impossible.
As long as Ling Han didn’t have killing intent towards Mi Qingdie, no one would interfere. This was everyone’s bottom line.
Ling Han’s expression was cold, and he sent Mi Qingdie flying with a kick. His eyes were set on Han Di.
Destructive Energy surged. This destructive power was too great, and no defense could block it, causing Han Di to cry out in pain, the injuries on his body becoming heavier and heavier.

“You dare! You dare!” Mi Qingdie’s eyes were red. She really admired this Imperial Son who had outstanding natural talent, and now, she was watching as her beloved was severely injured in front of her, and was even close to being killed. This caused a knife to twist in her heart.
Ling Han ignored her completely, and merely continued to target Han Di.

Han Di was already resisting with all his might, but there was nothing he could do. His strength was much weaker than Ling Han, and added with the fact that his injuries were getting more and more serious, his ability to resist was also becoming weaker and weaker.
He really couldn’t take it anymore.
“No!” he roared in fury, extremely defiant.

He was the Silver Generation, and furthermore, he had reached the Eighth Form, catching up to the Golden Generation and becoming a powerful participant in contest for the Imperial Path. However, the long journey had not even begun, and he was actually about to die?
How could he possibly accept this?

But so what? Even if he had Mi Qingdie’s help, it was useless. He was thrashed harshly by Ling Han, and finally, Ling Han’s fist landed on his head. Destructive Energy invaded, and his mind was instantly shattered.

One after another, the True Sellves dimmed and crumbled. Han Di stared blankly at Ling Han, his eyes still filled with hatred and defiance, but they became more and more lifeless. Finally, his head drooped and he collapsed.
Die.
“You, you, you!” Mi Qingdie pointed at Ling Han, her pretty face livid. She wanted nothing more than to swallow Ling Han whole and skin him alive.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “If I say it’s over, only then is it over.”
After saying this, he turned around and left.
How domineering!
So what if you are Mi Qingdie? So what if you interfere in the mortal duel? It cannot end unless I tell it to end.
Mi Qingdie was so furious that her chest rose and fell rapidly. Pointing at Ling Han’s back, she said, “I swear, I will not die until I kill you!”
Ling Han’s eyes turned cold, and he clenched his fists, killing intent blazing.
This woman was seeking her own death!

However, he couldn’t make a move here. There was definitely a Spirit Transformation True Lord or even Sect Master here. At the moment, he could only match the First Change of the Spirit Transformation Tier. At most, he would only be able to rival a Second Change of the Spirit Transformation Tier. If he encountered a Third Change or Fourth Change of the Spirit Transformation Tier, he would definitely be done for, what more a Sect Master.
Hence, if he made a move now, he would not be able to kill Mi Qingdie, but would instead draw a fatal calamity onto himself.
Ling Han smiled calmly, and strode off.

Mi Qingdie’s eyes were almost spitting fire. She really wanted to pounce on Ling Han and kill him—if she had that kind of strength. Unfortunately, this was too against the rules. Moreover, she couldn’t command Sect Masters.
‘I will definitely kill you! Definitely!’ she swore in her heart.
At this moment, everyone finally recovered from their shock.
What!

Ling Han had actually killed Han Di even with the intervention of a Spirit Transformation Tier. It should be known that Han Di’s strength had also been at the ninth form at that time, so his strength could be said to be boundless.
Terrifying, too terrifying.

Boom!

He vomited blood repeatedly, and he was constantly on the verge of death.

This was against the rules, but so what?

Boos rang out.

Because this was a tradition that had been passed down since ancient times.

But now?
Mi Qingdie publicly trampled on this ancient tradition, which naturally incited public indignation.
“Shh, shh, shh.

Mi Qingdie!
Pu!

chapters.title: Chapter 4298: Unprecedented, the Tenth Form of the True Self Tier!
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han left the Dark Battlefield, and endless enlightenment appeared in his mind.

This battle gave him a very great comprehension. Furthermore, killing someone even with the interference of a Spirit Transformation Tier made him feel incredibly carefree, as if a door had been opened to his heart. It was incredibly pleasurable.
And in these few days, he had been experiencing life all this while, savoring the great dao, and had gradually gained appreciation of the tenth form. He was only one step away from it.
And now, after this battle, he had finally touched the boundary.
After Ling Han walked around a corner, he immediately changed his appearance, then found an inn to stay in.
He was going to attempt breaking through to the Tenth Form.
No one knew whether it was possible to break through to the tenth form.
Because the ninth form only existed in legends, then what about the tenth form? It must be like a dream.
Ling Han was calm and unhurried, maintaining a calm heart.

After re-entering the City of Death, he lived a peaceful life, and added with the thrill of the previous battle, the two formed a strong contrast. The fierce collision also formed some kind of power, giving him endless appreciation.
Ling Han immersed himself in his mind. He had already changed his appearance, so he was not afraid of others discovering his identity. He could break through quietly.
Time passed continuously, and half a month later, a smile appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips.
He had finally touched the threshold of breaking through.
The tenth form was feasible.
‘Come!’

In his mind, the True Self of Destruction glowed with nine-colored divine light. Ling Han stimulated the power of millions and millions of living beings in the dimensions, and directly used his trump card, to suppress the repulsive power of the True Self of Destruction.
The Regulations of heaven and earth surged forth, turning into nutrients for the True Self, strengthening the True Self, and pushing the True Self into the Tenth Form.
Hiss, so difficult.
Ling Han immediately sensed that even though he had activated the Power of Dimension, it was still astonishingly repulsive, making it difficult for him to take another step forward.
Thankfully, he steadied his footing, and progressed bit by bit.
The True Self of Destruction was steadily growing, and the nine-coloured light was dimming, though the speed was not very fast.
A whole month had passed, and the True Self of Destruction had completely lost its brilliance, sinking into silence. Wrapped layer by layer by Regulations, it actually formed a cocoon.
Ling Han couldn’t help but be filled with anticipation. What form did this newly born True Self of Destruction take?
Ten coloured?
All of a sudden, another two months had passed, and there were only three months left until the deadline of ten years.
In his mind, the cocoon that the True Self of Destruction had formed suddenly trembled, and a crack appeared on it. Then, more and more cracks appeared, turning into a spider’s web.
It was about to appear.
Ling Han’s spirits were lifted, and he began to examine it even more closely.
Pa, the outer cocoon formed by Regulations instantly shattered, and a new True Self of Destruction appeared.
Yi!
Ling Han was astonished. This was the Tenth Form?
This True Self didn’t have a shred of brilliance, and couldn’t be any more ordinary. He was practically even more mediocre than when he was in the first form.
However, this was indeed the Tenth Form.
The Tenth Form was something that had never existed in legends, so how could it be so ordinary?
No, this was not ordinary, but rather returning to one’s true self.
The True Self of Destruction communicated with heaven and earth, and instantly, the energy of heaven and earth surged over in waves, terrifying without bounds.
Strong, too strong!
Previously, if Ling Han’s battle prowess was only slightly stronger than Mi Qingdie, then now, he could insta-kill her.
The Tenth Form of the True Self Tier was what it meant to really break limits!
Ling Han did some calculations. There was not much time left, and it was impossible that he would be able to calmly cultivate to the end of the tenth form here.

He thought for a moment, and decided to seek out Mi Qingdie for an accounting. Then, he would leave the City of Death, and exit the Dark Clouds Hell. He would return to the ancient stone door of the black hole, and waitfor the Nine Mountains Saint to open the black hole and take him away.
Ling Han returned to his “Huang Tian” appearance, and once again went to the Dark Battlefield.
However, in this period of time, Ling Han had already automatically forfeited the battle three times. He had been stripped of his right to battle, and could only fight again after three years.
Ling Han didn’t mind. He had only come to tell Mi Qingdie that he had appeared again.
It was best if he was disqualified. Ling Han directly cancelled his status as a participant, making it clear that he wanted to leave.
Mi Qingdie’s residence.

“That evil thief has appeared?” Mi Qingdie immediately stood up. She looked at the servant that had come to report, and a cold smile appeared at the corners of her lips, “Quick, go and inform Zuwa An.”
“Yes.”
It wasn’t long before Zuwa An arrived.
“Have you discovered that person?” Zuwa An asked.
“That’s right.” Mi Qingdie nodded, “We have to move quickly. That evil thief has been suspended from battle, and is already planning to leave the city.”
“All right, we will immediately set off in pursuit!” Zuwa An nodded.
“That evil criminal is not weak. Are the people you bring safe?” Mi Qingdie asked.

“After that battle, I’ve already asked someone to analyze it. Huang Tian’s battle prowess has not reached two Heavens of Spirit Transformation Tier, and is only slightly stronger than us. Thus, this time, I brought two elites of the Second Change of the Spirit Transformation Tier with me. Each of them has the battle prowess of four Heavens,” Zuwa An said.

Mi Qingdie nodded, “It’s more or less the same as the results of my analysis. I also brought two Spirit Transformation Tier elites with battle prowess at four Heavens of Spirit Transformation Tier. Four against one is enough to insta-kill that evil thief.”
“Can we set out now?” Zuwa An urged.
“Let’s go.”
The two of them set out. When they arrived outside the manor, another four Spirit Transformation Tier elites joined the team. They were all at the Second Change of Spirit Transformation Tier.
“Oh, that’s right. The reason why I hate that evil criminal to the core is because of Han Di. Why are you doing this?” Mi Qingdie couldn’t help but ask in curiosity.

Zuwa An faltered for a moment. How could he bring himself to say that he had a bad feeling when he saw Ling Han? He couldn’t help but want to worship Ling Han. This kind of feeling was really too terrible.
Thus, he definitely had to kill Ling Han.
“Why do you care so much?” he asked impatiently.
“All right, I won’t meddle in other people’s business. The most important thing now is to get rid of that evil thief!” Mi Qingdie said hatefully.
The six of them set off in pursuit, heading out of the city.

Ling Han was deliberately fishing. He naturally couldn’t walk very fast, so he followed the cold and eerie river. This was the last time he would admire this river whose scenery wasn’t beautiful at all. After killing Mi Qingdie, he would immediately leave.
—If not, would he be waiting to be killed by Crimson Moon Venerate?
Not long after, a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.
“Finally here.”
“Hehe, there are more people than expected.”
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Figures flew through the air. Three in front, three in back, and they intercepted Ling Han from the front and back.
Mi Qingdie stood in front of him, and a cold smile appeared on her face. “Do you really think you can escape after provoking me?”

Ling Han didn’t look at her. Instead, he turned around and looked at Zuwa An who was behind her. He asked in confusion, “Little Lord Wolf, I remember that there’s no animosity between us, right? Are you here to send me off or to hunt me down?”
Zuwa An shook his head, “Is there any need for a dying man to know so much?”
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Is it appropriate to speak to your Master like this?”
“How dare you!” Behind Zuwa An, the two Spirit Transformation True Lords shouted at the same time.
Ling Han completely ignored them. He glared at Zuwa An, and shouted harshly, “Kneel!”
Boom, might spread out.
Zuwa An’s heart trembled, and involuntarily, he knelt down.
F***, what was going on here?
Not only was Zuwa An confused, but even Mi Qingdie and the others found this extremely strange. ‘Are you f*cking sure you’re here to hunt him down?’

chapters.title: Chapter 4299: Extermination
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han also sighed internally. The suppression that this Great Emperor Horn had on the Wolf Tribe was truly astonishing. He had clearly changed his appearance, and even his soul fluctuation, but he was still able to command Zuwa An.
As expected of the handiwork of a Great Emperor.
“Zuwa An have you gone mad!” Mi Qingdie did not know that, and immediately shouted loudly.
Zuwa An didn’t want to kneel either. Didn’t he know that this was very embarrassing? Yet, he couldn’t help but help himself.
“I don’t know what’s going on either?” he said weakly, then shouted, “Kill, kill him!”
This was a great humiliation, to actually kneel down in front of so many people.
Xiu, xiu! The two Spirit Transformation True Lords behind him immediately charged out, attacking Ling Han.
At the same time, Mi Qingdie also commanded her two subordinates to attack Ling Han.
Boom!
Four great Spirit Transformation Tier elites attacked one True Self Tier at the same time, so who wouldn’t be insta-killed?
Ling Han’s heroic spirit soared, and his fists danced, instantly throwing four punches.
Peng, peng, peng, peng! After four strikes, Ling Han’s figure swayed, and the four Spirit Transformation True Lords were not much better. They too swayed.
Hiss, it was actually a tie.
What!

Zuwa An and the others were all numb with shock. This was too inconceivable. Four Spirit Transformation True Lords had joined forces, and all of them were at the Second Change of Spiritual Transformation Tier. Their battle prowess had reached four Heavens, yet they were only able to tie with a True Self Tier?
This was practically a fantasy story!
Meanwhile, Ling Han flicked his hand and said, “Four Spirit Transformation Tier, your battle prowess is really strong enough.”
On the surface, this was a compliment, but in everyone’s ears, it was completely filled with mockery and smugness.
‘Oh, such powerful battle prowess is still unable to suppress you. Aren’t you overwhelmingly powerful?’
But in truth, that was really the case.

This guy was obviously only in the True Self Tier, but his battle prowess had broken through to the Spiritual Transformation Tier. He was still not at a disadvantage even in a battle of one against four, and no matter how proud he was, no one could say anything. They could only exclaim endlessly in amazement and overflow with praise.

Meanwhile, Ling Han was very pleased. This was the battle prowess of the Tenth Form. It had truly broken through the limits. It was possible that there had never been an Ancestral King that had reached this kind of height in history. Then, if he advanced into it, how could his battle prowess not be terrifying?
It would be strange if Ling Han didn’t possess such battle prowess!

“Go, kill him!” Mi Qingdie shouted. She really couldn’t bear to see Ling Han’s arrogance.
The four Spirit Transformation True Lords attacked Ling Han again.
They became serious, and instantly, spiritual bodies walked out of their bodies one after another, instantly turning into a battle of twelve against one.

The number of spiritual bodies a Spirit Transformation Tier formed indicated what Change he had attained. These four Spirit Transformation True Lords were all at the Second Change. In other words, they each formed two spiritual bodies, and each spiritual body possessed almost the same battle prowess as the original.
Thus, once eight spiritual bodies appeared, they were naturally not completely the same.
Ling Han was completely suppressed.

Die, hurry up and die.
“Ignorant!” Mi Qingdie said coldly. By now, Ling Han was definitely going to die.

“Yes!” the four Spirit Transformation True Lords replied.

“Am I wrong?” Mi Qingdie said with a smile. The outcome was already decided.

“Wu!” The four Spirit Transformation True Lords immediately covered their heads with their hands and released muffled groans. Meanwhile, their spiritual bodies continued to tremble as if they were about to collapse.
This was natural. The spiritual body was formed from the soul as the core, which was fused with the Regulations of heaven and earth. Now that the soul was impacted, they naturally looked terrible.

—The strength of Ling Han’s soul had long since reached the level of Spiritual Transformation Tier. However, because of the limitations of his cultivation level, he had not been able to unleash it. This time, the situation had really changed in an instant. Ling Han had clearly been at a disadvantage just now, so how had it turned around?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Wasn’t I right?”
Mi Qingdie glanced at Zuwa An, and immediately broke into a run.
She didn’t want to die!
“Humph!” Ling Han activated the black light of illusion, and Mi Qingdie immediately stopped, an obsessive expression on her face.
In her illusion, Han Di had come back to life, and he had even lived a shameless life with her. Thus, she was naturally captivated by him.
When Zuwa An saw this, he couldn’t help but feel shocked.
Do you have some kind of freaking Demonic Power?
Ling Han looked at him, and said, “Commit suicide.”
“No!” Zuwa An exclaimed in a trembling voice. However, he couldn’t help but raise his right hand and slowly press it down on his forehead.

Ling Han merely wanted to give it a try. Was it his survival instinct that was stronger, or was it this kind of control that was stronger? Facts stunned him. The control of this Great Emperor Horn was really too terrifying.
“I don’t want to die!” Zuwa An was on the verge of tears.
“That’s right. Who wants to die?” Ling Han nodded. He continued to launch murderous aura attacks, leaving the four Spirit Transformation True Lords with no time to attack.

“You’re in big trouble!” the four Spirit Transformation True Lords shouted at the same time. They extracted the Regulations of heaven and earth, and added with the protection of two spiritual bodies, they finally managed to block the barrage of murderous aura, but were no longer able to attack Ling Han.
—He was not an Imperial Son, so he would really be too easy to deal with.
Ling Han smiled, “So what?”
As he said this, he immediately turned around and fled. That was because he could already sense two powerful auras surging out of the City of Death, instantly locking onto him.
The two great Venerate Tier elites, Crimson Moon and Blood Crow!
They already knew that their descendant had died, and were enraged, personally hunting him down.
Thus, if he didn’t flee now, when would he?
“Don’t even think about running!” The four Spirit Transformation True Lords hurriedly chased after him.
Xiu, xiu! Two figures appeared in the sky, instantly catching up to the four Spirit Transformation True Lords. They were the two Venerate Tier elites, Crimson Moon and Blood Crow.
“Trash!” the Blood Crow Venerate said with a cold humph. He didn’t attack at all, yet the heads of the four Spirit Transformation True Lords exploded in unison.

chapters.title: Chapter 4300: Venerate Tiers in pursuit
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The Blood Crow Venerate moved, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Instantly, an indescribable pressure surged madly like a tidal wave. This large hand was like a planet, incredibly huge, grabbing out at Ling Han at an astonishing speed.
Under the envelopment of Regulations, there was no way to hide!
There was no way to flee or dodge this. Unless Ling Han could still cast the Star Steps, his only option would be to surrender.
However, was that really the case?
Ling Han had already taken out the Great Emperor Horn at the first instant, and then blew it.

A soundless and invisible soundwave was released, and Blood Crow Venerate and Crimson Moon Venerate were instantly hit. So what if they were Venerate Tiers? They were still affected, and they both raised their heads and howled at the sky.
In this way, the large hand that had struck out also paused, and then struck back at the skies.
The two Venerate Tier elites were both startled. What was going on here?
Why were they howling like wolves for no reason?

It should be known that they were Venerate Tier elites at the fourth pinnacle level. In this world, only Saints could be stronger than them — not counting Great Emperor, as only one would appear in every era.
And now, for some reason, they were howling like wolves. Had they seen a ghost?

The two Venerate Tier elites exchanged looks. They believed that there was definitely something off about this. Thus, this definitely wasn’t because they suddenly wanted to howl like wolves, but because they had been affected by something.
Could it be that it was this person in front of them?
A mere True Self Tier cultivator?
“Humph!” The Blood Crow Venerate attacked again. As a dignified Venerate, he actually couldn’t take down a True Self Tier with a single strike. This was practically a joke.
Ling Han blew the Great Emperor Horn again, and soundless ripples spread out.
“Ao!” The two Venerate Tier elites were unable to resist, and again howled with their heads held high.
‘Holy f*ck!’
This time, the expressions of the two Venerate Tier elites became serious.
Definitely, definitely. This was definitely Ling Han’s doing.
However, could a mere True Self Tier cultivator truly affect a Venerate Tier cultivator?
“These must be definitely precious treasures!” The Blood Crow Venerate’s eyes involuntarily lit up.
Crimson Moon Venerate looked pleasantly surprised. This treasure could affect them even in the hands of a True Self Tier, then what about in their hands? What kind of power would it release?
Of course, the ability of this precious treasure was really enough to make one speechless. What the heck did it mean by causing others to howl like wolves?
No matter what, they definitely had to obtain this treasure.
The two great Venerate Tier elites moved at the same time, grabbing out at Ling Han.
“Ao!”
“Ao!”
“Ao!”
But every time they moved, Ling Han would blow the bugle horn, so they could only howl helplessly at the sky.
As dignified Venerate Tier elites, they had attacked time and time again, yet they were actually blocked by a True Self Tier?
If this spread out, the two Venerate Tier elites would really be too ashamed to face others, and Ling Han’s reputation would also spread throughout the universe. He was too awesome.
Thankfully, there was no one watching now. As long as Ling Han was killed, the two Venerate Tier elites would definitely not expose each other’s shame, and this matter could be concealed.
Ling Han raced madly all the way, with Venerate Tier elites chasing after him. That would be fatal.
At this time, he no longer had the time to put on any pretences, and revealed his true face.

Fortunately, the two Venerate Tier elites didn’t pay much attention to his true appearance. Otherwise, they would immediately connect the dots. Ling Han’s cultivation level could increase so quickly, so he must have obtained a large number of Source Dao Stones. He must be that thief.
Ling Han fled, and the two Venerate Tier elites chased after him.
“This brat is relying on that horn in his hand,” Crimson Moon Venerate said.
“En, every time he channels it, his spiritual power would decrease by a great amount. He can’t use it too many times,” the Blood Crow Venerate also said.
With their insight, they were naturally able to quickly determine the origins of Ling Han and the Great Emperor Horn.

Ling Han also knew that his Spiritual Power was being expended very quickly. Thankfully, the strength of his soul had long since reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier, and could withstand such extravagance, but if he continued to blow it like this, how long would he be able to last?
However, there was nothing else he could do now, so this was the only thing he could do.

“Yi, Ling Han — f***, f***!” Right at this moment, a person appeared ahead of him. When he saw Ling Han, he was first pleasantly surprised, but he immediately discovered the pursuers behind Ling Han, and his pleasant surprise immediately turned into shock.
It was Ding Shu.
Without another word, he immediately turned around and began to run as well.
Ling Han controlled the range of attack of the Great Emperor Horn slightly, and only aimed it behind him, to avoid affecting Ding Shu as well.
He laughed loudly, “So coincidental?”

“Coincidence my a*s!” Ding Shu directly cursed. Of course, his present mood was understandable, “I have been cultivating hard for more than eight years, and have just advanced into the ninth form, when I eagerly came back for revenge. In the end, you, a bringer of calamity, actually drew out two Venerate Tier elites!”
“Then why are you running?” Ling Han asked.
That’s right, why should he run? The two Venerate Tier elites didn’t know that he was the one who had stolen the storage of Source Dao Stones.
Ding Shu gritted his teeth. This was a sign of guilt.
You see, he had just done a great heist, and in the end, ran out after hiding for a while, and saw the owner coming towards him aggressively. How could he not feel guilty and turn around to run?
That was Venerate Tier, and they would not reason with you.
“Nothing good happens every time I see you!” Ding Shu screamed.
“You’ve really forgotten your debts. You have to remember who took you to empty the Source Dao Stone storage, allowing you to cultivate to the ninth form so quickly?” Ling Han said with a smile.

“Even so, you still expended my precious Forbidden Talisman, all right?” Ding Shu retorted. He naturally did not want to owe Ling Han a favour. His instincts told him that Ling Han’s favour was not so easily owed.
“Oh, that’s right. You’ve screwed me over this time, so you owe me one!” he hurriedly added.
“Hey, hey, hey. It was you who insisted on running out at this time, and I didn’t tell you to run,” Ling Han said with a smile. He naturally didn’t want to owe Ding Shu a favor.

The two of them were the greatest prodigies of this era, and as they ran, they communicated through divine sense. They actually did not delay in the slightest, and at the same time, Ling Han was still blowing the horn of the Great Emperor, causing the two Venerate Tier elites to howl repeatedly.
“Yi, what’s going on with them?” Ding Shu couldn’t help but feel curious. The two of you are Venerate Tier elites, so why are you howling like wolves?
“Maybe something wrong with their brains?” Ling Han said casually.
“How strange.” Ding Shu nodded.
Ling Han and Ding Shu didn’t transmit these words through divine sense, so the two Venerate Tier elites heard them clearly. Naturally, they were fuming with anger.
What was going on with True Self Tier now? They were already so arrogant?
They were furious, and wanted to capture and kill Ling Han and Ding Shu, but under the influence of the Great Emperor Horn, they were still unable to catch up, which made them extremely depressed.
Ling Han had already used up half of his Spiritual Power. He couldn’t help but frown. He couldn’t go on like this.
“Hey, can you do it or not?” Ding Shu also realized that something was off, and said with a frown, “Give it to me, I’ll blow on it for you for a while.”

With his intelligence, he naturally could guess that Ling Han had used the bugle horn in his hand to block the two Venerate Tier elites. He was also the “culprit” behind these two Venerate Tier elites howling like wolves.

Ling Han shook his head. It was not that he was stingy, fearing that Ding Shu would snatch the treasure from him, but rather that he had used the Time Chamber in Galaxy Network in order to grasp the method to blow it. How could Ding Shu possibly learn it in an instant?
If this was handed over to Ding Shu, they would definitely be dead.
What could he do?
Yi?
A figure suddenly appeared in his vision, and instantly, hope rose up in his heart.
